title: Yu and the Xia
summary: According to tradition, Yu tames the great flood and founds Xia, the first dynasty to pass the throne from father to son.
summary_zh: 据传大禹治水有功而建立夏朝，王位从此父死子继，四百多年后亡于商汤。

steps.text: About 2070 BC: according to tradition, Yu wins the people's trust by taming the great flood, dredging channels instead of building dams, and founds Xia with its seat near Yangcheng in the Song hills.
steps.text_zh: 约前2070年，据传禹改堵为疏，治平洪水，赢得各部族拥戴，以阳城（今河南登封一带）为都建立夏朝。

steps.text: About 2065 BC: tradition says Yu gathers the chiefs of the many tribes at Mount Tu on the Huai River, a sign that his authority now reaches far beyond the Yellow River.
steps.text_zh: 约前2065年，据传禹在淮河边的涂山大会诸侯，各部族首领前来朝见，表明夏的号召力已远出黄河流域。

steps.text: About 2060 BC: after Yu's death his son Qi takes the throne. The Youhu clan refuses to accept him, and according to tradition Qi crushes them at Gan in the Wei valley.
steps.text_zh: 约前2060年，禹死后其子启继位，有扈氏不服。据传启在甘地（今陕西户县一带）大败有扈氏，巩固了王位。

steps.text: About 2030 BC: Qi holds a great feast for the lords at Juntai, near today's Yuzhou. Tradition marks this as the start of hereditary rule, the realm as one family's possession.
steps.text_zh: 约前2030年，启在钧台（今河南禹州）大宴诸侯。传统史书把这看作“家天下”的开端：王位从禅让变为世袭。

steps.text: About 1980 BC: King Taikang spends his days hunting, and according to tradition Houyi of the Youqiong clan seizes power. Xia loses its throne for a generation.
steps.text_zh: 约前1980年，据传太康沉迷游猎，不理政事，有穷氏首领后羿乘机夺取政权，史称“太康失国”。

steps.text: About 1950 BC: tradition says Shaokang, a Xia heir who grew up in hiding, gathers loyal followers, defeats the usurpers and restores the Xia dynasty to its throne.
steps.text_zh: 约前1950年，据传在外流亡长大的夏王后裔少康聚集旧部，消灭篡位者，重新夺回王位，史称“少康中兴”。

steps.text: About 1900 BC: at Erlitou on the Luo River rise palace foundations, bronze workshops and the earliest Chinese bronze ritual vessels. Many archaeologists see it as a Xia capital.
steps.text_zh: 约前1900年，洛河边的二里头出现大型宫殿基址、铸铜作坊和中国最早的青铜礼器，许多学者认为这里是夏代晚期都城。

steps.text: About 1650 BC: Jie, the last Xia king, is remembered as a tyrant who wears out his people. The Shang, a rising people to the east, prepare to strike.
steps.text_zh: 约前1650年，夏朝末代君主桀被后世视为暴君，横征暴敛、民怨沸腾，东方的商族首领汤开始积蓄力量。

steps.text: About 1600 BC: according to tradition, Tang of Shang defeats Jie at Mingtiao in southern Shanxi. Jie flees south and dies in exile, and Shang replaces Xia.
steps.text_zh: 约前1600年，据传商汤与夏桀大战于鸣条（今山西运城一带），夏军溃败，桀南逃而死，商朝取代夏朝。

title: The moving Shang capitals
summary: The Shang kings move their capital again and again until Pangeng settles at Yin, where the oracle bones were buried.
summary_zh: 商王多次迁都，直到盘庚迁殷才安定下来，殷墟留下了大量甲骨文。

steps.text: About 1600 BC: after overthrowing Xia, Tang makes Bo his capital. The walled Shang city found at Yanshi, a few kilometres from Erlitou, is often identified as this Western Bo.
steps.text_zh: 约前1600年，商汤灭夏后定都于亳。在离二里头不远的偃师发现的商代城址，常被认为就是汤都“西亳”。

steps.text: About 1500 BC: at Zhengzhou stands a great rammed-earth city with walls nearly seven kilometres round, bronze foundries and large ritual vessels. It was one of the main early Shang centres.
steps.text_zh: 约前1500年，郑州商城城垣周长近七公里，城内有铸铜作坊并出土大型青铜方鼎，是商代前期最重要的中心之一。

steps.text: About 1450 BC: at Panlongcheng near Wuhan, a walled town with Shang-style bronzes shows Shang power reaching the Yangtze, probably to secure copper from the south.
steps.text_zh: 约前1450年，武汉附近的盘龙城出现一座有城墙的商式城邑，说明商的势力已到达长江边，很可能是为了获取南方的铜料。

steps.text: About 1420 BC: King Zhongding moves the capital to Ao. The Records of the Grand Historian say quarrels over the succession then trouble Shang for nine reigns.
steps.text_zh: 约前1420年，商王仲丁迁都于隞。据《史记》记载，此后王位纷争不断，商朝陷入长达九代的混乱。

steps.text: About 1400 BC: King Zuyi moves north to Xing, near today's Xingtai. Floods and power struggles keep the court on the move along the Taihang foothills.
steps.text_zh: 约前1400年，商王祖乙迁都于邢（今河北邢台一带）。水患和王室内争使商都在太行山东麓一迁再迁。

steps.text: About 1350 BC: on the north bank of the Huan River at Anyang rises a huge walled city with palace halls. It was abandoned after a short time, perhaps burned.
steps.text_zh: 约前1350年，安阳洹河北岸兴建了一座规模宏大的城址，内有成组的宫殿基址，但使用不久就被废弃，可能毁于火灾。

steps.text: About 1300 BC: King Pangeng moves the capital to Yin, across the Huan River, over the objections of his nobles. Shang never moves its capital again.
steps.text_zh: 约前1300年，商王盘庚不顾贵族反对，迁都于殷（今河南安阳）。此后直到商朝灭亡，再也没有迁都。

steps.text: About 1250 BC: at Yin, diviners carve the king's questions on turtle shells and ox bones. Found here from 1899 on, these oracle bones are the earliest known Chinese writing.
steps.text_zh: 约前1250年，殷都的贞人把商王的占卜问题刻在龟甲和牛骨上。这些甲骨自1899年起陆续被发现，是已知最早的汉字。

title: Bronze cultures of the Shang world
summary: While the Shang kings cast bronze at Yin, other peoples from the Yangtze to the Sichuan basin built bronze cultures of their own.
summary_zh: 商王在殷都铸造青铜礼器的同时，长江中游、赣江流域和成都平原的人们也发展出各具特色的青铜文化。

steps.text: About 1450 BC: at Panlongcheng on the Yangtze, the bronzes look just like those of the Shang heartland. Shang culture had reached the river, probably following the copper of the south.
steps.text_zh: 约前1450年，长江边的盘龙城出土的青铜器，器形和纹饰几乎与中原商器一样，说明商文化沿着获取南方铜料的道路伸展到了长江。

steps.text: About 1300 BC: at Wucheng on the Gan River a walled town casts its own bronzes and carves signs on pottery. Archaeologists call this the Wucheng culture, a neighbour of the Shang rather than a part of it.
steps.text_zh: 约前1300年，赣江边的吴城有城墙、铸铜作坊，陶器上还刻有符号。考古学家称之为吴城文化，它是与商并存的邻居，而不是商的一部分。

steps.text: About 1250 BC: at Yin, the Shang capital, large foundries cast ritual vessels in piece moulds of clay. No other centre of the time made bronzes in such numbers or for so many kinds of rite.
steps.text_zh: 约前1250年，商都殷的大型铸铜作坊用陶范分块合铸青铜礼器。同时代没有别的地方能铸出如此多的数量和如此多样的器类。

steps.text: About 1200 BC: a great tomb at Dayangzhou in Xingan held nearly 500 bronzes. Their tiger motifs and local shapes show that the Gan valley had its own bronze-casting tradition beside the Shang.
steps.text_zh: 约前1200年，江西新干大洋洲的一座大墓随葬青铜器近五百件，器物上常见虎形装饰，器形也有本地特色，证明赣江流域拥有独立的青铜传统。

steps.text: About 1200 BC: south of Lake Dongting, someone buried a square zun with four rams' heads at its shoulders, found at Ningxiang in 1938. Hunan bronzes of this time mix Shang forms with local animal designs.
steps.text_zh: 约前1200年，洞庭湖以南的宁乡一带埋下了四羊方尊，1938年才被发现。这一时期的湖南青铜器把商式器形和当地的动物造型结合在一起。

steps.text: About 1200 BC: at Sanxingdui in the Sichuan basin, people buried a standing bronze figure over 2.6 metres tall, masks with protruding eyes and bronze trees. Nothing like them was made at Yin.
steps.text_zh: 约前1200年，四川盆地的三星堆人在祭祀坑中埋下高约2.6米的青铜立人像、眼球凸出的纵目面具和青铜神树，这些都是殷都所没有的。

steps.text: About 1100 BC: as Sanxingdui declined, the centre of the Chengdu plain moved to Jinsha, now inside Chengdu. Its gold sun-bird foil and jade show the same beliefs carried on into Zhou times.
steps.text_zh: 约前1100年起，三星堆逐渐衰落，成都平原的中心转移到今成都市内的金沙。金沙出土的太阳神鸟金箔和玉器，说明三星堆的信仰延续到了周代。

title: Wu Ding's revival
summary: King Wu Ding and his consort Fu Hao lead Shang armies against its neighbours and bring the dynasty to its height.
summary_zh: 商王武丁和王妃妇好四出征伐，使商朝国力达到顶峰。

steps.text: About 1250 BC: King Wu Ding, who reigns for 59 years, raises Fu Yue, a labourer building walls, to be his chief minister. The Shang state revives under his rule.
steps.text_zh: 约前1250年，在位五十九年的商王武丁从筑墙的刑徒中提拔傅说为相，整顿朝政，商朝由衰转盛。

steps.text: About 1250 BC: Wu Ding's reign has left more oracle bones than any other. He asks his ancestors about wars, harvests, rain, illness and his wives' childbirths.
steps.text_zh: 约前1250年，武丁时期留下的甲骨卜辞最多。他向祖先询问征战、收成、风雨、疾病和王妃生育等大小事务。

steps.text: About 1230 BC: Wu Ding marches against the Guifang, a strong people beyond the Taihang mountains to the northwest. The Book of Changes says it took three years to subdue them.
steps.text_zh: 约前1230年，武丁讨伐西北边境强大的鬼方。《周易》记载“高宗伐鬼方，三年克之”，可见战事之艰苦。

steps.text: About 1220 BC: Shang armies fight the Qiang in the west. Oracle bones record captured Qiang being used as labour and as human sacrifices at Yin.
steps.text_zh: 约前1220年，商军不断西征羌方。甲骨卜辞记载，被俘的羌人或被役使，或在殷都的祭祀中被用作人牲。

steps.text: About 1200 BC: oracle bones show Fu Hao, Wu Ding's consort, leading armies against the Tufang, the Qiang and the Bafang, once at the head of 13,000 troops, and presiding over sacrifices.
steps.text_zh: 约前1200年，卜辞记载武丁的王妃妇好领兵征伐土方、羌方和巴方，一次伐羌就统率一万三千人，还主持祭祀。

steps.text: About 1200 BC: Fu Hao is buried at Yin. Her tomb, found intact in 1976, held bronze axes bearing her name along with jades, ivory and nearly 2,000 objects.
steps.text_zh: 约前1200年，妇好葬于殷都。她的墓1976年被发现时完好无损，出土刻有其名的青铜钺和玉器、象牙器等近两千件。

steps.text: About 1190 BC: a son of Wu Ding casts the Houmuwu cauldron for his mother. Weighing over 800 kilograms, it is the heaviest bronze vessel known from ancient China.
steps.text_zh: 约前1190年，武丁之子为母亲铸造后母戊鼎，重八百多公斤，是已知中国古代最重的青铜器，显示出商朝的国力。

title: King Wu defeats Shang
summary: From the Wei valley the Zhou grow strong over three generations, then cross the Yellow River and overthrow Shang at Muye.
summary_zh: 周人在渭水流域经营三代，终于渡河东进，在牧野一战灭商。

steps.text: About 1130 BC: pressed by raiders, the Zhou leader Gugong Danfu leads his people from Bin to the Zhou plain below Mount Qi. The Zhou take their name from this land.
steps.text_zh: 约前1130年，周族首领古公亶父为躲避戎狄侵扰，率族人从豳迁到岐山下的周原，周人由此得名并开始壮大。

steps.text: About 1060 BC: King Wen of Zhou meets Lü Shang, known as Jiang Ziya, fishing by the Wei River, and makes him his counsellor and general.
steps.text_zh: 约前1060年，周文王在渭水边遇见垂钓的吕尚（姜子牙），请他辅佐自己，此后吕尚成为周人的军师。

steps.text: About 1056 BC: alarmed by Zhou's growing power, King Zhou of Shang imprisons King Wen at Youli. Zhou officials ransom him with treasure and fine horses.
steps.text_zh: 约前1056年，商纣王忌惮周的势力，把文王囚禁在羑里（今河南汤阴）。周人献上美女、宝马，才换得文王获释。

steps.text: About 1052 BC: Zhou crosses the Taihang mountains and conquers Li, a Shang ally near today's Changzhi. Zhou forces now stand within reach of the Shang heartland.
steps.text_zh: 约前1052年，周军越过太行山，攻灭商的属国黎（今山西长治一带），兵锋直逼商朝腹地，商臣祖伊惊恐报告纣王。

steps.text: About 1050 BC: King Wen moves his capital east to Feng on the Feng River. His son King Wu later builds Hao on the opposite bank, and the twin city becomes the Zhou capital.
steps.text_zh: 约前1050年，文王把都城东迁到沣水西岸的丰；其子武王又在对岸营建镐，丰镐成为西周的都城。

steps.text: About 1048 BC: King Wu leads his army to the Yellow River crossing at Mengjin, and many lords come to join him. Judging the time not yet right, he turns back.
steps.text_zh: 约前1048年，武王率军东进至孟津渡口，据《史记》记载，不约而来会盟的诸侯有八百之多，武王认为时机未到而回师。

steps.text: 1046 BC: Zhou and its allies cross at Mengjin and meet the Shang army at Muye. Many Shang soldiers turn their weapons around, and the Shang army collapses in a single day.
steps.text_zh: 前1046年，武王联合诸侯渡过孟津，在牧野与商军决战。商军前队倒戈，一日之间全线崩溃。

steps.text: 1046 BC: that evening King Zhou flees back to his capital Chaoge, climbs the Deer Terrace and dies in the flames. Shang falls after some five centuries, and Zhou rule begins.
steps.text_zh: 前1046年，兵败的纣王逃回都城朝歌，登上鹿台自焚而死。延续约五百年的商朝灭亡，周朝建立。

title: The Duke of Zhou and the fiefs
summary: The Duke of Zhou crushes a great revolt, builds an eastern capital and spreads Zhou kin across the plain; three centuries later the Western Zhou falls.
summary_zh: 周公平定三监之乱，营建洛邑，分封宗亲；近三百年后，西周在犬戎攻击下灭亡。

steps.text: 1044 BC: King Wu grants lands to kin and allies, Qi to Jiang Ziya and Yan to the Duke of Shao. The Shang heir Wugeng keeps Yin, watched by three of Wu's brothers.
steps.text_zh: 前1044年，武王分封功臣宗亲，封太公望于齐、召公奭于燕；又让纣子武庚治理殷遗民，派管叔、蔡叔、霍叔监视，称“三监”。

steps.text: 1042 BC: King Wu dies and his young son King Cheng takes the throne, with the Duke of Zhou as regent. The three guards suspect the Duke and rise with Wugeng and the eastern peoples.
steps.text_zh: 前1042年，武王去世，成王年幼，周公摄政。管叔、蔡叔猜疑周公，联合武庚和东方夷族起兵叛乱，史称“三监之乱”。

steps.text: 1039 BC: after three years of fighting the Duke of Zhou crushes the revolt and destroys Yan. Its land becomes Lu for his son Boqin; the Shang lands become Wey for his brother Kangshu.
steps.text_zh: 前1039年，周公东征三年，平定叛乱，灭掉奄国。奄地封给周公之子伯禽建立鲁国，殷地封给康叔建立卫国。

steps.text: 1038 BC: to control the east, the Duke of Zhou builds Chengzhou at Luoyi. The He zun bronze of this time calls the area "zhongguo", the central land, the earliest known use of the word.
steps.text_zh: 前1038年，为控制东方，周公在洛水边营建成周（洛邑）。同期的何尊铭文称这里为“中国”，是这个词已知最早的出处。

steps.text: 1036 BC: King Cheng comes of age and the Duke of Zhou hands back power. Tradition credits the Duke with the Zhou rites and music that later Confucians held up as a model.
steps.text_zh: 前1036年，成王长大，周公归还政权。相传周公制礼作乐，确立了一整套礼制，后来被儒家奉为治国的典范。

steps.text: 1033 BC: King Cheng enfeoffs his younger brother Shu Yu at Tang in southern Shanxi. Shu Yu's son renames the state Jin, later the strongest power of the Spring and Autumn period.
steps.text_zh: 前1033年，成王封弟弟叔虞于唐（今山西南部），相传起于“桐叶封弟”的戏言。叔虞之子改国号为晋，后来成为春秋大国。

steps.text: 841 BC: the people of Haojing rise against King Li, who silenced his critics, and drive him into exile. Nobles govern for fourteen years; 841 BC is the first precisely dated year in Chinese history.
steps.text_zh: 前841年，国人不满周厉王“弭谤”专利，发动暴动，厉王出逃。大臣共同执政，称“共和”，这是中国历史有确切纪年的开始。

steps.text: 771 BC: the Marquis of Shen and the Quanrong sack Haojing and kill King You at the foot of Mount Li. The next year the court moves east to Luoyi, ending Western Zhou.
steps.text_zh: 前771年，申侯联合犬戎攻破镐京，周幽王被杀于骊山下。次年平王东迁洛邑，西周结束。

title: The Zhou court moves east
summary: Within a few decades the Zhou king loses his western capital, moves to Luoyi and is shot in the shoulder by a vassal.
summary_zh: 短短几十年间，周王失去了西都镐京，东迁洛邑，最后在战场上被诸侯射伤，王室威信一落千丈。

steps.text: 780 BC: an earthquake shakes the old Zhou homeland and the three rivers dry up. The court astrologer Boyang Fu reads it as a sign that the dynasty is failing.
steps.text_zh: 前780年，周人故土发生大地震，泾、渭、洛三川枯竭。太史伯阳父认为这是阴阳失调的征兆，预言周朝将要灭亡。

steps.text: 779 BC: King You favours his consort Bao Si. He later sets aside Queen Shen and her son Yijiu, who flees to his mother's family in the state of Shen.
steps.text_zh: 前779年，周幽王宠爱褒姒，后来废掉申后和太子宜臼，改立褒姒之子。宜臼逃到外祖父家申国，埋下了祸根。

steps.text: 771 BC: the Marquis of Shen, angry at his grandson's removal, brings the Quanrong against Haojing. The capital is sacked and King You is killed below Mount Li.
steps.text_zh: 前771年，申侯为外孙被废而怨恨，联合缯国和犬戎进攻镐京。都城被攻破，周幽王逃到骊山下被杀，宗周故地从此落入戎人之手。

steps.text: 770 BC: Duke Xiang of Qin escorts the new king and is made a full vassal lord, with the right to the lands west of Qi if he can take them back from the Rong.
steps.text_zh: 前770年，秦襄公率兵护送平王有功，被正式封为诸侯，并获准占有岐山以西被戎人占据的土地，秦国由此立国。

steps.text: 770 BC: King Ping moves the court east to Luoyi, relying on Jin and Zheng for protection. The royal domain shrinks to the Luo valley and the Eastern Zhou begins.
steps.text_zh: 前770年，周平王依靠晋、郑等诸侯的保护，把都城东迁到洛邑。王畿缩小到洛阳一带，周王从此依附诸侯，东周开始。

steps.text: 722 BC: Duke Zhuang of Zheng, also a chief minister at the Zhou court, crushes his younger brother Duan at Yan. Zheng becomes the strongest power in the central plain.
steps.text_zh: 前722年，身兼周王卿士的郑庄公在鄢地打败谋反的弟弟共叔段，稳固了国内。郑国随后成为中原最有实力的诸侯。

steps.text: 720 BC: distrust between King Ping and Duke Zhuang grows so deep that the king and the duke exchange sons as hostages, as if they were equals.
steps.text_zh: 前720年，周平王与郑庄公互不信任，竟然互相交换儿子作为人质。天子与诸侯平起平坐，王室的尊严大打折扣。

steps.text: 707 BC: King Huan leads Chen, Cai and Wey against Zheng and is beaten at Xuge; a Zheng archer hits him in the shoulder. After this no one fears the Zhou king's army.
steps.text_zh: 前707年，周桓王率陈、蔡、卫联军讨伐郑国，在繻葛大败，郑将祝聃一箭射中周王肩膀。从此周天子再也不能号令诸侯。

title: The five hegemons
summary: As the Zhou king's power fades, the strongest lords of Qi, Jin, Qin and Chu take turns leading the states.
summary_zh: 周王室衰微，齐、晋、秦、楚等大国国君先后称霸，号令诸侯。

steps.text: 685 BC: Duke Huan of Qi makes Guan Zhong, who once shot an arrow at him, his chief minister. Guan Zhong's reforms of farming, salt, iron and the army make Qi rich and strong.
steps.text_zh: 前685年，齐桓公不计射钩之仇，任用管仲为相。管仲改革内政、经营盐铁、整顿军制，齐国很快富强起来。

steps.text: 651 BC: Duke Huan presides over a covenant of the lords at Kuiqiu, and the Zhou king sends him gifts. Under the slogan "honour the king, repel the barbarians", Qi's hegemony peaks.
steps.text_zh: 前651年，齐桓公在葵丘大会诸侯，周天子派使者赐胙。齐桓公以“尊王攘夷”为号召，霸业达到顶峰。

steps.text: 638 BC: Duke Xiang of Song, hoping to succeed Qi, refuses to attack Chu's army while it crosses the Hong River. Song is crushed and the duke dies of his wounds.
steps.text_zh: 前638年，宋襄公想继齐称霸，在泓水坚持等楚军渡河列阵后才出战，结果大败，自己也伤重而死。

steps.text: 636 BC: after nineteen years in exile, Chong'er returns to Jin with Qin's help and becomes Duke Wen. He reforms the government and builds up the army.
steps.text_zh: 前636年，流亡十九年的晋公子重耳在秦国帮助下回国即位，是为晋文公。他整顿内政，扩充军队。

steps.text: 632 BC: at Chengpu, Duke Wen keeps his old promise to the King of Chu and pulls back three days' march, then defeats the Chu army. Chu's advance north is checked.
steps.text_zh: 前632年，晋楚决战城濮。晋文公兑现当年诺言“退避三舍”，随后大败楚军，遏止了楚国北上。

steps.text: 632 BC: at Jiantu, Duke Wen holds a covenant of the lords, and the Zhou king formally names him leader of the lords. Jin's hegemony lasts for generations.
steps.text_zh: 前632年，晋文公在践土会盟诸侯，周襄王亲临并正式册命他为“侯伯”，晋国霸业由此延续百年。

steps.text: 623 BC: blocked from the east by Jin, Duke Mu of Qin turns west and subdues the Rong peoples. Sima Qian says he added twelve states and a thousand li of land.
steps.text_zh: 前623年，东进受晋阻挡的秦穆公转而向西，用由余之谋征服西戎，“益国十二，开地千里”，称霸西戎。

steps.text: 606 BC: King Zhuang of Chu parades his army on the Zhou border and asks the king's envoy how heavy the Nine Cauldrons are. The envoy replies that power rests on virtue, not cauldrons.
steps.text_zh: 前606年，楚庄王陈兵于周郊，向周王使者王孙满询问九鼎的大小轻重。王孙满答以“在德不在鼎”。

steps.text: 597 BC: King Zhuang routs the Jin army at Bi, by the Yellow River. Chu now leads the central states, and King Zhuang is counted among the five hegemons.
steps.text_zh: 前597年，楚庄王在黄河边的邲大败晋军，楚国势力深入中原，楚庄王跻身“春秋五霸”之列。

title: Jin and Chu contend
summary: For almost a century the northern power Jin and the southern power Chu fight over the small states between them, until both agree to a truce.
summary_zh: 近百年间，北方的晋国和南方的楚国反复争夺夹在中间的郑、宋等小国，最后双方在宋国订立弭兵之约。

steps.text: 632 BC: Chu besieges Song; Jin answers by striking Chu's allies Cao and Wey. At Chengpu the Chu commander Ziyu attacks and loses. Chu is kept south of the Yellow River plain.
steps.text_zh: 前632年，楚国围宋，晋国不直接救宋，而是攻打楚的盟国曹、卫。楚将子玉求战心切，在城濮被晋军击败，楚国北进受阻。

steps.text: 597 BC: Chu besieges Zheng for three months and Zheng submits. The Jin relief army arrives too late; its generals quarrel, and at Bi it is routed and scrambles to cross the Yellow River.
steps.text_zh: 前597年，楚国围郑三个月，郑国投降。晋国援军来迟，将帅意见不合，在邲被楚军击败，士兵争相渡黄河逃命。

steps.text: 594 BC: Chu besieges Song for nine months until the city runs out of food. Jin does not dare to send help, and Song makes peace with Chu.
steps.text_zh: 前594年，楚国围宋长达九个月，城中粮尽，到了交换孩子来吃的地步。晋国不敢出兵相救，宋国只得与楚讲和。

steps.text: 584 BC: Wuchen, a Chu noble who fled to Jin, is sent to Wu to teach chariot warfare. Jin now has an ally on Chu's eastern flank, and Wu begins to raid Chu.
steps.text_zh: 前584年，从楚国投奔晋国的巫臣出使吴国，教吴人乘车作战。晋国从此在楚国东面有了盟友，吴国开始不断侵扰楚国。

steps.text: 575 BC: Jin and Chu meet again at Yanling over Zheng. Jin wins; King Gong of Chu is hit in the eye by an arrow, and Chu withdraws.
steps.text_zh: 前575年，晋楚两国为争夺郑国在鄢陵再次交战。晋军获胜，楚共王被晋将吕锜射中眼睛，楚军连夜撤退。

steps.text: 573 BC: the young Duke Dao takes the Jin throne at Xintian and restores order. Jin wears Chu down by sending its armies in turns to Zheng, and Zheng finally stays with Jin.
steps.text_zh: 前573年，年轻的晋悼公在新田即位，整顿内政。晋国分批轮番出兵郑国，使楚国疲于奔命，郑国最终归附晋国。

steps.text: 546 BC: at the call of Xiang Xu of Song, Jin, Chu and other states meet at Song and agree that the lesser states will pay respects to both. The great wars between Jin and Chu stop for decades.
steps.text_zh: 前546年，宋国大夫向戌发起，晋、楚等国在宋都会盟，约定小国同时朝见晋、楚两国。此后数十年间，晋楚之间没有再发生大战。

title: Confucius on the road
summary: Leaving office in Lu, Confucius and his disciples spend fourteen years wandering the states in search of a ruler who would use him.
summary_zh: 孔子离开鲁国，带领弟子周游列国十四年，寻找能采纳其主张的君主，最终回到鲁国。

steps.text: 551 BC: Kong Qiu, later called Confucius, is born in the state of Lu near Qufu. His father dies when he is young, and he grows up in modest circumstances.
steps.text_zh: 前551年，孔丘出生于鲁国陬邑（今山东曲阜东南）。他幼年丧父，家境贫寒，却好学不倦。

steps.text: 498 BC: as minister of justice in Lu, Confucius tries to tear down the walled strongholds of the three great clans. The plan half fails, and his position weakens.
steps.text_zh: 前498年，任鲁国大司寇的孔子主张拆毁三桓私邑的城墙，以加强国君权力，结果半途而废，孔子在鲁国处境日难。

steps.text: 497 BC: disappointed with Lu's rulers, Confucius leaves with his disciples for Wey, at Diqiu near today's Puyang. Wey will be his base for much of his travels.
steps.text_zh: 前497年，孔子对鲁国执政失望，带领弟子离开鲁国前往卫国都城帝丘（今河南濮阳）。卫国成为他周游时停留最久的地方。

steps.text: 496 BC: on the way to Chen, Confucius passes Kuang, where locals mistake him for Yang Hu, who had once attacked them. They hold him for five days before letting him go.
steps.text_zh: 前496年，孔子前往陈国途经匡地，匡人误以为他是曾经侵扰过匡的阳虎，将他围困了五天才放行。

steps.text: 492 BC: passing through Song, Confucius teaches rites under a large tree. The Song minister Huan Tui tries to kill him by cutting it down, and the group slips away.
steps.text_zh: 前492年，孔子经过宋国，与弟子在大树下习礼。宋国司马桓魋想杀害他，派人砍倒大树，孔子一行只得离开。

steps.text: 489 BC: between Chen and Cai, officials who fear Confucius going to serve Chu surround his party. Their food runs out for days until Chu troops come to free them.
steps.text_zh: 前489年，陈、蔡两国大夫怕孔子被楚国重用，派人把他围困在陈蔡之间，孔子一行断粮多日，直到楚国派兵来迎才脱困。

steps.text: 484 BC: after fourteen years on the road, Confucius is invited home to Lu. No longer seeking office, he teaches his disciples and edits the old texts.
steps.text_zh: 前484年，在外周游十四年之后，孔子应召回到鲁国。他不再求官，专心教授弟子，整理《诗》《书》等古代文献。

steps.text: 479 BC: Confucius dies in Qufu at the age of 73 and is buried north of the city. His disciples record his sayings, which become the Analects.
steps.text_zh: 前479年，孔子在曲阜去世，享年七十三岁，葬于城北泗水之上。弟子们记录他的言行，编成《论语》。

title: Wu against Yue
summary: Two southern states rise, crush their neighbours and then destroy each other in a long cycle of revenge.
summary_zh: 长江下游的吴、越两国先后崛起，相互复仇，最终越灭吴。

steps.text: 514 BC: King Helü of Wu has Wu Zixu, a refugee from Chu, build a great walled capital at Gusu, today's Suzhou. Wu sets out to become a great power.
steps.text_zh: 前514年，吴王阖闾命从楚国逃来的伍子胥主持修筑都城（今江苏苏州），吴国从此积极图强。

steps.text: 506 BC: with Sun Wu and Wu Zixu, Helü strikes deep into Chu, wins at Boju and takes the Chu capital Ying after five battles. Wu becomes a major power.
steps.text_zh: 前506年，阖闾以孙武、伍子胥为将，深入楚境，在柏举大败楚军，五战五胜，攻入楚都郢，吴国威震诸侯。

steps.text: 496 BC: Helü attacks Yue but is beaten at Zuili by the new king Goujian. Wounded, Helü dies and tells his son Fuchai never to forget who killed him.
steps.text_zh: 前496年，阖闾攻越，在檇李被越王勾践打败，受伤而死。临终嘱咐儿子夫差不要忘记杀父之仇。

steps.text: 494 BC: Fuchai destroys the Yue army at Fujiao on Lake Tai. Goujian is trapped on Mount Kuaiji and survives only by begging Wu for peace.
steps.text_zh: 前494年，夫差在太湖夫椒大败越军。勾践退守会稽山，只得向吴求和，以称臣为条件保全越国。

steps.text: About 490 BC: back home after serving in Wu, Goujian hangs a gall bladder by his seat and tastes it before meals, the origin of the phrase about sleeping on brushwood and tasting gall.
steps.text_zh: 约前490年，勾践从吴国回到越国，在座旁挂上苦胆，饮食前先尝一尝，提醒自己勿忘国耻，后世称“卧薪尝胆”。

steps.text: 486 BC: Fuchai turns north. He digs the Han Canal linking the Yangtze and the Huai, so that Wu's army and supplies can move by boat into the central states.
steps.text_zh: 前486年，夫差决心北上争霸，开凿邗沟，沟通长江与淮河，使吴军可以经水路北进中原。

steps.text: 484 BC: Wu crushes Qi at Ailing. The same year Fuchai forces Wu Zixu, who warned that Yue was the real danger, to kill himself.
steps.text_zh: 前484年，吴军北上，在艾陵大败齐军。同年，屡次劝谏夫差先除越国的伍子胥被赐剑自杀。

steps.text: 482 BC: Fuchai meets the lords at Huangchi and contests leadership with Jin. While his army is far north, Yue attacks and takes the Wu capital.
steps.text_zh: 前482年，夫差在黄池会盟诸侯，与晋国争当盟主。越王勾践趁吴国精兵在外，攻入吴都。

steps.text: 473 BC: after years of siege, Yue takes Gusu and Fuchai kills himself. Goujian moves north and is recognised as the last hegemon of the age.
steps.text_zh: 前473年，越军围困吴都多年后终于破城，夫差自杀，吴国灭亡。勾践随后北上会盟，号称霸主。

title: Jin splits in three
summary: The great noble houses swallow Jin and Qi from within, and Wei, one of Jin's heirs, becomes the first leading power of the Warring States.
summary_zh: 大夫之家从内部吞并了晋国和齐国，由晋分出的魏国成为战国初期的头号强国。

steps.text: 453 BC: Zhi Bo, with Han and Wei, floods the Zhao stronghold of Jinyang. Zhao secretly wins over Han and Wei, the water is turned on Zhi's camp, and the three houses divide his lands.
steps.text_zh: 前453年，智伯联合韩、魏引汾水围灌赵氏据守的晋阳。赵襄子暗中说服韩、魏倒戈，反引水淹智伯军营，三家灭智氏，瓜分其地。

steps.text: 403 BC: King Weilie of Zhou formally makes the heads of Han, Zhao and Wei lords of their own states. Sima Guang begins the Zizhi Tongjian with this year.
steps.text_zh: 前403年，周威烈王正式册命韩虔、赵籍、魏斯为诸侯，承认了三家分晋的事实。司马光的《资治通鉴》就从这一年写起。

steps.text: 386 BC: in Qi, the Tian family, descended from a refugee prince of Chen, had long won people over with generous grain loans. Now Tian He is recognised as lord of Qi.
steps.text_zh: 前386年，齐国的田氏源自逃亡而来的陈国公子完，世代以“大斗出、小斗收”收买人心。这一年田和被周王列为诸侯，田氏代齐。

steps.text: 376 BC: Han, Zhao and Wei depose the last Duke of Jin and share out his remaining towns. Jin, which had led the lords for a century, disappears.
steps.text_zh: 前376年，韩、赵、魏三家废黜晋静公，瓜分晋君仅剩的城邑，静公被废为平民。曾称霸中原百年的晋国就此灭亡。

steps.text: 375 BC: Han conquers Zheng, the state that had led the central plain in the early Spring and Autumn, and moves its capital from Yangdi to Xinzheng.
steps.text_zh: 前375年，韩国灭掉春秋初年曾经称雄的郑国，并把都城从阳翟迁到郑国旧都新郑，从此立足中原腹地。

steps.text: 361 BC: King Hui of Wei moves his capital from Anyi in the west to Daliang on the plain, closer to the rich east but also to the rivalry of Qi.
steps.text_zh: 前361年，魏惠王把都城从西边的安邑迁到东方平原上的大梁，靠近富庶的东方，也更直接地面对齐国的竞争。

steps.text: 354 BC: Wei besieges Handan. Qi, advised by Sun Bin, strikes at Wei instead of going to Zhao, and beats the returning Wei army at Guiling.
steps.text_zh: 前354年，魏军围攻赵都邯郸。齐国采用孙膑之计，不直接救赵，而是进攻魏国，在桂陵截击回援的魏军，史称“围魏救赵”。

steps.text: 344 BC: King Hui gathers the lords at Fengze near Daliang and leads them to pay homage to the Zhou king. It is the high point of Wei; two years later comes defeat at Maling.
steps.text_zh: 前344年，魏惠王在大梁附近的逢泽会合诸侯，率领他们朝见周天子，魏国的声势达到顶点。两年后魏军在马陵惨败，霸业衰落。

title: Reform and survival
summary: In an age of total war, Wei, Chu, Qin and Zhao remake their laws and armies, and Qin's reform goes furthest.
summary_zh: 战国时期，魏、楚、秦、赵等国相继变法，其中秦国的商鞅变法最为彻底。

steps.text: 445 BC: Marquess Wen takes power in Wei and gathers able men such as Li Kui, Wu Qi and Ximen Bao. Wei becomes the first great power of the Warring States.
steps.text_zh: 前445年，魏文侯即位，礼贤下士，任用李悝、吴起、西门豹等人，使魏国成为战国初年的第一强国。

steps.text: 406 BC: Li Kui reforms Wei. Office goes by merit, not birth; farmers are urged to use the land fully; the state buys grain in good years and sells it in bad ones; he compiles the Canon of Laws.
steps.text_zh: 前406年，李悝在魏国变法：按功劳授官，废除世袭特权；“尽地力”鼓励耕作；实行平籴法稳定粮价，并编成《法经》。

steps.text: 386 BC: Wu Qi leaves Wei for Chu and reforms it for King Dao, cutting the privileges of distant royal kin to pay for the army. When the king dies, the nobles kill him.
steps.text_zh: 前386年，吴起离魏入楚，辅佐楚悼王变法，削减疏远贵族的特权，用来供养军队。悼王一死，吴起即被旧贵族杀害。

steps.text: 361 BC: Duke Xiao of Qin, ashamed that the eastern states look down on Qin, calls for able men from anywhere. Shang Yang comes from Wei to answer.
steps.text_zh: 前361年，秦孝公在栎阳发布求贤令，希望有人能使秦国强大。卫国人商鞅从魏国来到秦国，受到重用。

steps.text: 356 BC: Shang Yang's first reforms reward farming and battle merit, group households for mutual responsibility, and take away nobles' ranks unless they earn them.
steps.text_zh: 前356年，商鞅开始在秦国变法：奖励耕战，按军功授爵，编户连坐，没有军功的宗室贵族不得享有爵位。

steps.text: 355 BC: Shen Buhai becomes chancellor of Han and stresses the ruler's methods for controlling officials. For his fifteen years in office no state dares attack Han.
steps.text_zh: 前355年，申不害任韩国相，主张君主用“术”驾驭臣下，整顿吏治。他执政十五年间，韩国国治兵强。

steps.text: 350 BC: Qin moves its capital to Xianyang. Shang Yang's second round of reform merges villages into counties under appointed officials and opens up the old field boundaries.
steps.text_zh: 前350年，秦国迁都咸阳。商鞅推行第二次变法，合并乡邑设县，由国君派官治理，并废井田、开阡陌。

steps.text: 307 BC: King Wuling of Zhao orders his men to wear the trousers and short coats of the steppe and fight as mounted archers. Zhao's cavalry becomes the best among the states.
steps.text_zh: 前307年，赵武灵王下令改穿胡人的短衣长裤，学习骑马射箭，组建骑兵，赵国随后灭中山、拓地北方。

title: The Hundred Schools
summary: Thinkers of the Warring States travel between courts, argue at the Jixia academy and leave the books that shaped Chinese thought.
summary_zh: 战国时代的思想家奔走于各国之间，在稷下学宫辩论，留下了影响中国两千多年的著作。

steps.text: 440 BC: Mozi walks ten days and nights to the Chu capital Ying to stop an attack on Song. He defeats Gongshu Ban's siege engines in a model contest, and Chu gives up the war.
steps.text_zh: 前440年，墨子听说楚国要攻宋，走了十天十夜赶到郢都，与公输班模拟攻守，九次挡住进攻，楚王只好罢兵。墨家主张兼爱、非攻。

steps.text: 320 BC: Mencius of Zou reaches Daliang. King Hui asks how he will profit the state; Mencius replies that he speaks only of benevolence and righteousness.
steps.text_zh: 前320年，邹国人孟子来到魏都大梁。梁惠王问他有什么能使魏国得利，孟子回答“何必曰利？亦有仁义而已矣”。

steps.text: 319 BC: at Jixia, by a gate of Linzi, King Xuan of Qi gives scholars of every school houses and ranks. Their job is not to govern but to debate.
steps.text_zh: 前319年，齐宣王在都城临淄的稷门外扩建学宫，供养各派学者，授予上大夫的待遇，让他们“不治而议论”，稷下成为百家争鸣的中心。

steps.text: About 300 BC: Zhuang Zhou, once a minor official at Meng in Song, writes the Zhuangzi. Told that Chu wants him as minister, he says he would rather drag his tail in the mud like a free turtle.
steps.text_zh: 约前300年，曾任宋国蒙地漆园吏的庄周著书立说。据《史记》记载，楚王派人请他做相，他宁愿像乌龟一样“曳尾于涂中”，自由自在。

steps.text: About 280 BC: in Handan, Gongsun Long argues that a white horse is not a horse, a puzzle about names and the things they stand for that made the School of Names famous.
steps.text_zh: 约前280年，赵国的公孙龙提出“白马非马”之论，探讨名称与事物的关系。他是名家的代表人物，曾为平原君门客。

steps.text: About 270 BC: the Jixia scholar Zou Yan explains the rise and fall of dynasties by the five phases, each overcoming the last. Qin later adopts water as its own virtue.
steps.text_zh: 约前270年，稷下学者邹衍提出“五德终始”说，用金木水火土五行相胜来解释朝代更替。秦朝统一后就自认属“水德”，崇尚黑色。

steps.text: 255 BC: Xunzi, three times head of the Jixia scholars, becomes magistrate of Lanling in Chu. He teaches that human nature must be shaped by learning; Han Fei and Li Si are his students.
steps.text_zh: 前255年，曾三次担任稷下祭酒的荀子被春申君任为兰陵令。他主张人性本恶，须靠礼和学习加以改造，韩非、李斯都出自他门下。

steps.text: 233 BC: Han Fei, a prince of Han, is sent to Qin, whose king had admired his writings. Slandered by Li Si, he dies in prison, but his Legalist ideas guide Qin's rule.
steps.text_zh: 前233年，韩国公子韩非出使秦国。秦王嬴政曾读其著作而深为赞赏，但韩非遭李斯等人陷害，死于狱中，他的法家学说却成为秦的治国之道。

title: Canals and irrigation
summary: From the Zhang River to the Lingqu canal, irrigation works turn plains into granaries and link river systems for armies.
summary_zh: 从漳河十二渠到灵渠，战国与秦的水利工程把平原变成粮仓，也把不同水系连在一起。

steps.text: 422 BC: Ximen Bao, magistrate of Ye in Wei, ends the custom of giving brides to the River Lord by throwing the shamans in. He then digs twelve channels from the Zhang River to water the fields.
steps.text_zh: 前422年，魏国邺令西门豹把主持“河伯娶妇”的巫婆投入漳河，破除陋习，又开凿十二条水渠引漳水灌溉，邺地农田由此富饶。

steps.text: About 360 BC: Wei begins the Hong canal from the Yellow River near Daliang, linking it to rivers that flow to the Huai. The plain gains a waterway for boats and grain.
steps.text_zh: 约前360年，魏国在大梁附近开凿鸿沟，引黄河水向东南连通流入淮河的诸水。中原从此有了贯通黄河与淮河的水道。

steps.text: 316 BC: Qin conquers Shu and gains the Chengdu plain. The land is fertile, but the Min River pours out of the mountains and floods it again and again.
steps.text_zh: 前316年，秦国派司马错灭蜀，得到成都平原。这里土地肥沃，但岷江出山后经常泛滥，成都平原上旱涝无常，难以充分利用。

steps.text: About 256 BC: Li Bing, governor of Shu, splits the Min River with the Fish Mouth levee and cuts a channel through the hill at Baopingkou. Dujiangyan still waters the Chengdu plain today.
steps.text_zh: 约前256年，蜀郡守李冰主持修建都江堰，用鱼嘴把岷江分为内外二江，凿开宝瓶口引水入成都平原。这项工程至今仍在发挥作用。

steps.text: 246 BC: Han sends the engineer Zheng Guo to Qin to start a huge canal, hoping to drain Qin's strength. The canal from the Jing River to the Luo instead makes the Wei plain rich.
steps.text_zh: 前246年，韩国派水工郑国入秦，劝说秦国开凿大渠，想以此消耗秦的国力。这条引泾水入洛水的郑国渠，反而让关中成为沃野。

steps.text: 237 BC: when Zheng Guo's mission is exposed, Qin orders all foreigners out. Li Si's memorial against the expulsion changes the king's mind, and the canal is finished.
steps.text_zh: 前237年，郑国的使命被识破，秦国下令驱逐客卿。李斯上《谏逐客书》，秦王收回成命，郑国也得以继续把渠修完。

steps.text: 214 BC: to supply the armies in the far south, Qin cuts the Lingqu canal at Xing'an, joining the Xiang River, which flows to the Yangtze, with the Li, which flows to the Pearl River.
steps.text_zh: 前214年，为了给南征的秦军运送粮草，秦朝在今广西兴安开凿灵渠，连通北流入长江的湘江和南流入珠江的漓江。

title: Alliances and Changping
summary: Strategists bargain with alliances while Qin wears its rivals down, until Changping breaks Zhao and only Handan holds.
summary_zh: 纵横家在列国间奔走，秦国步步东进，长平一战重创赵国，邯郸被围。

steps.text: 342 BC: at Maling, Sun Bin of Qi lures the Wei army into an ambush by reducing his campfires each day. Pang Juan dies and Wei never regains its lead.
steps.text_zh: 前342年，齐军师孙膑用“减灶”之计诱魏军追击，在马陵设伏大败魏军，庞涓自杀，魏国从此失去霸主地位。

steps.text: 333 BC: according to the Records of the Grand Historian, Su Qin persuades the six eastern states to join in a north-south alliance against Qin and holds the seals of six states.
steps.text_zh: 前333年，据《史记》记载，苏秦游说燕、赵、韩、魏、齐、楚六国“合纵”抗秦，并佩六国相印。

steps.text: 328 BC: Zhang Yi becomes chancellor of Qin and pursues "horizontal" deals, drawing states one by one into alliance with Qin to break up the united front.
steps.text_zh: 前328年，张仪任秦国相，推行“连横”，拉拢东方各国分别与秦结盟，以瓦解六国的联合。

steps.text: 313 BC: Zhang Yi promises Chu six hundred li of land if it breaks with Qi. Chu breaks the alliance, the land shrinks to six li, and Chu's angry attacks on Qin end in defeat.
steps.text_zh: 前313年，张仪以商於六百里地为诱饵，骗楚怀王与齐断交。事后只给六里，楚怒而攻秦，次年在丹阳惨败。

steps.text: 266 BC: Fan Ju becomes chancellor of Qin and advises friendship with distant states while attacking near ones. Qin turns its full weight on Han and Zhao.
steps.text_zh: 前266年，范雎任秦相，提出“远交近攻”之策：结好远方的齐、楚，集中力量攻打邻近的韩、赵。

steps.text: 262 BC: Qin cuts off Han's Shangdang commandery. Rather than surrender to Qin, its governor hands it to Zhao, which accepts and so draws Qin's full attack.
steps.text_zh: 前262年，秦军切断韩国上党郡与本土的联系，上党郡守不愿降秦，转而献地给赵国，赵国接受，秦赵大战由此爆发。

steps.text: 260 BC: at Changping, Zhao replaces the cautious Lian Po with Zhao Kuo. Bai Qi surrounds the Zhao army, starves it for 46 days and kills the prisoners, more than 400,000 men by Sima Qian's count.
steps.text_zh: 前260年，赵以赵括代替廉颇，被秦将白起包围，断粮四十六天后投降。据《史记》，四十余万降卒被坑杀。

steps.text: 259 BC: Qin besieges Handan, the Zhao capital. The city holds out for more than a year while Lord Pingyuan seeks help from the other states.
steps.text_zh: 前259年，秦军围攻赵都邯郸。赵国军民坚守一年多，平原君四处求救，楚国和魏国先后发兵。

steps.text: 257 BC: Lord Xinling of Wei steals the king's tally, takes over the Wei army and marches to Handan. With Chu forces he breaks the siege, and Qin's advance stalls for a time.
steps.text_zh: 前257年，魏国信陵君窃得兵符，夺取魏军指挥权，与楚军共同救赵，大破秦军，邯郸之围得解。

title: Qu Yuan and Chu
summary: The poet-minister Qu Yuan argues for alliance with Qi, is pushed aside and exiled, and drowns himself as Qin takes the Chu capital.
summary_zh: 屈原主张联齐抗秦，却屡遭排挤和流放，在秦军攻破郢都后自沉汨罗江。

steps.text: 313 BC: at Ying, Qu Yuan, once trusted by King Huai, has been pushed aside by slander. Zhang Yi of Qin now persuades the king to break with Qi, the ally Qu Yuan had backed.
steps.text_zh: 前313年，在郢都，曾受楚怀王信任的屈原遭上官大夫谗害而被疏远。秦相张仪趁机诱使怀王与齐国断交，屈原主张的联齐抗秦之策落空。

steps.text: About 311 BC: after Chu loses Hanzhong and two battles to Qin, Qu Yuan is sent as envoy to Qi at Linzi to mend the alliance that Zhang Yi had broken.
steps.text_zh: 约前311年，楚国在丹阳、蓝田被秦打败、失去汉中之后，屈原奉命出使齐国都城临淄，设法修复被张仪破坏的齐楚联盟。

steps.text: About 305 BC: estranged from the court, Qu Yuan lives north of the Han River. The Li Sao, his long poem of a loyal man rejected, is traditionally dated to these years.
steps.text_zh: 约前305年，屈原被疏远后住在汉水以北。他的长诗《离骚》倾诉忠而被谤的悲愤，一般认为写于这一时期前后。

steps.text: 299 BC: back at court, Qu Yuan warns King Huai not to meet the King of Qin: Qin is a land of tigers and wolves. The king goes, is seized at the Wu Pass, and dies a captive.
steps.text_zh: 前299年，秦王约楚怀王会面，屈原劝谏说“秦虎狼之国，不可信”。怀王不听，入武关后被扣留，最终死在秦国。

steps.text: About 296 BC: under the new King Qingxiang, the chief minister Zilan has Qu Yuan banished south of the Yangtze. He crosses the river toward Lake Dongting.
steps.text_zh: 约前296年，顷襄王即位后，令尹子兰等人再次进谗，屈原被放逐到江南。他渡过长江，来到洞庭湖一带，从此再没有回到郢都。

steps.text: About 290 BC: in the poem Crossing the River, Qu Yuan travels up the Yuan River into the dark mountain forests of Xupu, where apes live and rain never stops.
steps.text_zh: 约前290年，屈原在《涉江》中写自己溯沅水而上，进入溆浦一带山高林深、终日阴雨的地方，漂泊于沅、湘之间。

steps.text: 278 BC: the Qin general Bai Qi takes Ying and burns the royal tombs at Yiling. Chu moves its capital to Chen. Qu Yuan mourns the lost city in Lament for Ying.
steps.text_zh: 前278年，秦将白起攻破郢都，焚烧楚王陵墓所在的夷陵，楚国被迫迁都于陈。屈原写下《哀郢》，哀悼故都沦陷。

steps.text: 278 BC: with his homeland lost, Qu Yuan drowns himself in the Miluo River. Later tradition links the Dragon Boat Festival to the search for his body.
steps.text_zh: 前278年，故国沦丧，屈原怀抱石头投入湘江支流汨罗江而死。后世相传，端午节划龙舟、包粽子，就是为了纪念他。

title: Qin unites the realm
summary: In ten years Qin conquers the six other states and its king becomes the First Emperor.
summary_zh: 十年之间，秦国先后灭掉韩、赵、魏、楚、燕、齐，秦王嬴政成为始皇帝。

steps.text: 246 BC: thirteen-year-old Ying Zheng becomes king of Qin at Xianyang. Behind the passes of the Wei valley, Qin is already the strongest of the seven states.
steps.text_zh: 前246年，十三岁的嬴政在咸阳即秦王位。秦据关中，背靠函谷关，已是七国中最强的一国。

steps.text: 230 BC: Han, the weakest state and Qin's direct neighbour to the east, falls first. Its king is captured and its land becomes Yingchuan commandery.
steps.text_zh: 前230年，最弱小、又紧挨秦国东面的韩国首先被灭，韩王安被俘，韩地设为颍川郡。

steps.text: 228 BC: Zhao, which had held out under the general Li Mu, falls after Li Mu is executed on false charges. Qin troops take Handan.
steps.text_zh: 前228年，赵国名将李牧被冤杀之后，秦将王翦攻破邯郸，赵王迁被俘。

steps.text: 225 BC: Wang Ben floods Daliang, the Wei capital, by diverting the Yellow River canals. After three months the walls give way.
steps.text_zh: 前225年，王贲引黄河、鸿沟之水灌大梁，三个月后城坏，魏王假投降。

steps.text: 223 BC: Chu, the largest state, is the hardest fight. A first army of 200,000 is beaten; Wang Jian then comes with 600,000 and takes Shouchun.
steps.text_zh: 前223年，疆域最大的楚国最难打。李信率二十万人先败，王翦再领六十万大军南下，攻破寿春，楚亡。

steps.text: 222 BC: Yan, whose crown prince had sent Jing Ke to kill the King of Qin, is pursued to Liaodong and destroyed.
steps.text_zh: 前222年，曾派荆轲刺秦的燕国被追击到辽东，燕王喜被俘，燕亡。

steps.text: 221 BC: Qi, which had stayed out of the wars, surrenders without a battle when Qin troops arrive from the north.
steps.text_zh: 前221年，长期置身事外的齐国在秦军自北南下时不战而降。

steps.text: 221 BC: the realm is one. Ying Zheng takes the new title Huangdi, splits the land into 36 commanderies and standardises script, coins and weights.
steps.text_zh: 前221年，天下一统。嬴政自称“始皇帝”，分天下为三十六郡，统一文字、货币和度量衡。

title: How Qin built an empire
summary: In eleven years the Qin empire sets up commanderies, one script and a network of roads and walls, at a heavy cost in labour.
summary_zh: 秦统一后的十余年间，推行郡县制，统一文字，修筑驰道、直道和长城，但沉重的徭役也耗尽了民力。

steps.text: 221 BC: ministers urge the emperor to give kingdoms to his sons. Li Si argues that this had ruined Zhou. Instead each commandery gets a governor, a commander and an inspector appointed from the capital.
steps.text_zh: 前221年，丞相王绾等人请求分封皇子为王，李斯认为周朝正是亡于分封。秦始皇采纳李斯之议，各郡设守、尉、监，由朝廷任免。

steps.text: 221 BC: the many local scripts of the six states are replaced by the Qin small seal script, and carts are given one axle width so they can use the same ruts.
steps.text_zh: 前221年，秦朝以秦国文字为基础，废除六国各不相同的写法，推行小篆；又规定车轴宽度一致，即“书同文、车同轨”。

steps.text: 220 BC: Qin begins the imperial highways, running from Xianyang east to the old lands of Yan and Qi and south to Wu and Chu, lined with pines, for tours and troops.
steps.text_zh: 前220年，秦开始修筑驰道，以咸阳为中心，向东通到燕、齐故地，向南直达吴、楚故地，路旁种植青松，便于皇帝出巡和调动军队。

steps.text: 217 BC: a local law clerk named Xi is buried at Shuihudi with over a thousand bamboo slips of Qin law. They show how closely the counties were run by written rules.
steps.text_zh: 前217年，南郡的一个县吏“喜”去世，随葬一千多枚抄写秦律的竹简。这批睡虎地秦简显示，秦朝对县乡的管理细致而严格。

steps.text: 215 BC: Meng Tian drives the Xiongnu out of the Ordos and joins the old walls of Qin, Zhao and Yan into one line from Lintao to Liaodong.
steps.text_zh: 前215年，蒙恬率大军北击匈奴，夺取河套地区，并把秦、赵、燕三国旧长城连接起来，西起临洮，东至辽东，绵延万余里。

steps.text: 214 BC: after years of hard fighting and with grain shipped through the new Lingqu canal, Qin takes the far south and sets up the Nanhai, Guilin and Xiang commanderies.
steps.text_zh: 前214年，秦军南征百越，经过多年苦战，依靠新开的灵渠运粮，终于平定岭南，设南海、桂林、象郡三郡，并迁徙中原人口前往戍守。

steps.text: 212 BC: Meng Tian builds the Straight Road from near Xianyang north to Jiuyuan on the Yellow River bend, cutting through hills and filling valleys so troops can reach the frontier fast.
steps.text_zh: 前212年，蒙恬奉命修筑直道，从咸阳附近的云阳一直向北到黄河河套的九原，开山填谷，便于军队迅速到达北方边境。

steps.text: 210 BC: the emperor is buried at Mount Li. By the Shiji, convicts by the hundred thousand had worked on this tomb and the Epang palace, and its chamber held rivers of mercury.
steps.text_zh: 前210年，秦始皇葬于骊山陵。据《史记》记载，修建骊山陵和阿房宫的刑徒多达七十余万人，墓室中用水银做成江河大海。

title: The First Emperor's tours
summary: The First Emperor travels his new empire five times, carving his deeds on mountains, until he dies on the road at Shaqiu.
summary_zh: 秦始皇五次出巡，登山刻石、宣扬功德，最后一次死于沙丘。

steps.text: 220 BC: on his first tour the First Emperor goes west to Longxi and Beidi, the old Qin homeland on the frontier, and returns through the Huizhong pass.
steps.text_zh: 前220年，秦始皇首次出巡，向西视察秦人故地陇西、北地两郡，出鸡头山，经回中返回咸阳。

steps.text: 219 BC: heading east, he carves a stone on Mount Yi, then climbs Mount Tai, performs the feng sacrifice to Heaven at the summit and leaves a carved stone praising Qin's virtue.
steps.text_zh: 前219年，秦始皇东巡，在邹峄山刻石后登上泰山，举行封禅大典祭告天地，并立石刻辞颂扬秦的功德。

steps.text: 219 BC: he stays three months at Langya on the coast, builds a terrace and a stele, and sends Xu Fu with thousands of children to seek the islands of the immortals.
steps.text_zh: 前219年，秦始皇到海边的琅琊，停留三个月，筑琅琊台、立石刻，又派徐福带数千童男童女出海寻仙。

steps.text: 218 BC: on his third tour, at Bolangsha, Zhang Liang's strongman hurls a heavy iron hammer at the imperial carriages but hits the wrong one.
steps.text_zh: 前218年，秦始皇第三次出巡，行至博浪沙，韩国贵族后代张良安排的力士用大铁椎袭击车队，误中副车。

steps.text: 215 BC: on his fourth tour he reaches Jieshi on the Bohai coast, has an inscription carved there and sends men to seek immortals. On his return he orders Meng Tian north against the Xiongnu.
steps.text_zh: 前215年，秦始皇第四次出巡到渤海边的碣石，刻石记功，派人求仙。回程巡视北边后，派蒙恬北击匈奴。

steps.text: 210 BC: on his last tour he travels south to Kuaiji, sacrifices to Yu the Great and leaves one more stone inscription before turning north along the coast.
steps.text_zh: 前210年，秦始皇最后一次出巡，经云梦南下会稽，祭祀大禹并立石刻辞，然后沿海北上到琅琊、之罘。

steps.text: 210 BC: falling ill on the way back, he dies at Shaqiu. Zhao Gao and Li Si hide his death, forge an edict for Huhai and order the heir Fusu to kill himself.
steps.text_zh: 前210年，秦始皇在归途中病倒，死于沙丘。赵高、李斯秘不发丧，伪造遗诏立胡亥，逼长子扶苏自杀。

steps.text: 210 BC: the body returns to Xianyang hidden in a carriage of salted fish. The First Emperor is buried at Mount Li, guarded by the terracotta army.
steps.text_zh: 前210年，车队用鲍鱼掩盖尸臭回到咸阳。秦始皇葬于骊山陵墓，陵东的兵马俑军阵守护着他。

title: The fall of Qin
summary: A mutiny of conscripts sets the empire alight; within three years Xiang Yu breaks the Qin army and Liu Bang takes Xianyang.
summary_zh: 戍卒在大泽乡起义，不到三年，项羽击溃秦军主力，刘邦攻入咸阳，秦朝灭亡。

steps.text: 209 BC: rain holds up 900 conscripts at Dazexiang, and lateness means death under Qin law. Chen Sheng and Wu Guang kill their officers and raise the first revolt against Qin.
steps.text_zh: 前209年，九百名戍卒被大雨困在大泽乡，按秦法误期当斩。陈胜、吴广杀死押送军官，揭竿而起。

steps.text: 209 BC: the rebels take Chen, and Chen Sheng makes himself king of a new state called Zhangchu. Revolts break out across the old lands of the six states.
steps.text_zh: 前209年，起义军攻下陈县，陈胜自立为王，国号“张楚”。各地纷纷起兵响应，六国旧贵族也乘机复国。

steps.text: 209 BC: Liu Bang, a minor official who had freed his convicts and fled, is welcomed back by the people of Pei, who kill their magistrate and make him their leader.
steps.text_zh: 前209年，曾私放刑徒而逃亡的亭长刘邦被沛县父老迎回，杀死县令，刘邦被推为沛公。

steps.text: 209 BC: in Wu, Xiang Liang, son of a Chu general, and his nephew Xiang Yu kill the governor of Kuaiji and raise 8,000 men.
steps.text_zh: 前209年，楚国名将项燕之子项梁和侄子项羽在吴中杀死会稽郡守起兵，召集江东子弟八千人。

steps.text: 208 BC: Qin's general Zhang Han strikes back with an army of convicts. Chen Sheng is beaten and killed by his own driver, six months after the revolt began.
steps.text_zh: 前208年，秦将章邯率骊山刑徒反扑，陈胜兵败，被自己的车夫庄贾杀死，起义仅六个月。

steps.text: 207 BC: at Julu, Xiang Yu crosses the river, sinks his boats and smashes the cooking pots. With no way back, his army defeats the main Qin forces; Zhang Han surrenders months later.
steps.text_zh: 前207年，项羽在巨鹿“破釜沉舟”，率军死战，大破秦军主力。数月后章邯投降，秦朝已无力回天。

steps.text: 207 BC: while Xiang Yu fights in the north, Liu Bang slips west, takes the Wu pass and enters the Wei valley from the south.
steps.text_zh: 前207年，项羽在北方与秦军主力鏖战时，刘邦率军西进，攻破武关，从南面进入关中。

steps.text: 206 BC: Ziying, the last ruler of Qin, surrenders to Liu Bang. Liu seals the treasury and replaces Qin's harsh laws with three simple rules on murder, injury and theft.
steps.text_zh: 前206年，秦王子婴向刘邦投降，秦朝灭亡。刘邦封存府库，与关中父老“约法三章”，深得民心。

steps.text: 206 BC: Xiang Yu arrives with a far larger army. At the feast at Hongmen his adviser Fan Zeng plans to kill Liu Bang, but Liu escapes and Xiang Yu becomes master of the realm.
steps.text_zh: 前206年，项羽率大军入关。在鸿门宴上，范增想借机杀刘邦，刘邦借故脱身。随后项羽分封诸王，自称西楚霸王。

title: Chu against Han
summary: After Qin falls, Liu Bang and Xiang Yu fight for five years until Liu Bang founds the Han.
summary_zh: 秦亡之后，刘邦与项羽争天下五年，最终刘邦胜出，建立汉朝。

steps.text: 206 BC: Liu Bang reaches the Wei valley first; Xiang Yu follows with 400,000 men and invites him to a feast at Hongmen. Liu Bang comes to apologise and slips away alive.
steps.text_zh: 前206年，刘邦先入关中，项羽率四十万大军随后赶到，在鸿门设宴。刘邦亲赴宴会谢罪，借机脱身，躲过一劫。

steps.text: 206 BC: Xiang Yu names himself Hegemon-King of Western Chu, rules from Pengcheng and carves the realm into eighteen kingdoms. Liu Bang gets remote Hanzhong and Sichuan; the Wei valley goes to three surrendered Qin generals.
steps.text_zh: 前206年，项羽自立为西楚霸王，定都彭城，分封十八王。刘邦被封为汉王，赶到偏远的巴蜀汉中，关中分给三位秦降将。

steps.text: 206 BC: in the eighth month Han Xin leads the Han army out by a back road, surprises Chencang and defeats Zhang Han. The Wei valley is soon Liu Bang's, the origin of the saying 'secretly crossing at Chencang'.
steps.text_zh: 前206年八月，韩信率汉军从故道出兵，突袭陈仓，击败雍王章邯，很快平定关中。后世“暗度陈仓”的典故即出于此。

steps.text: 205 BC: while Xiang Yu is fighting in Qi, Liu Bang takes Pengcheng with an allied army of 560,000. Xiang Yu returns with 30,000 picked troops and routs it; Liu Bang escapes with a few dozen riders.
steps.text_zh: 前205年，刘邦趁项羽攻齐，率五十六万诸侯联军攻入彭城。项羽带三万精兵回师，大破汉军，刘邦仅与数十骑逃脱。

steps.text: 204 BC: Xiang Yu besieges Xingyang. General Ji Xin poses as Liu Bang and surrenders at the east gate while Liu Bang slips out the west. Fed by the Ao granary, Han holds the Xingyang-Chenggao line for years.
steps.text_zh: 前204年，项羽围困荥阳，将军纪信假扮刘邦出东门诈降，刘邦趁机从西门脱身。汉军依托敖仓存粮，与楚军在荥阳、成皋长期相持。

steps.text: 204 BC: Han Xin comes out of the Jingxing pass and deploys with a river at his back so his men cannot retreat. Fighting for their lives, they beat a Zhao army said to number 200,000.
steps.text_zh: 前204年，韩信率军东出井陉，背靠河水列阵，士兵无路可退，拼死作战，以少胜多击败号称二十万的赵军。

steps.text: 203 BC: Han Xin invades Qi and crushes a Qi and Chu army on the Wei River, killing the Chu general Long Ju. Made King of Qi, he tips the balance of the war against Xiang Yu.
steps.text_zh: 前203年，韩信攻齐，在潍水大破齐楚联军，楚将龙且战死。韩信被封为齐王，楚汉力量对比随之逆转。

steps.text: 202 BC: Han forces and the armies of Han Xin and Peng Yue trap Xiang Yu at Gaixia. Hearing Chu songs on every side at night, he breaks out south and later kills himself by the Wu River.
steps.text_zh: 前202年，汉军会合韩信、彭越等各路兵马，把项羽围在垓下。夜闻四面楚歌，项羽突围南逃，最后在乌江自刎。

steps.text: 202 BC: Liu Bang takes the title of emperor at Dingtao and names his dynasty Han, soon fixing the capital at Chang'an. The wars that followed the fall of Qin are over.
steps.text_zh: 前202年，刘邦在定陶即皇帝位，国号汉，不久定都长安。秦亡后的分裂与混战就此结束。

title: Han strikes the Xiongnu
summary: From humiliation at Baideng to the great campaigns of Wei Qing and Huo Qubing, Han turns the tables on the steppe.
summary_zh: 从白登之围、和亲忍让，到卫青、霍去病远征漠北，汉朝扭转了对匈奴的被动局面。

steps.text: 200 BC: Liu Bang leads a great army north against the Xiongnu, but Modu Chanyu traps him on Baideng hill near Pingcheng for seven days. He escapes only through a ruse of Chen Ping.
steps.text_zh: 前200年，刘邦亲率大军北击匈奴，被冒顿单于以精兵围困在平城白登山七天，后用陈平之计才得以脱身。

steps.text: 198 BC: on Liu Jing's advice Han makes a marriage alliance, sending a princess of the imperial clan and yearly gifts of silk, wine and grain. For sixty years this buys an uneasy peace.
steps.text_zh: 前198年，汉朝采纳刘敬的建议与匈奴和亲，以宗室女嫁给单于，每年送去絮、缯、酒、米。此后六十多年，汉朝大体以和亲换取边境安宁。

steps.text: 166 BC: 140,000 Xiongnu horsemen break through the Xiao pass and burn the Huizhong palace. Their scouts ride as far as Yong and Ganquan, close enough to alarm Chang'an.
steps.text_zh: 前166年，匈奴十四万骑攻入萧关，烧毁回中宫，侦察骑兵一直到达雍和甘泉附近，长安为之震动。

steps.text: 133 BC: Emperor Wu hides 300,000 troops around Mayi to lure the chanyu into a trap. The chanyu sees through it and withdraws, but the marriage peace is over and open war begins.
steps.text_zh: 前133年，汉武帝在马邑一带埋伏三十万大军，想引诱单于深入。单于途中察觉有诈退走，汉匈和亲破裂，大战从此开始。

steps.text: 127 BC: Wei Qing marches west from Yunzhong and retakes the land inside the Yellow River loop. Han founds Shuofang commandery and builds a city there, removing the direct threat to Chang'an.
steps.text_zh: 前127年，卫青出云中向西进军，收复黄河河套以南的“河南地”。汉朝在这里设朔方郡、筑朔方城，解除了匈奴对长安的直接威胁。

steps.text: 121 BC: nineteen-year-old Huo Qubing strikes the Hexi corridor twice and smashes the Xiongnu there. The Hunye king surrenders, and the road to the Western Regions is open.
steps.text_zh: 前121年，十九岁的霍去病两次出击河西，大败匈奴。同年浑邪王率众降汉，河西走廊归入汉朝，通往西域的道路从此打通。

steps.text: 119 BC: Emperor Wu sends 100,000 cavalry in two columns across the Gobi. Wei Qing marches over a thousand li from Dingxiang, meets the chanyu's main army and fights until dusk; the chanyu flees.
steps.text_zh: 前119年，汉武帝发十万骑兵分两路远征漠北。卫青出定襄，北行千余里遇单于主力，激战至黄昏，单于突围远逃。

steps.text: 119 BC: Huo Qubing drives over two thousand li north from Dai, kills or captures more than 70,000 and holds a sacrifice on Mount Langjuxu. After this no Xiongnu court remains south of the Gobi.
steps.text_zh: 前119年，霍去病出代郡北进两千余里，歼敌七万余人，在狼居胥山祭天而还，史称“封狼居胥”。此后漠南不再有匈奴王庭。

title: Rebellion of the Seven States
summary: When Emperor Jing cuts the kings' lands, seven kingdoms rise; Liang holds out and Zhou Yafu starves the rebels in three months.
summary_zh: 汉景帝削减诸侯王封地，吴楚等七国起兵叛乱。梁国死守，周亚夫断敌粮道，三个月平定叛乱。

steps.text: 155 BC: Chao Cuo, now imperial counsellor, urges Emperor Jing to cut the kingdoms down. If they are cut, they will rebel; if not, they will rebel anyway, only later and stronger.
steps.text_zh: 前155年，晁错任御史大夫，向景帝建议削减诸侯王封地。他认为诸侯“削之亦反，不削亦反”，晚反祸更大。景帝开始削楚、赵等国土地。

steps.text: 154 BC: Liu Pi, King of Wu, rich from sea salt and copper coins, rises at Guangling, claiming to remove Chao Cuo. Chu, Zhao, Jiaoxi, Jiaodong, Zichuan and Jinan join him.
steps.text_zh: 前154年，靠煮盐铸钱致富的吴王刘濞在广陵起兵，打出“诛晁错，清君侧”的旗号，楚、赵、胶西、胶东、淄川、济南六国响应。

steps.text: 154 BC: hoping the rebels will stop, Emperor Jing has Chao Cuo executed in his court robes at the eastern market of Chang'an. The kings keep marching.
steps.text_zh: 前154年，景帝听从袁盎之言，以为杀了晁错叛军就会退兵，下令将晁错腰斩于长安东市。然而吴王已自称东帝，并不罢兵。

steps.text: 154 BC: Wu and Chu break into Liang and besiege its capital Suiyang. Liu Wu, King of Liang and the emperor's brother, holds the walls and ties down the main rebel army.
steps.text_zh: 前154年，吴楚联军攻入梁国，围攻都城睢阳。景帝的弟弟梁王刘武坚守城池，把叛军主力牢牢拖在梁地，使其无法西进。

steps.text: 154 BC: the commander Zhou Yafu fortifies Changyi to the northeast and refuses Liang's calls for help. Light cavalry slip south and cut the rebels' grain route from the Huai.
steps.text_zh: 前154年，太尉周亚夫在睢阳东北的昌邑深沟高垒，不顾梁王求救坚守不出，同时派轻骑南下截断吴楚从淮河运粮的通道。

steps.text: 154 BC: hungry, the Wu and Chu armies turn on Zhou Yafu near Xiayi. They feint at the south-east corner of his camp; he guards the north-west, beats the real attack, and the rebels break.
steps.text_zh: 前154年，断粮的吴楚军转而在下邑一带求战。他们佯攻营垒东南，周亚夫却加强西北，果然挡住主攻。叛军饥疲溃散。

steps.text: 154 BC: Liu Pi flees across the Yangtze to Dantu and the Dong Yue, bribed by Han, kill him. The other kings take their own lives within weeks.
steps.text_zh: 前154年，吴王刘濞渡江逃到丹徒，投靠东越。东越人受汉朝收买，杀死刘濞。楚王、胶西王、赵王等其余六王也先后兵败自杀或被杀。

steps.text: 154 BC: the revolt is over in about three months. Kings now lose the right to appoint their own officials and live only on their revenues; real power passes to the court.
steps.text_zh: 前154年，七国之乱约三个月即被平定。此后诸侯王不能再自行任免官吏，只能收取租税，权力集中到中央朝廷。

title: Zhang Qian opens the Western Regions
summary: An envoy sent to find allies against the Xiongnu comes back thirteen years later with knowledge of Central Asia.
summary_zh: 为联合大月氏夹击匈奴而出使的张骞，十三年后归来，带回了西域诸国的消息，开启了丝绸之路。

steps.text: About 139 BC: Emperor Wu sends Zhang Qian west with about a hundred men to find the Yuezhi, who had been driven out by the Xiongnu, and make them allies.
steps.text_zh: 约前139年，汉武帝派张骞率一百多人从长安出发，去寻找被匈奴赶走的大月氏，约其共击匈奴。

steps.text: Crossing the Hexi corridor, which the Xiongnu still control, the party is captured. Zhang Qian is held for about ten years, marries and has a son, but keeps his envoy's staff.
steps.text_zh: 途经匈奴控制的河西走廊时被俘，张骞被扣留约十年，娶妻生子，但始终持汉节不失。

steps.text: He escapes west across the Tian Shan to Dayuan (Ferghana), famous for its horses. The king of Dayuan sends him on with guides.
steps.text_zh: 他趁机逃脱，向西越过天山到达以汗血马闻名的大宛。大宛王派向导送他继续前行。

steps.text: Through Kangju he reaches the Yuezhi, now settled north of the Oxus and ruling Daxia (Bactria). They are prosperous and no longer want revenge.
steps.text_zh: 经康居到达大月氏。大月氏已在妫水（阿姆河）以北安居，并征服了大夏，生活富足，不想再与匈奴为敌。

steps.text: After a year he heads home along the southern edge of the Tarim basin, hoping to avoid the Xiongnu through the Qiang lands, but is captured again.
steps.text_zh: 一年后东归，想沿昆仑山北麓经羌人地区避开匈奴，结果再次被俘。

steps.text: 126 BC: in the turmoil after the Chanyu's death he escapes and reaches Chang'an with just one companion. His report describes Dayuan, Kangju, Daxia, Anxi (Parthia) and Shendu (India).
steps.text_zh: 前126年，趁匈奴单于去世内乱逃回长安，出发时一百多人，只剩两人。他向武帝详细介绍了大宛、康居、大夏、安息、身毒等国。

steps.text: After Han wins the Hexi corridor, he goes west again to the Wusun. His deputies visit many states; from now on envoys and trade caravans travel the road we call the Silk Road.
steps.text_zh: 汉朝夺得河西之后，张骞再次出使乌孙，副使分赴各国。此后使者和商队往来不绝，这条路后来被称为丝绸之路。

title: Emperor Wu's new frontiers
summary: Besides the wars with the Xiongnu, Emperor Wu's armies and envoys bring the south, the southwest, the Hexi corridor and northern Korea into the empire.
summary_zh: 除了北击匈奴，汉武帝还派兵遣使，把东南、岭南、西南夷、河西走廊和朝鲜半岛北部纳入汉朝版图。

steps.text: 138 BC: Minyue attacks its neighbour Dong'ou. Han sends troops from Kuaiji by sea; Minyue withdraws, and Dong'ou asks to move its whole people north to the Yangtze-Huai lands.
steps.text_zh: 前138年，闽越攻打东瓯，汉朝派严助从会稽发兵渡海救援。闽越退兵后，东瓯请求举国内迁，被安置在江淮之间。

steps.text: 135 BC: in Nanyue, the envoy Tang Meng tastes a sauce made in Shu and learns it came by river through Yelang. He goes to Yelang and opens a route from Shu toward the south.
steps.text_zh: 前135年，唐蒙在南越吃到蜀地出产的枸酱，得知可经夜郎沿江而下直达番禺。他奉命出使夜郎，设立犍为郡，打通了巴蜀南下的道路。

steps.text: 111 BC: after the Nanyue chancellor Lü Jia kills his pro-Han king, Han armies converge on Panyu and take it. Nanyue becomes nine commanderies reaching into today's Vietnam.
steps.text_zh: 前111年，南越丞相吕嘉杀死主张归汉的南越王，汉朝派路博德、杨仆等分路进攻，攻破番禺。南越故地设为九郡，南至今越南中部。

steps.text: 111 BC: returning troops crush Qielan in the southwest and the king of Yelang comes to court. New commanderies such as Zangke and Yuexi are set up.
steps.text_zh: 前111年，灭南越之后，汉军回师平定反叛的且兰，夜郎王入朝受封。汉朝在西南夷地区设立牂柯、越巂、沈黎等郡。

steps.text: About 111 BC: the Hexi corridor, taken from the Xiongnu ten years before, is organised into commanderies, later four: Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiuquan and Dunhuang, guarding the road west.
steps.text_zh: 约前111年，十年前从匈奴手中夺得的河西走廊陆续设郡，后来形成武威、张掖、酒泉、敦煌四郡，守护通往西域的道路。

steps.text: 110 BC: Yushan, king of Dong Yue, rebels. Han armies close in and his own men kill him. Emperor Wu moves the people to the Yangtze-Huai lands, leaving the coast nearly empty.
steps.text_zh: 前110年，东越王余善反汉，汉军分路进攻，东越人杀余善投降。汉武帝把东越百姓迁到江淮之间，闽地一时几乎空无人烟。

steps.text: 109 BC: Han troops reach Lake Dian and the King of Dian submits. His land becomes Yizhou commandery, but he keeps his title and a gold seal, found at Shizhaishan in 1956.
steps.text_zh: 前109年，汉军兵临滇池，滇王举国投降。汉在此设益州郡，仍赐滇王金印让他统治原有百姓。这枚“滇王之印”1956年在石寨山出土。

steps.text: 108 BC: after a year of war by land and sea, Wiman Joseon falls and its capital Wanggeom is taken. Han sets up four commanderies, including Lelang around today's Pyongyang.
steps.text_zh: 前108年，汉军水陆并进作战一年后，卫满朝鲜都城王险城被攻破。汉朝在此设乐浪、临屯、玄菟、真番四郡，乐浪郡治在今平壤附近。

title: The travels of Sima Qian
summary: The historian Sima Qian tours the south and east at twenty, later serves as envoy to the southwest, and finishes the Shiji after his disgrace.
summary_zh: 司马迁二十岁时南游江淮、北涉齐鲁，后来奉使西南，受宫刑后发愤完成了《史记》。

steps.text: About 126 BC: Sima Qian, son of the court astrologer Sima Tan and born at Longmen on the Yellow River, sets out from Chang'an at about twenty to see the places of the past.
steps.text_zh: 约前126年，太史令司马谈之子、生于黄河龙门的司马迁，约二十岁时从长安出发远游，去实地考察古代史事发生的地方。

steps.text: About 126 BC: at Huaiyin he hears local stories of Han Xin, whose mother's grave the poor young man had placed on high ground with room for ten thousand households around it.
steps.text_zh: 约前126年，他南游江淮，到了韩信的家乡淮阴。当地人告诉他，韩信还是平民、贫贱时就把母亲葬在高敞之地，旁边可安置万户人家。

steps.text: About 126 BC: further south he climbs Mount Kuaiji and looks for Yu's cave. By tradition Yu the Great, tamer of the floods, gathered the lords here and was buried here.
steps.text_zh: 约前126年，他从江淮继续南下，登上会稽山探访禹穴。相传治水的大禹曾在这里大会诸侯，死后也葬在这里。

steps.text: About 126 BC: he sails the Yuan and Xiang rivers and visits the pool where Qu Yuan drowned. He later writes that he wept, imagining the man.
steps.text_zh: 约前126年，他乘船漂游沅水、湘水，到长沙一带探看屈原自沉的地方，后来在《史记》中写道“未尝不垂涕，想见其为人”。

steps.text: About 126 BC: in Qufu he sees Confucius's temple, his carriage and robes, and students practising rites. He says he lingered there and could not bring himself to leave.
steps.text_zh: 约前126年，他北渡汶水、泗水，到曲阜观看孔子庙堂、车服礼器和诸生演习礼仪，在那里流连徘徊，久久不忍离去。

steps.text: About 126 BC: he runs into hardship around Xue and Pengcheng, visits Feng and Pei where Liu Bang and his men came from, and passes through the old lands of Liang and Chu on his way home.
steps.text_zh: 约前126年，他在鄱、薛、彭城一带遭遇困厄，又经过刘邦君臣起家的丰、沛，再走过梁、楚故地，最后才返回长安。

steps.text: 111 BC: now a palace attendant, Sima Qian is sent with the armies into the southwest, south of Ba and Shu, as far as the Qiong, Zuo and Kunming peoples.
steps.text_zh: 前111年，已任郎中的司马迁奉命随军出使西南，到达巴、蜀以南的邛、笮、昆明等地，参与安置新设的郡县。

steps.text: 110 BC: returning, he finds his father dying at Luoyang, grieved to miss the emperor's sacrifice at Mount Tai. Sima Tan makes his son promise to finish the history he had begun.
steps.text_zh: 前110年，他回来复命时，父亲司马谈因未能随武帝封禅而病重滞留洛阳。司马谈临终嘱托儿子继任太史令，完成自己未竟的史书。

steps.text: About 91 BC: punished with castration for defending the general Li Ling, Sima Qian lives on to finish the Shiji in Chang'an: 130 chapters from the Yellow Emperor to his own day.
steps.text_zh: 约前91年，因替李陵辩护而受宫刑的司马迁忍辱发愤，在长安完成《史记》一百三十篇，记事上起黄帝，下至汉武帝时代。

title: From Zhao and Xuan to Wang Mang
summary: After Emperor Wu's wars, Han makes peace with the Xiongnu and rules the Western Regions, then slides into the hands of the Wang clan.
summary_zh: 武帝之后，汉朝与民休息，设西域都护，匈奴称臣，最后大权落入外戚王莽手中。

steps.text: 81 BC: scholars from the provinces debate the state salt and iron monopolies and other policies of Emperor Wu with the minister Sang Hongyang. The court is turning from expansion to recovery.
steps.text_zh: 前81年，朝廷召集各地贤良文学，与御史大夫桑弘羊辩论盐铁官营等武帝时期的政策，反映出汉朝由对外扩张转向休养生息。

steps.text: 81 BC: Su Wu, held by the Xiongnu for nineteen years and set to herd sheep by Lake Baikal, is finally released and returns to Chang'an. He left in his prime and comes back white-haired.
steps.text_zh: 前81年，被匈奴扣留十九年、在北海（今贝加尔湖）边牧羊的苏武终于获释，回到长安。出使时正值壮年，归来已须发尽白。

steps.text: 60 BC: the Xiongnu Rizhu king surrenders, and Emperor Xuan makes Zheng Ji Protector General of the Western Regions, based at Wulei. The oases north and south of the Tianshan come under Han rule.
steps.text_zh: 前60年，匈奴日逐王降汉，汉宣帝任命郑吉为西域都护，治所设在乌垒城。天山南北从此正式归汉朝管辖。

steps.text: 51 BC: after the Xiongnu split, Huhanye Chanyu comes in person to the Ganquan palace to pay homage to Emperor Xuan. A century of war between Han and the Xiongnu comes to a pause.
steps.text_zh: 前51年，匈奴内部分裂后，呼韩邪单于亲自到甘泉宫朝见汉宣帝，称臣归附。汉匈之间百余年的战争告一段落。

steps.text: 36 BC: Chen Tang and the Protector General Gan Yanshou raise troops from the oasis states and march deep into Kangju. They storm the town of Zhizhi Chanyu and kill him.
steps.text_zh: 前36年，西域副校尉陈汤与都护甘延寿调发西域诸国兵马，远征康居境内的郅支单于，攻破郅支城，将其斩杀。

steps.text: 33 BC: Huhanye comes to court again and asks for a bride. Emperor Yuan gives him Wang Zhaojun, a lady of the palace. For decades afterwards the northern frontier is largely quiet.
steps.text_zh: 前33年，呼韩邪单于再次入朝求亲，汉元帝把宫女王昭君嫁给他。此后几十年间，汉匈边境少有战事。

steps.text: 6 AD: Wang Mang, from the empress dowager's clan, has run the court for years. After Emperor Ping dies he installs the infant Ruzi Ying and rules as 'acting emperor', one step from the throne.
steps.text_zh: 6年，外戚王莽长期把持朝政，平帝死后，他立年幼的孺子婴，自己“居摄”称“假皇帝”，代行天子之事，离篡汉只差一步。

title: Wang Mang and Kunyang
summary: Wang Mang's Xin dynasty tries to rebuild an ideal antiquity, but floods, failed reforms and rebellions bring it down in fifteen years.
summary_zh: 王莽建立新朝，仿古改制，加上黄河改道、饥荒四起，十五年后在起义中灭亡。

steps.text: 9 AD: Wang Mang accepts the 'abdication' of the child Ruzi Ying and founds the Xin dynasty. He sets out to rebuild society on the model of the Confucian classics.
steps.text_zh: 9年，王莽接受孺子婴“禅让”即皇帝位，改国号为新，西汉灭亡。他想按照《周礼》等儒家经典重建理想中的古代制度。

steps.text: 9 AD: Wang Mang declares all farmland 'royal land' and bans the sale of land and slaves, then reissues the coinage again and again. The constant changes hurt landlords and commoners alike.
steps.text_zh: 9年起，王莽把天下田地改称“王田”，禁止买卖土地和奴婢，又多次改革币制，发行繁杂的新币。政令朝令夕改，豪强和百姓都深受其害。

steps.text: 11 AD: the Yellow River breaks its banks in Wei commandery and shifts to a new course across northern Shandong. The breach is not closed, and the flooded, starving refugees feed later revolts.
steps.text_zh: 11年，黄河在魏郡决口，改道向东流经今山东北部入海。朝廷没有堵口，大片土地被淹，灾民四处流亡，成为日后起义的温床。

steps.text: 17 AD: famine strikes Jing province, and Wang Kuang and Wang Feng gather the hungry in the Lulin hills. Within months they have seven or eight thousand followers, the Green Forest army.
steps.text_zh: 17年，荆州一带发生饥荒，王匡、王凤聚集饥民在绿林山起事，几个月间发展到七八千人，史称绿林军。

steps.text: 18 AD: Fan Chong rises in Langya and fights across Qing and Xu provinces. To tell friend from foe his men paint their eyebrows red, and become the Red Eyebrows.
steps.text_zh: 18年，樊崇在琅琊起兵，转战青州、徐州一带。为了和官军区分，起义者把眉毛涂成红色，号称赤眉军。

steps.text: 23 AD: the Green Forest leaders make Liu Xuan, a member of the Han imperial clan, emperor under the reign name Gengshi. The call to restore Han draws local strongmen everywhere.
steps.text_zh: 23年初，绿林军拥立汉朝宗室刘玄为帝，年号更始，以恢复汉朝为号召，各地豪强纷纷响应。

steps.text: 23 AD: Wang Mang sends a huge army, claimed at a million, to besiege Kunyang. Liu Xiu breaks out with thirteen riders, returns with reinforcements and leads 3,000 picked men into its centre. The Xin army collapses.
steps.text_zh: 23年，王莽派王寻、王邑率号称百万的大军围攻昆阳。刘秀带十三骑突围求援，又率三千敢死之士冲击敌阵，内外夹击大破新军。

steps.text: 23 AD: in autumn the rebels break into Chang'an and the city's people rise with them. Wang Mang is killed on the Jian terrace, and the Xin dynasty ends after fifteen years.
steps.text_zh: 23年秋，起义军攻入长安，城中百姓也起来响应。王莽在渐台被杀，新朝仅存十五年便灭亡。

title: Guangwu restores the Han
summary: Liu Xiu builds a base north of the Yellow River, takes the throne and spends twelve years reuniting the realm.
summary_zh: 刘秀从河北起家，称帝后定都洛阳，用十余年时间削平群雄，重建汉朝。

steps.text: 23 AD: Liu Xiu's elder brother Liu Yan, too popular for the Gengshi emperor's comfort, is executed. Liu Xiu hides his grief and is soon sent north across the Yellow River to win over Hebei.
steps.text_zh: 23年，刘秀的哥哥刘縯因威望太高被更始帝杀害。刘秀隐忍不发，不久受命持节北渡黄河，安抚河北州郡。

steps.text: 24 AD: at first weak in Hebei and hunted by the pretender Wang Lang, Liu Xiu wins over local magnates at Zhending and Xindu, storms Handan and kills Wang Lang. Hebei is now his base.
steps.text_zh: 24年，刘秀在河北起初势单力薄，还被王郎悬赏追捕。他联合真定、信都等地豪强，攻破邯郸，诛杀王郎，在河北站稳了脚跟。

steps.text: 25 AD: in the sixth month Liu Xiu takes the throne at the Qianqiu pavilion south of Hao, keeping the name Han and the reign title Jianwu. He has openly broken with the Gengshi regime.
steps.text_zh: 25年六月，刘秀在鄗城南的千秋亭即皇帝位，仍以汉为国号，改元建武。这时他与更始政权已公开决裂。

steps.text: 25 AD: in the tenth month Han forces take Luoyang and Liu Xiu makes it his capital. Because it lies east of Chang'an, the restored dynasty is known as the Eastern Han.
steps.text_zh: 25年十月，汉军攻下洛阳，刘秀定都于此。因为洛阳在长安以东，后世称这个重建的汉朝为东汉。

steps.text: 27 AD: short of food, the Red Eyebrows abandon Chang'an and head east. Beaten by Feng Yi at Xiaodi, the rest surrender to Liu Xiu at Yiyang, and the turmoil in the Wei valley subsides.
steps.text_zh: 27年，赤眉军在长安一带缺粮东撤，在崤底被冯异击败，余部最后在宜阳向刘秀投降，关中的混乱告一段落。

steps.text: 32 AD: Liu Xiu campaigns in person in Longyou, and Wei Ao, warlord of Tianshui, is defeated and soon dies. By 34 the region is pacified and the road to Shu is open.
steps.text_zh: 32年，刘秀亲征陇右，割据天水的隗嚣兵败，不久病死。34年，陇右全部平定，蜀地门户随之打开。

steps.text: 36 AD: the general Wu Han invades Shu, and Gongsun Shu is mortally wounded outside Chengdu. His twelve-year state in Sichuan falls and the realm is united again.
steps.text_zh: 36年，大将吴汉攻入蜀地，公孙述在成都城下受伤身亡。割据巴蜀十二年的成家政权灭亡，天下重归统一。

title: Inventions and scholarship of Eastern Han
summary: In and around Luoyang, Eastern Han scholars and craftsmen produce paper, the seismoscope, the first dynastic history and the first character dictionary.
summary_zh: 以洛阳为中心，东汉人造出了纸和地动仪，写成第一部断代史和第一部字典，医学也留下了传世经典。

steps.text: 68: according to tradition, two Indian monks arrive at Luoyang with sutras carried on a white horse, and Emperor Ming builds the White Horse Temple for them, remembered as China's first Buddhist temple.
steps.text_zh: 68年，据传汉明帝遣使西行求法，天竺僧人摄摩腾、竺法兰用白马驮经来到洛阳，朝廷为他们修建白马寺，后世称为中国第一座佛寺。

steps.text: 82: after some twenty years of work, Ban Gu, brother of Ban Chao, largely completes the Book of Han, the first history to cover a single dynasty. His sister Ban Zhao later finishes the missing parts.
steps.text_zh: 82年前后，班超的哥哥班固用二十余年基本写成《汉书》，开创了只写一个朝代的断代史体例。他死后，妹妹班昭续成其中的八表和天文志。

steps.text: 100: Xu Shen finishes Shuowen Jiezi, which explains more than 9,000 characters and sorts them under 540 radicals, the first Chinese dictionary arranged by component.
steps.text_zh: 100年，许慎写成《说文解字》，收字九千多个，按五百四十个部首编排，逐字分析字形、解释本义，是中国第一部按部首编排的字典。

steps.text: 105: the palace official Cai Lun presents Emperor He with paper made from tree bark, hemp ends, rags and old fishing nets. Paper existed before, but his cheap method spreads it, and it becomes known as Marquis Cai paper.
steps.text_zh: 105年，宦官蔡伦把用树皮、麻头、破布和旧渔网制成的纸献给汉和帝。此前已有纸，但他的方法原料便宜、易于推广，人称“蔡侯纸”。

steps.text: 132: Zhang Heng, the court astronomer who had already built a water-driven armillary sphere, makes a bronze seismoscope: eight dragons hold balls, and a ball dropping into a toad's mouth points toward a distant quake.
steps.text_zh: 132年，曾造水运浑天仪的太史令张衡制成铜质地动仪。仪器外有八条龙口含铜珠，哪个方向发生地震，那条龙口中的铜珠就落入下方蟾蜍口中。

steps.text: 138: one dragon drops its ball though no one in Luoyang feels a tremor. Days later a courier arrives reporting a quake in Longxi, far to the west, and the doubters are convinced.
steps.text_zh: 138年，地动仪一条龙的铜珠落下，洛阳却毫无震感，众人怀疑。几天后驿使赶到，报告西面的陇西发生地震，大家这才信服。

steps.text: 175: Cai Yong and other scholars fix the standard text of the Confucian classics and have it carved on stone tablets outside the Imperial Academy. So many come to copy them that carriages jam the streets.
steps.text_zh: 175年，蔡邕等人校定儒家经典文字，刻成石碑立于洛阳太学门外，史称熹平石经。前来观看抄写的车辆每天上千，堵塞了街道。

steps.text: About 200: Hua Tuo of Qiao, the most famous doctor of his day, is said to operate on patients after numbing them with a drug called mafeisan, and devises exercises imitating five animals. He is later killed by Cao Cao.
steps.text_zh: 约200年，谯县名医华佗据记载用“麻沸散”使病人麻醉后施行腹部手术，又创编模仿虎、鹿、熊、猿、鸟动作的“五禽戏”。他后来因不肯为曹操效力而被杀。

steps.text: About 205: Zhang Zhongjing of Nanyang, who lost most of his large clan to epidemics, writes the Treatise on Cold Damage. It shapes Chinese medicine to this day and earns him the title Sage of Medicine.
steps.text_zh: 约205年，南阳人张仲景的家族二百多人在十年内死去三分之二，多死于伤寒。他写成《伤寒杂病论》，奠定辨证施治的方法，被尊为“医圣”。

title: Ban Chao in the Western Regions
summary: Over three decades Ban Chao wins back the oasis states of the Tarim basin for the Han and sends an envoy toward Rome.
summary_zh: 班超在西域经营三十年，使五十余国重新归附汉朝，并派甘英西使大秦。

steps.text: 73 AD: Dou Gu campaigns against the Xiongnu, beats the Huyan king in the Tianshan and pursues him to Lake Barkol. Ban Chao, a junior officer, distinguishes himself and is sent on to the Western Regions.
steps.text_zh: 73年，窦固率军北伐匈奴，在天山击败呼衍王，追击到蒲类海。随军的假司马班超作战有功，被派往西域。

steps.text: 73 AD: Ban Chao arrives in Shanshan with 36 men and finds a Xiongnu embassy there. Saying 'how can you catch tiger cubs without entering the tiger's den', he attacks it by night, and Shanshan submits to Han.
steps.text_zh: 73年，班超带三十六人到鄯善。得知匈奴使者也在，他说“不入虎穴，焉得虎子”，夜袭匈奴使团，鄯善王于是归附汉朝。

steps.text: 73 AD: in Khotan the king, urged by a shaman, demands Ban Chao's horse for a sacrifice. Ban Chao beheads the shaman on the spot; the frightened king kills the Xiongnu envoys and submits.
steps.text_zh: 73年，班超西行到于阗。于阗王听信巫师，要班超献出坐骑祭神，班超当场斩杀巫师。于阗王震恐，杀匈奴使者降汉。

steps.text: 74 AD: Ban Chao has Douti, the king Kucha had imposed on Kashgar, seized and restores the old royal line. Kashgar becomes his base for the next three decades.
steps.text_zh: 74年，班超派人劫持龟兹所立的疏勒王兜题，改立疏勒旧王族。疏勒从此成为他经营西域的根据地。

steps.text: 87 AD: Ban Chao leads 25,000 troops from Khotan and other states against Yarkand. By a ruse he defeats the relief army of Kucha and its allies, and Yarkand surrenders.
steps.text_zh: 87年，班超调集于阗等国兵马两万五千人进攻莎车，用计击败前来救援的龟兹等国联军，莎车投降。

steps.text: 91 AD: Kucha, Gumo and Wensu surrender. The Han court restores the post of Protector General of the Western Regions and gives it to Ban Chao, who sits at Kucha.
steps.text_zh: 91年，龟兹、姑墨、温宿等国投降，汉朝重新设立西域都护，任命班超为都护，驻在龟兹。

steps.text: 94 AD: Ban Chao marches on Karashahr with 70,000 men from eight states including Kucha and Shanshan and beheads its king. More than fifty states of the Western Regions now acknowledge Han.
steps.text_zh: 94年，班超调发龟兹、鄯善等八国兵马七万人讨伐焉耆，斩焉耆王。西域五十余国全部归附汉朝。

steps.text: 97 AD: Ban Chao sends Gan Ying toward Daqin, the Roman empire. He crosses Parthia to the shores of Tiaozhi but turns back when sailors warn the sea crossing takes years. No Han envoy goes farther west.
steps.text_zh: 97年，班超派甘英出使大秦（罗马），甘英经安息到达条支海边，听船夫说渡海艰险、需时数年，于是折返。这是汉朝使者西行最远的一次。

title: From the Yellow Turbans to Cao Cao
summary: A great religious rising shakes the Han, warlords seize the court, and Cao Cao emerges as master of the north.
summary_zh: 黄巾起义动摇汉朝统治，董卓乱政，群雄混战，曹操最终统一北方。

steps.text: 184: Zhang Jue, leader of the Way of Great Peace, launches a rising of 36 districts at once under the slogan 'the blue heaven is dead, the yellow heaven shall rise'. His followers wear yellow headbands.
steps.text_zh: 184年，张角以太平道组织信徒，提出“苍天已死，黄天当立”，三十六方同时起事，头裹黄巾，史称黄巾起义。

steps.text: 184: Huangfu Song burns out the Yingchuan Yellow Turbans at Changshe. The rising is crushed within the year, but generals and local strongmen now hold armies of their own.
steps.text_zh: 184年，皇甫嵩在长社用火攻大破颍川黄巾军。起义虽在年内被镇压，但地方豪强和将领借机掌握了兵权。

steps.text: 189: the regent He Jin is murdered by eunuchs and Yuan Shao massacres the eunuchs in turn. In the chaos the northwestern warlord Dong Zhuo marches into Luoyang, deposes the young emperor and installs Emperor Xian.
steps.text_zh: 189年，大将军何进被宦官杀死，袁绍随即尽诛宦官。西凉军阀董卓趁乱率军入洛阳，废少帝、立献帝，独揽朝政。

steps.text: 190: the eastern lords form a coalition under Yuan Shao against Dong Zhuo. Dong Zhuo drags Emperor Xian west to Chang'an and burns the palaces of Luoyang as he leaves.
steps.text_zh: 190年，关东诸侯推袁绍为盟主讨伐董卓。董卓挟持献帝西迁长安，临走焚毁洛阳宫室。

steps.text: 192: Wang Yun and Lü Bu kill Dong Zhuo in Chang'an. His officers Li Jue and Guo Si soon take the city, the court becomes a shell and the warlords fight on their own.
steps.text_zh: 192年，司徒王允与吕布在长安刺杀董卓。不久董卓部将李傕、郭汜攻入长安，朝廷名存实亡，天下陷入群雄混战。

steps.text: 196: Cao Cao brings Emperor Xian to Xu and makes it the capital. Acting in the emperor's name gives him political leverage, and military farm colonies around Xu give him grain.
steps.text_zh: 196年，曹操迎汉献帝迁都许县，此后奉天子以令不臣，在政治上占得先机，并在许下推行屯田。

steps.text: 200: Yuan Shao marches south with a large army and faces Cao Cao at Guandu. Cao Cao leads light horse by night to Wuchao, burns Yuan Shao's grain, and the Yuan army falls apart.
steps.text_zh: 200年，袁绍率大军南下，与曹操在官渡相持。曹操亲率轻骑夜袭乌巢，烧掉袁军粮草，袁军随即崩溃。

steps.text: 204: after Yuan Shao's death his sons fight each other, and Cao Cao takes their capital Ye. He makes Ye his own base and works through Hebei.
steps.text_zh: 204年，袁绍死后诸子相争，曹操趁机攻克袁氏的根据地邺城，此后以邺为大本营，逐步平定河北。

steps.text: 207: Cao Cao marches beyond the Lulong pass against the Wuhuan, surprises them at White Wolf Mountain and kills their chief Tadun. The north is his, and he turns south.
steps.text_zh: 207年，曹操远征乌桓，出卢龙塞，在白狼山突袭大破乌桓，斩杀蹋顿。北方基本统一，曹操随即把目光转向南方。

title: The Battle of Guandu
summary: Cao Cao, holding the emperor but outnumbered, breaks Yuan Shao, the strongest warlord in the north, and takes the Yellow River plain.
summary_zh: 挟天子而兵少的曹操以弱胜强，击败北方最强的袁绍，从此成为黄河流域的主人。

steps.text: 196: Cao Cao brings the wandering Emperor Xian to Xu and makes it the capital. Orders now go out in the emperor's name, and military farms around Xu start filling Cao's granaries.
steps.text_zh: 196年，曹操把流离的汉献帝迎到许县定都，从此以天子名义号令诸侯，又在许下屯田积粮。他的地盘夹在袁绍、袁术、吕布之间，四面受敌。

steps.text: 199: Yuan Shao tunnels under the towers of Yijing and Gongsun Zan burns himself to death. Yuan now holds four provinces north of the Yellow River and gathers some 100,000 picked troops to march on Xu.
steps.text_zh: 199年，袁绍挖地道攻破易京，公孙瓒自焚而死。袁绍据有冀、青、幽、并四州，挑选精兵十万、骑兵一万，准备南下进攻许都。

steps.text: Spring 200: Yuan's general Yan Liang besieges Baima on the south bank. Cao feints west as if to cross the river, Yuan splits his army to follow, and Cao races to Baima, where Guan Yu cuts down Yan Liang.
steps.text_zh: 200年春，袁绍派颜良围攻黄河南岸的白马。曹操用荀攸之计，佯装西去延津渡河，袁绍分兵应对，曹军轻骑急趋白马，关羽在万军之中斩杀颜良。

steps.text: 200: Yuan's cavalry under Wen Chou and Liu Bei chase the retreating Cao near Yanjin. Cao leaves his baggage on the road as bait, and while the riders scatter to loot, fewer than 600 horsemen rout them and kill Wen Chou.
steps.text_zh: 200年，文丑与刘备率骑兵在延津以南追击曹军。曹操故意把辎重丢在路上，袁军争抢之际，曹操以不满六百骑突然出击，大破袁军，斩杀文丑。

steps.text: Autumn 200: the armies face each other at Guandu. Yuan builds earth mounds and rains arrows into Cao's camp; Cao answers with stone-throwing carts and trenches against the tunnels. Months pass and Cao's grain runs short.
steps.text_zh: 200年秋，两军在官渡对峙。袁军堆土山、筑高橹向曹营放箭，曹军造发石车击毁；袁军挖地道，曹军掘长堑相拒。相持数月，曹军粮尽，曹操一度想退回许都，荀彧写信劝他坚持。

steps.text: Winter 200: Yuan sends Chunyu Qiong with over 10,000 men to guard a great grain convoy at Wuchao. Yuan's adviser Xu You, angry that his family has been arrested, defects to Cao and tells him exactly where the grain is.
steps.text_zh: 200年冬，袁绍派淳于琼率万余人押运粮车，屯在乌巢。谋士许攸因家人犯法被收押，愤而投奔曹操，献计偷袭乌巢。曹操听后大喜，决定亲自出击。

steps.text: Winter 200: Cao leads 5,000 men by night under Yuan's banners, takes Wuchao, kills Chunyu Qiong and burns all the grain. Yuan's generals Zhang He and Gao Lan defect, his army collapses, and he flees north with 800 riders.
steps.text_zh: 200年冬，曹操亲率步骑五千，打着袁军旗号连夜奔袭乌巢，斩淳于琼，烧尽粮草。袁将张郃、高览随即投降，袁军全线崩溃，袁绍只带八百骑渡河北逃。

steps.text: 201: Cao parades his army along the Yellow River and smashes Yuan's force at Cangting. Yuan Shao never recovers; he falls ill and dies in 202 without naming an heir.
steps.text_zh: 201年四月，曹操沿黄河耀兵，在仓亭再次击破袁绍军队。袁绍兵败后发病吐血，次年五月病死，生前没有确定继承人。

steps.text: 204: Yuan Shao's sons Tan and Shang fight each other, and Cao picks them off. He floods Ye with the Zhang River and takes it, making the Yuan capital his own base for conquering the north.
steps.text_zh: 204年，袁谭、袁尚兄弟相攻，曹操各个击破，引漳水灌邺城，八月攻克，自领冀州牧。袁氏的根据地成了曹操的大本营，北方统一已成定局。

title: The Battle of Red Cliffs
summary: Cao Cao's push south is stopped on the Yangtze, and the realm splits three ways.
summary_zh: 曹操南下统一的步伐在长江边被孙刘联军挡住，从此天下三分。

steps.text: 207: Liu Bei, a guest of Liu Biao in Jing province, visits Zhuge Liang three times. Zhuge Liang lays out the plan: take Jing and Yi provinces and ally with Sun Quan.
steps.text_zh: 207年，寄居荆州的刘备三顾茅庐，诸葛亮提出隆中对：占据荆、益二州，东联孙权，北抗曹操。

steps.text: Autumn 208: having unified the north, Cao Cao marches south. Liu Biao dies and his son Liu Cong surrenders Jing province without a fight.
steps.text_zh: 208年秋，统一北方的曹操挥师南下。刘表病死，其子刘琮不战而降，荆州落入曹操之手。

steps.text: Cao Cao's cavalry catches Liu Bei's fleeing column at Changban. Liu Bei escapes east to Xiakou with a few thousand men.
steps.text_zh: 曹军轻骑在当阳长坂坡追上南逃的刘备，刘备只带少数人突围，东走夏口。

steps.text: Zhuge Liang goes to Sun Quan at Chaisang. Against advisers who urge surrender, Sun Quan and Zhou Yu decide to fight.
steps.text_zh: 诸葛亮出使柴桑面见孙权。在众人主张投降之际，孙权与周瑜、鲁肃决意抗曹，孙刘联盟形成。

steps.text: Winter 208: at Red Cliffs, Huang Gai feigns surrender and sails fire ships into Cao Cao's chained fleet. Sickness and the fire break the northern army.
steps.text_zh: 208年冬，两军相持于赤壁。黄盖诈降，以火船冲入曹军连在一起的战船，加上北军水土不服、疾疫流行，曹军大败。

steps.text: Cao Cao retreats north through the marshes of Huarong back to Jiangling and then the north, leaving Cao Ren to hold the line.
steps.text_zh: 曹操经华容道狼狈北撤，留曹仁守江陵，自己返回北方。

steps.text: Liu Bei takes the commanderies south of the Yangtze; Sun Quan keeps the lower river. Cao Cao never crosses the Yangtze again, and three states take shape.
steps.text_zh: 战后刘备取得荆州江南四郡，孙权稳守江东。曹操再未能渡江，三国鼎立的格局由此奠定。

title: Liu Bei takes Shu and Hanzhong
summary: Invited into Sichuan as a guest, Liu Bei takes the province from his host and then wins Hanzhong from Cao Cao.
summary_zh: 刘备以客军入蜀，反取益州，又从曹操手中夺下汉中，达到一生事业的顶峰。

steps.text: 211: afraid of Zhang Lu in Hanzhong, Liu Zhang, governor of Yi province, invites Liu Bei into Sichuan. Liu Bei leaves Zhuge Liang and Guan Yu in Jing province and is feasted by Liu Zhang at Fu for over a hundred days.
steps.text_zh: 211年，益州牧刘璋害怕汉中张鲁来攻，听从张松、法正之议，迎刘备入蜀。刘备留诸葛亮、关羽守荆州，率军西上，刘璋在涪城与他欢宴百余日。

steps.text: 212: sent north to Jiameng to face Zhang Lu, Liu Bei avoids battle and wins over the locals instead. When Liu Zhang discovers Zhang Song's plot and executes him, Liu Bei turns his army south against his host.
steps.text_zh: 212年，刘备北上葭萌防备张鲁，却按兵不战，广施恩德收买人心。刘璋发觉张松暗通刘备，将他处死，刘备随即翻脸，回师南下进攻刘璋。

steps.text: 214: Liu Zhang's son holds Luo for nearly a year. Pang Tong, Liu Bei's chief strategist alongside Zhuge Liang, is killed by a stray arrow leading an assault on the walls, aged thirty-six.
steps.text_zh: 214年，刘璋之子刘循坚守雒城近一年。与诸葛亮齐名的军师庞统率众攻城，被流矢射中身亡，年仅三十六岁。雒城到这年夏天才被攻破。

steps.text: 214: Zhuge Liang, Zhang Fei and Zhao Yun come up the Yangzi from Jing province. At Jiangzhou Zhang Fei captures the old general Yan Yan, who refuses to bow, and Zhang Fei releases him in admiration.
steps.text_zh: 214年，诸葛亮与张飞、赵云率军从荆州溯江西上。张飞攻破江州，俘获老将严颜，严颜宁死不屈，张飞敬佩其气节，亲自为他松绑，以礼相待。

steps.text: 214: the armies join around Chengdu, and the famous general Ma Chao comes over to Liu Bei. After a siege of some weeks Liu Zhang opens the gates and Liu Bei becomes governor of Yi province.
steps.text_zh: 214年，各路大军会师围攻成都，名将马超也来投奔，城中震恐。围城数十日后刘璋出城投降，刘备自领益州牧，终于有了自己的根据地。

steps.text: 215: Cao Cao storms Yangping Pass and Zhang Lu surrenders. Hanzhong, the northern gate of Sichuan, is in Cao's hands; he leaves Xiahou Yuan and Zhang He to hold it.
steps.text_zh: 215年，曹操攻破阳平关，张鲁投降，汉中归曹。汉中是蜀地的北大门，蜀中为之震动。曹操留夏侯渊、张郃镇守，自己返回北方。
