steps.text_zh: 1911年4月，黄兴率敢死队攻打广州两广总督衙门，激战后失败。事后收殓的七十二位烈士葬在黄花岗，革命声势反而大振。

steps.text: May 1911: the court nationalises the privately funded Sichuan railway to pledge it for foreign loans. Sichuan rises in protest; after a massacre in Chengdu in September, Hubei's New Army is sent in.
steps.text_zh: 1911年5月，清廷宣布铁路国有，把民间集资的川汉铁路收回抵押借款，四川各界组织保路同志会。9月成都发生血案，清廷调湖北新军入川镇压。

steps.text: October 1911: a bomb goes off by accident in a Hankou safehouse and the members' list is seized. On the night of the 10th the engineers of the Wuchang New Army rise early, take Wuchang, then Hanyang and Hankou.
steps.text_zh: 1911年10月，革命党人在汉口制造炸弹时意外爆炸，名册落入官府手中。10日晚武昌新军工程营被迫提前起义，次日占领武昌，汉阳、汉口随即光复。

steps.text: 22 October 1911: Changsha in Hunan and Xi'an in Shaanxi declare independence on the same day. Jiangxi, Shanxi, Yunnan, Guizhou and others follow, and Qing rule crumbles.
steps.text_zh: 1911年10月22日，湖南长沙和陕西西安同一天宣布独立。此后江西、山西、云南、贵州等省接连响应，清朝的统治迅速瓦解。

steps.text: Early November 1911: Chen Qimei's men seize Shanghai, and Jiangsu and Zhejiang declare for the revolution. The rich southeast is now on the revolutionary side.
steps.text_zh: 1911年11月初，陈其美等在上海发动起义，光复上海，随后江苏、浙江也宣布独立，东南财富之区转向革命。

steps.text: 1 January 1912: Sun Yat-sen takes office as provisional president in Nanjing, which Jiangsu and Zhejiang forces had captured in early December. Delegates of seventeen provinces had elected him.
steps.text_zh: 1912年1月1日，孙中山在南京就任临时大总统。此前江浙联军已于12月初攻克南京，十七省代表选举孙中山，南京成为民国首都。

steps.text: 12 February 1912: after north-south talks, the court accepts Yuan Shikai's terms of favourable treatment and abdicates. Sun resigns the next day, and Yuan becomes provisional president in Beijing.
steps.text_zh: 1912年2月12日，经南北议和，清廷在袁世凯安排下接受优待条件，宣布退位。次日孙中山辞职，袁世凯随后在北京就任临时大总统。

title: Kush and Aksum
summary: Three thousand years of African kingdoms on the Nile and the Red Sea: Kerma, the Nubian pharaohs of Kush, Meroë and Christian Aksum.
summary_zh: 尼罗河与红海之滨三千年的非洲王国：克尔玛、统治埃及的努比亚法老、麦罗埃，以及皈依基督教的阿克苏姆。

steps.text: About 2500 BC: at Kerma, by the Nile's third cataract, a Nubian people grow rich on cattle, gold and trade with Egypt. Kerma becomes the first kingdom of Kush, with a vast mud-brick temple, the Deffufa.
steps.text_zh: 约前2500年，在尼罗河第三瀑布附近的克尔玛，努比亚人靠牧牛、黄金和与埃及的贸易致富。克尔玛后来发展为第一个库施王国，留下巨大的泥砖神庙“德富法”。

steps.text: 1504 BC: Pharaoh Thutmose I marches south and sacks Kerma. For five centuries Nubia is ruled as an Egyptian province, and its people take up Egyptian gods and writing.
steps.text_zh: 前1504年，法老图特摩斯一世南征，攻破克尔玛。此后约五百年，努比亚成为埃及的行省，当地人接受了埃及的神祇和文字。

steps.text: About 785 BC: as Egypt splinters, a new line of Kushite kings rises at Napata, beneath the sacred mountain of Jebel Barkal, home of the god Amun.
steps.text_zh: 约前785年，埃及陷入分裂，一支新的库施王系在纳帕塔兴起。他们在阿蒙神的圣山博尔戈尔山下建都。

steps.text: 727 BC: King Piye of Kush sails north and takes Memphis. His family rules all of Egypt as the 25th Dynasty, black pharaohs from the Sudan to the Mediterranean.
steps.text_zh: 前727年，库施国王皮耶挥师北上，攻占孟菲斯。他的家族作为第二十五王朝统治整个埃及，疆域从苏丹直抵地中海。

steps.text: About 300 BC: the royal center moves south to Meroë, a city of iron furnaces and steep pyramids. Kush soon writes its own language in a new Meroitic script.
steps.text_zh: 约前300年，王都南迁至麦罗埃，城中炼铁炉林立，金字塔陡峭密集。库施不久创造了书写本族语言的麦罗埃文字。

steps.text: 25 BC: the one-eyed queen Amanirenas of Meroë raids Roman Egypt and fights Augustus's legions to a draw; in the peace that follows, Rome drops its demand for tribute.
steps.text_zh: 前25年，麦罗埃独眼女王阿玛尼雷纳斯袭击罗马治下的埃及，与奥古斯都的军团相持不下。此后议和，罗马放弃了征收贡赋的要求。

steps.text: About 100: in the Ethiopian highlands, Aksum grows rich by sending ivory, gold and incense out through the Red Sea port of Adulis. It becomes a great trading power between Rome and India.
steps.text_zh: 约100年，埃塞俄比亚高原上的阿克苏姆通过红海港口阿杜利斯输出象牙、黄金和香料，日渐富强，成为罗马与印度之间的贸易大国。

steps.text: About 330: King Ezana becomes a Christian, making Aksum one of the first Christian states in the world. On his coins the crescent moon gives way to the cross.
steps.text_zh: 约330年，阿克苏姆国王埃扎纳皈依基督教，阿克苏姆成为世界上最早的基督教国家之一。他的钱币上，新月图案换成了十字架。

steps.text: About 350: Ezana's army marches down into the Nile valley. Meroë, already in decline, falls, and the long history of Kush comes to an end.
steps.text_zh: 约350年，埃扎纳率军进入尼罗河谷，本已衰落的麦罗埃陷落，库施王国的漫长历史就此终结。

steps.text: 615: early followers of Muhammad, persecuted in Mecca, cross the Red Sea and are sheltered by the Christian king of Aksum, the first hijra of Islam.
steps.text_zh: 615年，在麦加受迫害的穆罕默德早期追随者渡过红海，得到阿克苏姆基督教国王的庇护，史称伊斯兰教的“第一次迁徙”。

title: Empires of gold: Ghana, Mali, Songhai
title_zh: 黄金帝国：加纳、马里、桑海
summary: Gold and salt across the Sahara built three great empires in West Africa, from Sundiata's Mali and Mansa Musa's pilgrimage to the fall of Songhai.
summary_zh: 穿越撒哈拉的黄金与食盐贸易在西非孕育了三大帝国，从松迪亚塔建立马里、曼萨·穆萨朝觐，到桑海帝国覆灭。

steps.text: 1076: Ghana, the 'land of gold' whose kings had long taxed the gold and salt caravans across the Sahara, is attacked by the Almoravids from the north and begins to break apart.
steps.text_zh: 1076年，长期向撒哈拉商队征收黄金与食盐税的“黄金之国”加纳，遭到北方阿尔摩拉维德人的进攻，从此逐渐瓦解。

steps.text: 1235: at Kirina, the Mande prince Sundiata Keita defeats Sumanguru of the Sosso and founds the Mali Empire. Griots still sing his story today.
steps.text_zh: 1235年，曼丁王子松迪亚塔·凯塔在基里纳击败索索国王苏曼古鲁，建立马里帝国。他的事迹至今仍由格里奥说唱艺人传唱。

steps.text: 1236: at Kouroukan Fouga the Mande clans agree a charter for the new empire, setting out the duties of each clan and protections for ordinary people.
steps.text_zh: 1236年，曼丁各氏族在库鲁坎富加订立帝国宪章，规定各氏族的职责，并保护普通人的权利。

steps.text: 1324: Mansa Musa of Mali passes through Cairo on his pilgrimage to Mecca with thousands of followers and so much gold that its price there falls for years.
steps.text_zh: 1324年，马里国王曼萨·穆萨前往麦加朝觐，率数千随从途经开罗，挥洒的黄金之多，使开罗金价多年低迷。

steps.text: 1327: back home, Musa has the Djinguereber Mosque built in Timbuktu, which grows into a great center of trade and Islamic learning.
steps.text_zh: 1327年，曼萨·穆萨回国后在廷巴克图兴建津加里贝尔清真寺。廷巴克图逐渐成为商业重镇和伊斯兰学术中心。

steps.text: 1352: the Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta reaches the court of Mali. He praises the safety of its roads, where a stranger's goods are never stolen.
steps.text_zh: 1352年，摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰来到马里宫廷。他称赞这里道路安全，外乡人的财物从不会被偷盗。

steps.text: 1464: Sonni Ali becomes king at Gao and builds Songhai into an empire with cavalry and a river fleet on the Niger, taking Timbuktu from the Tuareg in 1468.
steps.text_zh: 1464年，索尼·阿里在加奥即位，依靠骑兵和尼日尔河上的船队把桑海建成帝国，并于1468年从图阿雷格人手中夺取廷巴克图。

steps.text: 1493: Askia Muhammad seizes power and rules the largest of the Sahel empires, with Timbuktu's scholars and libraries at its heart.
steps.text_zh: 1493年，阿斯基亚·穆罕默德夺取政权，统治萨赫勒地区最辽阔的帝国，廷巴克图的学者和藏书是帝国的文化中心。

steps.text: 1591: a Moroccan army armed with guns crosses the Sahara and routs the Songhai at Tondibi. The empire collapses, ending the age of the great Sahel empires.
steps.text_zh: 1591年，携带火枪的摩洛哥军队穿越撒哈拉，在通迪比击溃桑海军队。桑海帝国崩溃，萨赫勒大帝国的时代就此结束。

title: The Swahili coast and Great Zimbabwe
title_zh: 斯瓦希里海岸与大津巴布韦
summary: The monsoon linked East Africa to Arabia, India and China: Swahili trading cities, the gold of Great Zimbabwe, then Portuguese guns and Omani sultans.
summary_zh: 季风把东非与阿拉伯、印度和中国连在一起：斯瓦希里商业城邦、大津巴布韦的黄金，以及后来的葡萄牙枪炮和阿曼苏丹。

steps.text: About 800: in towns along the East African coast, Swahili merchants trade ivory and gold with Arab and Persian ships that ride the monsoon winds, and many turn to Islam.
steps.text_zh: 约800年，东非沿岸城镇的斯瓦希里商人与乘季风而来的阿拉伯和波斯商船交易象牙和黄金，许多人皈依了伊斯兰教。

steps.text: 957: by tradition, a prince from Shiraz founds the sultanate of Kilwa. Kilwa later controls the gold trade of the southern coast and mints its own coins.
steps.text_zh: 957年，据传一位来自设拉子的王子建立了基尔瓦苏丹国。基尔瓦后来控制了南部海岸的黄金贸易，还铸造了自己的钱币。

steps.text: About 1075: inland, Mapungubwe on the Limpopo becomes southern Africa's first kingdom. Its rulers are buried with golden rhinos and glass beads from the Indian Ocean trade.
steps.text_zh: 约1075年，内陆林波波河畔的马蓬古布韦成为南部非洲第一个王国，统治者的墓中随葬金犀牛和来自印度洋贸易的玻璃珠。

steps.text: About 1100: Great Zimbabwe rises. Its kings control the gold fields and build massive dry stone walls, and their gold flows to Kilwa and across the ocean.
steps.text_zh: 约1100年，大津巴布韦兴起。国王控制着金矿，用不加灰浆的石块砌起巨大城墙，黄金经基尔瓦运往大洋彼岸。

steps.text: 1418: Zheng He's treasure fleet reaches the Swahili coast. Malindi had already sent a giraffe to the Ming emperor, hailed in China as a qilin.
steps.text_zh: 1418年，郑和船队到访斯瓦希里海岸。此前马林迪已向明朝皇帝进贡长颈鹿，在中国被当作祥瑞“麒麟”。

steps.text: 1498: Vasco da Gama reaches Malindi, whose sultan gives him a pilot to cross to India. Portugal has found the sea route around Africa.
steps.text_zh: 1498年，达·伽马抵达马林迪，当地苏丹为他提供领航员横渡印度洋。葡萄牙由此打通了绕过非洲的航路。

steps.text: 1505: Portuguese fleets sack Kilwa and Mombasa to seize the gold trade. The proud Swahili cities never fully recover.
steps.text_zh: 1505年，葡萄牙舰队洗劫基尔瓦和蒙巴萨，夺取黄金贸易。繁华的斯瓦希里城邦从此一蹶不振。

steps.text: 1698: after a siege of nearly three years, Omani Arabs take Fort Jesus in Mombasa and drive the Portuguese from the coast north of Mozambique.
steps.text_zh: 1698年，阿曼阿拉伯人围攻近三年后攻占蒙巴萨的耶稣堡，把葡萄牙人逐出莫桑比克以北的海岸。

steps.text: 1840: Sultan Said of Oman moves his capital to Zanzibar, which grows rich on cloves and on caravans bringing ivory and slaves from the interior.
steps.text_zh: 1840年，阿曼苏丹赛义德迁都桑给巴尔。桑给巴尔靠丁香种植园和从内陆运来象牙与奴隶的商队致富。

title: The Atlantic slave trade
summary: From the first Portuguese fort on the Gold Coast to British abolition, the trade that carried some 12 million Africans to the Americas and reshaped West and Central Africa.
summary_zh: 从黄金海岸第一座葡萄牙城堡到英国废除奴隶贸易，这场贸易把约一千二百万非洲人运往美洲，也重塑了西非和中非。

steps.text: 1482: the Portuguese build São Jorge da Mina on the Gold Coast, the first European fort in tropical Africa. Built to buy gold, it later holds captives for the ships.
steps.text_zh: 1482年，葡萄牙人在黄金海岸修建圣乔治达米纳城堡（埃尔米纳），这是欧洲人在热带非洲的第一座要塞。它起初用来收购黄金，后来成为关押奴隶的地方。

steps.text: 1509: Afonso I takes the throne of Kongo. A devout Catholic, he trades with Portugal, but soon writes to Lisbon begging it to stop the slavers carrying off his people.
steps.text_zh: 1509年，阿方索一世成为刚果国王。他笃信天主教，与葡萄牙通商，但不久便致信里斯本，恳请制止奴隶贩子掳走他的臣民。

steps.text: 1526: slave ships begin sailing directly from Africa to the Americas. Over three and a half centuries about 12.5 million Africans are shipped across the Atlantic.
steps.text_zh: 1526年，奴隶船开始从非洲直航美洲。此后三个半世纪里，约一千二百五十万非洲人被运过大西洋。

steps.text: 1624: Queen Nzinga takes power in Ndongo and fights the Portuguese for decades, allying with the Dutch and building a new kingdom in Matamba.
steps.text_zh: 1624年，恩津加女王在恩东戈掌权，与葡萄牙人周旋数十年，曾联合荷兰人，并在马坦巴另建王国。

steps.text: About 1700: the trade nears its peak. From ports such as Bonny in the Bight of Biafra, captives are chained below deck for the Middle Passage, and many die at sea.
steps.text_zh: 约1700年，奴隶贸易接近顶峰。在比夫拉湾的邦尼等港口，被掳者被锁在船舱底层横渡大西洋，即“中间航程”，许多人死于途中。

steps.text: 1701: Osei Tutu unites the Asante around the Golden Stool and defeats Denkyira. The Asante Empire grows strong trading gold and captives for guns.
steps.text_zh: 1701年，奥塞·图图以“金凳子”为象征统一阿散蒂各部，击败登基拉。阿散蒂帝国用黄金和俘虏换取枪支，日益强盛。

steps.text: 1727: King Agaja of Dahomey seizes the port of Ouidah, and Dahomey becomes one of the chief suppliers of the slave ships.
steps.text_zh: 1727年，达荷美国王阿加扎攻占维达港，达荷美从此成为奴隶船的主要供货者之一。

steps.text: 1792: about 1,200 Black Loyalists from Nova Scotia, freed for fighting for Britain in the American war, found Freetown in Sierra Leone.
steps.text_zh: 1792年，约一千二百名曾为英国参加北美独立战争而获得自由的黑人效忠派，从新斯科舍来到塞拉利昂，建立弗里敦。

steps.text: 1807: Britain bans the slave trade, and Freetown becomes the base of the naval squadron that hunts slave ships, though the trade goes on for decades.
steps.text_zh: 1807年，英国废除奴隶贸易，弗里敦成为海军巡逻队搜捕奴隶船的基地，但奴隶贸易此后仍延续了数十年。

title: Zulu, Boers and Britons
title_zh: 祖鲁人、布尔人与英国人
summary: Two and a half centuries of struggle for southern Africa, from the Dutch supply station at the Cape to the Zulu kingdom, the Great Trek, diamonds, gold and the Boer War.
summary_zh: 南部非洲两个半世纪的争夺：从开普的荷兰补给站，到祖鲁王国、布尔人大迁徙、钻石与黄金，再到布尔战争。

steps.text: 1652: Jan van Riebeeck sets up a supply station at the Cape for the Dutch East India Company. Settlers soon push onto the grazing lands of the Khoikhoi.
steps.text_zh: 1652年，范里贝克为荷兰东印度公司在开普建立补给站。殖民者很快侵占了科伊科伊人的牧场。

steps.text: 1779: on the Fish River frontier, settlers and the Xhosa fight the first of nine wars over cattle and land that last for a century.
steps.text_zh: 1779年，在鱼河边境，殖民者与科萨人为争夺牛群和土地爆发第一次战争。此后百年间双方共交战九次。

steps.text: 1816: Shaka becomes chief of the Zulu and remakes their army with short stabbing spears and age regiments, building a powerful kingdom in a few years.
steps.text_zh: 1816年，恰卡成为祖鲁首领，以短刺矛和年龄军团改造军队，几年间建立起强大的祖鲁王国。

steps.text: 1835: angry at British rule and the end of slavery, thousands of Boers leave the Cape in ox wagons and trek inland, later founding the Transvaal and Orange Free State.
steps.text_zh: 1835年，不满英国统治和废除奴隶制的数千名布尔人赶着牛车离开开普，向内陆迁徙，后来建立了德兰士瓦和奥兰治自由邦。

steps.text: 1867: diamonds are found near Kimberley. Britain annexes the fields, and the 'Big Hole' draws diggers from around the world.
steps.text_zh: 1867年，金伯利附近发现钻石。英国吞并了钻石产区，“大洞”吸引了世界各地的淘金者。

steps.text: 1879: at Isandlwana a Zulu army wipes out a British column, Britain's worst defeat by an African army. Months later Britain burns the Zulu capital, Ulundi.
steps.text_zh: 1879年，祖鲁军队在伊散德尔瓦纳全歼一支英军纵队，这是英军败给非洲军队最惨重的一次。数月后英军焚毁祖鲁首都乌伦迪。

steps.text: 1886: gold is found on the Witwatersrand in the Boer Transvaal. Johannesburg springs up almost overnight, and British miners flood in.
steps.text_zh: 1886年，布尔人的德兰士瓦境内威特沃特斯兰德发现金矿。约翰内斯堡几乎一夜之间兴起，大批英国矿工涌入。

steps.text: 1899: Britain and the Boer republics go to war over the goldfields. Britain wins in 1902 after burning farms and holding Boer and African families in deadly camps.
steps.text_zh: 1899年，英国与布尔人共和国为争夺金矿开战。英军焚烧农庄，把布尔人和非洲人家庭关进死亡率极高的集中营，于1902年获胜。

title: The Scramble for Africa
summary: In barely twenty years Europe carved up almost the whole continent. Africans fought back, and Ethiopia alone kept its freedom.
summary_zh: 短短二十年间，欧洲列强瓜分了几乎整个非洲大陆。非洲人奋起抵抗，只有埃塞俄比亚保住了独立。

steps.text: 1884: in Berlin, European powers meet to set rules for claiming Africa. No African is invited; within twenty years nearly the whole continent is colonized.
steps.text_zh: 1884年，欧洲列强在柏林开会，制定瓜分非洲的规则，没有一个非洲人受邀。此后二十年内，非洲几乎全部沦为殖民地。

steps.text: 1885: King Leopold II of Belgium takes the Congo as his private property. Forced labour for rubber, with hostages and severed hands, kills millions.
steps.text_zh: 1885年，比利时国王利奥波德二世把刚果据为私产。为采集橡胶而实行的强迫劳动，伴随着扣押人质和砍手，致使数百万人死亡。

steps.text: 1885: in Sudan the forces of the Mahdi storm Khartoum and kill the British general Gordon. The Mahdist state rules Sudan for thirteen years.
steps.text_zh: 1885年，苏丹马赫迪的军队攻破喀土穆，杀死英国将军戈登。马赫迪国统治苏丹达十三年。

steps.text: 1896: at Adwa, Emperor Menelik II of Ethiopia crushes an invading Italian army. Ethiopia stays independent and becomes a symbol of African freedom.
steps.text_zh: 1896年，埃塞俄比亚皇帝孟尼利克二世在阿杜瓦大败入侵的意大利军队。埃塞俄比亚保住独立，成为非洲自由的象征。

steps.text: 1898: at Omdurman, Kitchener's machine guns kill about 10,000 Mahdist soldiers in a morning, and Britain takes Sudan.
steps.text_zh: 1898年，在恩图曼，基钦纳的机枪在一个上午打死约一万名马赫迪军士兵，英国占领苏丹。

steps.text: 1904: the Herero and Nama rise against German rule in South West Africa. The German army drives them into the desert to die, the first genocide of the 20th century.
steps.text_zh: 1904年，德属西南非洲的赫雷罗人和纳马人起义反抗。德军把他们驱入沙漠任其死去，这是20世纪第一场种族灭绝。

steps.text: 1905: in German East Africa, peoples forced to grow cotton rise in the Maji Maji revolt, trusting in sacred water to turn bullets. Famine and war kill perhaps 200,000.
steps.text_zh: 1905年，德属东非被强迫种植棉花的各族发动马及马及起义，相信圣水能挡子弹。战乱和饥荒造成约二十万人死亡。

steps.text: 1935: Mussolini's Italy invades Ethiopia with tanks and poison gas. Emperor Haile Selassie appeals to the League of Nations, which does almost nothing.
steps.text_zh: 1935年，墨索里尼的意大利以坦克和毒气入侵埃塞俄比亚。皇帝海尔·塞拉西向国际联盟求援，国联却几乎毫无作为。

title: Independence and the end of apartheid
title_zh: 非洲独立与种族隔离的终结
summary: From Ghana's freedom in 1957 to Mandela's election in 1994: how Africa won independence, and the hard years that followed.
summary_zh: 从1957年加纳独立到1994年曼德拉当选总统：非洲如何赢得独立，以及独立后的艰难岁月。

steps.text: 1948: the National Party wins power in South Africa and builds apartheid, a legal system of racial separation that classifies every person by race.
steps.text_zh: 1948年，国民党在南非上台，建立种族隔离制度，以法律把每个人按种族分类并强制隔离。

steps.text: 1952: in Kenya the Mau Mau rise against British settlers who hold the best land. Britain crushes the revolt, but the cost speeds Kenya's independence.
steps.text_zh: 1952年，肯尼亚茅茅起义爆发，矛头指向占据最好土地的英国移民。英国镇压了起义，但沉重代价加快了肯尼亚独立。

steps.text: 1957: the Gold Coast becomes independent as Ghana, the first colony south of the Sahara to win freedom. Kwame Nkrumah declares Ghana 'free forever'.
steps.text_zh: 1957年，黄金海岸独立，改名加纳，成为撒哈拉以南第一个获得独立的殖民地。恩克鲁玛宣告：“加纳永远自由了！”

steps.text: 1960: the Year of Africa, when seventeen countries win independence. In Congo, Prime Minister Patrice Lumumba is overthrown and murdered within months.
steps.text_zh: 1960年被称为“非洲独立年”，十七个国家获得独立。在刚果，总理卢蒙巴就职仅数月即被推翻并遇害。

steps.text: 1960: at Sharpeville, South African police fire on a crowd protesting the pass laws, killing 69. The ANC is banned and turns to armed struggle.
steps.text_zh: 1960年，南非警察在沙佩维尔向抗议通行证法的人群开枪，打死69人。非洲人国民大会被取缔，转向武装斗争。

steps.text: 1963: thirty-two African states found the Organisation of African Unity in Addis Ababa to end colonialism and settle disputes among themselves.
steps.text_zh: 1963年，三十二个非洲国家在亚的斯亚贝巴成立非洲统一组织，致力于消灭殖民主义并协调成员国间的争端。

steps.text: 1967: the southeast of Nigeria breaks away as Biafra. In the war and blockade that follow, a million or more people die, many of hunger.
steps.text_zh: 1967年，尼日利亚东南部宣布独立，成立“比夫拉共和国”。随后的战争和封锁造成一百万以上的人死亡，许多人死于饥饿。

steps.text: 1976: schoolchildren in Soweto march against being taught in Afrikaans. Police open fire, and the uprising spreads across South Africa.
steps.text_zh: 1976年，索韦托的中学生游行反对强制以阿非利卡语授课，警察开枪镇压，起义随即蔓延至南非全境。

steps.text: 1990: Nelson Mandela walks free after 27 years in prison, and talks begin to dismantle apartheid.
steps.text_zh: 1990年，被囚禁27年的纳尔逊·曼德拉获释，废除种族隔离的谈判随即展开。

steps.text: 1994: in South Africa's first election open to all races, Mandela's ANC wins and he becomes president, a peaceful end to apartheid.
steps.text_zh: 1994年，南非举行首次不分种族的大选，非洲人国民大会获胜，曼德拉就任总统，种族隔离制度和平终结。

title: Mound builders and pueblos
summary: Long before Europeans arrived, the peoples of North America mined copper, raised great earthworks, dug desert canals and built a city at Cahokia.
summary_zh: 早在欧洲人到来之前，北美各民族就已开采铜矿、修筑巨大的土方工程、在沙漠中开凿水渠，并在卡霍基亚建起了城市。

steps.text: About 3000 BC: around the Great Lakes, people hammer pure native copper into spear points, knives and fishhooks, among the earliest metalworkers in the world.
steps.text_zh: 约前3000年，五大湖周围的居民把天然纯铜锤打成矛头、刀和鱼钩，他们是世界上最早的金属加工者之一。

steps.text: About 1700 BC: at Poverty Point in Louisiana, hunter-gatherers who do not farm build six huge curved earth ridges and great mounds, the center of a wide trade network.
steps.text_zh: 约前1700年，在路易斯安那的波弗蒂角，尚不务农的狩猎采集者筑起六道巨大的弧形土垄和高大土丘，这里是一个广阔贸易网的中心。

steps.text: About 800 BC: in the Ohio valley the Adena people bury their leaders in great earth mounds and begin to make pottery and grow garden crops.
steps.text_zh: 约前800年，俄亥俄河谷的阿德纳人用巨大的土丘埋葬首领，并开始制作陶器、种植园圃作物。

steps.text: About 100 BC: the Hopewell build geometric earthworks and trade across half the continent, bringing obsidian from the Rockies, shells from the Gulf and copper from Lake Superior.
steps.text_zh: 约前100年，霍普韦尔人修筑几何形土方工程，贸易范围遍及半个大陆，从落基山运来黑曜石，从墨西哥湾运来贝壳，从苏必利尔湖运来铜。

steps.text: About 300: in the Arizona desert the Hohokam dig hundreds of kilometres of irrigation canals to water maize, beans and cotton.
steps.text_zh: 约300年，亚利桑那沙漠中的霍霍坎人开凿数百公里灌溉渠，浇灌玉米、豆类和棉花。

steps.text: About 850: in Chaco Canyon, New Mexico, Ancestral Puebloans begin building 'great houses' of stone with hundreds of rooms, linked by straight roads.
steps.text_zh: 约850年，新墨西哥查科峡谷的古普韦布洛人开始用石块修建拥有数百个房间的“大屋”，并以笔直的道路相连。

steps.text: About 1050: Cahokia, near the Mississippi, grows into a city of perhaps 15,000 people around Monks Mound, the largest earthwork in the Americas, the heart of the Mississippian culture.
steps.text_zh: 约1050年，密西西比河畔的卡霍基亚发展为人口约一万五千的城市，中心是美洲最大的土丘“僧侣丘”，这里是密西西比文化的核心。

steps.text: About 1190: at Mesa Verde, Puebloans move into houses built under cliff overhangs. A great drought leads them to leave by about 1300.
steps.text_zh: 约1190年，梅萨维德的普韦布洛人迁入建在悬崖凹壁下的房屋。约1300年，一场大旱迫使他们离开。

steps.text: About 1450: five Iroquois nations, the Haudenosaunee, join under the Great Law of Peace, a league that will shape the history of the northeast for centuries.
steps.text_zh: 约1450年，易洛魁五个部族（豪德诺索尼人）依照“和平大法”结成联盟，此后数百年深刻影响了北美东北部的历史。

title: First Europeans in North America
summary: From a Norse camp in Newfoundland to Spanish expeditions and a lost English colony: the first century of European contact.
summary_zh: 从纽芬兰的诺斯人营地，到西班牙远征和失踪的英国殖民地：欧洲人接触北美的第一个世纪。

steps.text: About 1000: Norse sailors from Greenland, led by Leif Erikson, camp at L'Anse aux Meadows in Newfoundland. They call the land Vinland, but stay only a few years.
steps.text_zh: 约1000年，莱夫·埃里克松率领来自格陵兰的诺斯人在纽芬兰的兰塞奥兹牧草地扎营。他们把这片土地称为“文兰”，但只停留了几年。

steps.text: 1497: John Cabot, sailing for England, reaches Newfoundland and reports seas so thick with cod they can be scooped up in baskets.
steps.text_zh: 1497年，为英国效力的约翰·卡伯特抵达纽芬兰，报告说那里的海中鳕鱼多得用篮子就能捞起。

steps.text: 1513: the Spaniard Juan Ponce de León lands on a coast he names La Florida, the first recorded European landing in what is now the United States.
steps.text_zh: 1513年，西班牙人庞塞·德莱昂登上一片海岸，将其命名为“佛罗里达”，这是欧洲人在今美国境内有记载的首次登陆。

steps.text: 1534: Jacques Cartier plants a cross at Gaspé and claims the land for France. Next year he sails up the St. Lawrence to the Iroquoian towns at Quebec and Montreal.
steps.text_zh: 1534年，雅克·卡蒂埃在加斯佩竖起十字架，宣布此地归法国所有。次年他溯圣劳伦斯河而上，到达今魁北克和蒙特利尔一带的易洛魁人村镇。

steps.text: 1539: Hernando de Soto lands in Florida and spends four years wandering the Southeast in search of gold. His army and the diseases it carries devastate the Mississippian chiefdoms.
steps.text_zh: 1539年，德索托在佛罗里达登陆，此后四年在东南部四处寻找黄金。他的军队和带来的疾病使密西西比文化诸酋邦遭到毁灭性打击。

steps.text: 1540: Francisco Vázquez de Coronado marches north from Mexico looking for the Seven Cities of Gold. He finds only the Zuni pueblos, and goes on as far as Kansas.
steps.text_zh: 1540年，科罗纳多从墨西哥北上寻找“黄金七城”，却只找到祖尼人的村落，随后一直走到今堪萨斯。

steps.text: 1565: Spain founds St. Augustine in Florida, the oldest continuously inhabited European town in the United States.
steps.text_zh: 1565年，西班牙在佛罗里达建立圣奥古斯丁，这是今美国境内有人连续居住的最古老的欧洲人城镇。

steps.text: 1587: English settlers land on Roanoke Island, where Virginia Dare is born. When ships return in 1590, the colony has vanished, leaving only the word 'Croatoan'.
steps.text_zh: 1587年，英国移民登上罗阿诺克岛，弗吉尼亚·戴尔在此出生。1590年补给船返回时，整个殖民地已消失，只留下刻着的“Croatoan”一词。

title: Colonies and the fight for a continent
summary: English, French and Spanish colonies take root, clash with Native nations, and fight a final war that decides who rules North America.
summary_zh: 英国、法国和西班牙的殖民地在北美扎根，与原住民发生冲突，并通过一场决定性战争决定北美的归属。

steps.text: 1607: the Virginia Company founds Jamestown, the first lasting English colony. Most settlers die in the first years before tobacco makes it pay.
steps.text_zh: 1607年，弗吉尼亚公司建立詹姆斯敦，这是英国在北美的第一个永久殖民地。最初几年大多数移民死去，直到烟草种植让殖民地有利可图。

steps.text: 1608: Samuel de Champlain founds Quebec on the St. Lawrence, the heart of New France and its fur trade with Native allies.
steps.text_zh: 1608年，尚普兰在圣劳伦斯河畔建立魁北克城。这里成为新法兰西的中心，法国人在此与原住民盟友进行毛皮贸易。

steps.text: 1619: about twenty captive Africans are brought to Point Comfort in Virginia, the start of African slavery in the English colonies.
steps.text_zh: 1619年，约二十名被掳的非洲人被运到弗吉尼亚的康福特角，英属殖民地的非洲奴隶制由此开始。

steps.text: 1620: Pilgrims on the Mayflower sign a compact to govern themselves and found Plymouth. Wampanoag help them survive the first year.
steps.text_zh: 1620年，“五月花号”上的清教徒签订自治公约，建立普利茅斯殖民地。万帕诺亚格人帮助他们度过了第一年。

steps.text: 1675: the Wampanoag leader Metacom, called King Philip, leads Native nations against New England. It is, for its size, one of the bloodiest wars in American history.
steps.text_zh: 1675年，万帕诺亚格首领梅塔科姆（“菲利普王”）率各部族与新英格兰殖民者开战。按人口比例计算，这是美国历史上最血腥的战争之一。

steps.text: 1680: led by Popé, the Pueblo peoples rise together and drive the Spanish out of New Mexico for twelve years.
steps.text_zh: 1680年，在波佩的领导下，普韦布洛各族同时起义，将西班牙人逐出新墨西哥长达十二年。

steps.text: 1754: a young Virginian officer, George Washington, clashes with the French in the Ohio country, sparking a war that spreads into the global Seven Years' War.
steps.text_zh: 1754年，年轻的弗吉尼亚军官乔治·华盛顿在俄亥俄地区与法军交火，引发法国-印第安人战争，并扩大为全球性的七年战争。

steps.text: 1759: British troops climb the cliffs and defeat the French on the Plains of Abraham outside Quebec. In 1763 France gives up Canada.
steps.text_zh: 1759年，英军攀上悬崖，在魁北克城外的亚伯拉罕平原击败法军。1763年，法国被迫放弃加拿大。

title: The American Revolution
summary: Thirteen colonies go from protesting taxes to declaring independence, win a war with French help, and write a new constitution.
summary_zh: 北美十三个殖民地从抗议征税走向宣布独立，在法国帮助下赢得战争，并制定了一部新宪法。

steps.text: 1765: Britain taxes printed paper in the colonies with the Stamp Act. Delegates meet in New York and protest: no taxation without representation.
steps.text_zh: 1765年，英国颁布印花税法，对殖民地的印刷品征税。各殖民地代表在纽约集会抗议，提出“无代表，不纳税”。

steps.text: 1773: protesters disguised as Mohawks dump 342 chests of East India Company tea into Boston harbour. Britain answers by closing the port.
steps.text_zh: 1773年，装扮成莫霍克人的抗议者把东印度公司的342箱茶叶倒进波士顿港。英国随即下令封闭港口。

steps.text: 1775: British troops march out to seize arms at Concord and meet militia at Lexington. The first shots of the Revolutionary War are fired.
steps.text_zh: 1775年，英军前往康科德收缴军火，在莱克星顿与民兵遭遇，独立战争的第一枪就此打响。

steps.text: 1776: in Philadelphia the Continental Congress adopts Thomas Jefferson's Declaration of Independence: all men are created equal.
steps.text_zh: 1776年，大陆会议在费城通过杰斐逊起草的《独立宣言》，宣告“人人生而平等”。

steps.text: 1777: a British army under Burgoyne surrenders at Saratoga. The victory persuades France to join the war on the American side.
steps.text_zh: 1777年，伯戈因率领的英军在萨拉托加投降。这场胜利促使法国参战支持美国。

steps.text: 1781: trapped at Yorktown by Washington's army and a French fleet, Cornwallis surrenders, and Britain gives up the war.
steps.text_zh: 1781年，康沃利斯在约克镇被华盛顿的军队和法国舰队围困，被迫投降，英国放弃了战争。

steps.text: 1783: in the Treaty of Paris, Britain recognizes the United States, with borders reaching west to the Mississippi.
steps.text_zh: 1783年，英国在《巴黎条约》中承认美国独立，美国疆域向西延伸到密西西比河。

steps.text: 1787: delegates meet in Philadelphia and write the Constitution, creating a federal government with a president, Congress and courts that check one another.
steps.text_zh: 1787年，各州代表在费城召开制宪会议，制定宪法，建立总统、国会和法院相互制衡的联邦政府。

steps.text: 1789: George Washington takes the oath in New York as the first president of the United States.
steps.text_zh: 1789年，乔治·华盛顿在纽约宣誓就职，成为美国第一任总统。

title: Across the continent
summary: In less than a century the United States and Canada spread from the Atlantic to the Pacific, by purchase, canal, railroad and war, at a terrible cost to Native nations.
summary_zh: 不到一个世纪，美国和加拿大通过购地、运河、铁路和战争从大西洋扩张到太平洋，原住民为此付出了惨痛代价。

steps.text: 1803: Jefferson buys Louisiana from Napoleon for 15 million dollars, doubling the size of the United States overnight.
steps.text_zh: 1803年，杰斐逊以一千五百万美元从拿破仑手中买下路易斯安那，美国领土一夜之间扩大了一倍。

steps.text: 1805: Lewis and Clark, guided across the Rockies with help from the Shoshone woman Sacagawea, reach the Pacific at the mouth of the Columbia.
steps.text_zh: 1805年，刘易斯和克拉克在肖肖尼族女子萨卡加维亚的帮助下翻越落基山脉，抵达哥伦比亚河口的太平洋岸边。

steps.text: 1825: the Erie Canal links the Hudson to the Great Lakes. Freight costs drop by nine tenths, and New York becomes the nation's great port.
steps.text_zh: 1825年，伊利运河通航，连接哈得孙河与五大湖。货运成本下降九成，纽约成为全国最大的港口。

steps.text: 1838: the army forces the Cherokee out of Georgia and west to Indian Territory. About 4,000 die on the march known as the Trail of Tears.
steps.text_zh: 1838年，美国军队把切罗基人从佐治亚强行驱赶到西部的印第安领地，约四千人死于途中，史称“血泪之路”。

steps.text: 1848: gold is found at Sutter's Mill, just as California is taken from Mexico. Hundreds of thousands rush in, many from China.
steps.text_zh: 1848年，萨特磨坊发现黄金，恰在此时加利福尼亚从墨西哥割让给美国。数十万人蜂拥而至，其中许多来自中国。

steps.text: 1869: at Promontory, Utah, a golden spike joins the first transcontinental railroad, built in the west largely by Chinese workers.
steps.text_zh: 1869年，在犹他州的普罗蒙特里，一枚金道钉把第一条横贯大陆铁路连成一体。铁路西段主要由华工修建。

steps.text: 1876: Lakota and Cheyenne warriors under Sitting Bull and Crazy Horse wipe out Custer's cavalry at the Little Bighorn, but the army soon hunts them down.
steps.text_zh: 1876年，坐牛和疯马率领的拉科塔人和夏延人在小大角河全歼卡斯特的骑兵，但不久便遭到美军围剿。

steps.text: 1885: the last spike of the Canadian Pacific Railway is driven in British Columbia, binding the new Canadian Confederation from sea to sea.
steps.text_zh: 1885年，加拿大太平洋铁路在不列颠哥伦比亚钉下最后一枚道钉，把新成立的加拿大联邦从东海岸连到西海岸。

steps.text: 1890: soldiers massacre about 250 Lakota men, women and children at Wounded Knee, the end of the Indian wars on the Plains.
steps.text_zh: 1890年，美军在伤膝河屠杀约二百五十名拉科塔男女老幼，大平原上的印第安战争就此结束。

title: Civil War and Reconstruction
summary: Slavery splits the United States in two. Four years of war end it, and Reconstruction tries, then fails, to make freed people equal citizens.
summary_zh: 奴隶制问题使美国分裂。四年战争终结了奴隶制，重建时期试图让获得自由的黑人成为平等公民，最终半途而废。

steps.text: 1852: Harriet Beecher Stowe publishes Uncle Tom's Cabin. The novel sells hundreds of thousands of copies and turns many northerners against slavery.
steps.text_zh: 1852年，斯托夫人出版《汤姆叔叔的小屋》。小说销量达数十万册，使许多北方人转而反对奴隶制。

steps.text: 1860: Abraham Lincoln of Illinois, who opposes the spread of slavery, is elected president. Southern states begin to leave the Union.
steps.text_zh: 1860年，反对奴隶制扩张的伊利诺伊人亚伯拉罕·林肯当选总统，南方各州随即开始脱离联邦。

steps.text: 1861: Confederate guns fire on Fort Sumter in Charleston harbour, and the Civil War begins.
steps.text_zh: 1861年，南方邦联炮轰查尔斯顿港的萨姆特堡，南北战争爆发。

steps.text: 1863: Lincoln's Emancipation Proclamation declares slaves in the rebel states free, and Black soldiers begin to join the Union army.
steps.text_zh: 1863年，林肯发布《解放黑人奴隶宣言》，宣布叛乱各州的奴隶获得自由，黑人士兵开始加入联邦军。

steps.text: 1863: Lee's invasion of the North is stopped at Gettysburg after three days of fighting. Lincoln later honors the dead: government of the people, by the people, for the people.
steps.text_zh: 1863年，李将军进攻北方，在葛底斯堡激战三天后受挫。林肯随后在此发表演说：“民有、民治、民享的政府”。

steps.text: 1864: Sherman's army takes Atlanta and marches to the sea, wrecking the South's railways and farms and helping Lincoln win re-election.
steps.text_zh: 1864年，谢尔曼率军攻占亚特兰大，随后向海边进军，沿途摧毁南方的铁路和农庄，助林肯赢得连任。

steps.text: 1865: Lee surrenders to Grant at Appomattox Court House. About 620,000 soldiers have died, and the Thirteenth Amendment soon abolishes slavery.
steps.text_zh: 1865年，李将军在阿波马托克斯向格兰特投降。战争中约六十二万士兵死亡，不久宪法第十三修正案废除了奴隶制。

steps.text: 1865: five days later, Lincoln is shot at Ford's Theatre in Washington by the actor John Wilkes Booth.
steps.text_zh: 1865年，李将军投降五天后，林肯在华盛顿福特剧院被演员布斯枪杀。

steps.text: 1877: in a deal to settle a disputed election, federal troops leave the South. Reconstruction ends, and segregation and Jim Crow laws follow.
steps.text_zh: 1877年，为解决有争议的大选达成妥协，联邦军队撤出南方。重建时期结束，种族隔离的“吉姆·克劳法”随之而来。

title: The American century
summary: Two world wars, the Great Depression, the Cold War and the civil rights movement turn the United States into a superpower and change it at home.
summary_zh: 两次世界大战、大萧条、冷战和民权运动，使美国成为超级大国，也深刻改变了美国社会。

steps.text: 1917: after German submarines sink American ships, the United States enters the First World War, and two million troops sail for France.
steps.text_zh: 1917年，德国潜艇击沉美国船只后，美国加入第一次世界大战，两百万美军远赴法国。

steps.text: 1929: the Wall Street crash sets off the Great Depression. By 1933 a quarter of American workers have no job.
steps.text_zh: 1929年，华尔街股灾引发大萧条。到1933年，四分之一的美国工人失业。

steps.text: 1933: Franklin D. Roosevelt launches the New Deal, with relief, public works and later Social Security, greatly expanding the federal government.
steps.text_zh: 1933年，富兰克林·罗斯福推行新政，实施救济、兴办公共工程，后来又建立社会保障制度，联邦政府的职能大为扩展。

steps.text: 1941: Japan attacks the US fleet at Pearl Harbor in Hawaii, and the United States enters the Second World War.
steps.text_zh: 1941年，日本偷袭夏威夷珍珠港的美国舰队，美国加入第二次世界大战。

steps.text: 1942: the Manhattan Project begins. At Los Alamos, scientists build the atomic bomb, tested in July 1945 and dropped on Hiroshima and Nagasaki weeks later.
steps.text_zh: 1942年，曼哈顿计划启动。科学家在洛斯阿拉莫斯研制原子弹，1945年7月试爆成功，数周后投向广岛和长崎。

steps.text: 1955: Rosa Parks refuses to give up her bus seat in Montgomery, Alabama. The boycott that follows makes Martin Luther King Jr. a national leader.
steps.text_zh: 1955年，罗莎·帕克斯在阿拉巴马州蒙哥马利拒绝在公交车上让座。随后的抵制运动使马丁·路德·金成为全国性领袖。

steps.text: 1962: US spy planes find Soviet nuclear missiles in Cuba. For thirteen days the world stands at the brink of nuclear war, until Khrushchev agrees to withdraw them.
steps.text_zh: 1962年，美国侦察机发现苏联在古巴部署核导弹。世界在核战争边缘徘徊了十三天，最终赫鲁晓夫同意撤走导弹。

steps.text: 1963: at the March on Washington, King tells 250,000 people 'I have a dream'. The Civil Rights Act outlaws segregation the next year.
steps.text_zh: 1963年，马丁·路德·金在向华盛顿进军中向二十五万人发表《我有一个梦想》演说。次年，《民权法案》宣布种族隔离为非法。

steps.text: 1969: Apollo 11 lifts off from Florida, and Neil Armstrong becomes the first person to walk on the Moon, a victory in the space race with the Soviet Union.
steps.text_zh: 1969年，阿波罗11号从佛罗里达升空，尼尔·阿姆斯特朗成为第一个踏上月球的人，美国在与苏联的太空竞赛中胜出。

steps.text: 2001: al-Qaeda hijackers fly airliners into the World Trade Center and the Pentagon, killing nearly 3,000. The United States launches wars in Afghanistan and Iraq.
steps.text_zh: 2001年，基地组织劫持客机撞击世界贸易中心和五角大楼，造成近三千人死亡。美国随后发动阿富汗战争和伊拉克战争。

title: Maize, ballgames and the Olmecs
summary: How Mesoamerican civilization began: maize farming, the first ballcourts, the colossal heads of the Olmecs and the first writing of the Zapotecs.
summary_zh: 中美洲文明的起源：玉米种植、最早的球场、奥尔梅克的巨石人头像，以及萨波特克人最早的文字。

steps.text: About 3000 BC: in valleys such as Tehuacán, maize, bred over thousands of years from a wild grass called teosinte, becomes the staple food of Mesoamerica.
steps.text_zh: 约前3000年，在特瓦坎等河谷，人们用几千年时间从野生大刍草培育出的玉米，成为中美洲的主食。

steps.text: About 1650 BC: at Paso de la Amada on the Pacific coast, villagers build the oldest known ballcourt. The rubber-ball game will be played across Mesoamerica for 3,000 years.
steps.text_zh: 约前1650年，太平洋沿岸的帕索德拉阿马达村民修建了已知最早的球场。此后三千年，橡胶球赛风行整个中美洲。

steps.text: About 1600 BC: at the sacred spring of El Manatí, people offer rubber balls, the oldest ever found, along with jade axes.
steps.text_zh: 约前1600年，人们在埃尔马纳蒂的圣泉中献祭橡胶球和玉斧，这些橡胶球是迄今发现最古老的。

steps.text: About 1400 BC: San Lorenzo, on a raised plateau in the Gulf lowlands, becomes the first great center of the Olmecs, often called Mesoamerica's mother culture.
steps.text_zh: 约前1400年，墨西哥湾低地高台上的圣洛伦索成为奥尔梅克人的第一个大中心。奥尔梅克常被称为中美洲的“母文明”。

steps.text: About 1200 BC: Olmec sculptors carve colossal basalt heads of their rulers, some weighing over 20 tonnes, from stone hauled from the Tuxtla mountains.
steps.text_zh: 约前1200年，奥尔梅克雕刻家用从图斯特拉山运来的玄武岩雕出统治者的巨大头像，有的重逾二十吨。

steps.text: About 900 BC: La Venta becomes the leading Olmec center, with a great earthen pyramid and buried offerings of jade and serpentine.
steps.text_zh: 约前900年，拉文塔成为奥尔梅克的主要中心，建有巨大的土筑金字塔，地下埋藏着玉石和蛇纹石祭品。

steps.text: About 600 BC: in the Oaxaca valley a carved stone at San José Mogote bears a calendar name, among the earliest writing in the Americas.
steps.text_zh: 约前600年，瓦哈卡河谷圣何塞莫戈特的一块石刻上出现历法名字，这是美洲最早的文字之一。

steps.text: About 500 BC: the Zapotecs level a mountaintop and build their capital, Monte Albán, which rules the Oaxaca valley for over a thousand years.
steps.text_zh: 约前500年，萨波特克人削平山顶，建起都城阿尔班山，此后统治瓦哈卡河谷一千多年。

steps.text: About 400 BC: La Venta is abandoned and Olmec civilization fades, perhaps after river changes, but its gods, ballgame and art live on in later cultures.
steps.text_zh: 约前400年，拉文塔被废弃，奥尔梅克文明衰落，可能与河道改变有关。但它的神祇、球赛和艺术在后来的文明中延续下来。

title: The Classic Maya
summary: Kings, calendars and rival cities in the rainforest: the rise of Maya civilization, its great dynasties and its mysterious collapse.
summary_zh: 雨林中的国王、历法与城邦争霸：玛雅文明的兴起、伟大王朝及其神秘的崩溃。

steps.text: About 300 BC: El Mirador in the Guatemalan rainforest grows into a huge city; its La Danta pyramid is one of the largest buildings in the ancient world.
steps.text_zh: 约前300年，危地马拉雨林中的埃尔米拉多尔发展为巨大城市，其拉丹塔金字塔是古代世界体量最大的建筑之一。

steps.text: 36 BC: a monument at Chiapa de Corzo bears the earliest known Long Count date, the calendar the Maya use to record their history day by day.
steps.text_zh: 前36年，恰帕德科尔索的一块石碑上刻有已知最早的长纪历日期。玛雅人用这种历法逐日记录自己的历史。

steps.text: 378: Siyaj K'ak', a warlord from Teotihuacan, arrives at Tikal on the same day its king dies. A new dynasty tied to the great Mexican city takes power.
steps.text_zh: 378年，来自特奥蒂瓦坎的军事首领西亚赫·卡克抵达蒂卡尔，当天蒂卡尔国王死去，一个与特奥蒂瓦坎关系密切的新王朝随即掌权。

steps.text: 426: K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo' founds the royal dynasty of Copán, which rules for nearly 400 years and raises some of the finest Maya sculpture.
steps.text_zh: 426年，基尼奇·亚什·库克·莫建立科潘王朝。王朝延续近四百年，留下了玛雅最精美的一些石雕。

steps.text: 562: Caracol, allied with Calakmul's Snake kings, defeats Tikal. Tikal raises no dated monuments for over a century.
steps.text_zh: 562年，卡拉科尔与卡拉克穆尔的“蛇王朝”联手击败蒂卡尔。此后一百多年，蒂卡尔再未竖立刻有日期的石碑。

steps.text: 615: K'inich Janaab Pakal becomes king of Palenque at the age of twelve and rules for 68 years, rebuilding the city in splendour.
steps.text_zh: 615年，十二岁的巴加尔成为帕伦克国王，在位68年，把帕伦克重建得富丽堂皇。

steps.text: 683: Pakal dies and is buried in a hidden tomb inside the Temple of the Inscriptions, wearing a mask of jade. The tomb is found only in 1952.
steps.text_zh: 683年，巴加尔去世，戴着玉面具葬于铭文神庙内的秘密墓室。这座墓直到1952年才被发现。

steps.text: 790: painters at Bonampak cover three rooms with murals of battle, captives and court festivals, the most vivid picture of Maya life to survive.
steps.text_zh: 790年，博南帕克的画师在三间屋子里绘满了战争、俘虏和宫廷庆典的壁画，这是现存最生动的玛雅生活图景。

steps.text: About 800: the great cities of the southern lowlands begin to empty. Drought, war and exhausted land bring building to a halt; Tikal's last dated monument is from 869.
steps.text_zh: 约800年，南部低地的大城市开始衰落人空。干旱、战争和地力耗竭使建设停止，蒂卡尔最后一块刻有日期的石碑立于869年。

title: Teotihuacan and the Toltecs
title_zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎与托尔特克
summary: From the City of the Gods to Toltec Tula and Chichén Itzá: the great powers of central Mexico before the Aztecs.
summary_zh: 从“众神之城”特奥蒂瓦坎到托尔特克人的图拉和奇琴伊察：阿兹特克之前墨西哥中部的强国。

steps.text: About 100: at Teotihuacan the Pyramid of the Sun rises over a planned city that will grow to perhaps 100,000 people, one of the largest in the world.
steps.text_zh: 约100年，特奥蒂瓦坎建成太阳金字塔。这座经过规划的城市后来人口达到约十万，跻身世界最大城市之列。

steps.text: About 200: the Temple of the Feathered Serpent is built, with some 200 sacrificed warriors buried beneath it.
steps.text_zh: 约200年，羽蛇神庙建成，神庙下埋葬着约两百名献祭的武士。

steps.text: About 550: the palaces and temples along Teotihuacan's Avenue of the Dead are burned, perhaps in a revolt, and the great city declines.
steps.text_zh: 约550年，特奥蒂瓦坎“亡灵大道”两旁的宫殿和神庙被焚毁，可能源于一场暴动，这座大城从此衰落。

steps.text: About 900: on the Gulf coast El Tajín reaches its height, with its Pyramid of the Niches and some twenty ballcourts.
steps.text_zh: 约900年，墨西哥湾沿岸的埃尔塔欣达到鼎盛，建有壁龛金字塔和约二十座球场。

steps.text: About 900: Chichén Itzá becomes the leading power of Yucatán. Its warrior temples look strikingly like those of Tula, far away in central Mexico.
steps.text_zh: 约900年，奇琴伊察称雄尤卡坦半岛。它的武士神庙与远在墨西哥中部的图拉惊人相似。

steps.text: About 950: Tula becomes the capital of the Toltecs, guarded by stone warrior columns. The Aztecs later look back on the Toltecs as the source of all civilization.
steps.text_zh: 约950年，图拉成为托尔特克人的都城，城中矗立着石雕武士柱。后来的阿兹特克人把托尔特克人奉为一切文明的源头。

steps.text: About 1100: the Mixtec lord Eight Deer Jaguar Claw unites much of the Mixtec highlands by conquest; his deeds are painted in surviving codices.
steps.text_zh: 约1100年，米斯特克首领“八鹿美洲豹爪”通过征战统一了米斯特克高地的大部分地区，他的事迹记载在流传至今的抄本中。

steps.text: About 1150: Tula is sacked and burned, and the Toltec state breaks up, leaving central Mexico divided among rival towns.
steps.text_zh: 约1150年，图拉遭洗劫焚毁，托尔特克国家瓦解，墨西哥中部陷入诸城争雄的局面。

steps.text: About 1220: Mayapán replaces Chichén Itzá as the capital of northern Yucatán, ruling through a council of lords until about 1450.
steps.text_zh: 约1220年，玛雅潘取代奇琴伊察成为尤卡坦北部的都城，由贵族会议统治，直到约1450年。

title: The rise of the Aztecs
summary: Wandering newcomers found a city on a lake island and, in less than a century, build the greatest empire Mesoamerica had seen.
summary_zh: 一群外来的流浪者在湖岛上建城，不到一个世纪便建立起中美洲前所未有的大帝国。

steps.text: About 1250: the Mexica, latecomers from the north who say they come from Aztlan, reach the Valley of Mexico and settle at Chapultepec, despised by their neighbours.
steps.text_zh: 约1250年，自称来自阿兹特兰的墨西加人从北方迁入墨西哥谷地，在查普尔特佩克落脚，受到邻族的轻视。

steps.text: About 1300: to the west, the Purépecha found the Tarascan state around Lake Pátzcuaro. Skilled in metalwork, it will defeat every Aztec attempt to conquer it.
steps.text_zh: 约1300年，西边的普雷佩查人在帕茨夸罗湖周围建立塔拉斯坎国。他们擅长金属冶炼，后来多次击退阿兹特克人的进攻。

steps.text: 1325: by legend, the Mexica see an eagle on a cactus on an island in Lake Texcoco and found Tenochtitlan there. The image is on Mexico's flag today.
steps.text_zh: 1325年，相传墨西加人在特斯科科湖的小岛上看见一只雄鹰立在仙人掌上，于是在此建立特诺奇蒂特兰。这一图案至今仍在墨西哥国旗上。

steps.text: 1428: Tenochtitlan joins Texcoco and Tlacopan in a Triple Alliance, overthrows its Tepanec overlords and becomes the core of the Aztec Empire.
steps.text_zh: 1428年，特诺奇蒂特兰与特斯科科、特拉科潘结成三城同盟，推翻特帕内克霸主，成为阿兹特克帝国的核心。

steps.text: 1440: Moctezuma I takes the throne and leads conquests to the Gulf coast, bringing in tribute of cotton, cacao and feathers.
steps.text_zh: 1440年，蒙特祖马一世即位，率军远征至墨西哥湾沿岸，各地进贡棉布、可可和羽毛。

steps.text: About 1450: after a terrible famine, the Aztecs begin ritual 'flower wars' with Tlaxcala and its neighbours, fought to take captives for sacrifice.
steps.text_zh: 约1450年，一场大饥荒之后，阿兹特克人开始与特拉斯卡拉等城邦进行“荣冠战争”，目的是俘获献祭的人牲。

steps.text: 1487: the rebuilt Great Temple of Tenochtitlan is dedicated, with shrines to the war god Huitzilopochtli and the rain god Tlaloc and thousands of sacrifices.
steps.text_zh: 1487年，重建的特诺奇蒂特兰大神庙落成，供奉战神维齐洛波奇特利和雨神特拉洛克，并举行了大规模人祭。

steps.text: 1502: Moctezuma II becomes ruler of an empire of some 5 million people. Tenochtitlan, with its causeways and canals, is one of the largest cities on Earth.
steps.text_zh: 1502年，蒙特祖马二世成为统治约五百万人口帝国的君主。有堤道与运河的特诺奇蒂特兰是当时世界上最大的城市之一。

title: The fall of the Aztec Empire
summary: Hernán Cortés, a few hundred Spaniards, tens of thousands of Native allies and an epidemic bring down Tenochtitlan in two years.
summary_zh: 埃尔南·科尔特斯带着几百名西班牙人、数万原住民盟军，加上一场瘟疫，在两年内攻灭了特诺奇蒂特兰。

steps.text: 1519: Hernán Cortés lands on the Gulf coast with about 500 men, founds Veracruz and scuttles his ships so no one can turn back.
steps.text_zh: 1519年，埃尔南·科尔特斯率约五百人在墨西哥湾沿岸登陆，建立韦拉克鲁斯，并凿沉船只，断绝退路。

steps.text: 1519: after fierce battles, Tlaxcala, the bitter enemy of the Aztecs, makes an alliance with the Spaniards. Its warriors become the backbone of the conquest.
steps.text_zh: 1519年，经过几场激战，阿兹特克人的宿敌特拉斯卡拉与西班牙人结盟，其战士成为征服战争的主力。

steps.text: 1519: at Cholula, the holy city of the feathered serpent, Cortés and his allies massacre thousands of unarmed people, fearing an ambush.
steps.text_zh: 1519年，在供奉羽蛇神的圣城乔卢拉，科尔特斯和盟军以防伏击为名屠杀了数千名手无寸铁的居民。

steps.text: 1519: Moctezuma II welcomes Cortés into Tenochtitlan in November. Within days the Spaniards take him hostage in his own palace.
steps.text_zh: 1519年11月，蒙特祖马二世迎接科尔特斯进入特诺奇蒂特兰。没过几天，西班牙人便在王宫中将他扣为人质。

steps.text: 1520: after a massacre at a festival, the city rises. Moctezuma is killed, and on the 'Night of Sorrows' the Spaniards flee across the causeway, losing hundreds of men.
steps.text_zh: 1520年，西班牙人在节庆中屠杀贵族后，全城起义。蒙特祖马死去，西班牙人在“悲痛之夜”沿堤道突围，损失数百人。

steps.text: 1520: smallpox, brought by the Spaniards, sweeps through the Valley of Mexico, killing a huge share of the people, including the new emperor Cuitláhuac.
steps.text_zh: 1520年，西班牙人带来的天花在墨西哥谷地肆虐，大批居民死亡，新君奎特拉瓦克也未能幸免。

steps.text: 1521: after a siege of nearly three months by Spanish boats and Native armies, Tenochtitlan falls and its last ruler, Cuauhtémoc, is captured. Mexico City rises on its ruins.
steps.text_zh: 1521年，在西班牙战船和原住民大军近三个月的围攻下，特诺奇蒂特兰陷落，末代君主夸乌特莫克被俘。墨西哥城在废墟上建立起来。

steps.text: 1524: Cortés's captain Pedro de Alvarado marches south and defeats the K'iche' Maya, beginning the Spanish conquest of Guatemala.
steps.text_zh: 1524年，科尔特斯的部将阿尔瓦拉多南下击败基切玛雅人，开始了西班牙对危地马拉的征服。

title: Mexico from independence to revolution
title_zh: 从独立到革命的墨西哥
summary: From a priest's call to arms to the Zapatistas: two centuries of Mexico's struggle over land, faith, foreign invaders and who holds power.
summary_zh: 从神父的起义号召到萨帕塔民族解放军：墨西哥两个世纪以来围绕土地、宗教、外敌入侵和政权的斗争。

steps.text: 1810: in the town of Dolores, the priest Miguel Hidalgo rings the church bell and calls his parishioners to rise against Spanish rule.
steps.text_zh: 1810年，神父米格尔·伊达尔戈在多洛雷斯镇敲响教堂钟声，号召教民起来反抗西班牙统治。

steps.text: 1821: after eleven years of war, Agustín de Iturbide and the rebel Vicente Guerrero join forces, and Mexico wins its independence from Spain.
steps.text_zh: 1821年，经过十一年战争，伊图尔维德与起义军领袖格雷罗联手，墨西哥脱离西班牙获得独立。

steps.text: 1847: in the war with the United States, American troops storm Chapultepec Castle and take Mexico City. In 1848 Mexico loses about half its territory.
steps.text_zh: 1847年，美墨战争中美军攻破查普尔特佩克城堡，占领墨西哥城。1848年，墨西哥被迫割让约一半国土。

steps.text: 1862: on 5 May a Mexican army beats the French at Puebla. France returns, makes Maximilian of Austria emperor, but Benito Juárez's republic wins and executes him in 1867.
steps.text_zh: 1862年5月5日，墨西哥军队在普埃布拉击败法军。法国卷土重来，扶植奥地利的马克西米利安为皇帝，但胡亚雷斯领导的共和国最终获胜，于1867年处决了他。

steps.text: 1876: Porfirio Díaz seizes power and rules for 35 years. Railways and foreign investment grow, while most peasants lose their land.
steps.text_zh: 1876年，波菲里奥·迪亚斯夺取政权，统治长达35年。铁路和外国投资迅速增长，大多数农民却失去了土地。

steps.text: 1910: Francisco Madero calls for revolt against Díaz. The Mexican Revolution begins, a decade of war that kills perhaps a million people.
steps.text_zh: 1910年，马德罗号召起兵推翻迪亚斯，墨西哥革命爆发。十年战乱中约有一百万人丧生。

steps.text: 1911: in Morelos, Emiliano Zapata issues the Plan of Ayala, demanding that land be returned to the villages: land and liberty.
steps.text_zh: 1911年，埃米利亚诺·萨帕塔在莫雷洛斯发布《阿亚拉计划》，要求把土地归还给村社，口号是“土地与自由”。

steps.text: 1917: a new constitution, written at Querétaro, promises land reform, workers' rights and national ownership of the subsoil.
steps.text_zh: 1917年，在克雷塔罗制定的新宪法承诺土地改革、保障劳工权利，并规定地下资源归国家所有。

steps.text: 1938: President Lázaro Cárdenas nationalizes the foreign oil companies, a moment of national pride still celebrated in Mexico.
steps.text_zh: 1938年，总统拉萨罗·卡德纳斯将外国石油公司收归国有，这一举动至今仍被墨西哥人视为民族骄傲。

steps.text: 1994: on the day NAFTA takes effect, Maya rebels calling themselves Zapatistas seize towns in Chiapas, demanding rights for Mexico's indigenous peoples.
steps.text_zh: 1994年，就在北美自由贸易协定生效当天，自称“萨帕塔民族解放军”的玛雅起义者占领恰帕斯的多座城镇，要求保障原住民权利。

title: Caral and Chavín
summary: Civilization in the Andes began almost as early as in Egypt: pyramids on the Peruvian coast, temples in the highlands and the pilgrim shrine of Chavín.
summary_zh: 安第斯文明几乎与埃及同样古老：秘鲁海岸的金字塔、高原上的神庙，以及朝圣中心查文。

steps.text: About 3000 BC: at Áspero on the Peruvian coast, fishing people living on anchovies build platform mounds, among the first monuments in the Americas.
steps.text_zh: 约前3000年，在秘鲁海岸的阿斯佩罗，以捕捞鳀鱼为生的渔民修建平台土丘，这是美洲最早的纪念性建筑之一。

steps.text: About 2600 BC: inland in the Supe valley, Caral rises with pyramids and sunken plazas, one of the oldest cities in the Americas, as old as the pyramids of Egypt.
steps.text_zh: 约前2600年，内陆苏佩河谷的卡拉尔兴起，城中有金字塔和下沉式广场。它是美洲最古老的城市之一，与埃及金字塔同时代。

steps.text: About 2300 BC: in the highlands at Kotosh, people build temples with sacred fire pits and the famous relief of crossed hands.
steps.text_zh: 约前2300年，高原上的科托什建起设有圣火坑的神庙，墙上有著名的交叉双手浮雕。

steps.text: About 1800 BC: in the Casma valley, Sechín Alto becomes the largest monument in the Americas of its time, as farmers with irrigation and pottery spread along the coast.
steps.text_zh: 约前1800年，卡斯马河谷的塞钦阿尔托成为当时美洲最大的建筑。掌握灌溉和制陶技术的农民在沿海各地扩散。

steps.text: About 1600 BC: nearby at Cerro Sechín, hundreds of carved stones show victorious warriors and the cut-up bodies of their enemies.
steps.text_zh: 约前1600年，附近的塞罗塞钦竖起数百块石雕，刻画凯旋的武士和被肢解的敌人。

steps.text: About 900 BC: the temple of Chavín de Huántar becomes a great pilgrimage center. Deep in its dark galleries stands the carved god of the Lanzón, and its style spreads across Peru.
steps.text_zh: 约前900年，查文·德万塔尔神庙成为重要的朝圣中心。幽暗的地下廊道深处立着兰松石柱神像，查文艺术风格传遍秘鲁。

steps.text: About 800 BC: on the southern coast, the Paracas culture arises; its people later wrap their dead in some of the finest embroidered textiles ever made.
steps.text_zh: 约前800年，南部海岸兴起帕拉卡斯文化，当地人后来用极其精美的刺绣织物包裹死者。

steps.text: About 500 BC: Chavín's influence begins to fade, and the Andes break into regional cultures, each with its own gods and styles.
steps.text_zh: 约前500年，查文的影响开始衰退，安第斯地区分化为各具神祇和风格的地方文化。

title: Nazca, Moche, Tiwanaku and Wari
title_zh: 纳斯卡、莫切、蒂瓦纳库与瓦里
summary: Between Chavín and the Inca, desert lines, gold-laden royal tombs, a holy city by Lake Titicaca and the first Andean empire.
summary_zh: 从查文到印加之间：沙漠中的巨画、满载黄金的王墓、的的喀喀湖畔的圣城，以及安第斯第一个帝国。

steps.text: About 100 BC: in the southern desert of Peru, the Nazca build their ceremonial center at Cahuachi, famed for its painted pottery.
steps.text_zh: 约前100年，秘鲁南部沙漠中的纳斯卡人在卡瓦奇修建祭祀中心，以彩绘陶器闻名。

steps.text: About AD 1: the Nazca begin scraping huge lines and figures into the desert, a hummingbird, a monkey, a spider, best seen from the air.
steps.text_zh: 公元1年前后，纳斯卡人开始在沙漠地面刻划巨大的线条和图案，有蜂鸟、猴子和蜘蛛，只有从空中才能看清全貌。

steps.text: About 100: on the north coast the Moche rise, building the adobe Huacas of the Sun and Moon and making lifelike portrait pottery.
steps.text_zh: 约100年，北部海岸的莫切人兴起，用土坯修建太阳神庙和月亮神庙，并烧制栩栩如生的肖像陶器。

steps.text: About 250: a Moche warrior-priest, the Lord of Sipán, is buried with gold and silver jewellery. His untouched tomb, found in 1987, is called the Tutankhamun of the Americas.
steps.text_zh: 约250年，莫切武士祭司“西潘王”下葬，随葬大量金银饰品。1987年发现的这座未被盗掘的王墓被誉为“美洲的图坦卡蒙墓”。

steps.text: About 400: by Lake Titicaca, Tiwanaku grows into a great city, fed by raised fields that protect crops from frost at nearly 4,000 metres.
steps.text_zh: 约400年，的的喀喀湖畔的蒂瓦纳库发展为大城市。人们在近四千米的高原上修建台田防御霜冻，养活城中人口。

steps.text: About 600: Tiwanaku's stone carvers make the Gate of the Sun, cut from a single block, with a staff-holding god whose image spreads across the Andes.
steps.text_zh: 约600年，蒂瓦纳库工匠用整块巨石雕成太阳门，门上手持权杖的神像在安第斯各地广为流传。

steps.text: About 600: from Ayacucho, Wari builds the first Andean empire, with roads, storehouses and administrative centers such as Pikillacta near Cusco.
steps.text_zh: 约600年，以阿亚库乔为中心的瓦里建立安第斯第一个帝国，修建道路、仓库和行政中心，例如库斯科附近的皮基利亚克塔。

steps.text: About 1000: as a long drought sets in, both Wari and Tiwanaku collapse, and their roads and ideas are later taken up by the Inca.
steps.text_zh: 约1000年，随着长期干旱来临，瓦里和蒂瓦纳库相继衰亡，它们的道路和制度后来被印加人继承。

steps.text: About 1000: on the north coast the kingdom of Chimor builds Chan Chan, the largest adobe city in the world, with walled royal compounds.
steps.text_zh: 约1000年，北部海岸的奇穆王国修建昌昌古城，这是世界上最大的土坯城市，城内有高墙环绕的王室宫苑。

title: The Inca Empire
summary: In less than a century a small kingdom at Cusco became Tawantinsuyu, the largest empire in the Americas, stretching 4,000 km along the Andes.
summary_zh: 不到一个世纪，库斯科的一个小王国发展为“塔万廷苏尤”，成为美洲最大的帝国，沿安第斯山脉绵延四千公里。

steps.text: About 1200: by legend, Manco Cápac, son of the Sun, rises from Lake Titicaca and founds Cusco. For two centuries it remains a small highland kingdom.
steps.text_zh: 约1200年，相传太阳之子曼科·卡帕克从的的喀喀湖出发，建立库斯科。此后两百年间，库斯科只是一个高原小王国。

steps.text: 1438: Pachacuti beats back the Chanka attack on Cusco, seizes the throne and begins the conquests that create the Inca Empire, Tawantinsuyu.
steps.text_zh: 1438年，帕查库特克击退昌卡人对库斯科的进攻，夺取王位，开始了一系列征服，建立起印加帝国“塔万廷苏尤”。

steps.text: About 1450: Pachacuti builds Machu Picchu as a royal estate on a ridge above the Urubamba, with fine stonework fitted without mortar.
steps.text_zh: 约1450年，帕查库特克在乌鲁班巴河上方的山脊修建马丘比丘作为王室庄园，石块砌合严丝合缝，不用灰浆。

steps.text: About 1450: the Inca build the Qhapaq Ñan, some 40,000 km of roads with bridges and way stations. Runners carry messages and quipu, knotted-cord records, across the empire.
steps.text_zh: 约1450年，印加人修建总长约四万公里的道路网“卡帕克南”，设有桥梁和驿站。信使沿路传递消息和结绳记事的“基普”。

steps.text: About 1470: Topa Inca conquers the coastal kingdom of Chimor and carries its goldsmiths and treasure to Cusco.
steps.text_zh: 约1470年，图帕克·印卡征服沿海的奇穆王国，把奇穆的金匠和财宝迁往库斯科。

steps.text: About 1480: Inca armies push south into Chile, but at the Maule River the Mapuche stop them, marking the empire's southern frontier.
steps.text_zh: 约1480年，印加军队南下进入智利，在马乌莱河被马普切人阻挡，这里成为帝国的南部边界。

steps.text: 1527: smallpox, spreading ahead of the Spaniards, kills the emperor Huayna Cápac at Quito and his chosen heir, leaving no clear successor.
steps.text_zh: 1527年，先于西班牙人传入的天花在基多夺去了皇帝瓦伊纳·卡帕克及其指定继承人的生命，帝国继承人悬而未决。

steps.text: 1529: his sons Huáscar in Cusco and Atahualpa in Quito go to war. Atahualpa wins in 1532, just as Pizarro lands on the coast.
steps.text_zh: 1529年，瓦伊纳·卡帕克的两个儿子，库斯科的瓦斯卡尔和基多的阿塔瓦尔帕爆发内战。1532年阿塔瓦尔帕获胜，恰逢皮萨罗在海岸登陆。

title: Conquest, silver and sugar
summary: How Spain and Portugal took South America: the fall of the Inca, the silver of Potosí, Brazil's sugar and gold built on African slavery, and the revolts against it all.
summary_zh: 西班牙和葡萄牙如何占领南美：印加覆灭、波托西的白银、建立在非洲奴隶劳动上的巴西蔗糖与黄金，以及各种反抗。

steps.text: 1500: a Portuguese fleet bound for India under Pedro Álvares Cabral sights the coast of Brazil and claims it for Portugal.
steps.text_zh: 1500年，卡布拉尔率领前往印度的葡萄牙船队望见巴西海岸，宣布此地归葡萄牙所有。

steps.text: 1532: at Cajamarca, Francisco Pizarro and 168 Spaniards ambush the Inca emperor Atahualpa and his unarmed escort and take him prisoner.
steps.text_zh: 1532年，弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗率168名西班牙人在卡哈马卡伏击印加皇帝阿塔瓦尔帕及其手无寸铁的随从，将其俘获。

steps.text: 1533: Atahualpa fills a room with gold and two with silver for his ransom, but Pizarro has him executed and marches on Cusco.
steps.text_zh: 1533年，阿塔瓦尔帕用黄金填满一间屋子、用白银填满两间作为赎金，皮萨罗却将他处死，随后进军库斯科。

steps.text: 1536: the puppet emperor Manco Inca escapes and besieges Cusco. He fails, and the Inca hold out in the jungle at Vilcabamba until 1572.
steps.text_zh: 1536年，傀儡皇帝曼科·印卡出逃并围攻库斯科，未能成功。印加人退守丛林中的比尔卡班巴，一直坚持到1572年。

steps.text: 1545: a mountain of silver is found at Potosí. Worked by forced Native labour, it pours silver into Spain and, by way of Manila, into China.
steps.text_zh: 1545年，波托西发现一座银山。原住民被强征在此劳作，白银源源不断流入西班牙，并经马尼拉流入中国。

steps.text: About 1550: in Pernambuco, Brazil's sugar plantations boom, worked by enslaved Africans. Brazil will receive more captives than any other country.
steps.text_zh: 约1550年，巴西伯南布哥的甘蔗种植园迅速兴起，劳力是非洲奴隶。巴西后来成为接收奴隶最多的国家。

steps.text: About 1605: escaped slaves found Palmares in the hills of northeast Brazil. Home to thousands, it resists Portuguese and Dutch attacks for nearly a century.
steps.text_zh: 约1605年，逃亡奴隶在巴西东北部山区建立帕尔马雷斯，居民达数千人，抵抗葡萄牙人和荷兰人的进攻近一个世纪。

steps.text: 1609: Jesuits begin founding mission towns for the Guaraní in Paraguay, protecting them from slave raiders until the order is expelled in 1767.
steps.text_zh: 1609年，耶稣会开始在巴拉圭为瓜拉尼人建立传教村镇，保护他们免遭奴隶贩子掳掠，直到1767年耶稣会被驱逐。

steps.text: 1693: gold is found in Minas Gerais, starting the world's largest gold rush of the century and moving Brazil's center south, toward Rio de Janeiro.
steps.text_zh: 1693年，米纳斯吉拉斯发现金矿，引发当时世界上规模最大的淘金热，巴西的重心也随之南移到里约热内卢一带。

steps.text: 1780: Túpac Amaru II, a descendant of the Inca, leads a huge revolt against Spanish abuses. He is captured and executed in Cusco, but the uprising shakes the empire.
steps.text_zh: 1780年，印加后裔图帕克·阿马鲁二世领导大规模起义反抗西班牙的压迫。他被俘后在库斯科遇害，但起义动摇了殖民统治。

title: Bolívar, San Martín and independence
title_zh: 玻利瓦尔、圣马丁与南美独立
summary: When Napoleon toppled Spain's king, South America rose. Armies crossed the Andes from north and south, and in 17 years the continent was free.
summary_zh: 拿破仑推翻西班牙国王后，南美各地纷纷起义。独立军队从南北两路翻越安第斯山，十七年间整个大陆获得独立。

steps.text: 1808: fleeing Napoleon, the Portuguese royal family sails to Brazil and makes Rio de Janeiro the capital of its empire.
steps.text_zh: 1808年，为躲避拿破仑，葡萄牙王室乘船逃往巴西，把里约热内卢定为帝国首都。

steps.text: 1810: in Buenos Aires, the May Revolution removes the Spanish viceroy and sets up a local government junta.
steps.text_zh: 1810年，布宜诺斯艾利斯爆发五月革命，罢黜西班牙总督，成立本地执政委员会。

steps.text: 1811: Venezuela declares independence. Simón Bolívar loses this first republic, but returns to lead the long war in the north.
steps.text_zh: 1811年，委内瑞拉宣布独立。西蒙·玻利瓦尔虽然失去了这个第一共和国，但后来卷土重来，领导北方的长期战争。

steps.text: 1817: José de San Martín leads an army over the Andes from Argentina through passes nearly 4,000 m high and defeats the royalists at Chacabuco, freeing Chile.
steps.text_zh: 1817年，何塞·德圣马丁率军从阿根廷翻越近四千米高的山口，在查卡布科击败保王军，解放智利。

steps.text: 1819: Bolívar crosses the flooded plains and the Andes and wins at Boyacá, freeing New Granada; Gran Colombia is proclaimed.
steps.text_zh: 1819年，玻利瓦尔穿越洪水泛滥的平原和安第斯山，在博亚卡取胜，解放新格拉纳达，宣布成立大哥伦比亚。

steps.text: 1821: San Martín enters Lima by sea and declares the independence of Peru, though royalist armies still hold the highlands.
steps.text_zh: 1821年，圣马丁从海路进入利马，宣布秘鲁独立，但保王军仍控制着高原地区。

steps.text: 1822: San Martín and Bolívar meet in secret at Guayaquil. Afterwards San Martín withdraws, leaving Bolívar to finish the war.
steps.text_zh: 1822年，圣马丁与玻利瓦尔在瓜亚基尔秘密会晤。会后圣马丁引退，由玻利瓦尔完成独立战争。

steps.text: 1822: by the Ipiranga stream near São Paulo, Prince Pedro cries 'Independence or death!' and becomes emperor of an independent Brazil.
steps.text_zh: 1822年，佩德罗王子在圣保罗附近的伊皮兰加河畔高呼“不独立，毋宁死！”，随后成为独立的巴西帝国皇帝。

steps.text: 1824: Bolívar's general Antonio José de Sucre defeats the last major Spanish army at Ayacucho, ending Spanish rule in South America.
steps.text_zh: 1824年，玻利瓦尔的部将苏克雷在阿亚库乔击败西班牙最后一支主力军，西班牙在南美的统治宣告结束。

steps.text: 1825: Upper Peru becomes an independent republic and names itself Bolivia after the Liberator.
steps.text_zh: 1825年，上秘鲁成为独立共和国，并以“解放者”玻利瓦尔的名字命名为玻利维亚。

title: Wars, dictators and democracy
summary: A century and a half of modern South America: deadly border wars, the end of slavery, populist leaders, military juntas and the return of democracy.
summary_zh: 南美近一个半世纪的历史：惨烈的边界战争、奴隶制的废除、民粹主义领袖、军政府，以及民主的回归。

steps.text: 1864: Paraguay goes to war with Brazil, Argentina and Uruguay. By 1870 it has lost perhaps half its people, the deadliest war in Latin American history.
steps.text_zh: 1864年，巴拉圭与巴西、阿根廷、乌拉圭开战。到1870年，巴拉圭可能已失去一半人口，这是拉丁美洲历史上最惨烈的战争。

steps.text: 1879: Chile fights Peru and Bolivia over the nitrate deserts of the Atacama. Chile wins, and Bolivia loses its coast for good.
steps.text_zh: 1879年，智利为争夺阿塔卡马沙漠的硝石资源与秘鲁和玻利维亚开战。智利获胜，玻利维亚从此失去出海口。

steps.text: 1888: Princess Isabel signs the Golden Law, and Brazil becomes the last country in the Americas to abolish slavery. The monarchy falls a year later.
steps.text_zh: 1888年，伊莎贝尔公主签署《黄金法》，巴西成为美洲最后一个废除奴隶制的国家。一年后君主制被推翻。

steps.text: 1930: Getúlio Vargas takes power in Brazil by revolution. He builds a strong state, industry and labour laws, and rules for most of the next 24 years.
steps.text_zh: 1930年，热图利奥·瓦加斯通过革命在巴西掌权。他建立强有力的国家，发展工业，制定劳动法，此后24年间大部分时间执政。

steps.text: 1946: Juan Perón is elected president of Argentina with the support of workers; with his wife Evita he shapes Argentine politics for decades.
steps.text_zh: 1946年，胡安·庇隆在工人支持下当选阿根廷总统。他与妻子埃维塔深刻影响了此后数十年的阿根廷政治。

steps.text: 1960: Brazil moves its capital to Brasília, a modernist city built in under four years in the empty interior.
steps.text_zh: 1960年，巴西迁都巴西利亚。这座现代主义城市在荒凉的内陆用不到四年时间建成。

steps.text: 1973: General Augusto Pinochet's coup overthrows Chile's elected socialist president Salvador Allende, who dies in the presidential palace.
steps.text_zh: 1973年，奥古斯托·皮诺切特将军发动政变，推翻民选社会主义总统萨尔瓦多·阿连德，阿连德死于总统府。

steps.text: 1982: Argentina's military junta invades the Falkland Islands and loses a short war with Britain. The junta falls and democracy returns in 1983.
steps.text_zh: 1982年，阿根廷军政府出兵马尔维纳斯群岛（福克兰群岛），在与英国的短暂战争中失败。军政府随之倒台，1983年恢复民主。

steps.text: 1988: Chileans vote 'No' to eight more years of Pinochet, and the country returns to democracy in 1990.
steps.text_zh: 1988年，智利人在公投中对皮诺切特再执政八年投下“不”，智利于1990年恢复民主。

steps.text: 2016: Colombia signs a peace deal with the FARC guerrillas, ending a war of more than fifty years, the longest in the Americas.
steps.text_zh: 2016年，哥伦比亚政府与哥伦比亚革命武装力量签署和平协议，结束了持续五十多年、美洲历时最长的内战。

title: The age of the pyramids
summary: Egypt becomes one kingdom under Narmer, invents writing, and pours its wealth into ever greater royal tombs, until the Old Kingdom falls apart.
summary_zh: 纳尔迈统一上下埃及，文字随之出现，王国把财富倾注在越建越宏伟的王陵上，直到古王国崩溃。

steps.text: About 3000 BC: Narmer, a king from Upper Egypt, brings the Nile valley and the Delta under one crown. The Narmer Palette shows him smiting his northern enemies.
steps.text_zh: 约前3000年，上埃及国王纳尔迈征服下埃及，把尼罗河谷和三角洲统一为一个王国。纳尔迈调色板上刻画了他击打北方敌人的场景。

steps.text: About 2990 BC: Memphis is founded where the valley meets the Delta, a capital placed to rule both halves of the new kingdom.
steps.text_zh: 约前2990年，孟菲斯在河谷与三角洲交界处建立，这里便于同时控制上下埃及，成为新王国的都城。

steps.text: About 2900 BC: hieroglyphic writing comes into regular use for royal names, labels and offerings, one of the world's first scripts.
steps.text_zh: 约前2900年，象形文字开始普遍用于记录王名、标签和祭品清单，这是世界上最早的文字之一。

steps.text: About 2670 BC: the architect Imhotep stacks six stone platforms over King Djoser's tomb at Saqqara. The Step Pyramid is the first large building made entirely of cut stone.
steps.text_zh: 约前2670年，建筑师伊姆霍特普在萨卡拉为法老左塞尔把六层石台层层叠起，建成阶梯金字塔，这是世界上第一座全部用切割石块建成的大型建筑。

steps.text: About 2560 BC: the Great Pyramid of Khufu is finished at Giza, about 146 metres tall. It stays the tallest building on Earth for nearly 4,000 years.
steps.text_zh: 约前2560年，胡夫大金字塔在吉萨建成，高约146米，此后近四千年间一直是世界上最高的建筑。

steps.text: About 2560 BC: the official Merer keeps a logbook of his crew shipping limestone down the Nile to Giza. Found at Wadi al-Jarf, it is the oldest inscribed papyrus known.
steps.text_zh: 约前2560年，官员梅勒记下他的船队沿尼罗河把石灰石运往吉萨的工作日志。这份在旱谷贾尔夫发现的《梅勒日记》是已知最古老的书写纸草。

steps.text: About 2350 BC: King Unas has spells for the afterlife carved inside his pyramid. The Pyramid Texts are the oldest religious writings of Egypt.
steps.text_zh: 约前2350年，法老乌纳斯在金字塔墓室内刻满护佑亡灵升天的咒语，这些金字塔铭文是埃及最古老的宗教文献。

steps.text: 2181 BC: after the very long reign of Pepi II, low Nile floods and powerful provincial governors break the Old Kingdom apart, and Egypt falls into the First Intermediate Period.
steps.text_zh: 前2181年，佩皮二世漫长的统治结束后，尼罗河水位低落，地方州长坐大，古王国瓦解，埃及进入第一中间期。

title: Reunion, invasion and revival
summary: Theban kings reunite Egypt and push into Nubia; foreign Hyksos rulers later seize the Delta, and driving them out turns Egypt into an empire.
summary_zh: 底比斯国王重新统一埃及并向努比亚扩张；后来外来的希克索斯人占据三角洲，驱逐他们的战争使埃及走上帝国之路。

steps.text: About 2160 BC: with the old order gone, kings at Herakleopolis claim to rule the north while rival lords hold the south.
steps.text_zh: 约前2160年，旧秩序崩溃后，赫拉克利奥波利斯的国王控制北方，南方则由其他地方豪强把持。

steps.text: About 2134 BC: at Thebes the Intef family declare themselves kings, founding the Eleventh Dynasty and beginning a long war with Herakleopolis.
steps.text_zh: 约前2134年，因特夫家族在底比斯称王，建立第十一王朝，与赫拉克利奥波利斯展开长期争战。

steps.text: About 2055 BC: Mentuhotep II defeats the northern kings and reunites Egypt, opening the Middle Kingdom.
steps.text_zh: 约前2055年，门图霍特普二世击败北方王朝，再次统一埃及，开启中王国时代。

steps.text: About 1875 BC: the Story of Sinuhe, about a courtier who flees to Canaan and longs to be buried at home, becomes the most loved classic of Egyptian literature.
steps.text_zh: 约前1875年，《辛努海的故事》写成，讲述一位朝臣逃往迦南、晚年渴望归葬故土的经历，成为古埃及文学最受喜爱的经典。

steps.text: About 1870 BC: Senusret III conquers Lower Nubia up to the Second Cataract and lines the river with great mud-brick forts facing the kingdom of Kerma.
steps.text_zh: 约前1870年，塞索斯特里斯三世征服下努比亚直到第二瀑布，沿河修建一串巨大的泥砖要塞，防备南方的克尔玛王国。

steps.text: About 1650 BC: the Hyksos, settlers of Canaanite origin, take power in the Delta and rule from Avaris. Egypt is split again, with Thebes as a weak southern kingdom.
steps.text_zh: 约前1650年，源自迦南的希克索斯人在三角洲掌权，以阿瓦里斯为都。埃及再次分裂，底比斯沦为南方的弱小王国。

steps.text: About 1600 BC: the horse and the light war chariot reach Egypt through the Hyksos, weapons the Egyptians soon turn against them.
steps.text_zh: 约前1600年，马和轻型战车随希克索斯人传入埃及，埃及人很快学会了这种武器，并用它反过来对付希克索斯人。

steps.text: About 1550 BC: Ahmose I of Thebes captures Avaris and drives the Hyksos out, founding the New Kingdom.
steps.text_zh: 约前1550年，底比斯的雅赫摩斯一世攻陷阿瓦里斯，驱逐希克索斯人，建立新王国。

steps.text: 1479 BC: Hatshepsut becomes regent for the boy Thutmose III and soon rules as king herself. Her terraced temple at Deir el-Bahari still stands.
steps.text_zh: 前1479年，哈特谢普苏特为年幼的图特摩斯三世摄政，不久自立为法老。她在代尔巴哈里修建的阶梯式神庙至今犹存。

steps.text: 1457 BC: Thutmose III defeats a coalition of Canaanite kings at Megiddo, the first battle recorded in detail. Egypt now rules an empire in the Levant.
steps.text_zh: 前1457年，图特摩斯三世在美吉多击败迦南诸王联军，这是史上第一场有详细记载的战役。埃及从此在黎凡特建立起帝国。

title: Akhenaten to Ramesses
title_zh: 从阿肯那顿到拉美西斯
summary: A heretic king, a boy pharaoh and a great warrior king: the high New Kingdom, from Akhenaten's revolution to the troubles after the Sea Peoples.
summary_zh: 异端法老、少年法老与武功赫赫的拉美西斯：新王国的鼎盛时期，从阿肯那顿的宗教革命到海上民族之后的动荡。

steps.text: About 1353 BC: Akhenaten turns his back on Amun and the old gods, worships the sun disc Aten alone, and builds a new capital at Amarna.
steps.text_zh: 约前1353年，阿肯那顿抛弃阿蒙神和众神，独尊太阳圆盘阿顿神，并在阿马尔纳另建新都。

steps.text: About 1350 BC: clay tablets in Akkadian pile up in the Amarna archive, letters between the pharaoh and the kings of Babylon, Mitanni and the Hittites, the first great diplomatic archive.
steps.text_zh: 约前1350年，阿马尔纳档案中堆积起用阿卡德语写成的泥板书信，记录了法老与巴比伦、米坦尼、赫梯国王的往来，是世界上第一批大规模外交档案。

steps.text: About 1332 BC: the boy king Tutankhamun abandons Amarna and restores Amun and the old temples. He dies young, and his small tomb survives almost untouched.
steps.text_zh: 约前1332年，少年法老图坦卡蒙放弃阿马尔纳，恢复对阿蒙神的崇拜和旧神庙。他英年早逝，小小的陵墓却几乎完好地保存下来。

steps.text: 1274 BC: Ramesses II meets the Hittite army at Kadesh in Syria, perhaps the largest chariot battle ever fought. Neither side wins, though Ramesses proclaims a victory on temple walls.
steps.text_zh: 前1274年，拉美西斯二世在叙利亚的卡迭石与赫梯大军交战，这可能是史上规模最大的战车会战。双方不分胜负，拉美西斯却在神庙墙上宣扬自己的胜利。

steps.text: About 1264 BC: Ramesses II carves the temples of Abu Simbel into a Nubian cliff, four colossal statues of himself announcing Egypt's power to the land of Kush.
steps.text_zh: 约前1264年，拉美西斯二世在努比亚的山崖上开凿阿布辛拜勒神庙，门前四尊巨大的法老坐像向库施展示埃及的威势。

steps.text: 1259 BC: Egypt and the Hittites sign the oldest surviving peace treaty, with copies in hieroglyphs and in Akkadian.
steps.text_zh: 前1259年，埃及与赫梯签订和约，这是现存最古老的和平条约，有象形文字和阿卡德文两种文本。

steps.text: About 1175 BC: Ramesses III beats back the Sea Peoples on land and in the Delta. Egypt survives the storm that destroys the Hittites, but is exhausted.
steps.text_zh: 约前1175年，拉美西斯三世在陆上和三角洲击退海上民族。赫梯在这场风暴中灭亡，埃及虽然幸存，却已元气大伤。

steps.text: About 1157 BC: the royal tomb builders of Deir el-Medina down tools when their grain rations do not arrive, the first recorded strike in history.
steps.text_zh: 约前1157年，代尔麦地那的王陵工匠因口粮迟迟未发而停工，这是历史上第一次有记载的罢工。

title: Pharaohs from abroad
summary: After the New Kingdom, Egypt is ruled in turn by Libyan chiefs, Kushite kings, Assyrians and Persians, with one last native revival in between.
summary_zh: 新王国之后，利比亚首领、库施国王、亚述人和波斯人轮番统治埃及，其间埃及人只有短暂的复兴。

steps.text: 1069 BC: the New Kingdom ends. Kings at Tanis rule the Delta while the high priests of Amun govern the south from Thebes.
steps.text_zh: 前1069年，新王国结束。塔尼斯的国王统治三角洲，底比斯的阿蒙大祭司则控制南方。

steps.text: About 727 BC: Piye, king of Kush, marches north from Napata, takes Memphis and is accepted as pharaoh. The Kushite kings rule Egypt as its Twenty-fifth Dynasty.
steps.text_zh: 约前727年，库施国王皮耶从纳帕塔挥师北上，攻下孟菲斯，被承认为法老。库施王室成为埃及第二十五王朝。

steps.text: 671 BC: the Assyrian king Esarhaddon storms Memphis. Assyria and Kush fight over Egypt until the Kushites retreat south for good.
steps.text_zh: 前671年，亚述国王以撒哈顿攻陷孟菲斯。亚述与库施为争夺埃及反复交战，最终库施人退回南方。

steps.text: 664 BC: Psamtik I of Sais, first an Assyrian vassal, makes himself master of all Egypt with Greek mercenaries, starting the Saite revival.
steps.text_zh: 前664年，原为亚述附庸的赛斯城君主普萨美提克一世借助希腊雇佣兵统一埃及，开创赛斯王朝的复兴。

steps.text: 525 BC: the Persian king Cambyses II defeats the Egyptians at Pelusium. Egypt becomes a province of the Achaemenid Empire.
steps.text_zh: 前525年，波斯国王冈比西斯二世在培琉喜阿姆击败埃及军队，埃及成为阿契美尼德帝国的行省。

steps.text: 343 BC: after sixty years of independence, Persia reconquers Egypt. Nectanebo II flees south, the last native Egyptian to rule as pharaoh.
steps.text_zh: 前343年，埃及独立六十年后再被波斯征服。内克塔内布二世南逃，他是最后一位埃及本族法老。

steps.text: 332 BC: Alexander the Great enters Egypt without a fight and is welcomed as a liberator from Persia; at Siwa the oracle hails him as son of Amun.
steps.text_zh: 前332年，亚历山大大帝兵不血刃进入埃及，被当作从波斯手中解放埃及的救星；锡瓦绿洲的神谕称他为阿蒙之子。

title: Carthage and Roman Africa
title_zh: 迦太基与罗马的阿非利加
summary: A Phoenician colony grows into Rome's great rival, is destroyed, and rises again as the heart of Roman Africa, until Vandals and Byzantines fight over it.
summary_zh: 腓尼基人的殖民城市成长为罗马的劲敌，被毁之后又作为罗马阿非利加行省的中心重生，后来汪达尔人与拜占庭人在此反复争夺。

steps.text: 814 BC: by tradition, Phoenicians from Tyre led by Queen Dido found Carthage, a trading port on the Gulf of Tunis.
steps.text_zh: 前814年，相传推罗的腓尼基人在女王狄多率领下于突尼斯湾建立迦太基，这是一座贸易港口。

steps.text: About 500 BC: Hanno the Navigator sails a Carthaginian fleet out past the Pillars of Hercules and down the coast of West Africa.
steps.text_zh: 约前500年，迦太基航海家汉诺率船队驶出直布罗陀海峡，沿西非海岸南下探险。

steps.text: 202 BC: Scipio defeats Hannibal at Zama, ending the Second Punic War. Carthage loses its fleet and its empire.
steps.text_zh: 前202年，西庇阿在扎马击败汉尼拔，第二次布匿战争结束。迦太基失去舰队和海外领地。

steps.text: 202 BC: the Berber prince Masinissa, Rome's ally at Zama, unites Numidia and spends fifty years nibbling at Carthage's land.
steps.text_zh: 前202年，在扎马之战中站在罗马一方的柏柏尔王子马西尼萨统一努米底亚，此后五十年不断蚕食迦太基的土地。

steps.text: 146 BC: after a three-year siege, Rome razes Carthage and makes its land the province of Africa.
steps.text_zh: 前146年，经过三年围城，罗马把迦太基夷为平地，在其故土设立阿非利加行省。

steps.text: 112 BC: the Numidian king Jugurtha massacres Roman traders at Cirta, starting a war that exposes the corruption of the Roman Senate.
steps.text_zh: 前112年，努米底亚国王朱古达在锡尔塔屠杀罗马商人，引发朱古达战争，这场战争暴露了罗马元老院的腐败。

steps.text: 193: Septimius Severus, born at Lepcis Magna in Libya, becomes Roman emperor. Rebuilt Carthage is now one of the largest cities of the empire.
steps.text_zh: 193年，生于利比亚大莱普提斯的塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁成为罗马皇帝。此时重建的迦太基已是帝国最大的城市之一。

steps.text: 396: Augustine becomes bishop of Hippo. His Confessions and City of God make this African the most influential thinker of Latin Christianity.
steps.text_zh: 396年，奥古斯丁出任希波主教。他的《忏悔录》和《上帝之城》使这位北非人成为拉丁基督教最有影响的思想家。

steps.text: 439: the Vandals under Gaiseric seize Carthage and build a pirate kingdom that sacks Rome itself in 455.
steps.text_zh: 439年，盖萨里克率汪达尔人夺取迦太基，建立称霸海上的王国，并于455年洗劫罗马城。

steps.text: 533: the Byzantine general Belisarius lands with a small army and destroys the Vandal kingdom in a few months, returning Africa to the empire.
steps.text_zh: 533年，拜占庭名将贝利萨留率领一支小部队登陆，几个月内消灭汪达尔王国，阿非利加重归帝国。

title: Alexandria, city of learning
summary: For seven centuries Alexandria was the brain of the ancient world: the Library, the Ptolemies and Cleopatra, Roman astronomy, and the end of pagan learning.
summary_zh: 七百年间，亚历山大港是古代世界的学术中心：从图书馆、托勒密王朝和克娄巴特拉，到罗马时代的天文学，直至异教学术的终结。

steps.text: 331 BC: Alexander lays out a new city on the coast west of the Nile mouth. Alexandria will be the capital of Egypt for nearly a thousand years.
steps.text_zh: 前331年，亚历山大在尼罗河口以西的海岸规划新城。亚历山大港此后近千年都是埃及的首都。

steps.text: About 283 BC: the Ptolemaic Kingdom founds the Mouseion and the Library of Alexandria, which tries to collect every book in the world.
steps.text_zh: 约前283年，托勒密王朝创建缪斯神殿和亚历山大图书馆，力图收集天下所有的书籍。

steps.text: About 240 BC: the librarian Eratosthenes compares noon shadows at Alexandria and Syene and works out the size of the Earth, remarkably close to the true figure.
steps.text_zh: 约前240年，图书馆馆长埃拉托斯特尼比较亚历山大港和赛伊尼正午的日影，推算出地球的周长，结果与实际相当接近。

steps.text: 196 BC: priests at Memphis honour Ptolemy V in a decree written in hieroglyphs, Demotic and Greek. One copy, the Rosetta Stone, will one day unlock hieroglyphs.
steps.text_zh: 前196年，孟菲斯的祭司用象形文字、世俗体和希腊文三种文字颁布尊崇托勒密五世的诏令。刻有此诏的罗塞塔石碑后来成为破译象形文字的钥匙。

steps.text: 30 BC: after defeat at Actium, Mark Antony and Cleopatra VII take their own lives as Octavian enters Alexandria. Egypt becomes Rome's private granary.
steps.text_zh: 前30年，亚克兴战败后，屋大维攻入亚历山大港，马克·安东尼和克娄巴特拉七世相继自杀。埃及成为罗马皇帝直辖的粮仓。

steps.text: About 150: Claudius Ptolemy writes the Almagest in Alexandria, an Earth-centred astronomy that guides scholars in Europe and the Islamic world for 1,400 years.
steps.text_zh: 约150年，托勒密在亚历山大港写成《天文学大成》，其地心说体系此后一千四百年间一直主导欧洲和伊斯兰世界的天文学。

steps.text: 318: the Alexandrian priest Arius teaches that Christ was created by the Father. The quarrel splits the church and leads to the Council of Nicaea.
steps.text_zh: 318年，亚历山大港的神父阿里乌主张基督为圣父所造，由此引发的争论撕裂教会，并促成了尼西亚公会议。

steps.text: 415: the mathematician and philosopher Hypatia is murdered by a Christian mob, a symbol of the end of pagan learning in Alexandria.
steps.text_zh: 415年，女数学家、哲学家希帕提娅被基督徒暴民杀害，这被视为亚历山大港异教学术终结的象征。

title: Islam, Cairo and the sultans
summary: Arab armies carry Islam from Egypt to the Atlantic; Fatimids build Cairo, Saladin and the Mamluks make it the capital of the Muslim world, until the Ottomans arrive.
summary_zh: 阿拉伯军队把伊斯兰教从埃及传到大西洋岸；法蒂玛王朝兴建开罗，萨拉丁和马穆鲁克使它成为伊斯兰世界的中心，直到奥斯曼人到来。

steps.text: 641: the Arab general Amr ibn al-As takes the Byzantine fortress of Babylon and soon Alexandria. Egypt passes to the caliphate.
steps.text_zh: 641年，阿拉伯将领阿慕尔·本·阿斯攻下拜占庭的巴比伦堡，随后拿下亚历山大港，埃及归入哈里发国家。

steps.text: 670: Uqba ibn Nafi founds Kairouan in Tunisia as a camp for the conquest of the Maghreb. Its great mosque makes it a holy city of the west.
steps.text_zh: 670年，欧格白·本·纳菲在突尼斯建立凯鲁万，作为征服马格里布的营地。城中大清真寺使它成为西方伊斯兰世界的圣城。

steps.text: 711: the Berber commander Tariq ibn Ziyad crosses from Morocco into Spain and defeats the Visigoths. The rock he lands by is still called Gibraltar, Jabal Tariq.
steps.text_zh: 711年，柏柏尔将领塔里克·本·齐亚德从摩洛哥渡海进入西班牙，击败西哥特人。他登陆处的山岩至今仍以他命名，即直布罗陀。

steps.text: 859: Fatima al-Fihri, a merchant's daughter from Kairouan, founds the mosque of al-Qarawiyyin at Fez, later counted the oldest university still working.
steps.text_zh: 859年，来自凯鲁万的商人之女法蒂玛·菲赫里在非斯创建卡鲁因清真寺，它后来被视为世界上仍在运作的最古老大学。

steps.text: 909: in Ifriqiya the Ismaili leader Abdallah al-Mahdi overthrows the Aghlabids and proclaims himself caliph, a Shia rival to Baghdad.
steps.text_zh: 909年，伊斯玛仪派首领马赫迪在伊夫里基亚推翻阿格拉布王朝，自称哈里发，建立与巴格达对立的什叶派法蒂玛王朝。

steps.text: 969: the Fatimid Caliphate conquers Egypt and its general Jawhar founds a new royal city, al-Qahira, Cairo, which becomes the Fatimid capital.
steps.text_zh: 969年，法蒂玛王朝征服埃及，将领昭海尔营建新城“卡希拉”，即开罗，随后成为法蒂玛王朝的首都。

steps.text: 1171: Saladin, the Kurdish vizier of Egypt, ends the Fatimid Caliphate and founds the Ayyubid dynasty, then unites Egypt and Syria against the Crusaders.
steps.text_zh: 1171年，埃及的库尔德宰相萨拉丁废黜法蒂玛王朝，建立阿尤布王朝，随后统一埃及和叙利亚，对抗十字军。

steps.text: 1250: the Seventh Crusade is crushed at Mansurah and King Louis IX of France is captured. The victorious Mamluk slave soldiers seize power, founding the Mamluk Sultanate.
steps.text_zh: 1250年，第七次十字军在曼苏拉惨败，法王路易九世被俘。立下战功的马穆鲁克奴隶军人随即夺权，建立马穆鲁克王朝。

steps.text: 1377: Ibn Khaldun writes the Muqaddimah in a castle in Algeria, a theory of how desert peoples conquer cities and how dynasties rise and decay. He later teaches in Mamluk Cairo.
steps.text_zh: 1377年，伊本·赫勒敦在阿尔及利亚的一座城堡里写成《历史绪论》，阐述游牧民族征服城市、王朝兴衰循环的道理。他后来在马穆鲁克治下的开罗讲学。

steps.text: 1517: the Ottoman sultan Selim I defeats the Mamluks at Ridaniya outside Cairo. Egypt becomes an Ottoman province for three centuries.
steps.text_zh: 1517年，奥斯曼苏丹塞利姆一世在开罗城外的里达尼亚击败马穆鲁克军队，埃及此后三百年成为奥斯曼帝国的行省。

title: Empires and independence
summary: Napoleon's landing opens two centuries of upheaval: Muhammad Ali's modern Egypt, the Suez Canal, French and British rule, and the wars and revolutions that won independence.
summary_zh: 拿破仑登陆埃及揭开两百年的剧变：穆罕默德·阿里的近代化、苏伊士运河、英法殖民统治，以及赢得独立的战争与革命。

steps.text: 1798: Napoleon lands in Egypt and beats the Mamluks at the Battle of the Pyramids. His scholars begin the scientific study of ancient Egypt.
steps.text_zh: 1798年，拿破仑登陆埃及，在金字塔战役中击败马穆鲁克骑兵。随军学者开始了对古埃及的科学研究。

steps.text: 1805: after the French leave, the Albanian officer Muhammad Ali takes control of Egypt. He builds a modern army, factories and schools, and his family rules until 1952.
steps.text_zh: 1805年，法军撤离后，阿尔巴尼亚裔军官穆罕默德·阿里掌控埃及。他建立新式军队、工厂和学校，其家族统治埃及直到1952年。

steps.text: 1830: France invades Algiers, beginning 132 years of colonial rule in Algeria.
steps.text_zh: 1830年，法国入侵阿尔及尔，开始了对阿尔及利亚长达132年的殖民统治。

steps.text: 1869: the Suez Canal opens, linking the Mediterranean and the Red Sea. The cost drives Egypt into debt to European banks.
steps.text_zh: 1869年，苏伊士运河通航，连通地中海和红海。巨额工程开支使埃及欠下欧洲银行大笔债务。

steps.text: 1882: Britain crushes Colonel Urabi's nationalist army at Tel el-Kebir and occupies Egypt to protect the canal.
steps.text_zh: 1882年，英军在泰勒凯比尔击溃奥拉比上校的民族主义军队，以保护运河为名占领埃及。

steps.text: 1942: at El Alamein, Montgomery's Eighth Army stops Rommel's Afrika Korps 100 km from Alexandria, the turning point of the war in North Africa.
steps.text_zh: 1942年，蒙哥马利的英国第八集团军在距亚历山大港约一百公里的阿拉曼挡住隆美尔的非洲军团，北非战局由此逆转。

steps.text: 1952: the Free Officers overthrow King Farouk. Gamal Abdel Nasser emerges as Egypt's leader and the voice of Arab nationalism.
steps.text_zh: 1952年，自由军官组织推翻法鲁克国王，纳赛尔成为埃及领导人和阿拉伯民族主义的代言人。

steps.text: 1954: the FLN launches the Algerian War of Independence. Eight years of brutal fighting end with independence in 1962.
steps.text_zh: 1954年，民族解放阵线发动阿尔及利亚独立战争，经过八年惨烈战斗，阿尔及利亚于1962年独立。

steps.text: 1956: Nasser nationalises the Suez Canal. Britain, France and Israel invade, but American and Soviet pressure forces them out, a sign that the old empires are finished.
steps.text_zh: 1956年，纳赛尔宣布苏伊士运河国有化，英国、法国和以色列出兵入侵，却在美苏压力下被迫撤军，旧殖民帝国的时代就此结束。

steps.text: 2010: a street vendor's self-burning in Sidi Bouzid sets off the Tunisian Revolution. The Arab Spring spreads to Egypt, where Mubarak falls in 2011, and to Libya.
steps.text_zh: 2010年，小贩在西迪布济德自焚，引发突尼斯革命。“阿拉伯之春”随即蔓延到埃及和利比亚，穆巴拉克于2011年下台。

title: Elam, Iran's first kingdom
summary: Long before the Persians, the Elamites of Susa and the highlands built cities, wrote their own scripts and fought Mesopotamia for two thousand years.
summary_zh: 早在波斯人之前，苏萨和高原上的埃兰人就建立城市、创造自己的文字，与两河流域争战了两千年。

steps.text: About 3000 BC: Shahr-e Sukhteh, the Burnt City in Sistan, flourishes as a large town of craftsmen and traders on routes across the plateau.
steps.text_zh: 约前3000年，锡斯坦的“被焚之城”沙赫尔-索赫塔繁荣起来，是高原贸易路线上一座工匠和商人聚居的大城镇。

steps.text: About 3000 BC: at Susa, scribes begin writing Proto-Elamite, Iran's first script, used for accounts. It has still not been fully deciphered.
steps.text_zh: 约前3000年，苏萨的书吏开始使用原始埃兰文字记账，这是伊朗最早的文字，至今尚未完全破译。

steps.text: About 2500 BC: the Jiroft culture of Kerman carves fine chlorite vessels with snakes and eagles, traded as far as Mesopotamia.
steps.text_zh: 约前2500年，克尔曼的吉罗夫特文化雕刻出饰有蛇与鹰的精美绿泥石器皿，远销两河流域。

steps.text: About 2300 BC: Sargon of Akkad conquers Elam. For the next centuries Elam is caught between Mesopotamian empires and its own highland kings.
steps.text_zh: 约前2300年，阿卡德的萨尔贡征服埃兰。此后几百年间，埃兰在两河流域帝国与本土高原国王之间几经易手。

steps.text: About 2100 BC: King Puzur-Inshushinak frees Elam from Akkad, conquers lands in Mesopotamia and writes in Linear Elamite, a script deciphered only in 2020.
steps.text_zh: 约前2100年，埃兰国王普朱尔-因舒希纳克摆脱阿卡德的控制，攻入两河流域，并使用线形埃兰文字。这种文字直到2020年才被破译。

steps.text: About 1250 BC: King Untash-Napirisha builds the great ziggurat of Chogha Zanbil, the best preserved ziggurat in the world.
steps.text_zh: 约前1250年，埃兰国王温塔什-纳皮里沙修建恰高·占比尔大塔庙，这是世界上保存最完好的塔庙。

steps.text: 1158 BC: Shutruk-Nakhunte sacks Babylon and carries the stele of Hammurabi's laws back to Susa, where archaeologists found it in 1901.
steps.text_zh: 前1158年，埃兰国王舒特鲁克-纳洪特洗劫巴比伦，把汉谟拉比法典石碑运回苏萨，1901年考古学家在苏萨发现了它。

steps.text: 647 BC: the Assyrian king Ashurbanipal sacks Susa and salts the land of Elam. The power vacuum opens the way for the Medes and Persians.
steps.text_zh: 前647年，亚述国王亚述巴尼拔攻陷并洗劫苏萨，在埃兰土地上撒盐。埃兰的衰亡为米底人和波斯人的兴起让开了道路。

title: The first Persian Empire
