summary: From the Median kingdom to Cyrus, Darius and Xerxes, the Achaemenid Empire becomes the largest the world had seen, until Alexander burns Persepolis.
summary_zh: 从米底王国到居鲁士、大流士和薛西斯，阿契美尼德帝国成为当时世界上最大的帝国，直到亚历山大焚毁波斯波利斯。

steps.text: About 700 BC: according to Herodotus, Deioces unites the Median tribes and builds Ecbatana, modern Hamadan, as their capital.
steps.text_zh: 约前700年，据希罗多德记载，戴奥凯斯统一米底诸部，修建埃克巴坦那（今哈马丹）为都城。

steps.text: 585 BC: the Medes and Lydians are fighting on the Halys River when the sun goes dark in an eclipse. Both sides make peace, fixing the river as their border.
steps.text_zh: 前585年，米底与吕底亚两军在哈里斯河畔交战时恰逢日全食，双方罢兵议和，以哈里斯河为界。

steps.text: 550 BC: Cyrus the Great, a Persian king of Anshan, overthrows his Median overlord and founds the Achaemenid Empire, ruling from Pasargadae.
steps.text_zh: 前550年，安善的波斯国王居鲁士大帝推翻米底宗主，建立阿契美尼德帝国，定都帕萨尔加德。

steps.text: 539 BC: Cyrus takes Babylon almost without a fight and lets the exiled Jews return home. The Cyrus Cylinder records his conquest.
steps.text_zh: 前539年，居鲁士几乎兵不血刃拿下巴比伦，允许被掳的犹太人返回故乡。居鲁士圆柱记录了这次征服。

steps.text: About 520 BC: Darius I carves his seizure of the throne into the cliff at Behistun in Old Persian, Elamite and Babylonian, the key that later unlocked cuneiform.
steps.text_zh: 约前520年，大流士一世在贝希斯敦山崖上用古波斯文、埃兰文和巴比伦文刻下自己夺取王位的经过，后来成为破译楔形文字的钥匙。

steps.text: 518 BC: Darius begins Persepolis, a ceremonial capital where subject peoples from Egypt to India are carved bringing tribute to the king.
steps.text_zh: 前518年，大流士开始营建波斯波利斯。这座礼仪之都的浮雕上刻着从埃及到印度的各族使者向国王进贡的场景。

steps.text: About 500 BC: the Royal Road runs 2,500 km from Susa to Sardis, with relay stations where royal couriers change horses, carrying a message across in about a week.
steps.text_zh: 约前500年，御道从苏萨延伸到萨第斯，全长约2500公里，沿途设驿站换马，王室信使约一周即可传递消息。

steps.text: 480 BC: Xerxes I leads a vast army into Greece and burns Athens, but his fleet is destroyed at Salamis and the invasion fails.
steps.text_zh: 前480年，薛西斯一世率大军入侵希腊，焚毁雅典，但波斯舰队在萨拉米斯海战中覆没，远征失败。

steps.text: 331 BC: Alexander the Great defeats Darius III at Gaugamela. Darius flees east and is killed by his own officers the next year.
steps.text_zh: 前331年，亚历山大大帝在高加米拉击败大流士三世。大流士向东逃亡，次年被部下杀害。

steps.text: 330 BC: Alexander burns Persepolis, perhaps as revenge for Athens. The Achaemenid Empire is at an end.
steps.text_zh: 前330年，亚历山大焚毁波斯波利斯，或许是为了报复波斯人焚烧雅典。阿契美尼德帝国就此终结。

title: Parthians and Sasanians
summary: For nearly nine hundred years two Iranian empires stood against Rome and traded with China, until the Arab conquest.
summary_zh: 将近九百年间，两大伊朗帝国与罗马抗衡、与中国通商，直到被阿拉伯人征服。

steps.text: About 247 BC: Arsaces, chief of the nomadic Parni, seizes the Seleucid province of Parthia. His Arsacid line, called Anxi in Chinese records, will rule Iran for almost 500 years.
steps.text_zh: 约前247年，游牧的帕尼人首领阿尔萨息夺取塞琉古王朝的帕提亚行省。他建立的阿萨息斯王朝（中国史书称安息）将统治伊朗近五百年。

steps.text: 141 BC: Mithridates I takes Seleucia on the Tigris. The Parthian Empire now stretches from Mesopotamia to the borders of Bactria.
steps.text_zh: 前141年，米特里达梯一世攻占底格里斯河畔的塞琉西亚，帕提亚帝国从此横跨两河流域至巴克特里亚边境。

steps.text: About 115 BC: envoys of the Han emperor reach Parthia and are met at the border by 20,000 horsemen. The Silk Road now links China and Iran.
steps.text_zh: 约前115年，汉朝使者抵达安息，安息王派两万骑兵在边境迎接。丝绸之路从此连通中国与伊朗。

steps.text: 53 BC: at Carrhae, Parthian horse archers destroy the army of the Roman general Crassus. The Euphrates becomes the border between Rome and Iran.
steps.text_zh: 前53年，帕提亚骑射手在卡莱全歼罗马统帅克拉苏的军队。此后幼发拉底河成为罗马与伊朗的分界。

steps.text: 224: Ardashir I of Persis defeats the last Parthian king and founds the Sasanian Empire, which makes Zoroastrianism its state religion.
steps.text_zh: 224年，波斯省的阿尔达希尔一世击败帕提亚末代国王，建立萨珊王朝，以琐罗亚斯德教为国教。

steps.text: 260: Shapur I defeats and captures the Roman emperor Valerian at Edessa, a triumph he carves on the cliffs of Naqsh-e Rostam.
steps.text_zh: 260年，沙普尔一世在埃德萨击败并俘虏罗马皇帝瓦勒良，他把这场胜利刻在了鲁斯塔姆岩的崖壁上。

steps.text: 531: Khosrow I takes the throne at Ctesiphon, reforms taxes and the army, and welcomes Greek and Indian learning. He becomes the model of a just Persian king.
steps.text_zh: 531年，霍斯劳一世在泰西封即位，改革税制和军制，吸纳希腊和印度学术，成为波斯明君的典范。

steps.text: 642: after losing Mesopotamia at Qadisiyyah, the Sasanians make a last stand at Nahavand and are routed by the Arabs, the 'victory of victories'.
steps.text_zh: 642年，萨珊王朝在卡迪西亚之战失去两河流域后，在纳哈万德作最后抵抗，被阿拉伯军队击溃，阿拉伯人称之为“胜利中的胜利”。

steps.text: 651: the last Sasanian king, Yazdegerd III, is killed near Merv while fleeing. His son Peroz seeks refuge in Tang China.
steps.text_zh: 651年，萨珊末代国王伊嗣俟三世在逃亡途中于木鹿附近被杀，其子卑路斯流亡唐朝。

title: The Persian renaissance
summary: Under Arab and then Turkish rule, Iranians lead a revolution, revive the Persian language and produce some of the greatest scientists and poets of the Islamic world.
summary_zh: 在阿拉伯人和突厥人统治下，伊朗人发动革命、复兴波斯语，并涌现出伊斯兰世界最伟大的一批科学家和诗人。

steps.text: 747: Abu Muslim raises the black banners in Khorasan. His Iranian army topples the Umayyads and puts the Abbasid Caliphate in power.
steps.text_zh: 747年，阿布·穆斯林在呼罗珊举起黑旗起义，他率领的伊朗军队推翻倭马亚王朝，扶立阿拔斯王朝。

steps.text: 816: Babak Khorramdin leads a twenty-year revolt in Azerbaijan against the Abbasid Caliphate, mixing Iranian religion with resistance to Arab rule.
steps.text_zh: 816年，巴贝克在阿塞拜疆发动反抗阿拔斯王朝的起义，持续二十年，融合了伊朗本土宗教与反抗阿拉伯统治的诉求。

steps.text: 861: Yaqub the Coppersmith takes power in Sistan and founds the Saffarid dynasty. He is said to have made Persian, not Arabic, the language of his court.
steps.text_zh: 861年，铜匠出身的雅各布在锡斯坦掌权，建立萨法尔王朝。据说他要求宫廷使用波斯语而非阿拉伯语。

steps.text: About 900: al-Razi of Rey runs hospitals and writes the first clear account of smallpox and measles, one of the great doctors of the Middle Ages.
steps.text_zh: 约900年，雷伊的拉齐主持医院，首次清楚区分了天花和麻疹，是中世纪最伟大的医生之一。

steps.text: 1010: after thirty years, Ferdowsi of Tus completes the Shahnameh, a 50,000-couplet epic of Iran's kings that keeps the Persian language alive.
steps.text_zh: 1010年，图斯诗人菲尔多西历时三十年完成五万联的史诗《列王纪》，讲述伊朗历代君王的故事，使波斯语得以传承。

steps.text: 1025: Avicenna completes the Canon of Medicine, a medical textbook used in Europe and the Islamic world for six hundred years.
steps.text_zh: 1025年，伊本·西那完成《医典》，这部医学教科书在欧洲和伊斯兰世界沿用了六百年。

steps.text: 1040: the Seljuk Turks defeat the Ghaznavids at Dandanaqan and take Khorasan. Within fifteen years the Seljuk Empire rules from Central Asia to Baghdad.
steps.text_zh: 1040年，塞尔柱突厥人在丹丹坎击败伽色尼王朝，夺取呼罗珊。十五年内，塞尔柱帝国的版图从中亚扩展到巴格达。

steps.text: 1065: the Persian vizier Nizam al-Mulk, the real ruler of the Seljuk state, founds the Nizamiyya colleges and runs the empire through a Persian bureaucracy.
steps.text_zh: 1065年，塞尔柱王朝的实际掌权者、波斯宰相尼扎姆·穆尔克创办尼扎米耶学院，以波斯式官僚体系治理帝国。

steps.text: About 1100: Omar Khayyam of Nishapur, mathematician and maker of the precise Jalali calendar, writes the quatrains later loved worldwide as the Rubaiyat.
steps.text_zh: 约1100年，内沙布尔的欧玛尔·海亚姆，这位编订精确的哲拉里历的数学家，写下了后来风靡世界的四行诗集《鲁拜集》。

title: Mongols, Ilkhans and Timurids
summary: The Mongols devastate Iran, then rule it as the Ilkhanate and adopt its culture; after Timur's conquests, Herat becomes a capital of Persian art.
summary_zh: 蒙古人蹂躏伊朗，随后建立伊儿汗国并接受波斯文化；帖木儿征服之后，赫拉特成为波斯艺术的中心。

steps.text: 1221: Genghis Khan's armies take Nishapur and kill almost all its people. The cities of Khorasan never fully recover.
steps.text_zh: 1221年，成吉思汗的军队攻破内沙布尔，几乎屠尽全城居民。呼罗珊诸城从此再未完全恢复元气。

steps.text: 1256: Hulagu, grandson of Genghis Khan, destroys the Assassin castles of Alamut and settles in Azerbaijan, founding the Ilkhanate.
steps.text_zh: 1256年，成吉思汗之孙旭烈兀摧毁阿拉穆特的阿萨辛派城堡，驻扎阿塞拜疆，建立伊儿汗国。

steps.text: 1258: Hulagu sacks Baghdad and puts the last Abbasid caliph to death, ending the caliphate that had ruled Iran for five centuries.
steps.text_zh: 1258年，旭烈兀攻陷巴格达，处死阿拔斯王朝末代哈里发，统治伊朗五百年的哈里发政权就此终结。

steps.text: 1259: Hulagu builds an observatory at Maragheh for the astronomer Nasir al-Din Tusi. Its tables and models later reach China and Europe.
steps.text_zh: 1259年，旭烈兀为天文学家纳西尔丁·图西在马拉盖修建天文台，其历表和理论后来传到中国和欧洲。

steps.text: 1295: Ghazan Khan converts to Islam on taking the throne. With his vizier Rashid al-Din he reforms taxes, and Rashid writes the first history of the whole known world.
steps.text_zh: 1295年，合赞汗即位并皈依伊斯兰教。他与宰相拉施特一起改革税制，拉施特还编成了第一部世界通史《史集》。

steps.text: 1335: Abu Said dies without an heir and the Ilkhanate breaks into rival states.
steps.text_zh: 1335年，不赛因汗去世而无子嗣，伊儿汗国分裂为多个互相争斗的政权。

steps.text: About 1360: in Shiraz, Hafez writes his ghazals of love and wine. Iranians still open his Divan to read their fortune.
steps.text_zh: 约1360年，哈菲兹在设拉子写下吟咏爱与美酒的抒情诗。至今伊朗人仍会随手翻开他的诗集占卜运势。

steps.text: 1381: Timur takes Herat, the start of campaigns that bring all of Iran under the Timurid Empire with massacres and towers of skulls.
steps.text_zh: 1381年，帖木儿攻占赫拉特，此后接连征战，以屠城和人头塔威慑各地，把整个伊朗并入帖木儿帝国。

steps.text: 1409: Timur's son Shah Rukh rules from Herat and, with his queen Goharshad, fills it with mosques, libraries and gardens.
steps.text_zh: 1409年，帖木儿之子沙哈鲁定都赫拉特，与王后高哈尔沙德一起在城中兴建清真寺、图书馆和花园。

steps.text: About 1488: the painter Behzad leads the Herat school of miniature painting, the peak of Persian book art.
steps.text_zh: 约1488年，画家毕扎德领导赫拉特细密画派，这是波斯书籍艺术的巅峰。

title: Safavid Iran and its heirs
title_zh: 萨法维王朝及其后继者
summary: The Safavids make Iran a Shia state with borders close to today's; after their fall Nader Shah, Karim Khan and the Qajars fight over the inheritance.
summary_zh: 萨法维王朝把伊朗变成什叶派国家，疆域与今日相近；王朝覆灭后，纳迪尔沙、卡里姆汗和恺加王朝相继争夺天下。

steps.text: 1501: the fourteen-year-old Ismail, head of the Safavid Sufi order, takes Tabriz and crowns himself shah. He makes Twelver Shia Islam the state religion.
steps.text_zh: 1501年，萨法维苏菲教团十四岁的首领伊斯玛仪攻占大不里士，自立为沙阿，宣布十二伊玛目什叶派为国教。

steps.text: 1514: Ottoman cannon and muskets crush Ismail's cavalry at Chaldiran. The border between Sunni Ottomans and Shia Iran begins to set.
steps.text_zh: 1514年，奥斯曼帝国的火炮和火枪在查尔迪兰击溃伊斯玛仪的骑兵，逊尼派奥斯曼与什叶派伊朗的边界由此逐渐成形。

steps.text: 1598: Shah Abbas the Great moves his capital to Isfahan and builds the vast Naqsh-e Jahan square. 'Isfahan is half the world', people say.
steps.text_zh: 1598年，阿拔斯大帝迁都伊斯法罕，修建宏大的伊玛目广场。时人称“伊斯法罕半天下”。

steps.text: 1606: Shah Abbas settles Armenians from Julfa in a new quarter of Isfahan. Their merchants run Iran's silk trade from Amsterdam to Manila.
steps.text_zh: 1606年，阿拔斯大帝把朱勒法的亚美尼亚人迁到伊斯法罕的新朱勒法区，这些商人经营的伊朗丝绸贸易西至阿姆斯特丹、东至马尼拉。

steps.text: 1622: with English ships, Iran takes Hormuz from the Portuguese, who had held the gateway of the Gulf for a century.
steps.text_zh: 1622年，伊朗借助英国船只从葡萄牙人手中夺回霍尔木兹。葡萄牙人控制这一波斯湾门户已有百年。

steps.text: 1639: the Treaty of Zuhab ends a long war with the Ottomans. Iraq goes to the Ottomans, and the line drawn then is close to today's Iran-Iraq border.
steps.text_zh: 1639年，伊朗与奥斯曼帝国签订《祖哈布条约》，结束长期战争。伊拉克归属奥斯曼，当时划定的边界与今天的两伊边界大体相当。

steps.text: 1722: Afghan rebels besiege Isfahan for months; tens of thousands starve before the shah surrenders, and Safavid power collapses.
steps.text_zh: 1722年，阿富汗叛军围困伊斯法罕数月，数万人饿死，沙阿出城投降，萨法维王朝的统治随之崩溃。

steps.text: 1736: the general Nader, who has driven out the Afghans and Ottomans, has himself crowned shah on the Mughan plain. In 1739 he sacks Delhi and carries off the Peacock Throne.
steps.text_zh: 1736年，赶走阿富汗人和奥斯曼人的将领纳迪尔在穆甘草原加冕为沙阿。1739年他攻破德里，掠走孔雀宝座。

steps.text: 1751: after Nader's murder, Karim Khan Zand gains power and rules most of Iran from Shiraz, calling himself not shah but 'advocate of the people'.
steps.text_zh: 1751年，纳迪尔沙遇刺后，卡里姆汗·赞德掌握大权，以设拉子为都统治伊朗大部，不称沙阿而自称“人民的代理人”。

steps.text: 1796: the eunuch chief Agha Mohammad Khan Qajar is crowned shah and makes Tehran the capital, founding the Qajar dynasty.
steps.text_zh: 1796年，阿迦·穆罕默德汗加冕为沙阿，定都德黑兰，建立恺加王朝。

title: Oil, shahs and revolution
summary: Squeezed by Russia and Britain, Iranians demand a constitution, discover oil, modernise under the Pahlavis and then overthrow them in 1979.
summary_zh: 在俄英两国的挤压下，伊朗人要求立宪、发现石油，在巴列维王朝治下推行现代化，又在1979年推翻了它。

steps.text: 1828: defeated by Russia, Qajar Iran signs the Treaty of Turkmenchay, losing its Caucasus lands and granting Russians special legal rights.
steps.text_zh: 1828年，恺加王朝被俄国击败，签订《土库曼恰伊条约》，割让高加索领土，并给予俄国人领事裁判权。

steps.text: 1891: the shah sells a British company the monopoly on Iran's tobacco. A religious ruling against smoking leads to a nationwide boycott, and the concession is cancelled.
steps.text_zh: 1891年，国王把伊朗烟草专卖权卖给一家英国公司。宗教领袖发布禁烟令，全国抵制吸烟，迫使国王撤销特许权。

steps.text: 1906: after mass protests, the shah agrees to a constitution and an elected parliament, the Majlis, the first in the Middle East.
steps.text_zh: 1906年，民众大规模抗议后，国王被迫同意颁布宪法、设立民选议会，这是中东第一个议会。

steps.text: 1908: British prospectors strike oil at Masjed Soleyman. The Anglo-Persian Oil Company, later BP, controls Iranian oil for four decades.
steps.text_zh: 1908年，英国勘探者在马斯吉德苏莱曼钻出石油。英波石油公司（后来的英国石油公司）此后四十年控制着伊朗石油。

steps.text: 1925: the army officer Reza Khan deposes the last Qajar and becomes Reza Shah Pahlavi. He builds railways, schools and a modern army by force; in 1935 Persia is renamed Iran.
steps.text_zh: 1925年，军官礼萨·汗废黜恺加王朝末代国王，自立为礼萨·沙阿·巴列维。他以强权修铁路、办学校、建新军，1935年国号由波斯改为伊朗。

steps.text: 1941: Britain and the Soviet Union invade Iran to secure its oil and supply routes. Reza Shah abdicates for his son Mohammad Reza.
steps.text_zh: 1941年，英国和苏联出兵伊朗，以控制石油和援苏通道。礼萨·沙阿被迫退位，由儿子穆罕默德·礼萨继位。

steps.text: 1953: Prime Minister Mohammad Mosaddegh, who had nationalised the oil industry in 1951, is overthrown in a coup backed by the CIA and Britain. The shah returns to rule more firmly.
steps.text_zh: 1953年，曾于1951年把石油工业收归国有的首相摩萨台在美国中央情报局和英国策划的政变中下台，国王重掌大权。

steps.text: 1963: the shah launches the White Revolution of land reform and votes for women. The cleric Ruhollah Khomeini denounces him and is exiled.
steps.text_zh: 1963年，国王推行土地改革、给予妇女选举权的“白色革命”。教士霍梅尼公开抨击国王，随后被流放。

steps.text: 1979: millions march against the shah, who flees. Khomeini returns from exile and Iran becomes an Islamic Republic ruled by clerics.
steps.text_zh: 1979年，数百万人上街反对国王，国王出逃。霍梅尼结束流亡归国，伊朗成为由教士领导的伊斯兰共和国。

steps.text: 2022: the death in police custody of Mahsa Amini, arrested over her headscarf, sets off months of protests under the slogan 'Woman, Life, Freedom'.
steps.text_zh: 2022年，玛莎·阿米尼因头巾问题被捕后死于警方羁押，引发持续数月的抗议，口号是“妇女、生命、自由”。

title: Oasis towns and horse peoples
summary: Farmers build towns in the southern oases while steppe herders invent the chariot and spread across Eurasia; by the Iron Age the Saka bury their chiefs in gold.
summary_zh: 南方绿洲的农民修建城镇，草原牧民发明战车、扩散到欧亚各地；到铁器时代，塞人用黄金装殓他们的首领。

steps.text: About 3000 BC: at the foot of the Kopet Dag, farmers of the Namazga culture irrigate fields and live in mud-brick villages, the start of town life in Central Asia.
steps.text_zh: 约前3000年，科佩特山脚下的纳马兹加文化农民引水灌溉、住在泥砖村落里，中亚的城镇生活由此起步。

steps.text: About 2400 BC: Altyn-Depe grows into a proto-city with craftsmen's quarters and a stepped temple platform, trading with the Indus valley.
steps.text_zh: 约前2400年，阿尔丁特佩发展成一座原始城市，有工匠街区和阶梯状神庙台基，并与印度河流域往来贸易。

steps.text: About 2100 BC: in the southern Urals the Sintashta people build fortified settlements and bury the first true spoke-wheeled chariots with their dead.
steps.text_zh: 约前2100年，乌拉尔山南部的辛塔什塔人修建设防聚落，并在墓中随葬最早的真正辐条轮战车。

steps.text: About 2000 BC: the Oxus civilisation, also called Bactria-Margiana, is at its height, with walled palaces like Gonur Depe in the Murghab delta.
steps.text_zh: 约前2000年，阿姆河文明（又称巴克特里亚-马尔吉亚纳文明）达到鼎盛，在穆尔加布河三角洲建起戈努尔遗址这样的城墙宫殿。

steps.text: About 1800 BC: Andronovo herders, probably speaking early Indo-Iranian languages, spread with horses and bronze across the steppe from the Urals to the Altai.
steps.text_zh: 约前1800年，很可能说早期印度-伊朗语的安德罗诺沃牧民带着马匹和青铜器，从乌拉尔山扩散到阿尔泰山之间的广阔草原。

steps.text: About 1200 BC (the date is much debated): the prophet Zoroaster preaches in eastern Iran or Bactria a faith of one wise god and a struggle between truth and the lie.
steps.text_zh: 约前1200年（年代争议很大），先知琐罗亚斯德在伊朗东部或巴克特里亚一带传道，宣扬至善之神和真理与谎言的斗争。

steps.text: About 800 BC: in Tuva, horse nomads raise the Arzhan kurgan for a chief, with dozens of sacrificed horses, among the earliest of the great Scythian-style burials.
steps.text_zh: 约前800年，图瓦的骑马游牧民为首领修建阿尔然大墓，殉葬数十匹马，是最早的斯基泰式大型墓葬之一。

steps.text: About 700 BC: Samarkand, ancient Marakanda, is founded in the Zeravshan valley and becomes the heart of Sogdia.
steps.text_zh: 约前700年，撒马尔罕（古称马拉坎达）在泽拉夫尚河谷建立，后来成为粟特地区的中心。

steps.text: About 400 BC: in the Altai, permafrost preserves the Pazyryk tombs: tattooed chiefs, felt hangings, and the oldest knotted carpet in the world.
steps.text_zh: 约前400年，阿尔泰山的冻土保存下巴泽雷克墓葬：身有纹身的首领、毛毡挂毯，还有世界上最古老的栽绒地毯。

steps.text: About 400 BC: near Almaty a Saka warrior is buried in a suit covered with thousands of gold plaques, the 'Golden Man', now a symbol of Kazakhstan.
steps.text_zh: 约前400年，阿拉木图附近一位塞人武士下葬时身穿缀满数千片金饰的衣甲，这位“金人”如今是哈萨克斯坦的象征。

title: Persians, Greeks and Yuezhi
title_zh: 波斯人、希腊人与月氏人
summary: Cyrus, Alexander and the Greek kings of Bactria fight for the oases of Central Asia, until nomads from the east sweep them away.
summary_zh: 居鲁士、亚历山大和巴克特里亚的希腊国王先后争夺中亚绿洲，最终被来自东方的游牧民族一扫而空。

steps.text: About 545 BC: Cyrus the Great conquers Bactria and Sogdia and builds a fortress town, Cyropolis, on the Syr Darya frontier.
steps.text_zh: 约前545年，居鲁士大帝征服巴克特里亚和粟特，在锡尔河边境修建要塞居鲁士城。

steps.text: 530 BC: by Herodotus' account, Cyrus is killed fighting the Massagetae, nomads of the steppe led by their queen Tomyris.
steps.text_zh: 前530年，据希罗多德记载，居鲁士在与草原游牧民族马萨革泰人作战时阵亡，率领马萨革泰人的是女王托米丽司。

steps.text: 329 BC: Alexander reaches the Jaxartes, the Syr Darya, founds Alexandria Eschate, and crosses the river to beat the Saka with his catapults and archers.
steps.text_zh: 前329年，亚历山大抵达药杀水（锡尔河），建立“极远的亚历山大城”，并渡河以投石机和弓箭手击败塞人。

steps.text: 329 BC: behind him the Sogdian noble Spitamenes rises in revolt around Samarkand. It takes Alexander two hard years to put down.
steps.text_zh: 前329年，粟特贵族斯皮塔米尼斯在亚历山大身后的撒马尔罕一带起兵反抗，亚历山大苦战两年才将其平定。

steps.text: 327 BC: after storming the Sogdian Rock, Alexander marries Roxana, daughter of a Bactrian noble, to win over the local lords.
steps.text_zh: 前327年，亚历山大攻下粟特岩堡后，娶巴克特里亚贵族之女罗克珊娜为妻，以笼络当地贵族。

steps.text: About 280 BC: at Ai-Khanoum on the Oxus, Greek settlers build a city with a theatre, a gymnasium and Delphic maxims carved in stone.
steps.text_zh: 约前280年，希腊移民在阿姆河畔的阿伊哈努姆建起一座城市，有剧场和体育馆，还刻着来自德尔斐的格言。

steps.text: About 250 BC: the governor Diodotus breaks away from the Seleucids and founds the Greco-Bactrian kingdom, which Chinese records call Daxia.
steps.text_zh: 约前250年，总督狄奥多图斯脱离塞琉古王朝，建立希腊-巴克特里亚王国，中国史书称之为大夏。

steps.text: About 145 BC: nomads burn Ai-Khanoum and the Greek city is never rebuilt.
steps.text_zh: 约前145年，游牧民族焚毁阿伊哈努姆，这座希腊城市从此再未重建。

steps.text: About 130 BC: the Yuezhi, driven west from Gansu by the Xiongnu, cross the Oxus and conquer Bactria, ending Greek rule.
steps.text_zh: 约前130年，被匈奴从河西赶走的大月氏西迁，渡过阿姆河征服大夏，希腊人在此的统治宣告结束。

steps.text: About 128 BC: the Han envoy Zhang Qian finally reaches the Yuezhi, but they are content in their rich new land and refuse an alliance against the Xiongnu.
steps.text_zh: 约前128年，汉朝使者张骞终于抵达大月氏，但大月氏安于富饶的新土地，拒绝与汉朝联合攻打匈奴。

title: Kushans, Huns and Turks
summary: The Kushans build an empire astride the Silk Road and spread Buddhism; Huns and Hephthalites follow, until the Turks and Persians crush them.
summary_zh: 贵霜人在丝绸之路上建立帝国、传播佛教；随后匈人和嚈哒人相继称雄，直到突厥人与波斯人联手将其消灭。

steps.text: About 30: Kujula Kadphises unites the five Yuezhi tribes in Bactria and founds the Kushan Empire, which pushes south over the Hindu Kush into India.
steps.text_zh: 约30年，丘就却统一巴克特里亚的大月氏五部翕侯，建立贵霜帝国，并越过兴都库什山向印度扩张。

steps.text: 90: a Kushan army crosses the Pamirs to attack the Han general Ban Chao in the Tarim basin and is forced to withdraw.
steps.text_zh: 90年，贵霜军队翻越帕米尔高原进攻塔里木盆地的东汉将领班超，被迫撤退。

steps.text: About 100: Buddhist monasteries such as Fayaz Tepe rise around Termez on the Oxus, stations on the road that carries Buddhism toward China.
steps.text_zh: 约100年，阿姆河畔的铁尔梅兹周围建起法雅兹特佩等佛教寺院，成为佛教向中国传播途中的驿站。

steps.text: 127: Kanishka the Great rules from Peshawar to the Ganges. A patron of Buddhism, he presides over the art of Gandhara, where the Buddha is first shown in human form.
steps.text_zh: 127年，迦腻色伽一世的统治从白沙瓦延伸到恒河流域。他大力扶持佛教，犍陀罗艺术在他治下兴盛，佛陀首次以人的形象出现。

steps.text: About 240: the Sasanian Empire conquers Bactria, and Sasanian princes rule it as Kushanshahs.
steps.text_zh: 约240年，萨珊王朝征服巴克特里亚，由萨珊王子以“贵霜王”名号治理。

steps.text: About 360: the Kidarites, the first of the Huna peoples, take Bactria from the Sasanians.
steps.text_zh: 约360年，寄多罗人，即第一批南下的匈人部族，从萨珊手中夺取巴克特里亚。

steps.text: About 450: the Hephthalites, the 'White Huns', rise to power, ruling from Sogdia to northern India and taking tribute from Persia.
steps.text_zh: 约450年，号称“白匈奴”的嚈哒人崛起，统治范围从粟特延伸到印度北部，并向波斯索取贡赋。

steps.text: 484: the Sasanian king Peroz I attacks the Hephthalites and is killed with his army, lured into a hidden trench.
steps.text_zh: 484年，萨珊国王卑路斯一世进攻嚈哒，中了伏兵壕沟之计，与全军一同覆没。

steps.text: About 557: the new Turkic Khaganate and the Sasanian king Khosrow I crush the Hephthalites between them and split their lands along the Oxus.
steps.text_zh: 约557年，新兴的突厥汗国与萨珊国王霍斯劳一世东西夹击，消灭嚈哒，以阿姆河为界瓜分其领土。

steps.text: 568: the Byzantine envoy Zemarchus visits the Turkic khagan Istämi in the Tian Shan. Turks and Byzantium plan to trade silk while bypassing Persia.
steps.text_zh: 568年，拜占庭使者蔡马库斯到天山拜见突厥室点密可汗，双方商议绕开波斯直接进行丝绸贸易。

title: Sogdians, Arabs and Samanids
title_zh: 粟特、阿拉伯与萨曼王朝
summary: Sogdian Samarkand trades with Tang China; Arab armies bring Islam and the Samanids make Bukhara a centre of Persian culture before the Turks convert.
summary_zh: 粟特人的撒马尔罕与唐朝通商；阿拉伯军队带来伊斯兰教，萨曼王朝使布哈拉成为波斯文化中心，此后突厥人也皈依了伊斯兰教。

steps.text: 630: the Chinese monk Xuanzang, on his way to India, meets the Western Turkic khagan at Suyab and passes through Samarkand, a Sogdian city of merchants.
steps.text_zh: 630年，前往印度取经的玄奘在碎叶城拜见西突厥可汗，随后经过粟特商人之城撒马尔罕。

steps.text: About 660: King Varkhuman of Samarkand has his hall painted with envoys from China, Korea and Persia, a picture of the Silk Road world.
steps.text_zh: 约660年，撒马尔罕国王拂呼缦在宫殿墙上绘制来自中国、朝鲜半岛和波斯的使节，堪称丝绸之路世界的缩影。

steps.text: 705: the Arab general Qutayba ibn Muslim begins the conquest of Transoxiana, taking Bukhara and Samarkand for the Umayyad Caliphate.
steps.text_zh: 705年，阿拉伯将领屈底波开始征服河中地区，为倭马亚王朝攻下布哈拉和撒马尔罕。

steps.text: 751: Abbasid troops defeat a Tang army under Gao Xianzhi near the Talas river. Tang power west of the Pamirs fades and the region turns toward Islam.
steps.text_zh: 751年，阿拔斯王朝军队在怛罗斯河附近击败高仙芝率领的唐军。唐朝在帕米尔以西的影响力随之衰退，这一地区逐渐转向伊斯兰世界。

steps.text: 751: papermaking is set up in Samarkand, by legend by Chinese prisoners from Talas, and from there spreads to Baghdad and the West.
steps.text_zh: 751年，撒马尔罕开始造纸，相传由怛罗斯之战的中国战俘传授，此后造纸术传到巴格达和西方。

steps.text: 819: the Abbasid caliph rewards the sons of Saman Khuda with governorships in Transoxiana, the start of the Samanid Empire.
steps.text_zh: 819年，阿拔斯哈里发委任萨曼·胡达的孙辈治理河中各地，萨曼王朝由此兴起。

steps.text: About 914: the Samanid Mausoleum is raised in Bukhara, a cube of patterned brick, one of the oldest masterpieces of Islamic architecture in Central Asia.
steps.text_zh: 约914年，布哈拉建成萨曼王朝陵墓，这座以花纹砖砌成的立方体建筑是中亚最古老的伊斯兰建筑杰作之一。

steps.text: About 930: at the Samanid court in Bukhara, Rudaki writes poems in New Persian, and Persian returns as a language of literature.
steps.text_zh: 约930年，鲁达基在布哈拉的萨曼王朝宫廷用新波斯语作诗，波斯语重新成为文学语言。

steps.text: About 934: Satuq Bughra Khan of Kashgar converts to Islam. His Kara-Khanid dynasty is the first Turkic state to adopt the faith.
steps.text_zh: 约934年，喀什噶尔的萨图克·布格拉汗皈依伊斯兰教，他的喀喇汗王朝成为第一个接受伊斯兰教的突厥政权。

steps.text: 999: the Kara-Khanids take Bukhara and end the Samanids. From now on Turks, not Iranians, rule Central Asia.
steps.text_zh: 999年，喀喇汗王朝攻占布哈拉，萨曼王朝灭亡。此后统治中亚的是突厥人而不再是伊朗人。

title: The Mongol storm
summary: Khwarazm rises to power, provokes Genghis Khan and is destroyed; Central Asia then becomes the realm of his sons, the Chagatai Khanate and the Golden Horde.
summary_zh: 花剌子模崛起后招惹成吉思汗而遭灭顶之灾；此后中亚成为成吉思汗子孙的天下，分属察合台汗国和金帐汗国。

steps.text: 1141: the Kara Khitai under Yelü Dashi rout the Seljuk sultan Sanjar at Qatwan near Samarkand. Their victory gives rise in Europe to the legend of Prester John.
steps.text_zh: 1141年，耶律大石率领的西辽军队在撒马尔罕附近的卡特万大败塞尔柱苏丹桑贾尔。这场胜利在欧洲演变为“约翰长老”的传说。

steps.text: 1218: the governor of Otrar, a city of the Khwarazmian shah, massacres a Mongol trade caravan, and the shah kills Genghis Khan's envoys sent to protest.
steps.text_zh: 1218年，花剌子模的讹答剌守将屠杀蒙古商队，花剌子模沙随后又杀死成吉思汗派来交涉的使者。

steps.text: 1219: Genghis Khan invades with perhaps 100,000 horsemen. Otrar is besieged while his columns strike at the oasis cities.
steps.text_zh: 1219年，成吉思汗率约十万骑兵西征，一面围攻讹答剌，一面分兵进攻各绿洲城市。

steps.text: 1220: Bukhara falls and is burned; Samarkand surrenders soon after. Shah Muhammad flees and dies on an island in the Caspian Sea.
steps.text_zh: 1220年，布哈拉陷落并被焚毁，撒马尔罕随即投降。花剌子模沙摩诃末逃亡，死于里海的一座小岛上。

steps.text: 1221: the Mongols push into Khorasan and annihilate Nishapur, Merv and Herat. The old irrigated cities of the region never fully recover.
steps.text_zh: 1221年，蒙古军队深入呼罗珊，屠灭内沙布尔、木鹿和赫拉特。这一地区古老的灌溉城市从此一蹶不振。

steps.text: 1225: Genghis Khan gives Central Asia to his second son Chagatai, whose Chagatai Khanate will rule the region for over a century.
steps.text_zh: 1225年，成吉思汗把中亚分封给次子察合台，察合台汗国此后统治这一地区一百多年。

steps.text: 1242: back from Europe, Batu settles on the lower Volga and founds the Golden Horde, which rules the western steppe and the Rus' princes.
steps.text_zh: 1242年，拔都从欧洲回师，驻扎伏尔加河下游，建立金帐汗国，统治西部草原和罗斯诸公国。

steps.text: 1269: at a kurultai on the Talas, the Chagatai, Ögedei and Golden Horde princes divide Central Asia among themselves, defying Kublai Khan.
steps.text_zh: 1269年，察合台、窝阔台和金帐汗国的宗王在塔剌思河召开忽里勒台，自行瓜分中亚，公然对抗忽必烈。

steps.text: 1271: the administrator Mas'ud Beg introduces a sound silver coinage across the Chagatai lands and helps revive the ruined cities.
steps.text_zh: 1271年，理财官马苏德·别克在察合台汗国推行统一的足值银币，帮助残破的城市重新恢复。

steps.text: 1338: Nestorian gravestones near Lake Issyk-Kul record a wave of deaths from plague, perhaps the start of the Black Death that reaches Europe in 1347.
steps.text_zh: 1338年，伊塞克湖附近的景教徒墓碑记录了一场瘟疫造成的大量死亡，这可能是1347年传入欧洲的黑死病的源头。

title: Timur and his heirs
summary: A Turkic warlord from Samarkand conquers from Delhi to Ankara; his grandson Ulugh Beg makes Samarkand a city of astronomy, until the Uzbeks arrive.
summary_zh: 来自撒马尔罕的突厥军事首领帖木儿征服了从德里到安卡拉的广大地区；他的孙子兀鲁伯把撒马尔罕变成天文学之城，直到乌兹别克人到来。

steps.text: 1370: Timur, a lame Turkic noble, makes himself master of Transoxiana at Balkh and chooses Samarkand as the capital of the Timurid Empire.
steps.text_zh: 1370年，跛足的突厥贵族帖木儿在巴尔赫成为河中地区的主宰，定撒马尔罕为帖木儿帝国的首都。

steps.text: 1395: Timur crushes his former protégé Tokhtamysh of the Golden Horde on the Terek river, then sacks the Horde's trading cities.
steps.text_zh: 1395年，帖木儿在捷列克河畔击溃曾受他扶持的金帐汗国大汗脱脱迷失，随后洗劫金帐汗国的商业城市。

steps.text: 1398: Timur sacks Delhi and carries off its craftsmen and elephants to build his capital.
steps.text_zh: 1398年，帖木儿洗劫德里，把城中的工匠和大象掳回，用来营建都城。

steps.text: 1402: at Ankara Timur defeats and captures the Ottoman sultan Bayezid I, delaying the fall of Constantinople by fifty years.
steps.text_zh: 1402年，帖木儿在安卡拉击败并俘虏奥斯曼苏丹巴耶济德一世，使君士坦丁堡的陷落推迟了五十年。

steps.text: 1405: Timur dies at Otrar while setting out to invade Ming China, and his empire is divided among his sons.
steps.text_zh: 1405年，帖木儿在出兵征讨明朝的途中死于讹答剌，帝国随即被诸子瓜分。

steps.text: 1417: Timur's grandson Ulugh Beg, ruler of Samarkand, opens his madrasa on the Registan, where he himself teaches mathematics and astronomy.
steps.text_zh: 1417年，帖木儿之孙、撒马尔罕统治者兀鲁伯在列吉斯坦广场建成经学院，并亲自在此讲授数学和天文学。

steps.text: 1428: Ulugh Beg builds a giant observatory, and his star catalogue of over a thousand stars is the most accurate since antiquity.
steps.text_zh: 1428年，兀鲁伯修建巨型天文台，他编制的千余颗恒星星表是古代以来最精确的。

steps.text: About 1465: the sultans Kerey and Janibek lead their followers away from the Uzbek khan and found the Kazakh Khanate on the Chu river.
steps.text_zh: 约1465年，克烈和贾尼别克两位苏丹率部众脱离乌兹别克汗，在楚河流域建立哈萨克汗国。

steps.text: 1483: in Timurid Herat, Ali-Shir Navoi completes his Khamsa, proving that Chagatai Turkic can rival Persian as a language of poetry.
steps.text_zh: 1483年，阿里希尔·纳沃伊在帖木儿王朝的赫拉特完成《五卷诗》，证明察合台突厥语可以与波斯语并驾齐驱。

steps.text: 1500: the Uzbek leader Muhammad Shaybani takes Samarkand from the Timurids. The young prince Babur is driven south and will found the Mughal Empire in India.
steps.text_zh: 1500年，乌兹别克首领昔班尼从帖木儿后裔手中夺取撒马尔罕。年轻的王子巴布尔被迫南下，后来在印度建立莫卧儿帝国。

title: From khanates to republics
summary: Kazakh hordes turn to Russia for protection, the tsars conquer the oasis khanates, and Soviet rule draws new borders and new disasters before independence in 1991.
summary_zh: 哈萨克各玉兹向俄国寻求保护，沙皇征服绿洲诸汗国，苏联划定新边界、也带来新的灾难，直到1991年各国独立。

steps.text: 1723: the Dzungars invade the Kazakh lands, killing and scattering whole clans. The Kazakhs remember these as the Years of Great Disaster.
steps.text_zh: 1723年，准噶尔人大举进攻哈萨克草原，屠戮、驱散整个部落，哈萨克人称之为“大灾难年代”。

steps.text: 1731: seeking help against the Dzungars, Abulkhair Khan of the Junior Zhuz swears allegiance to the Russian Empire, the first step of Russia's advance into Central Asia.
steps.text_zh: 1731年，为求援抵御准噶尔，小玉兹的阿布尔海尔汗宣誓效忠俄罗斯帝国，这是俄国进入中亚的第一步。

steps.text: 1865: General Chernyayev storms Tashkent, the largest city of Central Asia, against orders. It becomes the capital of Russian Turkestan.
steps.text_zh: 1865年，切尔尼亚耶夫将军违抗命令攻占中亚最大城市塔什干，此后塔什干成为俄属突厥斯坦的首府。

steps.text: 1873: Russian columns cross the desert and take Khiva. Like Bukhara, the khanate survives only as a Russian protectorate.
steps.text_zh: 1873年，俄军穿越沙漠攻占希瓦。与布哈拉一样，希瓦汗国只能作为俄国的保护国苟存。

steps.text: 1881: General Skobelev storms the Turkmen fortress of Geok Tepe and massacres its defenders, completing the Russian conquest.
steps.text_zh: 1881年，斯科别列夫将军攻陷土库曼人的格奥克捷佩要塞并屠杀守军，俄国完成了对中亚的征服。

steps.text: 1916: a wartime order drafting Central Asians for labour behind the front sets off a revolt. Its brutal suppression drives many Kazakhs and Kyrgyz to flee to China.
steps.text_zh: 1916年，俄国战时征调中亚人到前线后方服劳役，引发大起义。起义遭到残酷镇压，大批哈萨克人和吉尔吉斯人逃往中国。

steps.text: 1924: the Soviets redraw the map along national lines, creating the Uzbek and Turkmen republics. The borders of today's five states start here.
steps.text_zh: 1924年，苏联按民族重新划分中亚，设立乌兹别克和土库曼等加盟共和国，今天五国的边界由此奠定。

steps.text: 1930: forced collectivisation and the seizure of herds bring famine to the Kazakh steppe. Perhaps 1.5 million die, close to two-fifths of the Kazakhs.
steps.text_zh: 1930年，强制集体化和没收牲畜给哈萨克草原带来大饥荒，约一百五十万人死亡，接近哈萨克人口的五分之二。

steps.text: 1960: Soviet planners divert the Amu Darya and Syr Darya to grow cotton. The Aral Sea, once the world's fourth largest lake, begins to dry up.
steps.text_zh: 1960年，苏联把阿姆河和锡尔河的河水引去种植棉花，曾是世界第四大湖的咸海开始干涸。

steps.text: 1991: as the Soviet Union collapses, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan become independent states.
steps.text_zh: 1991年，苏联解体，哈萨克斯坦、乌兹别克斯坦、土库曼斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦和塔吉克斯坦成为独立国家。

title: Bronze Age Europe and the Aegean
title_zh: 青铜时代的欧洲与爱琴海
summary: From the stones of Stonehenge to the palaces of Crete and Mycenae, Europe's first great builders rise, and then fall in the Bronze Age collapse.
summary_zh: 从巨石阵到克里特与迈锡尼的王宫，欧洲最早的伟大建造者相继崛起，又在青铜时代的大崩溃中衰落。

steps.text: About 3000 BC: on Salisbury Plain in Britain, farmers dig the first circular ditch of Stonehenge. Over the next thousand years the great stones are raised, lined up with the midsummer sunrise.
steps.text_zh: 约前3000年，不列颠索尔兹伯里平原上的农人挖出巨石阵最早的环形壕沟。此后一千多年间，巨大的石块陆续竖起，对准夏至的日出方向。

steps.text: About 3000 BC: a walled town is founded at Troy, guarding the entrance to the Dardanelles. It will be rebuilt layer upon layer for two thousand years.
steps.text_zh: 约前3000年，特洛伊城在达达尼尔海峡入口附近建立。此后两千年间，这座城市层层重建。

steps.text: About 2800 BC: the Bell Beaker culture, named for its drinking cups, spreads from Iberia across western Europe, carrying copper working and new burial customs.
steps.text_zh: 约前2800年，以钟形陶杯得名的钟形杯文化从伊比利亚半岛传遍西欧，带去了铜器冶炼和新的丧葬习俗。

steps.text: About 1900 BC: the Minoans of Crete build the palace of Knossos, a maze of courtyards, storerooms and painted halls. Crete becomes the hub of trade in the Aegean.
steps.text_zh: 约前1900年，克里特岛上的米诺斯人建起克诺索斯王宫，庭院、仓库与彩绘殿堂层层相连。克里特成为爱琴海贸易的中心。

steps.text: About 1600 BC: the volcano of Thera (Santorini) explodes in one of the largest eruptions in human history, burying the town of Akrotiri under ash.
steps.text_zh: 约前1600年，锡拉岛（今圣托里尼岛）火山大爆发，这是人类历史上规模最大的火山喷发之一，阿克罗蒂里城被火山灰掩埋。

steps.text: About 1550 BC: warrior chiefs at Mycenae on the Greek mainland are buried in shaft graves with gold masks and weapons. A Greek-speaking power is rising.
steps.text_zh: 约前1550年，希腊本土迈锡尼的武士首领葬于竖井墓中，随葬金面具和兵器。一个说希腊语的新兴力量正在崛起。

steps.text: About 1450 BC: Mycenaean Greeks take over Knossos, and palace scribes begin writing an early form of Greek in Linear B.
steps.text_zh: 约前1450年，迈锡尼希腊人控制了克诺索斯，宫廷书吏开始用线形文字B书写早期希腊语。

steps.text: About 1250 BC: Mycenae is ringed with huge 'Cyclopean' walls and entered through the Lion Gate, the high point of Mycenaean power.
steps.text_zh: 约前1250年，迈锡尼城修起巨石垒成的“独眼巨人墙”，以狮子门为入口，迈锡尼文明达到鼎盛。

steps.text: About 1200 BC: Troy is burned, perhaps in the war Homer would later sing of in the Iliad.
steps.text_zh: 约前1200年，特洛伊城毁于大火，这或许就是后来荷马在《伊利亚特》中吟唱的那场战争。

steps.text: About 1100 BC: the Mycenaean palaces have fallen, writing is forgotten, and newcomers such as the Dorians move south. Greece enters its Dark Ages.
steps.text_zh: 约前1100年，迈锡尼诸王宫相继毁灭，文字失传，多利亚人等族群南下，希腊进入黑暗时代。

title: Greek Cities and the Persian Wars
summary: Rival Greek cities share games and colonies, invent democracy in Athens, beat back the Persian Empire, then tear each other apart.
summary_zh: 彼此竞争的希腊城邦共享赛会、四处殖民，雅典创立民主，城邦联手击退波斯帝国，随后又陷入自相残杀。

steps.text: 776 BC: by tradition the first Olympic Games are held at Olympia. Greeks from rival cities compete under a sacred truce, and later count years by Olympiads.
steps.text_zh: 前776年，相传第一届古代奥运会在奥林匹亚举行。各城邦的希腊人在神圣休战期间同场竞技，后世以奥林匹亚纪年。

steps.text: 734 BC: settlers from Corinth found Syracuse in Sicily. Greek colonies come to ring the Mediterranean and the Black Sea.
steps.text_zh: 前734年，科林斯移民在西西里岛建立叙拉古。希腊殖民城邦逐渐遍布地中海与黑海沿岸。

steps.text: 594 BC: in Athens, Solon cancels debts, frees citizens enslaved for debt, and opens office to men by wealth rather than birth.
steps.text_zh: 前594年，雅典的梭伦废除债务，释放因债为奴的公民，按财产而非出身确定公民参政的资格。

steps.text: 508 BC: Cleisthenes reorganizes the citizens of Athens into ten tribes and gives the assembly real power, the birth of Athenian democracy.
steps.text_zh: 前508年，克里斯提尼将雅典公民重编为十个部落，并赋予公民大会实权，雅典民主政治由此诞生。

steps.text: 490 BC: a Persian army sent by Darius I lands at Marathon, and the Athenian hoplites defeat it by the shore.
steps.text_zh: 前490年，大流士一世派遣的波斯军队在马拉松登陆，雅典重装步兵在海边将其击败。

steps.text: 480 BC: Xerxes invades Greece with a vast army. At the pass of Thermopylae, King Leonidas and his 300 Spartans hold out for three days and die fighting.
steps.text_zh: 前480年，薛西斯一世率大军入侵希腊。斯巴达国王列奥尼达率三百勇士在温泉关坚守三天，全部战死。

steps.text: 480 BC: in the narrow strait of Salamis, the Greek fleet led by Themistocles of Athens destroys the Persian navy.
steps.text_zh: 前480年，雅典的地米斯托克利率领希腊联合舰队，在狭窄的萨拉米斯海峡击溃波斯海军。

steps.text: 447 BC: under Pericles, Athens leads the Delian League and spends its treasury on the Parthenon. Drama, philosophy and history flourish.
steps.text_zh: 前447年，伯里克利当政，雅典主导提洛同盟，并动用同盟金库修建帕特农神庙。戏剧、哲学与史学空前繁荣。

steps.text: 431 BC: fear of Athenian power drives Sparta and its allies to war. The Peloponnesian War drags on for 27 years and ends with Athens defeated.
steps.text_zh: 前431年，对雅典势力的恐惧促使斯巴达及其盟邦开战。伯罗奔尼撒战争持续了二十七年，以雅典战败告终。

steps.text: 399 BC: a defeated, bitter Athens sentences the philosopher Socrates to death. His pupil Plato carries on his questions.
steps.text_zh: 前399年，战败后的雅典判处哲学家苏格拉底死刑，他的学生柏拉图继承了他的追问。

title: Alexander the Great
summary: In eleven years a young king of Macedon marches from Greece to India, destroys the Persian Empire and opens the Hellenistic age.
summary_zh: 马其顿的年轻国王用十一年从希腊打到印度，灭亡波斯帝国，开启了希腊化时代。

steps.text: 336 BC: Philip II of Macedon is murdered, and his 20-year-old son Alexander takes the throne at Pella, inheriting an army built to invade Persia.
steps.text_zh: 前336年，马其顿国王腓力二世遇刺，二十岁的亚历山大在佩拉继位，接过了一支为远征波斯而打造的军队。

steps.text: 334 BC: Alexander crosses the Hellespont into Asia and defeats the Persian governors at the Granicus River.
steps.text_zh: 前334年，亚历山大渡过赫勒斯滂海峡进入亚洲，在格拉尼库斯河击败波斯诸总督。

steps.text: 333 BC: at Issus, Alexander routs King Darius III himself, who flees and leaves his family behind.
steps.text_zh: 前333年，亚历山大在伊苏斯大败大流士三世，波斯国王仓皇出逃，家眷被俘。

steps.text: 332 BC: Alexander takes the island city of Tyre after a seven-month siege, building a causeway out to its walls.
steps.text_zh: 前332年，亚历山大修筑通往海岛的长堤，围攻七个月后攻陷推罗。

steps.text: 331 BC: welcomed in Egypt as pharaoh, Alexander founds Alexandria on the coast, soon the greatest Greek city of the age.
steps.text_zh: 前331年，亚历山大在埃及被奉为法老，并在海岸建立亚历山大城，这座城市日后成为希腊化世界最大的都会。

steps.text: 331 BC: on the plain of Gaugamela, Alexander breaks Darius's main army. The Achaemenid Empire collapses.
steps.text_zh: 前331年，亚历山大在高加米拉平原击溃大流士三世的主力，阿契美尼德帝国随之崩溃。

steps.text: 330 BC: Alexander burns the palace of Persepolis, the ceremonial heart of the Persian kings.
steps.text_zh: 前330年，亚历山大焚毁波斯诸王的礼仪之都波斯波利斯。

steps.text: 326 BC: at the Hydaspes in India, Alexander defeats King Porus and his war elephants, but his exhausted soldiers refuse to march any further.
steps.text_zh: 前326年，亚历山大在印度的希达斯皮斯河击败波鲁斯王及其战象，但疲惫的士兵拒绝继续东进。

steps.text: 323 BC: Alexander dies in Babylon at 32. His generals carve up the empire into rival Hellenistic kingdoms.
steps.text_zh: 前323年，亚历山大在巴比伦去世，年仅三十二岁。他的部将瓜分帝国，形成相互争雄的希腊化诸王国。

title: Rome Conquers the Mediterranean
summary: Rome beats Carthage and the Greek kingdoms, then its own generals turn on the Republic until Augustus makes himself emperor.
summary_zh: 罗马先后击败迦太基和希腊化诸王国，随后共和国的将军们兵戎相向，直到奥古斯都建立帝制。

steps.text: 264 BC: a quarrel over Messina in Sicily draws Rome into its first war with Carthage. Rome builds a navy and wins Sicily.
steps.text_zh: 前264年，围绕西西里岛墨西拿的争端使罗马与迦太基爆发第一次布匿战争。罗马建起海军，最终夺得西西里。

steps.text: 218 BC: Hannibal marches from Spain over the Alps with his army and elephants to strike at Italy itself.
steps.text_zh: 前218年，汉尼拔率军队和战象从西班牙出发，翻越阿尔卑斯山，直扑意大利本土。

steps.text: 216 BC: at Cannae, Hannibal surrounds and destroys a Roman army of over 50,000 men, yet Rome refuses to surrender.
steps.text_zh: 前216年，汉尼拔在坎尼合围并歼灭五万多罗马大军，但罗马拒不投降。

steps.text: 202 BC: Scipio carries the war to Africa and defeats Hannibal at Zama. Carthage loses its overseas empire.
steps.text_zh: 前202年，大西庇阿将战火引向非洲，在扎马击败汉尼拔，迦太基丧失海外领地。

steps.text: 168 BC: Roman legions crush the Macedonian phalanx at Pydna, and Alexander's homeland kingdom comes to an end.
steps.text_zh: 前168年，罗马军团在彼得那击溃马其顿方阵，亚历山大的故国马其顿王国就此灭亡。

steps.text: 146 BC: Rome razes Carthage after a three-year siege, and in the same year destroys Corinth. Rome is master of the Mediterranean.
steps.text_zh: 前146年，罗马围攻三年后将迦太基夷为平地，同年又摧毁科林斯，罗马成为地中海的霸主。

steps.text: 58 BC: Julius Caesar begins the conquest of Gaul. In eight years of war, ending at Alesia, he wins a province, a loyal army and vast wealth.
steps.text_zh: 前58年，尤利乌斯·恺撒开始征服高卢。八年征战以阿莱西亚之战告终，他赢得了一个行省、一支忠于自己的军队和巨额财富。

steps.text: 49 BC: Caesar crosses the Rubicon with his legions, starting a civil war against Pompey and the Senate.
steps.text_zh: 前49年，恺撒率军渡过卢比孔河，向庞培和元老院开战，内战爆发。

steps.text: 44 BC: having made himself dictator for life, Caesar is stabbed to death by senators on the Ides of March.
steps.text_zh: 前44年，自任终身独裁官的恺撒在三月十五日被元老们刺杀身亡。

steps.text: 27 BC: after defeating Antony and Cleopatra at Actium, Octavian takes the name Augustus. The Republic gives way to the Roman Empire.
steps.text_zh: 前27年，在亚克兴海战中击败安东尼与克娄巴特拉之后，屋大维获得“奥古斯都”称号，罗马由共和国转为帝国。

title: The Fall of the Western Roman Empire
summary: Crisis, reform, a Christian emperor and a new capital, then Goths, Huns and Vandals: how the western half of Rome came apart.
summary_zh: 危机与改革、皈依基督教的皇帝与新都城，随后是哥特人、匈人和汪达尔人：罗马帝国西部如何走向崩溃。

steps.text: 235: the murder of Emperor Severus Alexander at Mainz opens fifty years of chaos, with civil wars, invasions and plague.
steps.text_zh: 235年，皇帝亚历山大·塞维鲁在美因茨遇害，罗马陷入长达五十年的危机，内战、外族入侵与瘟疫接踵而至。

steps.text: 293: Diocletian shares power among four emperors, the Tetrarchy, to defend the long frontiers.
steps.text_zh: 293年，戴克里先推行四帝共治，由四位皇帝分守漫长的边疆。

steps.text: 312: Constantine wins at the Milvian Bridge outside Rome under a Christian sign; the next year the Edict of Milan tolerates Christians.
steps.text_zh: 312年，君士坦丁打着基督教标志在罗马城外的米尔维安大桥取胜，次年颁布米兰敕令，宽容基督教。

steps.text: 330: Constantine dedicates a new capital on the Bosporus, Constantinople, which will outlive Rome by a thousand years.
steps.text_zh: 330年，君士坦丁在博斯普鲁斯海峡畔建成新都君士坦丁堡，这座城市此后比西罗马多存续了近一千年。

steps.text: 378: Goths who fled into the empire from the Huns destroy a Roman army at Adrianople and kill Emperor Valens.
steps.text_zh: 378年，为躲避匈人而进入帝国的哥特人在阿德里安堡全歼罗马军队，皇帝瓦伦斯阵亡。

steps.text: 395: on the death of Theodosius I the empire is divided for good between his sons, an eastern half ruled from Constantinople and a western half.
steps.text_zh: 395年，狄奥多西一世去世，帝国由他的两个儿子永久分治，分为以君士坦丁堡为都的东部和西部。

steps.text: 410: Alaric's Visigoths sack Rome, the first time in 800 years the city falls to a foreign enemy.
steps.text_zh: 410年，阿拉里克率西哥特人洗劫罗马，这是八百年来罗马城首次落入外敌之手。

steps.text: 451: Romans and Visigoths together halt Attila the Hun on the Catalaunian Plains in Gaul.
steps.text_zh: 451年，罗马人与西哥特人联手，在高卢的沙隆平原挡住了匈人阿提拉。

steps.text: 455: Vandals sail from Carthage and plunder Rome for two weeks.
steps.text_zh: 455年，汪达尔人从迦太基渡海而来，劫掠罗马达两周之久。

steps.text: 476: the Germanic general Odoacer deposes the boy emperor Romulus Augustulus at Ravenna. The Western Roman Empire is over; the eastern half lives on as Byzantium.
steps.text_zh: 476年，日耳曼将领奥多亚克在拉文纳废黜少年皇帝罗慕路斯·奥古斯都路斯，西罗马帝国灭亡，东部则延续为拜占庭帝国。

title: Franks and Vikings
summary: The Franks build a Christian empire under Charlemagne, while Viking ships raid, trade and found new states from England to Kiev.
summary_zh: 法兰克人在查理曼治下建立基督教帝国，维京人则驾船劫掠、经商，从英格兰到基辅建立起新的国家。

steps.text: 496: Clovis, king of the Franks, is baptized a Catholic Christian at Reims, winning the support of the church in Gaul.
steps.text_zh: 496年，法兰克国王克洛维在兰斯接受天主教洗礼，赢得了高卢教会的支持。

steps.text: 732: Charles Martel defeats an Umayyad army between Poitiers and Tours, ending Arab raids deep north of the Pyrenees.
steps.text_zh: 732年，查理·马特在普瓦捷与图尔之间击败倭马亚王朝的军队，阿拉伯人此后再未深入比利牛斯山以北。

steps.text: 793: raiders from Scandinavia plunder the monastery of Lindisfarne in England. The Viking Age has begun.
steps.text_zh: 793年，来自斯堪的纳维亚的维京人劫掠英格兰的林迪斯法恩修道院，维京时代由此开始。

steps.text: 800: on Christmas Day the Pope crowns Charlemagne emperor of the Romans in St Peter's. His realm covers most of western Europe.
steps.text_zh: 800年圣诞节，教宗在圣彼得大教堂为查理曼加冕为“罗马人的皇帝”，他的帝国囊括了西欧大部分地区。

steps.text: 843: Charlemagne's grandsons split his empire at Verdun into west, middle and east, the rough outlines of France and Germany.
steps.text_zh: 843年，查理曼的三个孙子在凡尔登瓜分帝国，分为西、中、东三部分，大致奠定了日后法国和德国的轮廓。

steps.text: 878: Alfred the Great of Wessex defeats the Danish Great Army at Edington, saving the last English kingdom.
steps.text_zh: 878年，韦塞克斯国王阿尔弗雷德大王在爱丁顿击败丹麦大军，保住了最后一个英格兰王国。

steps.text: 882: Oleg, a Varangian chief from Novgorod, takes Kiev and makes it the capital of Kievan Rus.
steps.text_zh: 882年，来自诺夫哥罗德的瓦良格首领奥列格夺取基辅并定都于此，基辅罗斯建立。

steps.text: 911: the West Frankish king grants the Viking leader Rollo the land around Rouen. It becomes Normandy, the land of the Northmen.
steps.text_zh: 911年，西法兰克国王把鲁昂一带封给维京首领罗洛，这片土地成为诺曼底，意为“北方人之地”。

steps.text: 962: Otto I of Germany is crowned emperor in Rome, founding what becomes the Holy Roman Empire.
steps.text_zh: 962年，德意志国王奥托一世在罗马加冕称帝，神圣罗马帝国由此建立。

steps.text: 1066: William, Duke of Normandy, defeats King Harold at Hastings and conquers England.
steps.text_zh: 1066年，诺曼底公爵威廉在黑斯廷斯击败英王哈罗德二世，征服了英格兰。

title: Popes, Kings and Plague
summary: Four centuries of medieval Europe: a split church, popes against emperors, the first universities, Magna Carta, the Mongols, the Black Death and the fall of Byzantium.
summary_zh: 中世纪欧洲的四百年：教会分裂、教宗与皇帝之争、最早的大学、《大宪章》、蒙古西征、黑死病，直到拜占庭灭亡。

steps.text: 1054: envoys of the Pope and the Patriarch of Constantinople excommunicate each other, splitting Christianity into Catholic and Orthodox churches.
steps.text_zh: 1054年，罗马教宗的使节与君士坦丁堡牧首互相绝罚，基督教分裂为天主教和东正教。

steps.text: 1077: Emperor Henry IV stands barefoot in the snow at Canossa, begging Pope Gregory VII to lift his excommunication, a high point of papal power.
steps.text_zh: 1077年，神圣罗马皇帝亨利四世赤足立于卡诺莎城堡外的雪中，恳求教宗格列高利七世撤销绝罚，教权由此臻于顶峰。

steps.text: 1088: the University of Bologna grows up around teachers of Roman law, the first of Europe's universities.
steps.text_zh: 1088年，博洛尼亚大学围绕罗马法教师逐渐形成，成为欧洲最早的大学。

steps.text: 1204: the Fourth Crusade, steered by Venice, sacks Christian Constantinople and sets up a Latin Empire.
steps.text_zh: 1204年，被威尼斯引向歧途的第四次十字军攻陷同为基督教城市的君士坦丁堡，建立拉丁帝国。

steps.text: 1215: English barons force King John to seal Magna Carta at Runnymede, putting the king under the law.
steps.text_zh: 1215年，英格兰贵族在兰尼米德迫使约翰王签署《大宪章》，确立国王也须受法律约束。

steps.text: 1237: Batu's Mongol armies storm the cities of Rus, and in 1240 they burn Kiev. The Rus princes will pay tribute to the Golden Horde for two centuries.
steps.text_zh: 1237年，拔都率蒙古大军攻破罗斯诸城，1240年焚毁基辅。此后两百多年，罗斯诸公国向金帐汗国纳贡。

steps.text: 1337: Edward III of England claims the French throne, opening the Hundred Years' War; in 1346 his longbowmen cut down the French knights at Crecy.
steps.text_zh: 1337年，英王爱德华三世宣称拥有法国王位，英法百年战争爆发。1346年，英国长弓手在克雷西大败法国骑士。

steps.text: 1347: Genoese ships from the Black Sea bring the Black Death to Sicily. In four years it kills perhaps a third of Europe's people.
steps.text_zh: 1347年，从黑海归来的热那亚商船把黑死病带到西西里。四年之内，欧洲约三分之一的人口死于这场瘟疫。

steps.text: 1429: the peasant girl Joan of Arc lifts the English siege of Orleans and turns the war in France's favor.
steps.text_zh: 1429年，农家少女贞德解除英军对奥尔良的围困，战局从此转向有利于法国。

steps.text: 1453: the cannon of Sultan Mehmed II breach the walls of Constantinople. The Byzantine Empire falls to the Ottomans.
steps.text_zh: 1453年，苏丹穆罕默德二世的巨炮轰开君士坦丁堡城墙，拜占庭帝国被奥斯曼帝国灭亡。

title: Print, Ships and Reformation
summary: The printing press, ocean voyages and Renaissance art remake Europe, Luther splits the Western church, and a century of religious war ends at Westphalia.
summary_zh: 印刷术、远洋航行与文艺复兴艺术重塑欧洲，路德使西方教会分裂，一个世纪的宗教战争最终以威斯特伐利亚和约收场。

steps.text: About 1440: Johannes Gutenberg develops printing with movable metal type in Mainz. Books become cheap, and ideas spread fast.
steps.text_zh: 约1440年，约翰内斯·古腾堡在美因茨发明金属活字印刷术，书籍变得廉价，思想得以迅速传播。

steps.text: 1492: Ferdinand and Isabella take Granada, the last Muslim state in Spain.
steps.text_zh: 1492年，斐迪南与伊莎贝拉攻占西班牙最后的穆斯林政权格拉纳达。

steps.text: 1492: with their backing, Columbus sails west from Palos and reaches the Caribbean, linking Europe and the Americas.
steps.text_zh: 1492年，在两位君主资助下，哥伦布从帕洛斯港向西航行，抵达加勒比海，欧洲与美洲从此相连。

steps.text: 1497: Vasco da Gama sails from Lisbon around Africa and reaches India the next year. Portugal opens the sea route to Asia.
steps.text_zh: 1497年，达·伽马从里斯本出发绕过非洲，次年抵达印度，葡萄牙开辟了通往亚洲的海路。

steps.text: 1508: Michelangelo begins painting the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel, a summit of the Italian Renaissance.
steps.text_zh: 1508年，米开朗基罗开始绘制西斯廷礼拜堂天顶画，这是意大利文艺复兴的巅峰之作。

steps.text: 1517: Martin Luther publishes his Ninety-five Theses against the sale of indulgences in Wittenberg. Printed copies spread across Germany within weeks.
steps.text_zh: 1517年，马丁·路德在维滕贝格发表反对出售赎罪券的《九十五条论纲》，印刷本数周内传遍德意志。

steps.text: 1534: Henry VIII breaks with Rome and makes himself head of the Church of England.
steps.text_zh: 1534年，亨利八世与罗马教廷决裂，自任英格兰教会的最高首脑。

steps.text: 1545: the Catholic Church opens the Council of Trent to answer the Protestants and reform itself.
steps.text_zh: 1545年，天主教会召开特伦托会议，回应新教的挑战并进行自我改革。

steps.text: 1618: Protestant nobles throw imperial officials out of a window in Prague, setting off the Thirty Years' War that devastates Germany.
steps.text_zh: 1618年，新教贵族在布拉格将皇帝的官员扔出窗外，引发三十年战争，德意志遭受浩劫。

steps.text: 1648: the Peace of Westphalia ends the war and lets each state settle its own religion, a foundation of Europe's system of sovereign states.
steps.text_zh: 1648年，威斯特伐利亚和约结束战争，承认各国自主决定宗教，奠定了欧洲主权国家体系的基础。

title: Revolution, Napoleon and the Nations
title_zh: 大革命、拿破仑与民族国家
summary: The French Revolution topples a king, Napoleon conquers and loses Europe, and the ideas they spread lead on to 1848 and the new nations of Italy and Germany.
summary_zh: 法国大革命推翻了国王，拿破仑征服又失去了欧洲，他们传播的思想引出了1848年革命和意大利、德国两个新的民族国家。

steps.text: 1789: Parisians storm the Bastille prison on 14 July. Within weeks the National Assembly abolishes feudal privileges and declares the Rights of Man.
steps.text_zh: 1789年7月14日，巴黎民众攻占巴士底狱。数周之内，国民议会废除封建特权，发表《人权宣言》。

steps.text: 1792: the revolutionary army halts the Prussians at Valmy. The next day France becomes a republic, and in 1793 Louis XVI is guillotined.
steps.text_zh: 1792年，革命军在瓦尔密挡住普鲁士军队，次日法国宣布成立共和国。1793年，路易十六被送上断头台。

steps.text: 1799: General Napoleon Bonaparte seizes power in the coup of 18 Brumaire; five years later he crowns himself emperor.
steps.text_zh: 1799年，拿破仑·波拿巴将军发动雾月政变夺取政权，五年后加冕称帝。

steps.text: 1805: Nelson's British fleet destroys the French and Spanish navies off Cape Trafalgar, ending any hope of invading Britain.
steps.text_zh: 1805年，纳尔逊率英国舰队在特拉法尔加角外歼灭法西联合舰队，拿破仑入侵英国的希望彻底破灭。

steps.text: 1805: on land, Napoleon crushes the Austrians and Russians at Austerlitz. A year later the Holy Roman Empire is dissolved.
steps.text_zh: 1805年，拿破仑在奥斯特里茨大败奥俄联军，次年神圣罗马帝国解体。

steps.text: 1812: Napoleon invades Russia with over 600,000 men and reaches a burning Moscow, but the winter retreat destroys his Grand Army.
steps.text_zh: 1812年，拿破仑率六十余万大军入侵俄国，攻入燃烧的莫斯科，但在冬季撤退中大军几乎全军覆没。

steps.text: 1815: Napoleon escapes from Elba but is finally beaten at Waterloo by Wellington and Blucher. The Congress of Vienna restores the old monarchies.
steps.text_zh: 1815年，拿破仑从厄尔巴岛逃回法国，最终在滑铁卢被威灵顿与布吕歇尔击败。维也纳会议恢复了旧日的君主秩序。

steps.text: 1848: revolutions sweep from Paris to Vienna, Berlin and Milan, demanding constitutions and national unity. Most are crushed, but the ideas survive.
steps.text_zh: 1848年，革命浪潮从巴黎席卷维也纳、柏林和米兰，人们要求宪法与民族统一。革命多被镇压，但理想延续了下来。

steps.text: 1861: after Garibaldi's campaign in the south, the Kingdom of Italy is proclaimed in Turin.
steps.text_zh: 1861年，加里波第远征南方之后，意大利王国在都灵宣告成立。

steps.text: 1871: Prussia defeats France, and Bismarck has the German Empire proclaimed in the Hall of Mirrors at Versailles.
steps.text_zh: 1871年，普鲁士战胜法国，俾斯麦在凡尔赛宫镜厅宣告德意志帝国成立。

title: War, Division and Union
summary: Two world wars wreck Europe, an Iron Curtain divides it for forty years, and when the Berlin Wall falls the continent begins to unite.
summary_zh: 两次世界大战摧毁了欧洲，铁幕将其分裂四十年，柏林墙倒塌后，欧洲走向联合。

steps.text: 1914: a young Bosnian Serb shoots Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria-Hungary in Sarajevo. Within weeks the alliances drag Europe into the First World War.
steps.text_zh: 1914年，一名波斯尼亚塞族青年在萨拉热窝刺杀奥匈帝国皇储斐迪南大公，数周之内，同盟体系将欧洲拖入第一次世界大战。

steps.text: 1917: Lenin's Bolsheviks seize power in Petrograd, take Russia out of the war and found the first communist state.
steps.text_zh: 1917年，列宁领导的布尔什维克在彼得格勒夺取政权，俄国退出战争，建立了第一个社会主义国家。

steps.text: 1919: the Treaty of Versailles blames Germany for the war, while the old empires of central and eastern Europe break up into new nations.
steps.text_zh: 1919年，凡尔赛和约将战争责任归于德国，中欧和东欧的旧帝国则解体为一系列新国家。

steps.text: 1939: Hitler's Germany invades Poland. Britain and France declare war, and the Second World War begins.
steps.text_zh: 1939年，希特勒统治下的德国入侵波兰，英法对德宣战，第二次世界大战爆发。

steps.text: 1942: the German drive into the Soviet Union is stopped at Stalingrad; the surrender of a whole German army early in 1943 turns the war.
steps.text_zh: 1942年，德军对苏联的进攻在斯大林格勒受阻，次年初整个德国第六集团军投降，战局由此扭转。

steps.text: 1944: on D-Day, Allied armies land on the beaches of Normandy and open a second front in the west.
steps.text_zh: 1944年，盟军在诺曼底海滩登陆，在西线开辟了第二战场。

steps.text: 1945: Soviet troops storm Berlin and Germany surrenders. Europe is left divided between the Western powers and the Soviet Union.
steps.text_zh: 1945年，苏军攻克柏林，德国投降。欧洲随即被分割为西方阵营和苏联阵营。

steps.text: 1961: East Germany builds the Berlin Wall overnight to stop its people fleeing west, the starkest symbol of the Iron Curtain.
steps.text_zh: 1961年，东德一夜之间筑起柏林墙，阻止民众逃往西方，柏林墙成为“铁幕”最鲜明的象征。

steps.text: 1989: as communist governments collapse across eastern Europe, crowds open the Berlin Wall. Germany reunites the next year.
steps.text_zh: 1989年，东欧各国共产党政权相继垮台，民众推开柏林墙，次年两德统一。

steps.text: 1992: twelve countries sign the Maastricht Treaty, creating the European Union and the road to a single currency.
steps.text_zh: 1992年，十二个国家签署马斯特里赫特条约，欧洲联盟由此诞生，并确立了单一货币的进程。

title: Sumer and Akkad
summary: The first cities and the first writing appear in southern Mesopotamia, Sargon builds the first empire, and Ur rises and falls.
summary_zh: 两河流域南部出现了最早的城市和文字，萨尔贡建立了第一个帝国，乌尔盛极而衰。

steps.text: About 3000 BC: in Uruk, then the largest city in the world, scribes press wedge-shaped signs into clay. Cuneiform writing grows out of temple accounts.
steps.text_zh: 约前3000年，在当时世界上最大的城市乌鲁克，书吏在泥板上压出楔形符号，楔形文字从神庙记账中发展成熟。

steps.text: About 2700 BC: Gilgamesh rules Uruk and builds its walls. His legend becomes the Epic of Gilgamesh, one of the oldest great stories ever written.
steps.text_zh: 约前2700年，吉尔伽美什统治乌鲁克并修建城墙。他的传说后来写成《吉尔伽美什史诗》，是现存最古老的伟大文学作品之一。

steps.text: About 2600 BC: the rulers of Ur are buried with gold, lyres and dozens of attendants, showing the wealth of the Sumerian city-states.
steps.text_zh: 约前2600年，乌尔的统治者下葬时以黄金、竖琴和数十名侍从陪葬，显示出苏美尔城邦的富庶。

steps.text: About 2450 BC: Lagash defeats its neighbor Umma in a long war over water and fields, celebrated on the Stele of the Vultures.
steps.text_zh: 约前2450年，拉格什在与邻邦温马争夺水源和田地的长期战争中获胜，并立鹫碑纪念。

steps.text: About 2334 BC: Sargon of Akkad conquers the Sumerian cities and builds the first empire, stretching from the Gulf toward the Mediterranean.
steps.text_zh: 约前2334年，阿卡德的萨尔贡征服苏美尔诸城邦，建立了从波斯湾延伸到地中海方向的第一个帝国。

steps.text: About 2285 BC: Sargon's daughter Enheduanna becomes high priestess at Ur. Her hymns make her the first author in history known by name.
steps.text_zh: 约前2285年，萨尔贡之女恩赫杜安娜出任乌尔大祭司，她的颂诗使她成为历史上第一位留下姓名的作者。

steps.text: About 2250 BC: Sargon's grandson Naram-Sin campaigns into the Zagros mountains, calls himself 'king of the four quarters' and even claims to be a god.
steps.text_zh: 约前2250年，萨尔贡之孙纳拉姆辛征战扎格罗斯山区，自称“四方之王”，甚至自封为神。

steps.text: About 2190 BC: the Gutians, a people from the mountains, overrun Akkad, and the empire falls apart.
steps.text_zh: 约前2190年，来自山地的库提人攻入阿卡德，阿卡德王国瓦解。

steps.text: About 2112 BC: Ur-Nammu revives Sumer as the Third Dynasty of Ur, issues the oldest surviving law code and raises the great Ziggurat of Ur.
steps.text_zh: 约前2112年，乌尔纳姆建立乌尔第三王朝，复兴苏美尔，颁布现存最早的法典，并修建乌尔大塔庙。

steps.text: About 2004 BC: the Elamites sack Ur and carry off its king. The age of Sumer ends in lament.
steps.text_zh: 约前2004年，埃兰人攻陷乌尔，俘走国王，苏美尔时代在哀歌声中结束。

title: Babylon and the Hittites
summary: Merchants link Mesopotamia and Anatolia, Hammurabi writes his laws, the Hittites sack Babylon and fight Egypt at Kadesh, and the whole Bronze Age world collapses.
summary_zh: 商人把两河流域与安纳托利亚连在一起，汉谟拉比颁布法典，赫梯人攻陷巴比伦、在卡迭石与埃及交战，最终整个青铜时代世界走向崩溃。

steps.text: About 1950 BC: merchants from Ashur run donkey caravans of tin and cloth to Kanesh in Anatolia, leaving thousands of business letters.
steps.text_zh: 约前1950年，亚述城的商人用驴队把锡和布匹运到安纳托利亚的卡内什，留下了数千封商业信函。

steps.text: 1763 BC: Hammurabi of Babylon defeats Larsa and soon unites Mesopotamia under Babylon.
steps.text_zh: 前1763年，巴比伦国王汉谟拉比击败拉尔萨，随后统一两河流域。

steps.text: About 1754 BC: Hammurabi has his laws carved on a stone stele: 'an eye for an eye', with punishments set by social rank.
steps.text_zh: 约前1754年，汉谟拉比将法律刻在石碑上，规定“以眼还眼”，量刑依身份等级而定。

steps.text: About 1650 BC: Hattusili I makes Hattusa in central Anatolia the capital of the Hittite kingdom.
steps.text_zh: 约前1650年，哈图西里一世以安纳托利亚中部的哈图沙为都城，建立赫梯王国。

steps.text: 1595 BC: the Hittite king Mursili I raids far down the Euphrates and sacks Babylon, ending Hammurabi's dynasty.
steps.text_zh: 前1595年，赫梯国王穆尔西里一世沿幼发拉底河长途奔袭，攻陷巴比伦，汉谟拉比王朝灭亡。

steps.text: About 1531 BC: the Kassites take over Babylon and rule it for four centuries, keeping its old culture alive.
steps.text_zh: 约前1531年，加喜特人入主巴比伦，统治长达四个世纪，延续了巴比伦的古老文化。

steps.text: About 1344 BC: Suppiluliuma I crushes Mitanni and makes the Hittites a great power, rivaling Egypt in Syria.
steps.text_zh: 约前1344年，苏庇路里乌玛一世击败米坦尼，赫梯成为与埃及在叙利亚争雄的强国。

steps.text: 1274 BC: Ramesses II of Egypt and the Hittite king Muwatalli II fight at Kadesh in one of the largest chariot battles ever. Their successors later sign the oldest known peace treaty.
steps.text_zh: 前1274年，埃及的拉美西斯二世与赫梯国王穆瓦塔里二世在卡迭石展开史上规模最大的战车会战之一，两国后来缔结了已知最早的和约。

steps.text: About 1185 BC: the rich port of Ugarit is destroyed by raiders, among them the 'Sea Peoples'; its last letters plead for help that never comes.
steps.text_zh: 约前1185年，富庶的港口乌加里特被包括“海上民族”在内的入侵者摧毁，城中最后的信件仍在请求永远等不来的援兵。

steps.text: About 1180 BC: Hattusa is abandoned and burned. The Hittite Empire vanishes in the Bronze Age collapse.
steps.text_zh: 约前1180年，哈图沙被遗弃并焚毁，赫梯帝国在青铜时代大崩溃中消失。

title: Assyria and Babylon
summary: From the Phoenician alphabet and the kingdom of David to the iron empire of Assyria, Nebuchadnezzar's Babylon and its fall to Cyrus of Persia.
summary_zh: 从腓尼基字母和大卫王国，到铁血的亚述帝国、尼布甲尼撒二世的巴比伦，直到巴比伦落入波斯居鲁士之手。

steps.text: About 1050 BC: Phoenician scribes at Byblos write with just 22 letters for sounds. Carried by their ships, this alphabet becomes the ancestor of Greek and Latin letters.
steps.text_zh: 约前1050年，比布鲁斯的腓尼基书吏只用二十二个字母记录语音。这套字母随腓尼基商船远播，成为希腊字母和拉丁字母的祖先。

steps.text: About 1000 BC: David makes Jerusalem the capital of a united Israel; his son Solomon builds the First Temple there.
steps.text_zh: 约前1000年，大卫定都耶路撒冷，建立统一的以色列王国，其子所罗门在此修建第一圣殿。

steps.text: 853 BC: at Qarqar on the Orontes, Syrian kings and King Ahab of Israel join forces against the Assyrian king Shalmaneser III.
steps.text_zh: 前853年，叙利亚诸王与以色列王亚哈结成联军，在奥龙特斯河畔的卡尔卡尔抵挡亚述国王沙尔马那塞尔三世。

steps.text: 745 BC: Tiglath-Pileser III builds a standing army and turns conquered lands into provinces, making Assyria a true empire.
steps.text_zh: 前745年，提格拉特帕拉沙尔三世建立常备军，把被征服地区改为行省，亚述由此成为真正的帝国。

steps.text: 722 BC: Assyria captures Samaria and deports the people of the northern kingdom of Israel.
steps.text_zh: 前722年，亚述攻陷撒马利亚，把以色列王国的居民大批迁走。

steps.text: About 650 BC: Ashurbanipal gathers tens of thousands of clay tablets in his library at Nineveh, among them the Epic of Gilgamesh.
steps.text_zh: 约前650年，亚述巴尼拔在尼尼微的图书馆中收藏了数万块泥板，其中包括《吉尔伽美什史诗》。

steps.text: 612 BC: Babylonians and Medes storm Nineveh. Within a few years the Assyrian Empire is gone.
steps.text_zh: 前612年，巴比伦人与米底人联军攻陷尼尼微，几年之内新亚述帝国便土崩瓦解。

steps.text: 586 BC: Nebuchadnezzar II destroys Jerusalem and its Temple and carries the people of Judah into exile in Babylon.
steps.text_zh: 前586年，尼布甲尼撒二世攻毁耶路撒冷及其圣殿，把犹大王国的居民掳往巴比伦。

steps.text: About 575 BC: Nebuchadnezzar rebuilds Babylon with the blue-glazed Ishtar Gate, making it the most splendid city of its day.
steps.text_zh: 约前575年，尼布甲尼撒二世重建巴比伦，修起蓝色琉璃砖装饰的伊什塔尔城门，巴比伦成为当时最宏伟的城市。

steps.text: 539 BC: Cyrus the Great of Persia takes Babylon almost without a fight and lets the exiled Jews go home.
steps.text_zh: 前539年，波斯的居鲁士大帝几乎兵不血刃地攻占巴比伦，并允许被掳的犹太人返回故土。

title: Persians, Greeks and Romans
summary: Persia rules, Alexander conquers, Greek kingdoms build cities and libraries, then Rome and Parthia split the region while Judaea gives birth to Christianity.
summary_zh: 波斯统治、亚历山大征服、希腊化王国兴建城市与图书馆，随后罗马与安息瓜分这一地区，犹太地则孕育了基督教。

steps.text: 499 BC: the Greek cities of Ionia, led by Miletus, rise against Persian rule. Athens sends help, drawing Persia into war with Greece.
steps.text_zh: 前499年，以米利都为首的爱奥尼亚希腊城邦反抗波斯统治，雅典出兵相助，引发了波斯与希腊之间的战争。

steps.text: About 350 BC: Mausolus, a governor under Persia, is buried at Halicarnassus in a tomb so grand that the word 'mausoleum' comes from his name.
steps.text_zh: 约前350年，波斯治下的总督摩索拉斯葬于哈利卡纳苏斯，陵墓极其宏伟，西方语言中的“陵墓”一词即源于他的名字。

steps.text: 333 BC: Alexander the Great defeats Darius III at Issus and marches down the coast; two years later the Persian Empire falls.
steps.text_zh: 前333年，亚历山大大帝在伊苏斯击败大流士三世，随后沿海岸南下，两年后波斯帝国覆灭。

steps.text: 300 BC: Seleucus, one of Alexander's generals, founds Antioch, a capital of the Seleucid kingdom that stretches from Syria to Iran.
steps.text_zh: 前300年，亚历山大的部将塞琉古建立安条克城，作为疆域从叙利亚延伸到伊朗的塞琉古王国的都城。

steps.text: About 190 BC: the kings of Pergamon build a library to rival Alexandria's; parchment is said to take its name from the city.
steps.text_zh: 约前190年，帕加马国王修建图书馆与亚历山大图书馆争胜，相传“羊皮纸”一词即源于帕加马。

steps.text: 167 BC: when the Seleucid king bans Jewish worship, the Maccabees revolt and win back the Temple in Jerusalem, the origin of Hanukkah.
steps.text_zh: 前167年，塞琉古国王禁止犹太教礼拜，马加比家族起兵反抗，夺回耶路撒冷圣殿，这就是光明节的由来。

steps.text: 64 BC: Pompey ends the Seleucid kingdom and makes Syria a Roman province. Rome now borders Parthia.
steps.text_zh: 前64年，庞培终结塞琉古王国，设立叙利亚行省，罗马从此与安息接壤。

steps.text: 53 BC: at Carrhae, Parthian horse archers destroy the army of Crassus. The Euphrates becomes the line between Rome and Parthia.
steps.text_zh: 前53年，安息骑射手在卡莱全歼克拉苏的大军，幼发拉底河成为罗马与安息的分界。

steps.text: About 30: in Jerusalem, Jesus of Nazareth is crucified under the Roman governor Pontius Pilate. His followers carry his teaching across the empire.
steps.text_zh: 约30年，拿撒勒人耶稣在罗马总督本丢·彼拉多治下被钉死在耶路撒冷的十字架上，他的门徒将其教导传遍帝国。

steps.text: 70: Roman legions under Titus crush the Jewish revolt and burn the Second Temple. Jewish life recenters on scripture and the synagogue.
steps.text_zh: 70年，提图斯率罗马军团镇压犹太起义，焚毁第二圣殿，犹太人的宗教生活从此转向经典与会堂。

title: Rome, Persia and the Rise of Islam
title_zh: 罗马、波斯与伊斯兰的兴起
summary: Rome and Persia fight for four centuries until both are exhausted; then a prophet from Mecca unites Arabia, and Arab armies defeat both empires in a single year.
summary_zh: 罗马与波斯争战四百年，双方精疲力竭；这时麦加的先知统一了阿拉伯半岛，阿拉伯军队在一年之内先后击败两大帝国。

steps.text: 260: the Sasanian king Shapur I captures the Roman emperor Valerian near Edessa, the only Roman emperor ever taken prisoner by a foreign enemy.
steps.text_zh: 260年，萨珊国王沙普尔一世在埃德萨附近俘获罗马皇帝瓦勒良，他是唯一被外敌俘虏的罗马皇帝。

steps.text: 270: Queen Zenobia of Palmyra seizes Rome's eastern provinces as far as Egypt, until Aurelian takes them back in 272.
steps.text_zh: 270年，帕尔米拉女王芝诺比娅夺取罗马东方诸行省，势力远达埃及，直到272年才被奥勒良收复。

steps.text: 325: Constantine gathers the bishops at Nicaea, who agree the Nicene Creed. A Christian Roman Empire now faces Zoroastrian Sasanian Persia.
steps.text_zh: 325年，君士坦丁召集主教在尼西亚开会，制定《尼西亚信经》。信奉基督教的罗马帝国从此与信奉琐罗亚斯德教的萨珊波斯对峙。

steps.text: About 570: Muhammad is born in Mecca, a trading town of Arabia built around the shrine of the Kaaba.
steps.text_zh: 约570年，穆罕默德出生于麦加，这是阿拉伯半岛一座围绕克尔白神殿兴起的商业城镇。

steps.text: 610: in a cave on Mount Hira, Muhammad receives what Muslims hold to be the first revelation of the Quran, and begins to preach one God.
steps.text_zh: 610年，穆罕默德在希拉山洞中得到穆斯林所信的第一次《古兰经》启示，开始宣扬独一的真主。

steps.text: 622: persecuted in Mecca, Muhammad and his followers move to Medina. The Hijra marks year one of the Islamic calendar.
steps.text_zh: 622年，穆罕默德及其追随者因在麦加受迫害而迁往麦地那，这次迁徙（希吉拉）成为伊斯兰历元年。

steps.text: 627: the Byzantine emperor Heraclius defeats the Persians near Nineveh, ending a war that has exhausted both empires.
steps.text_zh: 627年，拜占庭皇帝希拉克略在尼尼微附近大败波斯军队，结束了一场使两大帝国精疲力竭的战争。

steps.text: 630: Muhammad returns to Mecca with 10,000 men; the city submits, and the idols are cleared from the Kaaba.
steps.text_zh: 630年，穆罕默德率一万人回到麦加，麦加归顺，克尔白中的偶像被清除。

steps.text: 636: four years after Muhammad's death, Arab armies destroy the Byzantine army at the Yarmuk River and take Syria.
steps.text_zh: 636年，穆罕默德去世四年后，阿拉伯军队在雅穆克河击溃拜占庭大军，夺取叙利亚。

steps.text: 636: the same year at Qadisiyyah, near the Euphrates, they defeat the Sasanian Persians, opening Iraq and Iran to Islam.
steps.text_zh: 636年，阿拉伯军队又在幼发拉底河畔的卡迪西亚击败萨珊波斯，打开了通往伊拉克和伊朗的大门。

title: Umayyads and Abbasids
summary: The caliphate splits Sunni from Shia, rules from Damascus and then Baghdad, and makes Baghdad the world's center of learning before its power drains away.
summary_zh: 哈里发国分裂出逊尼派与什叶派，先后定都大马士革和巴格达，巴格达一度成为世界学术中心，随后哈里发的权力逐渐旁落。

steps.text: 637: Caliph Umar receives the surrender of Jerusalem, which becomes the third holy city of Islam.
steps.text_zh: 637年，哈里发欧麦尔接受耶路撒冷投降，这座城市成为伊斯兰教的第三圣地。

steps.text: 657: at Siffin on the Euphrates, Caliph Ali fights Muawiya, governor of Syria. The quarrel splits the Muslim community.
steps.text_zh: 657年，哈里发阿里与叙利亚总督穆阿维叶在幼发拉底河畔的隋芬交战，这场争端导致穆斯林社群的分裂。

steps.text: 661: after Ali is murdered, Muawiya founds the Umayyad Caliphate with Damascus as its capital.
steps.text_zh: 661年，阿里遇刺，穆阿维叶建立倭马亚王朝，定都大马士革。

steps.text: 680: Ali's son Husayn and his small band are killed by Umayyad troops at Karbala. His martyrdom becomes the heart of Shia Islam.
steps.text_zh: 680年，阿里之子侯赛因及其随从在卡尔巴拉被倭马亚军队杀害，他的殉难成为什叶派信仰的核心。

steps.text: 691: Caliph Abd al-Malik completes the Dome of the Rock in Jerusalem, proclaiming Islam's place among the older faiths.
steps.text_zh: 691年，哈里发阿卜杜勒·马利克在耶路撒冷建成圆顶清真寺，宣示伊斯兰教在古老信仰之间的地位。

steps.text: 717: an Umayyad army and fleet besiege Constantinople for a year but are driven off by Greek fire and a hard winter.
steps.text_zh: 717年，倭马亚王朝的大军和舰队围攻君士坦丁堡一年之久，最终被希腊火和严冬击退。

steps.text: 750: rebels from Khurasan under the black banners of the Abbasids overthrow the Umayyads at the battle of the Zab.
steps.text_zh: 750年，来自呼罗珊、打着黑旗的阿拔斯起义军在扎卜河战役中推翻倭马亚王朝。

steps.text: 762: Caliph al-Mansur founds Baghdad, a round city on the Tigris that grows into one of the largest cities in the world.
steps.text_zh: 762年，哈里发曼苏尔在底格里斯河畔建造圆形的巴格达城，它很快发展成当时世界上最大的城市之一。

steps.text: 830: under Caliph al-Mamun, scholars of the House of Wisdom translate Greek, Persian and Indian works, and al-Khwarizmi writes the book that gives us the word 'algebra'.
steps.text_zh: 830年，在哈里发麦蒙支持下，智慧宫的学者翻译希腊、波斯和印度典籍，花剌子米写下了“代数”一词由来的著作。

steps.text: 945: the Buyids, a Persian dynasty, take Baghdad. The caliphs keep their title, but real power has passed to military rulers.
steps.text_zh: 945年，波斯人建立的布韦希王朝控制巴格达，哈里发虽保留名号，实权已落入军事统治者手中。

title: Crusaders, Mongols and Mamluks
title_zh: 十字军、蒙古与马穆鲁克
summary: Turks take Anatolia, crusaders take Jerusalem, Saladin takes it back, the Mongols destroy Baghdad, and the Mamluks of Egypt end the crusader states.
summary_zh: 突厥人进入安纳托利亚，十字军攻占耶路撒冷，萨拉丁将其收复，蒙古人摧毁巴格达，埃及的马穆鲁克终结了十字军国家。

steps.text: 1071: the Seljuk Turks under Alp Arslan defeat and capture the Byzantine emperor at Manzikert, opening Anatolia to Turkish settlement.
steps.text_zh: 1071年，阿尔普·阿尔斯兰率塞尔柱突厥人在曼齐刻尔特击败并俘虏拜占庭皇帝，安纳托利亚从此向突厥人敞开。

steps.text: 1099: answering the Pope's call, the First Crusade storms Jerusalem and massacres its people. Crusader states are set up along the coast.
steps.text_zh: 1099年，响应教宗号召的第一次十字军攻破耶路撒冷，屠杀城中居民，并在沿海建立十字军国家。

steps.text: 1142: the Knights Hospitaller take over Krak des Chevaliers and build it into the greatest of the crusader castles.
steps.text_zh: 1142年，医院骑士团接管骑士堡，并将其扩建为最宏伟的十字军城堡。

steps.text: 1144: Zengi of Mosul takes Edessa, the first crusader state to fall, and the Muslim counterattack begins.
steps.text_zh: 1144年，摩苏尔的赞吉攻占埃德萨，第一个十字军国家灭亡，穆斯林开始反攻。

steps.text: 1187: Saladin, ruler of Egypt and Syria, destroys the crusader army at the Horns of Hattin and retakes Jerusalem three months later.
steps.text_zh: 1187年，统治埃及和叙利亚的萨拉丁在哈丁角全歼十字军，三个月后收复耶路撒冷。

steps.text: 1191: the Third Crusade of Richard the Lionheart retakes Acre, but cannot win back Jerusalem.
steps.text_zh: 1191年，狮心王理查参加的第三次十字军攻占阿卡，但未能夺回耶路撒冷。

steps.text: 1258: the Mongols under Hulagu sack Baghdad and kill the last Abbasid caliph, ending five centuries of the caliphate in Baghdad.
steps.text_zh: 1258年，旭烈兀率蒙古大军攻陷巴格达，处死最后一位阿拔斯哈里发，巴格达五百年的哈里发都城历史就此终结。

steps.text: 1260: the Mamluks of Egypt defeat the Mongols at Ain Jalut in Palestine, stopping their advance toward Africa.
steps.text_zh: 1260年，埃及马穆鲁克王朝在巴勒斯坦的艾因贾鲁击败蒙古军，阻止了蒙古人向非洲推进。

steps.text: 1291: the Mamluks take Acre, the last great crusader stronghold. The crusader states are gone.
steps.text_zh: 1291年，马穆鲁克攻占十字军最后的重要据点阿卡，十字军国家就此覆灭。

steps.text: 1402: Timur, after sacking Damascus and Baghdad, defeats and captures the Ottoman sultan Bayezid I at Ankara.
steps.text_zh: 1402年，帖木儿在洗劫大马士革和巴格达之后，于安卡拉击败并俘虏奥斯曼苏丹巴耶济德一世。

title: From the Ottomans to Today
summary: Four centuries of Ottoman rule, reform and collapse in the First World War, then new borders drawn by Britain and France, and the wars that have shaped the region since.
summary_zh: 奥斯曼帝国统治四个世纪，历经改革，最终在第一次世界大战中崩溃；英法划定新的边界，此后的一场场战争塑造了今天的中东。

steps.text: 1516: Selim I defeats the Mamluks at Marj Dabiq north of Aleppo; within a year Syria, Egypt and the holy cities of Arabia are Ottoman.
steps.text_zh: 1516年，塞利姆一世在阿勒颇以北的马尔季达比格击败马穆鲁克王朝，一年之内，叙利亚、埃及和阿拉伯圣城都归入奥斯曼帝国。

steps.text: 1839: facing defeat and debt, the Ottoman government launches the Tanzimat reforms, promising equal law for all subjects.
steps.text_zh: 1839年，屡战屡败、债台高筑的奥斯曼政府推行坦齐马特改革，承诺所有臣民在法律面前一律平等。

steps.text: 1915: the Ottoman army, with Mustafa Kemal among its commanders, throws back the Allied landings at Gallipoli.
steps.text_zh: 1915年，奥斯曼军队在加里波利击退协约国的登陆，穆斯塔法·凯末尔在此战中崭露头角。

steps.text: 1916: Sharif Hussein of Mecca, promised independence by Britain, launches the Arab Revolt; the same year Britain and France secretly agree, in the Sykes-Picot pact, to divide the region.
steps.text_zh: 1916年，获得英国独立承诺的麦加谢里夫侯赛因发动阿拉伯大起义，同年英法却秘密签订赛克斯-皮科协定，计划瓜分这一地区。

steps.text: 1917: British troops enter Jerusalem, a month after the Balfour Declaration promises a Jewish national home in Palestine.
steps.text_zh: 1917年，英军进入耶路撒冷，一个月前英国刚以贝尔福宣言承诺在巴勒斯坦建立犹太民族家园。

steps.text: 1923: Mustafa Kemal proclaims the Republic of Turkey in Ankara; the next year the caliphate is abolished.
steps.text_zh: 1923年，穆斯塔法·凯末尔在安卡拉宣布成立土耳其共和国，次年废除哈里发制度。

steps.text: 1948: as the British Mandate ends, Israel declares independence. In the war that follows, some 700,000 Palestinians flee or are driven from their homes.
steps.text_zh: 1948年，英国委任统治结束，以色列宣布建国。随后的战争中，约七十万巴勒斯坦人逃离或被逐出家园。

steps.text: 1967: in the Six-Day War Israel takes Sinai, Gaza, the West Bank, East Jerusalem and the Golan Heights, lines still disputed today.
steps.text_zh: 1967年，以色列在六日战争中占领西奈半岛、加沙、约旦河西岸、东耶路撒冷和戈兰高地，这些边界至今仍有争议。

steps.text: 1990: Saddam Hussein's Iraq invades oil-rich Kuwait; early next year a US-led coalition drives it out.
steps.text_zh: 1990年，萨达姆·侯赛因统治的伊拉克入侵盛产石油的科威特，次年初以美国为首的联军将伊军逐出。

steps.text: 2011: the Arab Spring protests reach Syria at Daraa; Bashar al-Assad's crackdown starts a civil war that kills hundreds of thousands, until his fall in 2024.
steps.text_zh: 2011年，“阿拉伯之春”抗议浪潮在德拉波及叙利亚，巴沙尔·阿萨德的镇压引发内战，数十万人丧生，直至2024年其政权倒台。

title: Cities of the Indus
summary: Some of the world's first planned cities rise along the Indus, trade as far as Mesopotamia, and then slowly fade away.
summary_zh: 世界上最早的一批规划城市在印度河畔兴起，贸易远达美索不达米亚，随后又悄然衰落。

steps.text: About 2800 BC: at Kot Diji in Sindh, farmers ring their town with a stone wall. Pottery like theirs spreads across the Indus plain, the first sign of one shared culture.
steps.text_zh: 约前2800年，信德的科特迪吉居民用石墙围起城镇。类似的陶器风格遍布印度河平原，显示一种共同的文化正在形成。

steps.text: About 2800 BC: at Kalibangan on the Ghaggar river, criss-cross furrows preserve the oldest ploughed field yet found anywhere.
steps.text_zh: 约前2800年，加加尔河畔的卡利班甘留下了纵横交错的犁沟，这是迄今发现的世界上最早的犁耕田地。

steps.text: About 2650 BC: Dholavira grows on an island in the salt flats of Kutch, storing monsoon rain in great stone reservoirs.
steps.text_zh: 约前2650年，多拉维拉在卡奇盐沼中的一座岛上兴起，居民修建巨大的石砌水库储存季风雨水。

steps.text: About 2600 BC: Harappa on the Ravi becomes a true city, with walled mounds, granaries and baked bricks of one standard size. Its seals carry a script nobody has yet deciphered.
steps.text_zh: 约前2600年，拉维河畔的哈拉帕发展为真正的城市，有设防的土丘、粮仓和统一规格的烧砖。印章上刻着至今无人破译的文字。

steps.text: About 2500 BC: Mohenjo-daro, the largest Indus city, lays out its houses on a grid with covered drains. On its citadel stands the Great Bath, perhaps used for ritual washing.
steps.text_zh: 约前2500年，最大的印度河城市摩亨佐·达罗按网格布局，家家连通有盖的排水沟。卫城上的大浴池可能用于宗教沐浴。

steps.text: About 2400 BC: at Lothal in Gujarat a great brick basin may be the world's oldest dock. Indus beads and seals reach Mesopotamia, whose texts call this land Meluhha.
steps.text_zh: 约前2400年，古吉拉特的洛塔尔建有一座巨大的砖砌水池，可能是世界上最早的船坞。印度河的珠子和印章远销美索不达米亚，当地文献称这片土地为“美路哈”。

steps.text: About 1900 BC: the Ghaggar-Hakra river, once lined with towns, dries up as the monsoon weakens and rivers shift their beds.
steps.text_zh: 约前1900年，季风减弱、河流改道，曾经城镇林立的加加尔-哈克拉河逐渐干涸。

steps.text: About 1900 BC: Mohenjo-daro and Harappa are slowly abandoned. Writing and standard weights fall out of use, and people move east into smaller villages toward the Ganges.
steps.text_zh: 约前1900年，摩亨佐·达罗和哈拉帕逐渐被遗弃，文字和统一的度量衡不再使用，人们向东迁往恒河方向的小村落。

title: From the Vedas to the Buddha
summary: Indo-Aryan settlers compose the Vedas and push into the Ganges plain, where new kingdoms rise and the Buddha teaches.
summary_zh: 雅利安人创作吠陀经典并向恒河平原推进，新兴的王国在那里崛起，佛陀也在那里传道。

steps.text: About 1700 BC: Indo-Aryan herders speaking an early form of Sanskrit come through the northwestern passes, bringing horses and chariots.
steps.text_zh: 约前1700年，说早期梵语的雅利安牧民经西北山口进入次大陆，带来了马匹和战车。

steps.text: About 1500 BC: in the land of seven rivers, the Punjab, priests compose the hymns of the Rigveda, handed down by memory for centuries before being written.
steps.text_zh: 约前1500年，在“七河之地”旁遮普，祭司们创作了《梨俱吠陀》的颂歌，此后数百年间一直靠口耳相传。

steps.text: About 1400 BC: the Rigveda tells of the Battle of the Ten Kings on the Ravi, where King Sudas of the Bharatas defeats an alliance of tribes.
steps.text_zh: 约前1400年，据《梨俱吠陀》记载，婆罗多族国王苏达斯在拉维河畔的十王之战中击败了部落联军。

steps.text: About 1200 BC: the Kuru kingdom forms between the Yamuna and the Ganges, the first Vedic state. Its hymns and rituals are gathered into fixed collections.
steps.text_zh: 约前1200年，俱卢王国在亚穆纳河与恒河之间形成，这是第一个吠陀国家，其颂诗和祭祀被整理成固定的经典。

steps.text: About 1000 BC: as settlers clear the Ganges forests with iron tools, society is ranked in four varnas: priests, warriors, farmers and traders, and servants.
steps.text_zh: 约前1000年，移民用铁器开垦恒河平原的森林，社会分为婆罗门、刹帝利、吠舍和首陀罗四个种姓。

steps.text: About 800 BC: the Upanishads look behind the rituals, teaching that the inner self (atman) is one with the absolute (brahman).
steps.text_zh: 约前800年，《奥义书》开始追问祭祀背后的真理，提出“梵我一如”的思想。

steps.text: About 600 BC: sixteen great states, kingdoms and republics, divide the Ganges plain. Magadha, ruling from Rajagriha, will grow strongest.
steps.text_zh: 约前600年，恒河平原上出现了十六个大国，有王国也有共和国。以王舍城为都的摩揭陀日后最为强大。

steps.text: About 563 BC: Siddhartha Gautama is born at Lumbini, a prince of the Shakya people in the Himalayan foothills.
steps.text_zh: 约前563年，乔达摩·悉达多诞生于喜马拉雅山麓的蓝毗尼，是释迦族的王子。

steps.text: About 528 BC: after years as a wandering ascetic, he attains enlightenment under a pipal tree at Bodh Gaya and becomes the Buddha. Soon after he preaches his first sermon at Sarnath.
steps.text_zh: 约前528年，他苦修多年后在菩提伽耶的菩提树下觉悟成佛，不久在鹿野苑初次说法。

steps.text: About 483 BC: the Buddha dies at Kushinagar. His followers, like those of his contemporary Mahavira, founder of Jainism, carry their teaching across the Ganges plain.
steps.text_zh: 约前483年，佛陀在拘尸那揭罗涅槃。他的弟子和同时代耆那教创始人大雄的信徒一样，把教义传遍了恒河平原。

title: Chandragupta and Ashoka
summary: After Alexander turns back, Chandragupta builds India's first great empire, and his grandson Ashoka gives up war for Buddhism.
summary_zh: 亚历山大退兵之后，旃陀罗笈多建立了印度第一个大帝国，其孙阿育王放弃征战，皈依佛教。

steps.text: 326 BC: Alexander the Great defeats King Porus at the Hydaspes river. His weary army refuses to go further east, and he turns back at the Beas.
steps.text_zh: 前326年，亚历山大大帝在希达斯皮斯河击败波鲁斯王，但疲惫的军队拒绝继续东进，他只得在比亚斯河折返。

steps.text: 321 BC: Chandragupta Maurya, guided by the minister Chanakya, overthrows the Nanda kings and takes Pataliputra.
steps.text_zh: 前321年，旃陀罗笈多在谋臣考底利耶的辅佐下推翻难陀王朝，占领华氏城，建立孔雀王朝。

steps.text: 303 BC: Seleucus, Alexander's former general, gives up the lands west of the Indus in return for 500 war elephants. The Maurya Empire now reaches into Afghanistan.
steps.text_zh: 前303年，亚历山大的旧部塞琉古割让印度河以西的土地，换取五百头战象，孔雀帝国的疆域延伸到了阿富汗。

steps.text: 302 BC: the Greek envoy Megasthenes lives at Pataliputra and describes a vast city behind timber walls, a huge army and a well run state.
steps.text_zh: 前302年，希腊使节麦加斯梯尼驻留华氏城，记述了这座木墙环绕的大城、庞大的军队和井然有序的国家。

steps.text: 261 BC: Ashoka, Chandragupta's grandson, conquers Kalinga on the east coast. By his own account 100,000 are killed and many more carried away.
steps.text_zh: 前261年，旃陀罗笈多之孙阿育王征服东海岸的羯陵伽。据他自己的诏令所说，十万人被杀，被掳走的人更多。

steps.text: 260 BC: stricken with remorse, Ashoka turns to Buddhism and vows to rule by dharma, conquest by righteousness instead of by war.
steps.text_zh: 前260年，阿育王深感悔恨，皈依佛教，誓以“正法”治国，以德服人而不再以武力征服。

steps.text: About 258 BC: Ashoka has his edicts carved on rocks and pillars across the empire, as here at Girnar, urging tolerance and kindness to people and animals.
steps.text_zh: 约前258年，阿育王把诏令刻在帝国各地的岩石和石柱上，吉尔纳尔的摩崖诏令便是一例，劝导人们宽容待人、善待众生。

steps.text: About 250 BC: Ashoka's son Mahinda carries Buddhism to Sri Lanka, which keeps the Theravada tradition alive for the next two thousand years.
steps.text_zh: 约前250年，阿育王之子摩哂陀将佛教传入斯里兰卡，此后两千年这里一直是上座部佛教的中心。

steps.text: 185 BC: the general Pushyamitra kills the last Maurya king at a review of the army and founds the Shunga dynasty. The empire breaks into regional states.
steps.text_zh: 前185年，将军普士亚密多罗在检阅军队时刺杀孔雀王朝末代君主，建立巽伽王朝，帝国分裂为各地政权。

title: Kushans and Guptas
summary: Greek, Kushan and Gupta kings preside over Gandhara art, the Nalanda monastery and a golden age of Sanskrit learning.
summary_zh: 从印度-希腊诸王到贵霜和笈多，犍陀罗艺术、那烂陀寺和梵语学术相继繁荣。

steps.text: About 155 BC: the Indo-Greek king Menander rules from Sagala. A Buddhist text records his questions to the monk Nagasena.
steps.text_zh: 约前155年，印度-希腊国王弥兰陀以奢羯罗为都。佛经《弥兰陀王问经》记录了他与那先比丘的问答。

steps.text: About 100: in Gandhara, sculptors blending Greek and Indian styles carve some of the first images of the Buddha in human form.
steps.text_zh: 约100年，犍陀罗的工匠融合希腊和印度风格，雕刻出最早的一批人形佛像。

steps.text: 127: Kanishka becomes king of the Kushan Empire, which stretches from Central Asia to the Ganges. From Purushapura (Peshawar) he patronises Buddhism, and merchants and monks carry it toward China.
steps.text_zh: 127年，迦腻色伽成为贵霜帝国国王，帝国从中亚延伸到恒河流域。他以布路沙布逻（今白沙瓦）为都，护持佛教，商人和僧侣沿商路把佛教传向中国。

steps.text: 320: Chandragupta I founds the Gupta dynasty in Magadha, reviving the old heartland of the Mauryas.
steps.text_zh: 320年，旃陀罗笈多一世在摩揭陀建立笈多王朝，复兴了孔雀王朝的故地。

steps.text: 335: Samudragupta campaigns from the Ganges to the far south. His victories are carved on the Ashoka pillar at Prayaga (Allahabad).
steps.text_zh: 335年，沙摩陀罗笈多从恒河流域一路征战到南印度，他的战功被刻在钵逻耶伽（今阿拉哈巴德）的阿育王石柱上。

steps.text: About 395: Chandragupta II defeats the Saka satraps and takes Ujjain and the western ports. The Chinese pilgrim Faxian soon finds a peaceful, prosperous land.
steps.text_zh: 约395年，旃陀罗笈多二世（超日王）消灭西部的塞种总督，夺取优禅尼和西海岸港口。不久后到访的中国僧人法显看到的是一片安宁富庶的国土。

steps.text: About 427: the monastery of Nalanda is founded. It grows into the greatest university of the Buddhist world, with thousands of monks and a famous library.
steps.text_zh: 约427年，那烂陀寺建立，后来发展为佛教世界规模最大的学府，僧众数千，藏书闻名。

steps.text: About 460: at Ajanta in the Deccan, monks and patrons cut new cave halls and cover them with paintings of the Buddha's past lives.
steps.text_zh: 约460年，德干高原上的阿旃陀开凿了新的石窟，窟内绘满佛本生故事壁画。

steps.text: 499: Aryabhata of Kusumapura (Pataliputra) writes the Aryabhatiya, using place-value numbers and arguing that the Earth turns on its axis.
steps.text_zh: 499年，华氏城的阿耶波多写成《阿耶波多历书》，运用位值记数法，并提出地球绕轴自转。

title: Harsha, Kannauj and the Cholas
title_zh: 戒日王、曲女城与朱罗王朝
summary: As Harsha's north fades, rival dynasties fight over Kannauj, temples are cut from living rock, and the Cholas of the south build a sea empire.
summary_zh: 戒日王之后北方群雄争夺曲女城，各地开山凿岩建造神庙，南方的朱罗王朝则建立了海上帝国。

steps.text: 606: Harsha becomes king and makes Kannauj the leading city of the north.
steps.text_zh: 606年，戒日王即位，把曲女城建成北印度的中心。

steps.text: About 618: Harsha marches south but is stopped on the Narmada by the Chalukya king Pulakeshin II. The river becomes the border between north and south.
steps.text_zh: 约618年，戒日王挥师南下，在纳尔默达河畔被遮娄其王补罗稽舍二世击退，这条河从此成为南北的分界。

steps.text: 631: the Chinese monk Xuanzang arrives at Nalanda to study. He later meets Harsha and describes his court in his Records of the Western Regions.
