steps.text_zh: 631年，中国僧人玄奘来到那烂陀寺求学，后来见到戒日王，并在《大唐西域记》中记述了他的宫廷。

steps.text: About 700: the Pallava kings of Kanchipuram build the Shore Temple at Mamallapuram, one of the first free-standing stone temples in the south.
steps.text_zh: 约700年，建都建志补罗的帕拉瓦诸王在马哈巴利普拉姆建造海岸神庙，这是南印度最早的独立石砌神庙之一。

steps.text: 712: an Arab army under Muhammad ibn Qasim conquers Sindh, bringing Muslim rule to the subcontinent for the first time.
steps.text_zh: 712年，穆罕默德·本·卡西姆率阿拉伯军队征服信德，次大陆首次出现穆斯林政权。

steps.text: About 760: the Rashtrakuta king Krishna I has the Kailasa temple at Ellora carved downward out of a single hill of rock.
steps.text_zh: 约760年，罗湿陀罗拘陀国王克里希纳一世下令在埃洛拉从整座山岩向下凿出凯拉萨神庙。

steps.text: About 786: the Palas of Bengal, the Pratiharas and the Rashtrakutas begin a long three-way war for Kannauj and the Ganges plain.
steps.text_zh: 约786年，孟加拉的波罗王朝、普腊蒂哈腊王朝和罗湿陀罗拘陀王朝为争夺曲女城和恒河平原展开长期混战。

steps.text: 985: Rajaraja I becomes king of the Cholas and goes on to conquer the southern Deccan and northern Sri Lanka.
steps.text_zh: 985年，罗茶罗乍一世登上朱罗王位，此后征服了德干南部和斯里兰卡北部。

steps.text: 1010: Rajaraja dedicates the great Brihadisvara temple at Thanjavur, its tower rising 66 metres.
steps.text_zh: 1010年，坦贾武尔的布里哈迪斯瓦拉大庙落成，主塔高达66米。

steps.text: 1025: Rajendra I's fleet raids Srivijaya and its ports on the Strait of Malacca, the farthest reach of any Indian kingdom by sea.
steps.text_zh: 1025年，拉金德拉一世的舰队远征室利佛逝，袭击马六甲海峡沿岸的港口，这是印度王国海上力量所及的最远处。

title: The Delhi Sultanate
summary: Turkic raiders from Afghanistan turn into conquerors and found a Muslim sultanate at Delhi that rules the north for three centuries.
summary_zh: 来自阿富汗的突厥劫掠者变成了征服者，在德里建立穆斯林苏丹国，统治北印度长达三百年。

steps.text: 1025: Mahmud of Ghazni sacks the temple of Somnath in Gujarat, one of seventeen raids he leads into India for plunder.
steps.text_zh: 1025年，伽色尼的马哈茂德洗劫古吉拉特的苏摩那特神庙，这是他十七次入侵印度劫掠中的一次。

steps.text: 1192: Muhammad of Ghor defeats the Rajput king Prithviraj Chauhan at Tarain, opening the north to Turkic rule.
steps.text_zh: 1192年，古尔王朝的穆罕默德在德赖恩击败拉其普特国王普里特维拉杰·乔汉，北印度从此向突厥人敞开。

steps.text: About 1193: Turkic raiders burn Nalanda. Buddhism, already in decline, almost vanishes from the land of its birth.
steps.text_zh: 约1193年，突厥军队焚毁那烂陀寺。本已衰落的佛教在其诞生地几乎消失。

steps.text: 1199: Qutb al-Din Aibak begins the Qutb Minar at Delhi, a victory tower of red sandstone.
steps.text_zh: 1199年，库特布丁·艾伊拜克在德里始建顾特卜塔，这座红砂岩高塔象征着胜利。

steps.text: 1206: after Muhammad of Ghor is killed, his slave general Aibak rules from Delhi as its first sultan.
steps.text_zh: 1206年，古尔的穆罕默德遇刺身亡，他的奴隶出身的将领艾伊拜克在德里称苏丹，德里苏丹国建立。

steps.text: 1236: Razia becomes sultan, the only woman to sit on Delhi's throne before modern times.
steps.text_zh: 1236年，拉齐娅登上苏丹之位，成为近代以前唯一统治德里的女性。

steps.text: 1303: Alauddin Khalji, who has driven back the Mongols, fixes prices in Delhi's markets to pay a huge standing army.
steps.text_zh: 1303年，击退蒙古入侵的阿拉丁·卡尔吉在德里实行市场限价，以供养庞大的常备军。

steps.text: 1327: Muhammad bin Tughluq orders the court and much of Delhi's population to move to Daulatabad in the Deccan, then lets them return.
steps.text_zh: 1327年，穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克下令朝廷和大批德里居民迁往德干的道拉塔巴德，后来又允许他们返回。

steps.text: 1336: in the south, the brothers Harihara and Bukka found Vijayanagara on the Tungabhadra, a Hindu power that will hold the Deccan for two centuries.
steps.text_zh: 1336年，诃里诃罗和布迦兄弟在栋格珀德拉河畔建立维查耶那加尔，这个印度教强国将雄踞德干两百年。

steps.text: 1398: Timur sacks Delhi and massacres its people. The sultanate never fully recovers.
steps.text_zh: 1398年，帖木儿攻陷德里并大肆屠杀，德里苏丹国从此一蹶不振。

title: The Mughal Empire
summary: Babur's heirs build an empire over almost all of India, then lose their grip to the Marathas and the Persian Nadir Shah.
summary_zh: 巴布尔的后代建立起几乎囊括整个印度的帝国，后来却在马拉塔人和波斯纳迪尔沙的打击下衰落。

steps.text: 1526: Babur, a descendant of Timur and Genghis Khan, uses cannon and cavalry to defeat Sultan Ibrahim Lodi at Panipat and founds the Mughal Empire.
steps.text_zh: 1526年，帖木儿和成吉思汗的后裔巴布尔凭借火炮和骑兵在帕尼帕特击败易卜拉欣·洛迪苏丹，建立莫卧儿帝国。

steps.text: 1540: the Afghan Sher Shah Suri drives Babur's son Humayun into exile, and reforms coinage, roads and land revenue.
steps.text_zh: 1540年，阿富汗人舍尔沙把巴布尔之子胡马雍逐出印度，并改革币制、修筑大道、整顿田赋。

steps.text: 1556: Humayun returns but soon dies. His 13-year-old son Akbar is crowned at Kalanaur and wins the second battle of Panipat.
steps.text_zh: 1556年，胡马雍复国后不久去世，13岁的阿克巴在卡拉瑙尔即位，随即在第二次帕尼帕特战役中获胜。

steps.text: 1565: in the south, an alliance of Deccan sultanates crushes Vijayanagara at Talikota and sacks its capital, Hampi.
steps.text_zh: 1565年，德干诸苏丹国联军在塔利科塔大败维查耶那加尔帝国，洗劫了都城亨比。

steps.text: 1582: at Fatehpur Sikri, Akbar, who has abolished the tax on non-Muslims and hosts debates among faiths, proclaims a new court creed, the Din-i Ilahi.
steps.text_zh: 1582年，已经废除非穆斯林人头税、并在法塔赫布尔西格里主持各宗教辩论的阿克巴，提出了宫廷信仰“神圣宗教”。

steps.text: 1632: Shah Jahan begins the Taj Mahal at Agra as a tomb for his wife Mumtaz Mahal.
steps.text_zh: 1632年，沙贾汗在阿格拉为亡妻慕塔芝·玛哈开始修建泰姬陵。

steps.text: 1658: Aurangzeb imprisons his father Shah Jahan and takes the throne. He pushes the empire to its greatest size but rules as a strict Sunni.
steps.text_zh: 1658年，奥朗则布囚禁父亲沙贾汗夺取皇位。他把帝国扩张到最大，却以严格的逊尼派教规治国。

steps.text: 1674: the Maratha leader Shivaji, who has fought the Mughals from his hill forts, is crowned king at Raigad.
steps.text_zh: 1674年，凭借山地要塞对抗莫卧儿的马拉塔领袖西瓦吉在赖加德加冕称王。

steps.text: 1707: Aurangzeb dies in the Deccan after 25 years of war against the Marathas. The empire soon breaks into provinces under their own rulers.
steps.text_zh: 1707年，奥朗则布在德干去世，此前他与马拉塔人苦战了二十五年。帝国很快分裂为各自为政的省份。

steps.text: 1739: Nadir Shah of Persia routs the Mughal army at Karnal and sacks Delhi, carrying off the Peacock Throne.
steps.text_zh: 1739年，波斯的纳迪尔沙在卡尔纳尔击溃莫卧儿军队，洗劫德里，掠走了孔雀宝座。

title: From the Company to independence
summary: A British trading company conquers India, the Crown takes over after 1857, and a mass movement led by Gandhi wins independence.
summary_zh: 英国东印度公司征服了印度，1857年后英国王室接管统治，甘地领导的群众运动最终赢得独立。

steps.text: 1757: Robert Clive's East India Company troops, helped by the treachery of the Nawab's commander Mir Jafar, win at Plassey and take control of Bengal.
steps.text_zh: 1757年，罗伯特·克莱武率东印度公司军队，借助孟加拉纳瓦布手下将领米尔·贾法尔的倒戈，在普拉西取胜，控制了孟加拉。

steps.text: 1764: at Buxar the Company defeats the Nawabs and the Mughal emperor together, and wins the right to collect Bengal's taxes.
steps.text_zh: 1764年，东印度公司在布克萨尔击败几位纳瓦布与莫卧儿皇帝的联军，获得了孟加拉的征税权。

steps.text: 1799: Tipu Sultan of Mysore, the Company's fiercest enemy in the south, dies defending his capital Seringapatam.
steps.text_zh: 1799年，东印度公司在南印度最顽强的对手、迈索尔的蒂普苏丹在保卫都城塞林伽巴丹时战死。

steps.text: 1818: the last Maratha Peshwa surrenders. The Company is now master of most of India, ruling directly or through princes.
steps.text_zh: 1818年，马拉塔最后一位佩什瓦投降，东印度公司成为印度大部分地区的主人，或直接统治，或通过土邦王公间接控制。

steps.text: 1857: Indian soldiers mutiny at Meerut and march on Delhi, setting off a great uprising across the north. It is crushed after more than a year of fighting.
steps.text_zh: 1857年，印度士兵在密拉特起事并进军德里，掀起席卷北印度的大起义，经过一年多的战斗才被镇压。

steps.text: 1885: the Indian National Congress first meets in Bombay, giving educated Indians a voice to press for self-rule.
steps.text_zh: 1885年，印度国民大会党在孟买召开首次会议，受过教育的印度人有了争取自治的组织。

steps.text: 1919: at Jallianwala Bagh in Amritsar, British troops fire on an unarmed crowd, killing hundreds. Many Indians turn against British rule for good.
steps.text_zh: 1919年，英军在阿姆利则的贾利安瓦拉园向手无寸铁的人群开枪，数百人遇难，许多印度人从此彻底反对英国统治。

steps.text: 1930: Mahatma Gandhi walks about 390 km to the sea at Dandi and makes salt in defiance of the British salt tax, launching mass civil disobedience.
steps.text_zh: 1930年，圣雄甘地步行约390公里到丹迪海边自行制盐，抗议英国的食盐税，掀起大规模的不服从运动。

steps.text: 1942: in Bombay, Congress demands that Britain Quit India. Its leaders are jailed, but the war leaves Britain too weak to hold on for long.
steps.text_zh: 1942年，国大党在孟买提出“退出印度”的要求，领导人被捕入狱，但战争使英国再也无力长期维持统治。

steps.text: 1947: British India is partitioned into India and Pakistan, independent on 14 and 15 August. The migrations and massacres that follow cost up to a million lives.
steps.text_zh: 1947年，英属印度分为印度和巴基斯坦两国，于8月14日和15日独立。随之而来的大迁徙和屠杀造成多达百万人死亡。

title: Seafarers, bronze drums and Funan
summary: Rice farmers and Austronesian sailors settle the region, bronze cultures flourish, and the first kingdoms rise on the trade routes.
summary_zh: 稻作农民和南岛语族航海者定居各地，青铜文化繁荣，最早的王国在贸易航线上兴起。

steps.text: About 2200 BC: Austronesian seafarers cross from Taiwan to Luzon in outrigger canoes, beginning a migration that will reach Madagascar and the far Pacific.
steps.text_zh: 约前2200年，南岛语族航海者乘舷外浮杆独木舟从台湾渡海到吕宋，开始了一场最终远达马达加斯加和太平洋深处的迁徙。

steps.text: About 2100 BC: at Ban Chiang in northeast Thailand, rice farmers bury their dead with painted pots; later layers hold some of the region's earliest bronze.
steps.text_zh: 约前2100年，泰国东北部班清的稻农以彩陶随葬，较晚的地层中出土了东南亚最早的一批青铜器。

steps.text: About 1000 BC: the Đông Sơn culture grows up in the Red and Ma river valleys. Its great bronze drums, cast with boats and feathered dancers, are traded far across the islands.
steps.text_zh: 约前1000年，东山文化在红河和马江流域兴起，其铸有船只和羽人舞者的大铜鼓远销各岛。

steps.text: About 1000 BC: on the central coast of Vietnam, the Sa Huỳnh people bury their dead in jars and trade jade ornaments with Taiwan and the Philippines.
steps.text_zh: 约前1000年，越南中部沿海的沙萤文化居民实行瓮棺葬，并与台湾和菲律宾交换玉饰。

steps.text: About 500 BC: on a plateau in Laos, people set up thousands of huge stone jars, probably for funerals.
steps.text_zh: 约前500年，老挝高原上的人们竖起数以千计的巨大石缸，可能用于丧葬。

steps.text: 257 BC: King An Dương founds Âu Lạc and builds the spiral citadel of Cổ Loa near today's Hanoi.
steps.text_zh: 前257年，安阳王建立瓯雒国，在今河内附近修筑螺旋形的古螺城。

steps.text: About 200 BC: the Pyu build walled brick cities in the dry zone of Burma, later famed for Buddhism and music.
steps.text_zh: 约前200年，骠人在缅甸干旱地带修建砖砌城邦，后来以佛教和音乐闻名。

steps.text: 111 BC: Han China conquers Nanyue and sets up Jiaozhi commandery in the Red River delta, beginning a thousand years of Chinese rule in northern Vietnam.
steps.text_zh: 前111年，汉朝灭南越，在红河三角洲设交趾郡，越南北部开始了上千年的中国郡县统治。

steps.text: 40: the Trưng sisters lead a revolt and drive out the Han governor. They are crushed three years later but remain heroines of Vietnamese independence.
steps.text_zh: 40年，征侧、征贰姐妹起兵赶走汉朝太守。三年后起义被镇压，但姐妹二人至今仍是越南民族独立的象征。

steps.text: About 150: Funan's port of Óc Eo on the Mekong delta trades with India, China and even Rome. Funan adopts Indian-style kingship and Hindu gods.
steps.text_zh: 约150年，扶南的喔㕭港位于湄公河三角洲，与印度、中国乃至罗马通商。扶南接受了印度式的王权和印度教神祇。

title: Srivijaya, Java and Angkor
summary: Kingdoms shaped by Indian religion grow rich on trade and rice, and build Borobudur, Prambanan and Angkor.
summary_zh: 受印度宗教影响的王国依靠贸易和稻作致富，建造了婆罗浮屠、普兰巴南和吴哥。

steps.text: About 550: Chenla, a Khmer state up the Mekong, overruns Funan and becomes the leading power in Cambodia.
steps.text_zh: 约550年，湄公河中游的高棉人国家真腊吞并扶南，成为柬埔寨地区的主要强国。

steps.text: 671: the Chinese monk Yijing stops at Srivijaya's capital near Palembang and finds over a thousand monks studying Buddhist texts.
steps.text_zh: 671年，中国僧人义净途经室利佛逝都城（今巨港附近），发现那里有上千名僧人研习佛经。

steps.text: 683: an inscription records King Jayanasa's victorious expedition. Srivijaya comes to control the Strait of Malacca and the trade between India and China.
steps.text_zh: 683年，一块碑铭记载了阇耶那沙国王的胜利远征。室利佛逝逐渐控制马六甲海峡和印度与中国之间的贸易。

steps.text: About 780: the Sailendra kings of central Java begin Borobudur, a vast stepped mountain of stone carved with the Buddha's path to enlightenment.
steps.text_zh: 约780年，中爪哇的夏连特拉王朝开始修建婆罗浮屠，这座阶梯状的石砌“圣山”刻满了佛陀成道的故事。

steps.text: 802: Jayavarman II declares himself universal monarch on Mount Kulen, free of Java, and founds the Khmer Empire.
steps.text_zh: 802年，阇耶跋摩二世在荔枝山宣布自己为“转轮王”，脱离爪哇独立，建立高棉帝国。

steps.text: 856: the Hindu kings of Mataram dedicate Prambanan, a great temple to Shiva close to Borobudur.
steps.text_zh: 856年，马打兰王国的印度教君主在婆罗浮屠附近建成供奉湿婆的普兰巴南神庙。

steps.text: About 889: Yasovarman I founds Yasodharapura at Angkor, a capital fed by huge reservoirs that store the monsoon rains.
steps.text_zh: 约889年，耶输跋摩一世在吴哥建立都城耶输陀罗补罗，依靠巨大的蓄水池储存季风雨水。

steps.text: 1025: a Chola fleet from south India sacks Srivijaya's ports. The empire survives but loses its grip on the strait.
steps.text_zh: 1025年，南印度朱罗王朝的舰队攻掠室利佛逝的港口，室利佛逝虽未灭亡，但对海峡的控制从此松动。

steps.text: 1113: Suryavarman II begins Angkor Wat, dedicated to Vishnu and still the largest religious monument in the world.
steps.text_zh: 1113年，苏利耶跋摩二世开始修建吴哥窟，这座供奉毗湿奴的神庙至今仍是世界上最大的宗教建筑。

steps.text: 1181: after driving out invaders from Champa, Jayavarman VII is crowned. A Buddhist, he builds Angkor Thom and the Bayon with its smiling stone faces.
steps.text_zh: 1181年，阇耶跋摩七世赶走入侵的占城军队后加冕。他信奉佛教，修建了大吴哥城和满布微笑石雕面孔的巴戎寺。

title: Đại Việt wins its freedom
summary: Northern Vietnam breaks free of Chinese rule, then defends its independence against Song, Mongol and Ming armies.
summary_zh: 越南北部摆脱中国统治后，又先后抵御宋、元、明的进攻，守住了独立。

steps.text: 722: Mai Thúc Loan raises a revolt in Hoan province against Tang rule, one of many risings against the Protectorate of Annan.
steps.text_zh: 722年，梅叔鸾在驩州起兵反抗唐朝统治，这是反抗安南都护府的多次起义之一。

steps.text: 938: Ngô Quyền plants iron-tipped stakes in the Bạch Đằng river. The Southern Han fleet is caught on them at low tide and destroyed, ending a thousand years of Chinese rule.
steps.text_zh: 938年，吴权在白藤江中暗植包铁木桩，南汉水军在退潮时触桩覆灭，越南结束了上千年的北属时期。

steps.text: 968: Đinh Bộ Lĩnh ends the strife of twelve warlords and takes the title of emperor of Đại Cồ Việt, with his capital at Hoa Lư.
steps.text_zh: 968年，丁部领平定十二使君之乱，称帝建立大瞿越，定都华闾。

steps.text: 1010: Lý Công Uẩn moves the capital to Thăng Long, today's Hanoi, where it will stay for most of the next eight centuries.
steps.text_zh: 1010年，李公蕴迁都升龙（今河内），此后八百年间这里大多是越南的都城。

steps.text: 1070: the Temple of Literature is built in Thăng Long to honour Confucius. Đại Việt adopts Chinese-style learning and exams while guarding its independence.
steps.text_zh: 1070年，升龙建立文庙祭祀孔子。大越一面仿行中国式的儒学和科举，一面坚守独立。

steps.text: 1226: the Trần family takes the throne. Within sixty years it must face three Mongol invasions.
steps.text_zh: 1226年，陈氏取代李朝建立陈朝，此后六十年间三次遭遇蒙古入侵。

steps.text: 1288: Trần Hưng Đạo repeats Ngô Quyền's trap at Bạch Đằng and destroys the Yuan fleet, ending the third Mongol invasion.
steps.text_zh: 1288年，陈兴道在白藤江重施吴权的木桩之计，全歼元朝水军，击退了蒙古的第三次入侵。

steps.text: 1407: Ming armies overthrow the Hồ dynasty and make Đại Việt a Chinese province once again.
steps.text_zh: 1407年，明军推翻胡朝，越南再次被并入中国版图。

steps.text: 1428: after ten years of guerrilla war, Lê Lợi drives out the Ming and founds the Later Lê dynasty.
steps.text_zh: 1428年，黎利经过十年抗战赶走明军，建立后黎朝。

steps.text: 1471: Lê Thánh Tông takes Vijaya, the capital of Champa, and pushes Đại Việt far to the south.
steps.text_zh: 1471年，黎圣宗攻破占城都城阇槃，大越的疆域大幅南扩。

title: Pagan, Sukhothai and Ayutthaya
title_zh: 蒲甘、素可泰与阿瑜陀耶
summary: Burmese, Thai and Lao kingdoms rise as Angkor fades, and Burma and Siam fight for mastery of the mainland.
summary_zh: 吴哥衰落之际，缅族、泰族和老族王国纷纷崛起，缅甸与暹罗为争夺中南半岛的霸权反复交战。

steps.text: 1044: Anawrahta becomes king of Pagan and unites the Irrawaddy valley in the first Burmese empire.
steps.text_zh: 1044年，阿奴律陀成为蒲甘国王，统一伊洛瓦底江流域，建立第一个缅甸帝国。

steps.text: 1057: Anawrahta conquers the Mon city of Thaton and carries home its monks and scriptures. Theravada Buddhism takes root, and Pagan fills with thousands of temples.
steps.text_zh: 1057年，阿奴律陀征服孟人的直通，带回僧侣和经典。上座部佛教在缅甸扎根，蒲甘建起数千座佛塔。

steps.text: 1238: Thai chiefs throw off Khmer rule and found Sukhothai, the first great Thai kingdom.
steps.text_zh: 1238年，泰族首领摆脱高棉统治，建立素可泰王朝，这是第一个强大的泰族王国。

steps.text: 1287: Yuan armies take Pagan. The empire breaks apart into Burmese, Mon and Shan states.
steps.text_zh: 1287年，元军攻入蒲甘，蒲甘王朝瓦解，缅甸分裂为缅族、孟族和掸族诸国。

steps.text: 1292: a stone inscription credited to King Ramkhamhaeng, written in an early Thai script, praises Sukhothai's free trade and fair justice.
steps.text_zh: 1292年，相传为兰甘亨国王所立的石碑以早期泰文写成，称颂素可泰的自由贸易和公正司法。

steps.text: 1351: King U Thong founds Ayutthaya on an island in the Chao Phraya river. It will rule Siam for four centuries.
steps.text_zh: 1351年，乌通王在湄南河中的岛上建立阿瑜陀耶王朝，此后统治暹罗四百年。

steps.text: 1353: Fa Ngum founds Lan Xang, the kingdom of a million elephants, ancestor of today's Laos.
steps.text_zh: 1353年，法昂建立澜沧王国（意为“百万大象之国”），这是今天老挝的前身。

steps.text: 1431: Ayutthaya's army sacks Angkor. The Khmer court moves south toward Phnom Penh, and the great city is slowly left to the forest.
steps.text_zh: 1431年，阿瑜陀耶军队攻陷吴哥，高棉王室南迁金边一带，这座大城逐渐湮没于丛林。

steps.text: 1569: Bayinnaung of Toungoo, who has united Burma, captures Ayutthaya and makes Siam his vassal.
steps.text_zh: 1569年，统一缅甸的东吁国王莽应龙攻陷阿瑜陀耶，暹罗沦为属国。

steps.text: 1593: Prince Naresuan, who has restored Siam's independence, kills the Burmese crown prince in a duel on elephant back at Nong Sarai.
steps.text_zh: 1593年，恢复暹罗独立的纳黎萱在廊沙莱与缅甸王储骑象决斗，将其斩杀。

title: Majapahit, Malacca and the spice trade
title_zh: 满者伯夷、马六甲与香料贸易
summary: Majapahit rules the islands, Malacca becomes the hub of Asian trade and Islam, and then European ships arrive for the spices.
summary_zh: 满者伯夷称雄群岛，马六甲成为亚洲贸易和伊斯兰教的枢纽，随后欧洲船队为香料而来。

steps.text: 1293: Raden Wijaya uses a Mongol fleet sent to punish Java to beat his rival, then turns on the Mongols and founds Majapahit.
steps.text_zh: 1293年，拉登·威查耶借元朝远征爪哇的军队击败对手，随即反戈驱逐元军，建立满者伯夷。

steps.text: 1297: the gravestone of Sultan Malik al-Saleh shows that Samudera Pasai in northern Sumatra has become a Muslim port.
steps.text_zh: 1297年，马利克·萨利赫苏丹的墓碑表明，苏门答腊北部的须文答剌已成为伊斯兰港口。

steps.text: 1336: Majapahit's chief minister Gajah Mada swears to taste no spice until the archipelago is united under his king.
steps.text_zh: 1336年，满者伯夷宰相加查·马达立下帕拉帕誓言，在群岛统一于国王之前绝不享用香料。

steps.text: 1365: the court poem Nagarakretagama lists Majapahit's tributaries from Sumatra to New Guinea, at the height of its power.
steps.text_zh: 1365年，宫廷长诗《爪哇史颂》列举了从苏门答腊到新几内亚的属地，满者伯夷达到鼎盛。

steps.text: About 1400: Parameswara, a prince from Palembang, founds Malacca on the strait. Its sheltered harbour draws ships from India, China and the islands.
steps.text_zh: 约1400年，来自巨港的王子拜里米苏拉在海峡边建立马六甲，良港吸引了来自印度、中国和群岛各地的船只。

steps.text: 1409: Zheng He's treasure fleet calls at Malacca. Ming protection helps the young port stand up to Siam and Majapahit.
steps.text_zh: 1409年，郑和船队到达满剌加。明朝的庇护帮助这个新兴港口抵御暹罗和满者伯夷。

steps.text: About 1414: Malacca's ruler becomes a Muslim. As the port grows into the hub of Indian Ocean trade, Islam spreads with its merchants across the islands.
steps.text_zh: 约1414年，马六甲统治者皈依伊斯兰教。随着这里成为印度洋贸易的枢纽，伊斯兰教随商人传遍群岛。

steps.text: 1511: Afonso de Albuquerque captures Malacca for Portugal, hoping to control the spice trade.
steps.text_zh: 1511年，阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克为葡萄牙攻占马六甲，意图控制香料贸易。

steps.text: 1521: Ferdinand Magellan, sailing round the world for Spain, is killed by the chief Lapulapu at Mactan in the Philippines.
steps.text_zh: 1521年，为西班牙进行环球航行的麦哲伦在菲律宾麦克坦岛被酋长拉普拉普击杀。

steps.text: 1619: the Dutch East India Company seizes Jayakarta and builds Batavia, the base from which it will win the spice islands and Java.
steps.text_zh: 1619年，荷兰东印度公司夺取雅加达，建立巴达维亚，以此为据点逐步控制香料群岛和爪哇。

title: From colonies to nations
summary: European powers divide the region, Japan's invasion breaks their hold, and new nations win independence, some only after long wars.
summary_zh: 欧洲列强瓜分东南亚，日本的入侵打破了殖民秩序，新国家相继独立，有的历经长期战争。

steps.text: 1824: Britain goes to war with Burma and takes Rangoon, the first step toward conquering the whole country by 1885.
steps.text_zh: 1824年，英国对缅甸开战并攻占仰光，这是英国到1885年吞并缅甸全境的第一步。

steps.text: 1825: Prince Diponegoro leads a five-year war against the Dutch in Java. After his defeat the Dutch force farmers to grow crops for export.
steps.text_zh: 1825年，蒂博尼哥罗亲王在爪哇领导了长达五年的抗荷战争。战争失败后，荷兰人强迫农民种植出口作物。

steps.text: 1868: King Chulalongkorn takes the throne in Bangkok. His reforms and careful diplomacy keep Siam the only independent state in the region.
steps.text_zh: 1868年，朱拉隆功在曼谷即位。他推行改革、周旋于列强之间，使暹罗成为东南亚唯一保持独立的国家。

steps.text: 1887: France joins Cochinchina, Annam, Tonkin and Cambodia into French Indochina; Laos is added in 1893.
steps.text_zh: 1887年，法国把交趾支那、安南、东京和柬埔寨合并为法属印度支那，1893年又并入老挝。

steps.text: 1896: the Katipunan rises against Spain in the Philippines. Two years later the United States takes the islands and crushes the new republic.
steps.text_zh: 1896年，菲律宾的卡蒂普南秘密会社发动反抗西班牙的起义。两年后美国夺取菲律宾，并镇压了新成立的共和国。

steps.text: 1928: young nationalists in Batavia swear the Youth Pledge: one motherland, one nation and one language, Indonesia.
steps.text_zh: 1928年，巴达维亚的青年民族主义者发表“青年誓言”：一个祖国、一个民族、一种语言，都叫印度尼西亚。

steps.text: 1941: Japan lands at Kota Bharu in Malaya. Within months it takes Singapore and the British, Dutch and American colonies.
steps.text_zh: 1941年，日军在马来亚哥打巴鲁登陆，数月之内攻占新加坡以及英国、荷兰和美国的殖民地。

steps.text: 1945: two days after Japan surrenders, Sukarno proclaims Indonesia's independence in Jakarta. The Dutch fight for four years before giving way.
steps.text_zh: 1945年，日本投降两天后，苏加诺在雅加达宣布印度尼西亚独立。荷兰经过四年战争后才最终放弃。

steps.text: 1954: the Việt Minh under Võ Nguyên Giáp besiege and take the French base at Điện Biên Phủ, ending French rule in Indochina. Vietnam is divided at the 17th parallel.
steps.text_zh: 1954年，武元甲指挥越盟军队围攻并攻克法军据点奠边府，法国在印度支那的统治结束，越南以北纬17度线为界分治。

steps.text: 1975: North Vietnamese tanks enter Saigon, ending the Vietnam War. Communist forces also take power in Laos and Cambodia the same year.
steps.text_zh: 1975年，北越坦克开进西贡，越南战争结束。同年老挝和柬埔寨也由共产党力量掌权。

title: Korea's beginnings
summary: From Neolithic villages and dolmens to Gojoseon, the Han commanderies and the founding of the Three Kingdoms.
summary_zh: 从新石器时代的村落和支石墓，到古朝鲜、汉四郡和三国的建立。

steps.text: About 3000 BC: villagers at Amsa-dong on the Han river live in pit houses and make the comb-pattern pottery that gives the Jeulmun period its name.
steps.text_zh: 约前3000年，汉江边岩寺洞的居民住在半地穴式房屋中，制作篦纹陶器，栉文土器时代由此得名。

steps.text: About 3000 BC: at Bangudae near Ulsan, hunters carve whales, boats and harpoons into a cliff, among the oldest whaling scenes in the world.
steps.text_zh: 约前3000年，蔚山附近盘龟台的猎人在崖壁上刻下鲸鱼、船只和鱼叉，这是世界上最早的捕鲸图像之一。

steps.text: About 1500 BC: rice farming spreads through the peninsula with plain Mumun pottery, and villages grow larger.
steps.text_zh: 约前1500年，水稻种植随无纹陶器在半岛传播，村落规模不断扩大。

steps.text: About 1000 BC: chiefs are buried beneath great stone dolmens. Korea has more of them than anywhere else on earth, many here at Gochang.
steps.text_zh: 约前1000年，首领们被葬在巨大的支石墓下。朝鲜半岛的支石墓数量居世界之首，高敞就是其中一处集中地。

steps.text: About 300 BC: Gojoseon, the first Korean state, loses its lands in Liaodong to the Yan general Qin Kai and is pushed back toward the peninsula.
steps.text_zh: 约前300年，朝鲜半岛最早的国家古朝鲜遭燕将秦开攻击，失去辽东的土地，退向半岛。

steps.text: 194 BC: Wiman, a refugee from Yan, seizes the throne of Gojoseon at Wanggeom (Pyongyang) and builds it into a strong trading state.
steps.text_zh: 前194年，来自燕地的卫满夺取古朝鲜王位，以王险城（今平壤）为都，使其成为强盛的贸易国家。

steps.text: 108 BC: Han armies take Wanggeom and divide Gojoseon into four commanderies. Lelang will be a centre of Chinese culture for four centuries.
steps.text_zh: 前108年，汉军攻破王险城，在古朝鲜故地设立四郡，其中乐浪郡此后四百年里一直是汉文化的中心。

steps.text: 57 BC: by tradition, Bak Hyeokgeose founds Silla at Gyeongju in the southeast.
steps.text_zh: 前57年，相传朴赫居世在东南部的庆州建立新罗。

steps.text: 37 BC: by tradition, Jumong founds Goguryeo at Jolbon in the mountains of the middle Yalu.
steps.text_zh: 前37年，相传朱蒙在鸭绿江中游山区的卒本建立高句丽。

steps.text: 18 BC: by tradition, Onjo, a son of Jumong, founds Baekje on the Han river.
steps.text_zh: 前18年，相传朱蒙之子温祚在汉江流域建立百济。

title: The Three Kingdoms
summary: Goguryeo, Baekje and Silla fight over the peninsula for three centuries until Silla, allied with Tang, comes out on top.
summary_zh: 高句丽、百济、新罗争霸三百多年，最终新罗联合唐朝胜出。

steps.text: 313: Goguryeo captures Lelang, ending four centuries of Chinese commanderies on the peninsula.
steps.text_zh: 313年，高句丽攻灭乐浪郡，结束了中原王朝在半岛设郡长达四百年的历史。

steps.text: 371: King Geunchogo of Baekje attacks Pyongyang and kills the king of Goguryeo. Baekje is at its height and trades with Wa and Eastern Jin.
steps.text_zh: 371年，百济近肖古王进攻平壤，杀死高句丽故国原王。百济进入全盛期，与倭国和东晋往来密切。

steps.text: 391: Gwanggaeto the Great takes the throne and expands Goguryeo deep into Manchuria. His deeds are carved on a great stele at Gungnae.
steps.text_zh: 391年，广开土王即位，把高句丽的疆域扩展到满洲腹地。他的功绩被刻在国内城附近的巨碑上。

steps.text: 427: King Jangsu moves Goguryeo's capital south to Pyongyang and turns its power against Baekje and Silla.
steps.text_zh: 427年，长寿王迁都平壤，把兵锋转向百济和新罗。

steps.text: 475: Goguryeo storms Baekje's capital Hanseong and kills its king. Baekje retreats south to Ungjin.
steps.text_zh: 475年，高句丽攻破百济都城汉城，杀死盖卤王，百济被迫南迁熊津。

steps.text: 553: Silla seizes the Han river valley from Baekje, gaining a gateway to the Yellow Sea and a direct link to China.
steps.text_zh: 553年，新罗从百济手中夺取汉江流域，获得了通往黄海和中国的门户。

steps.text: 612: a huge Sui army invades Goguryeo. General Eulji Mundeok lures it deep inland and destroys it at the Salsu river.
steps.text_zh: 612年，隋朝大军入侵高句丽，乙支文德诱敌深入，在萨水大败隋军。

steps.text: 660: Silla and Tang attack Baekje together. General Gyebaek falls at Hwangsanbeol and the capital Sabi surrenders.
steps.text_zh: 660年，新罗与唐朝联军进攻百济，阶伯将军在黄山伐战死，都城泗沘投降。

steps.text: 668: Pyongyang falls to Silla and Tang, and Goguryeo comes to an end.
steps.text_zh: 668年，平壤被新罗和唐朝联军攻陷，高句丽灭亡。

steps.text: 670: Silla turns on Tang, which wants to rule the whole peninsula. By 676 the Tang armies withdraw and Silla holds the land south of the Taedong river.
steps.text_zh: 670年，新罗与企图控制整个半岛的唐朝反目开战。到676年唐军撤退，大同江以南归新罗所有。

title: Unified Silla and Balhae
summary: Silla's golden age in Gyeongju and Balhae's in the north give way to rebel kingdoms, until Goryeo reunites the land.
summary_zh: 新罗在庆州迎来黄金时代，北方渤海兴盛；之后各地叛乱迭起，直到高丽重新统一。

steps.text: 685: Silla organises its enlarged kingdom into nine provinces and five secondary capitals, ruled from Gyeongju.
steps.text_zh: 685年，新罗把扩大后的国土划为九州五小京，由庆州统一治理。

steps.text: 751: work begins on Bulguksa temple and the Seokguram grotto near Gyeongju, high points of Silla's Buddhist art.
steps.text_zh: 751年，庆州附近开始修建佛国寺和石窟庵，这是新罗佛教艺术的巅峰。

steps.text: About 751: a Dharani sutra sealed inside Bulguksa's Seokga pagoda is printed from woodblocks; it is among the oldest printed texts in the world.
steps.text_zh: 约751年，封存在佛国寺释迦塔中的《无垢净光大陀罗尼经》以雕版印成，是世界上现存最早的印刷品之一。

steps.text: 755: King Mun of Balhae, heir to Goguryeo in the north, moves his capital to Sanggyeong. Balhae becomes known as the flourishing land in the east.
steps.text_zh: 755年，北方继承高句丽的渤海国文王迁都上京龙泉府，渤海被誉为“海东盛国”。

steps.text: 828: Jang Bogo sets up the Cheonghae garrison on Wando island, clears out pirates and dominates trade between Silla, Tang and Japan.
steps.text_zh: 828年，张保皋在莞岛设立清海镇，肃清海盗，主导了新罗、唐朝与日本之间的海上贸易。

steps.text: 881: the Silla scholar Choe Chiwon, who has passed the Tang exams, writes a famous call to arms against Huang Chao. Back home he finds Silla falling apart.
steps.text_zh: 881年，考中唐朝宾贡进士的新罗学者崔致远写下著名的《讨黄巢檄文》。他回国后却发现新罗已濒临崩溃。

steps.text: 900: Gyeon Hwon proclaims Later Baekje at Wansan (Jeonju).
steps.text_zh: 900年，甄萱在完山（今全州）建立后百济。

steps.text: 901: the monk-turned-rebel Gung Ye proclaims Later Goguryeo in the north, later renamed Taebong.
steps.text_zh: 901年，僧人出身的弓裔在北方建立后高句丽，后改国号为泰封。

steps.text: 918: Gung Ye's generals overthrow him and crown Wang Geon, who names his state Goryeo and rules from Gaegyeong (Kaesong).
steps.text_zh: 918年，弓裔的部将推翻他，拥立王建为王，国号高丽，定都开京（今开城）。

steps.text: 936: Wang Geon defeats Later Baekje at the Illi river, a year after Silla's last king has surrendered. Goryeo reunites the peninsula and takes in refugees from Balhae.
steps.text_zh: 936年，王建在一利川击败后百济，此前一年新罗末代国王已经归降。高丽统一了半岛，并接纳了渤海遗民。

title: Goryeo against Khitans and Mongols
summary: Goryeo holds off the Khitans, survives decades of Mongol invasions, and leaves behind the Tripitaka Koreana and the oldest metal-type book.
summary_zh: 高丽抵御契丹，在蒙古数十年的侵袭中幸存，留下了《高丽大藏经》和现存最早的金属活字印本。

steps.text: 958: King Gwangjong introduces civil service exams on the Chinese model to curb the powerful clans.
steps.text_zh: 958年，光宗仿照中国实行科举，以抑制豪族势力。

steps.text: 993: the Khitan Liao invade. The minister Seo Hui talks their commander into peace and even wins Goryeo the land up to the Yalu.
steps.text_zh: 993年，契丹辽国入侵，大臣徐熙与辽将谈判议和，反而为高丽争得鸭绿江以东的土地。

steps.text: 1019: General Gang Gam-chan destroys a Khitan army at Gwiju, ending the wars with Liao.
steps.text_zh: 1019年，姜邯赞在龟州大败契丹军，高丽与辽的战争就此结束。

steps.text: 1145: Kim Busik completes the Samguk Sagi, the oldest surviving history of Korea.
steps.text_zh: 1145年，金富轼编成《三国史记》，这是现存最早的朝鲜史书。

steps.text: 1170: insulted army officers kill civil officials and seize power. Military strongmen, later the Choe family, rule for a century.
steps.text_zh: 1170年，受辱的武将杀死文臣夺取政权，此后武臣（后为崔氏家族）专权近百年。

steps.text: 1231: the Mongols invade. The next year the court flees to Ganghwa island and holds out for nearly thirty years while the mainland is ravaged.
steps.text_zh: 1231年，蒙古大军入侵。次年朝廷迁都江华岛，坚持了近三十年，本土则惨遭蹂躏。

steps.text: 1236: Goryeo begins carving the Tripitaka Koreana, more than 80,000 woodblocks made to win the Buddha's protection. They are kept today at Haeinsa.
steps.text_zh: 1236年，高丽开始雕刻八万余块经版的《高丽大藏经》，祈求佛力护国，经版今藏于海印寺。

steps.text: 1270: when the court makes peace with the Mongols, the Sambyeolcho troops rebel and fight on from Jindo and then Jeju.
steps.text_zh: 1270年，朝廷与蒙古议和，三别抄拒不投降，先后据守珍岛和济州岛继续抗争。

steps.text: 1377: at Heungdeoksa temple in Cheongju, monks print the Jikji with metal movable type, the oldest surviving book printed this way.
steps.text_zh: 1377年，清州兴德寺的僧人用金属活字印成《直指》，这是现存最早的金属活字印本。

steps.text: 1388: sent to attack the Ming in Liaodong, General Yi Seong-gye turns his army back at Wihwa island and takes power in Gaegyeong.
steps.text_zh: 1388年，奉命进攻辽东明军的李成桂在威化岛回军，夺取开京政权。

title: Joseon: Hangul and the Imjin War
title_zh: 朝鲜王朝：谚文与壬辰战争
summary: Joseon builds a Confucian kingdom, creates Hangul, and survives the Japanese and Manchu invasions.
summary_zh: 朝鲜王朝建立儒家国家，创制谚文，并挺过了日本和满洲的入侵。

steps.text: 1392: Yi Seong-gye takes the throne himself and founds the Joseon dynasty, with Neo-Confucianism as its creed.
steps.text_zh: 1392年，李成桂即王位，建立朝鲜王朝，以性理学为立国之本。

steps.text: 1394: the capital moves to Hanyang, today's Seoul, between the mountains and the Han river.
steps.text_zh: 1394年，朝鲜迁都汉阳（今首尔），都城背山面水，临汉江。

steps.text: 1446: King Sejong publishes Hunminjeongeum, a new alphabet so simple that a wise man can learn it in a morning.
steps.text_zh: 1446年，世宗大王颁布《训民正音》，这种新文字简单易学，聪明人一个早上就能学会。

steps.text: 1485: the Gyeongguk Daejeon, Joseon's great law code, is completed and will govern the kingdom for four centuries.
steps.text_zh: 1485年，朝鲜的根本法典《经国大典》正式颁行，此后沿用四百年。

steps.text: 1592: Toyotomi Hideyoshi's army lands at Busan and takes Hanseong within three weeks. King Seonjo flees north.
steps.text_zh: 1592年，丰臣秀吉的军队在釜山登陆，不到三周便攻陷汉城，宣祖向北出逃。

steps.text: 1592: Admiral Yi Sun-sin's turtle ships destroy a Japanese fleet off Hansan island, cutting the invaders' supply line by sea.
steps.text_zh: 1592年，李舜臣率龟船在闲山岛大败日本水军，切断了日军的海上补给线。

steps.text: 1597: when Japan invades again, Yi with just 13 ships beats a fleet of over 130 in the narrow strait of Myeongnyang.
steps.text_zh: 1597年，日本再次入侵，李舜臣仅率13艘战船在狭窄的鸣梁海峡击败一百三十余艘日舰。

steps.text: 1598: as the Japanese withdraw, Yi is killed at Noryang in the last battle of the war. 'Do not announce my death,' he orders.
steps.text_zh: 1598年，日军撤退时，李舜臣在战争的最后一战露梁海战中阵亡，临终嘱咐“勿言我死”。

steps.text: 1636: the Qing invade. King Injo holds out in the mountain fortress of Namhansanseong but must kneel and submit to Hong Taiji.
steps.text_zh: 1636年，清军入侵，仁祖困守南汉山城，最终被迫向皇太极跪拜称臣。

steps.text: 1796: King Jeongjo completes Hwaseong Fortress at Suwon, a showcase of the Practical Learning (Silhak) movement.
steps.text_zh: 1796年，正祖在水原建成华城，这是实学思想的代表作。

title: From open ports to a divided Korea
summary: Korea is forced open, proclaims an empire, falls to Japan, and after liberation is divided and torn by war.
summary_zh: 朝鲜被迫开港，改称帝国，随后沦为日本殖民地；光复之后又陷入分裂和战争。

steps.text: 1876: Japan forces Joseon to sign the Treaty of Ganghwa, opening its ports and ending centuries of seclusion.
steps.text_zh: 1876年，日本迫使朝鲜签订《江华岛条约》，开放港口，朝鲜的闭关时代就此结束。

steps.text: 1894: Donghak peasants rise in Jeolla. Both Qing and Japan send troops, and the First Sino-Japanese War is fought on Korean soil.
steps.text_zh: 1894年，东学党农民在全罗道起义，清朝和日本同时出兵，甲午战争在朝鲜的土地上爆发。

steps.text: 1895: Japanese agents break into the palace and murder Queen Min, who has resisted Japan's influence.
steps.text_zh: 1895年，日本浪人闯入王宫，杀害了抵制日本势力的明成皇后（闵妃）。

steps.text: 1897: King Gojong proclaims the Korean Empire to assert full independence from Qing.
steps.text_zh: 1897年，高宗宣布建立大韩帝国，以表明完全脱离清朝独立。

steps.text: 1905: after defeating Russia, Japan forces the Eulsa Treaty on Korea and takes over its foreign affairs.
steps.text_zh: 1905年，日本战胜俄国后强迫韩国签订《乙巳条约》，夺取其外交权。

steps.text: 1910: Japan annexes Korea outright and rules it through a governor-general in Seoul.
steps.text_zh: 1910年，日本正式吞并韩国，通过设在京城（今首尔）的朝鲜总督府进行殖民统治。

steps.text: 1919: on 1 March a Declaration of Independence is read in Seoul, and peaceful protests spread across the country before being crushed.
steps.text_zh: 1919年3月1日，《独立宣言》在京城宣读，和平示威遍及全国，随后遭到残酷镇压。

steps.text: 1945: Japan's surrender liberates Korea, but Soviet and American troops divide it at the 38th parallel.
steps.text_zh: 1945年，日本投降，朝鲜半岛光复，但苏美两军以北纬38度线为界分区占领。

steps.text: 1950: North Korean troops cross the 38th parallel. UN forces land at Incheon and drive north, and China then enters the war.
steps.text_zh: 1950年，朝鲜人民军越过三八线南下，联合国军在仁川登陆后向北推进，中国随即参战。

steps.text: 1953: an armistice is signed at Panmunjom. The fighting stops close to where it began, and Korea remains divided to this day.
steps.text_zh: 1953年，交战双方在板门店签订停战协定，战线大致停在战前分界线附近，朝鲜半岛分裂至今。

title: From Jōmon to Yamato
summary: Jōmon foragers, Yayoi rice farmers and the Yamato kings in their giant keyhole-shaped tombs.
summary_zh: 从绳文时代的采集者、弥生时代的稻农，到葬于巨大前方后圆坟中的大和王权。

steps.text: About 3000 BC: at Sannai-Maruyama in the far north of Honshu, hundreds of Jōmon people live in a large settled village with tall timber structures, all without farming.
steps.text_zh: 约前3000年，本州北端的三内丸山聚落住着数百名绳文人，建有高大的木柱建筑，但他们并不务农。

steps.text: About 2000 BC: at Ōyu, Jōmon people set river stones in great circles, probably for burials and rites.
steps.text_zh: 约前2000年，绳文人在大汤用河石摆成巨大的环状列石，可能用于丧葬和祭祀。

steps.text: About 500 BC: wet-rice farming crosses from the Korean peninsula to northern Kyushu, starting the Yayoi way of life.
steps.text_zh: 约前500年，水田稻作从朝鲜半岛传入九州北部，弥生时代的生活方式由此开始。

steps.text: About 300 BC: villages like Yoshinogari ring themselves with moats and watchtowers, as rice land brings both wealth and war.
steps.text_zh: 约前300年，吉野里等村落四周挖起环壕、建起望楼，稻田带来了财富，也带来了战争。

steps.text: About 100 BC: in western Japan, bronze bells called dōtaku are cast for farming rites; 39 were buried together at Kamo-Iwakura.
steps.text_zh: 约前100年，日本西部铸造称为铜铎的青铜祭器用于农耕祭祀，加茂岩仓一处就埋藏了39件。

steps.text: About 180: after years of war among the states of Wa, they agree on a queen, Himiko of Yamatai, who later sends envoys to the Wei court in China.
steps.text_zh: 约180年，倭国诸国连年混战，最终共同拥立邪马台国的卑弥呼为女王，她后来遣使朝贡曹魏。

steps.text: About 250: the Hashihaka mound, perhaps Himiko's tomb, is raised at Makimuku. Keyhole-shaped tombs spread with the power of the Yamato kings.
steps.text_zh: 约250年，缠向建起箸墓古坟，有人认为这就是卑弥呼之墓。前方后圆坟随着大和王权的扩张传播开来。

steps.text: About 405: by tradition the scholar Wani comes from Baekje with the Analects, bringing Chinese writing to the Yamato court.
steps.text_zh: 约405年，相传百济学者王仁携《论语》来到日本，把汉字带入大和朝廷。

steps.text: About 450: the Daisen tomb near Sakai, said to be Emperor Nintoku's, is finished. At 486 metres long it is the largest burial mound in the world.
steps.text_zh: 约450年，堺市附近的大仙陵古坟建成，相传为仁德天皇陵，全长486米，是世界上最大的坟丘墓。

steps.text: 527: Iwai, a Kyushu chief allied with Silla, rebels against Yamato and is crushed. The court tightens its hold on the west.
steps.text_zh: 527年，与新罗结盟的九州豪族磐井起兵反抗大和，被镇压，朝廷加强了对西部的控制。

title: Buddhism and the imperial state
summary: Buddhism arrives from Baekje, Prince Shōtoku and the Taika reformers copy the Tang state, and Nara raises the Great Buddha.
summary_zh: 佛教从百济传入，圣德太子和大化改新仿照唐朝建立国家制度，奈良铸造了东大寺大佛。

steps.text: 538: the king of Baekje sends a Buddha image and sutras to the Yamato court. The powerful Soga clan embraces the new faith.
steps.text_zh: 538年，百济国王向大和朝廷献上佛像和经卷，权臣苏我氏积极信奉这一新宗教。

steps.text: 587: the Soga defeat the Mononobe, who opposed Buddhism, and become masters of the court.
steps.text_zh: 587年，苏我氏击败反对佛教的物部氏，掌控了朝廷。

steps.text: 604: Prince Shōtoku, regent for Empress Suiko, issues the Seventeen-Article Constitution, urging harmony and reverence for Buddhism.
steps.text_zh: 604年，推古天皇的摄政圣德太子颁布《十七条宪法》，倡导“以和为贵”，尊崇佛法。

steps.text: 607: Shōtoku founds Hōryū-ji, whose rebuilt halls are the oldest wooden buildings in the world. The same year his envoy Ono no Imoko sails to Sui China.
steps.text_zh: 607年，圣德太子创建法隆寺，其重建后的殿堂是世界上现存最古老的木构建筑。同年他派小野妹子出使隋朝。

steps.text: 645: Prince Naka no Ōe and Nakatomi no Kamatari kill Soga no Iruka at court and launch the Taika Reform, placing land and people under the throne.
steps.text_zh: 645年，中大兄皇子与中臣镰足在宫中刺杀苏我入鹿，推行大化改新，土地和人民收归天皇所有。

steps.text: 663: a fleet sent to restore Baekje is destroyed by Tang and Silla at Baekgang. Yamato pulls out of the peninsula and fortifies its own coasts.
steps.text_zh: 663年，大和派去复兴百济的舰队在白江口被唐朝和新罗联军击败，此后撤出朝鲜半岛，加紧修筑本土海防。

steps.text: 672: in the Jinshin War, Prince Ōama wins the throne as Emperor Tenmu and greatly strengthens the emperor's power.
steps.text_zh: 672年，大海人皇子在壬申之乱中获胜即位，是为天武天皇，大大加强了天皇的权力。

steps.text: 701: the Taihō Code sets up a full system of law and government on the Tang model, and the country soon calls itself Nihon, Japan.
steps.text_zh: 701年，仿照唐制的《大宝律令》颁布，建立了完整的律令制度，不久国号定为“日本”。

steps.text: 710: the court moves to Heijō-kyō (Nara), laid out on a grid like Chang'an.
steps.text_zh: 710年，朝廷迁都仿照长安棋盘格局修建的平城京（奈良）。

steps.text: 752: the Great Buddha of Tōdai-ji, about 15 metres of gilded bronze, is consecrated before monks from India and China.
steps.text_zh: 752年，东大寺大佛开眼，这尊镀金铜像高约15米，开眼仪式上有来自印度和中国的僧人。

title: The Heian court
summary: From Kyoto the Fujiwara regents rule through the emperors, while court ladies write Japan's classics in the new kana script.
summary_zh: 藤原氏在平安京借天皇之名执政，宫廷女性用新兴的假名写下了日本文学的经典。

steps.text: 794: Emperor Kanmu moves the capital to Heian-kyō, today's Kyoto, which remains the imperial seat for over a thousand years.
steps.text_zh: 794年，桓武天皇迁都平安京（今京都），此后一千多年这里一直是天皇所在的都城。

steps.text: 802: Sakanoue no Tamuramaro, the great shōgun of his day, builds Isawa castle after defeating the Emishi of the north.
steps.text_zh: 802年，征夷大将军坂上田村麻吕击败北方的虾夷，修筑胆泽城。

steps.text: 866: Fujiwara no Yoshifusa becomes the first regent from outside the imperial family. Through marriages the Fujiwara control the throne for two centuries.
steps.text_zh: 866年，藤原良房成为第一位非皇族出身的摄政。藤原氏通过联姻控制皇位长达两百年。

steps.text: 894: Sugawara no Michizane advises ending the missions to Tang. With fewer ties to China, a native court culture grows.
steps.text_zh: 894年，菅原道真建议停派遣唐使。与中国的往来减少后，本土的宫廷文化日益发展。

steps.text: 905: the Kokin Wakashū, the first imperial anthology of Japanese poems, is compiled, with a preface written in the new kana script.
steps.text_zh: 905年，第一部敕撰和歌集《古今和歌集》编成，其序言用新兴的假名书写。

steps.text: 939: Taira no Masakado rebels in the east and calls himself the new emperor, a sign of the rising power of provincial warriors.
steps.text_zh: 939年，平将门在关东起兵，自称“新皇”，显示出地方武士势力的崛起。

steps.text: 1008: Murasaki Shikibu, a lady at court, is writing The Tale of Genji, often called the world's first novel.
steps.text_zh: 1008年，宫中女官紫式部正在写作《源氏物语》，它常被称为世界上第一部长篇小说。

steps.text: 1053: the Phoenix Hall of Byōdō-in at Uji is completed for the regent Fujiwara no Yorimichi, an image of the Pure Land paradise.
steps.text_zh: 1053年，关白藤原赖通在宇治建成平等院凤凰堂，再现了净土极乐世界的景象。

steps.text: 1086: Emperor Shirakawa abdicates but keeps ruling as a cloistered emperor, breaking the Fujiwara grip on power.
steps.text_zh: 1086年，白河天皇让位后仍以上皇身份执政，开创院政，打破了藤原氏对朝政的垄断。

title: The rise of the samurai
summary: Warrior clans take over from the court, found a shogunate at Kamakura and drive off two Mongol invasions.
summary_zh: 武士集团从朝廷手中夺得权力，在镰仓建立幕府，并两次击退元军入侵。

steps.text: 1156: in the Hōgen disturbance, rival court factions call in the Taira and Minamoto warrior clans, and the warriors decide the outcome.
steps.text_zh: 1156年，保元之乱中朝廷各派借助平氏和源氏武士角逐，胜负最终由武士决定。

steps.text: 1167: Taira no Kiyomori becomes chancellor, the first warrior to head the court government.
steps.text_zh: 1167年，平清盛出任太政大臣，成为第一个执掌朝政的武士。

steps.text: 1180: Minamoto no Yoritomo raises his banner in the east and makes Kamakura his base, starting the Genpei War against the Taira.
steps.text_zh: 1180年，源赖朝在关东起兵，以镰仓为据点，源平合战爆发。

steps.text: 1185: the Taira are destroyed in the sea battle of Dan-no-ura, and the child emperor Antoku drowns.
steps.text_zh: 1185年，平氏在坛之浦海战中覆灭，年幼的安德天皇投海而死。

steps.text: 1192: Yoritomo is named shōgun. From Kamakura his warrior government rules alongside the court in Kyoto.
steps.text_zh: 1192年，源赖朝被任命为征夷大将军，他在镰仓建立的武家政权与京都朝廷并立。

steps.text: 1221: the retired emperor Go-Toba tries to overthrow the shogunate and is defeated. The Hōjō regents now dominate Kyoto as well.
steps.text_zh: 1221年，后鸟羽上皇企图推翻幕府，兵败被流放，执权北条氏的势力从此也压倒了京都朝廷。

steps.text: 1274: a Mongol and Korean fleet sent by Kublai Khan lands at Hakata Bay but withdraws after a day of fighting and a storm.
steps.text_zh: 1274年，忽必烈派遣的元朝与高丽联军在博多湾登陆，激战一日后遭遇风暴撤退。

steps.text: 1281: a far larger invasion is held at Hakata by a stone sea wall until a typhoon, the kamikaze or divine wind, wrecks much of the fleet.
steps.text_zh: 1281年，规模更大的元军再度来袭，被博多湾的石垒阻挡，随后台风（日本人称“神风”）摧毁了大部分舰队。

steps.text: 1333: supporters of Emperor Go-Daigo storm Kamakura, and the last Hōjō regent kills himself with his followers.
steps.text_zh: 1333年，后醍醐天皇的支持者攻入镰仓，北条氏最后的执权与部下集体自尽。

steps.text: 1338: Ashikaga Takauji, who has turned against Go-Daigo, becomes shōgun in Kyoto. Rival Northern and Southern Courts fight for nearly sixty years.
steps.text_zh: 1338年，背弃后醍醐天皇的足利尊氏在京都就任征夷大将军，南北两个朝廷对立将近六十年。

title: The three unifiers
summary: After a century of civil war, Oda Nobunaga, Toyotomi Hideyoshi and Tokugawa Ieyasu reunite Japan with guns and diplomacy.
summary_zh: 经过一个世纪的内战，织田信长、丰臣秀吉和德川家康凭借火枪和谋略重新统一日本。

steps.text: 1467: the Ōnin War between rival lords burns much of Kyoto. The shogunate never recovers, and the age of warring states begins.
steps.text_zh: 1467年，各大名之间爆发应仁之乱，京都大半化为焦土。幕府从此一蹶不振，战国时代开始。

steps.text: 1543: Portuguese traders blown ashore on Tanegashima bring the first firearms. Within decades Japan is making them in great numbers.
steps.text_zh: 1543年，漂流到种子岛的葡萄牙商人带来了第一批火绳枪，数十年间日本便开始大量仿制。

steps.text: 1549: the Jesuit Francis Xavier lands at Kagoshima and begins Christian missions in Japan.
steps.text_zh: 1549年，耶稣会士沙勿略在鹿儿岛登陆，开始在日本传播天主教。

steps.text: 1560: Oda Nobunaga, a minor lord of Owari, surprises and kills the powerful warlord Imagawa Yoshimoto at Okehazama.
steps.text_zh: 1560年，尾张的小大名织田信长在桶狭间奇袭并斩杀了强大的今川义元。

steps.text: 1575: at Nagashino, Nobunaga's musketeers fire in volleys from behind fences and cut down the Takeda cavalry.
steps.text_zh: 1575年，织田信长的铁炮队在长篠藏身栅栏后轮番射击，击溃了武田家的骑兵。

steps.text: 1582: Nobunaga is betrayed by his general Akechi Mitsuhide and dies in the burning Honnō-ji temple in Kyoto.
steps.text_zh: 1582年，织田信长遭部将明智光秀背叛，在京都本能寺的大火中自尽。

steps.text: 1590: Toyotomi Hideyoshi takes Odawara castle from the Hōjō, completing the reunification of Japan.
steps.text_zh: 1590年，丰臣秀吉攻下北条氏的小田原城，完成了日本的统一。

steps.text: 1592: from Nagoya castle in Kyushu, Hideyoshi launches his invasion of Korea. It fails, and his troops come home after his death in 1598.
steps.text_zh: 1592年，丰臣秀吉从九州的名护屋城出兵侵略朝鲜，战争以失败告终，1598年他死后日军撤回。

steps.text: 1600: Tokugawa Ieyasu defeats the western lords at Sekigahara, the decisive battle for control of Japan.
steps.text_zh: 1600年，德川家康在关原之战中击败西军，取得了对日本的控制权。

steps.text: 1603: Ieyasu is named shōgun and makes Edo his capital. Tokugawa rule will last until 1867.
steps.text_zh: 1603年，德川家康受封征夷大将军，以江户为政治中心，德川幕府的统治一直延续到1867年。

title: Edo Japan: peace and seclusion
summary: The Tokugawa keep the peace for two and a half centuries, close the country to most foreigners, and preside over a lively urban culture until Perry's ships arrive.
summary_zh: 德川幕府维持了两个半世纪的和平，对大多数外国人关闭国门，城市文化繁荣，直到佩里的黑船到来。

steps.text: 1614: Ieyasu besieges Osaka castle. It falls the next summer and Hideyoshi's heir dies, removing the last rival to the Tokugawa.
steps.text_zh: 1614年，德川家康围攻大坂城，次年夏天城破，丰臣秀赖自尽，德川氏最后的对手被消灭。

steps.text: 1635: the shogunate requires the daimyō to spend every other year in Edo, keeping them in check and turning Edo into one of the world's largest cities.
steps.text_zh: 1635年，幕府规定大名每隔一年须到江户居住，借此控制大名，也使江户发展成世界上最大的城市之一。

steps.text: 1637: Christian peasants rise at Shimabara against heavy taxes and persecution. The revolt is crushed and Christianity is driven underground.
steps.text_zh: 1637年，岛原的天主教农民因重税和迫害起义，起义被镇压，天主教被迫转入地下。

steps.text: 1639: the Portuguese are expelled. Only the Dutch, confined to the islet of Dejima at Nagasaki, and the Chinese may trade, a policy later called sakoku.
steps.text_zh: 1639年，葡萄牙人被驱逐，只有荷兰人（限居长崎出岛）和中国人获准通商，这一政策后来被称为“锁国”。

steps.text: 1669: the Ainu leader Shakushain rises against the Matsumae domain in Hokkaido and is killed by treachery. Japanese control of Ainu trade tightens.
steps.text_zh: 1669年，阿伊努首领沙牟奢允在北海道起兵反抗松前藩，被诱杀，日本加强了对阿伊努贸易的控制。

steps.text: 1689: the poet Matsuo Bashō leaves Edo on the journey he describes in The Narrow Road to the Deep North.
steps.text_zh: 1689年，俳句诗人松尾芭蕉从江户出发，踏上《奥之细道》所记的旅程。

steps.text: 1730: the shogunate licenses the Dōjima rice exchange in Osaka, where merchants trade rice futures.
steps.text_zh: 1730年，幕府正式批准大坂的堂岛米市场，商人在此进行大米期货交易。

steps.text: 1774: Sugita Genpaku and his colleagues publish a translation of a Dutch anatomy book, launching Dutch learning (rangaku).
steps.text_zh: 1774年，杉田玄白等人翻译出版荷兰解剖学书籍《解体新书》，兰学由此兴起。

steps.text: About 1831: Katsushika Hokusai publishes The Great Wave off Kanagawa, a print from Edo's lively popular culture.
steps.text_zh: 约1831年，葛饰北斋出版《神奈川冲浪里》，这幅浮世绘展现了江户繁荣的市民文化。

steps.text: 1853: Commodore Perry's black ships steam into Uraga Bay and demand that Japan open its ports. The shogunate gives way the next year.
steps.text_zh: 1853年，美国海军准将佩里率“黑船”驶入浦贺湾，要求日本开港，幕府次年被迫让步。

title: From the Meiji Restoration to defeat
summary: Japan remakes itself as a modern industrial power, builds an empire through war, and loses it all in 1945.
summary_zh: 日本把自己改造成近代工业强国，通过战争建立殖民帝国，最终在1945年失去一切。

steps.text: 1867: under pressure from Satsuma and Chōshū, the last shōgun, Tokugawa Yoshinobu, hands power back to the emperor.
steps.text_zh: 1867年，在萨摩、长州的压力下，末代将军德川庆喜奉还大政于天皇。

steps.text: 1868: the new imperial government defeats shogunate forces at Toba-Fushimi. Edo is renamed Tokyo and becomes the capital.
steps.text_zh: 1868年，新政府军在鸟羽伏见击败幕府军，江户随后改名东京，成为新的首都。

steps.text: 1871: the domains are abolished and replaced by prefectures. A centralised state, a conscript army and national schools follow.
steps.text_zh: 1871年，日本废藩置县，随后建立了中央集权的国家、征兵制军队和全国性的学校制度。

steps.text: 1877: Saigō Takamori leads the samurai of Satsuma in a last revolt. The new conscript army crushes it.
steps.text_zh: 1877年，西乡隆盛率萨摩武士发动最后的叛乱，被新式征兵军队镇压。

steps.text: 1889: the Meiji Constitution creates an elected Diet under a sovereign emperor.
steps.text_zh: 1889年，《大日本帝国宪法》颁布，在天皇主权下设立民选的帝国议会。

steps.text: 1895: after defeating Qing China, Japan takes Taiwan in the Treaty of Shimonoseki.
steps.text_zh: 1895年，日本在甲午战争中战胜清朝，通过《马关条约》割占台湾。

steps.text: 1905: Admiral Tōgō destroys the Russian fleet at Tsushima. Japan becomes the first Asian power in modern times to defeat a European one.
steps.text_zh: 1905年，东乡平八郎在对马海战中全歼俄国舰队，日本成为近代第一个战胜欧洲强国的亚洲国家。

steps.text: 1931: Japanese officers blow up a railway near Mukden and use it as a pretext to seize Manchuria.
steps.text_zh: 1931年，日本关东军在沈阳附近炸毁铁路，以此为借口侵占中国东北。

steps.text: 1941: Japan attacks the US fleet at Pearl Harbor and sweeps across Southeast Asia, opening the Pacific War.
steps.text_zh: 1941年，日本偷袭珍珠港的美国舰队，并横扫东南亚，太平洋战争爆发。

steps.text: 1945: atomic bombs destroy Hiroshima and Nagasaki. On 15 August the emperor announces Japan's surrender.
steps.text_zh: 1945年，原子弹摧毁广岛和长崎，8月15日天皇宣布日本投降。

title: South Korea: from ruins to democracy
summary: After the Korean War, South Korea passes through student revolt, military rule and a fast industrial boom, then wins democracy and hosts the world.
summary_zh: 朝鲜战争之后，韩国经历学生革命、军人统治和高速工业化，最终赢得民主，走向世界舞台。

steps.text: 1960: Students in Seoul rise against a rigged election. The April Revolution forces President Syngman Rhee to resign after twelve years in power.
steps.text_zh: 1960年，汉城学生抗议选举舞弊，四一九革命迫使执政十二年的李承晚总统下台。

steps.text: 1961: Major General Park Chung-hee seizes power in the May 16 coup. He will rule South Korea for eighteen years.
steps.text_zh: 1961年，朴正熙少将发动五一六军事政变夺取政权，此后统治韩国长达十八年。

steps.text: 1962: The first five-year plan launches export-led industry, and Ulsan grows from a fishing town into a centre of refining, shipbuilding and cars. This is the start of the Miracle on the Han River.
steps.text_zh: 1962年，第一个五年经济计划启动出口导向的工业化，蔚山从渔村发展为炼油、造船和汽车工业中心，“汉江奇迹”由此开始。

steps.text: 1970: Park launches the Saemaul (New Village) Movement, in which villagers build roads, bridges and new roofs with state cement and steel.
steps.text_zh: 1970年，朴正熙发起新村运动，农民利用政府提供的水泥和钢材修路架桥、翻新房屋。

steps.text: 1979: Park is shot dead at a dinner by his own intelligence chief, Kim Jae-gyu, ending his long rule.
steps.text_zh: 1979年，朴正熙在晚宴上被中央情报部部长金载圭枪杀，长期统治就此结束。

steps.text: 1980: General Chun Doo-hwan extends martial law, and the people of Gwangju rise against it. Troops crush the uprising and hundreds die.
steps.text_zh: 1980年，全斗焕将军扩大戒严，光州市民奋起反抗，军队血腥镇压，数百人遇难。

steps.text: 1987: Weeks of nationwide protest in the June Democratic Struggle force the government to accept direct presidential elections.
steps.text_zh: 1987年，席卷全国的六月民主运动迫使政府接受总统直选，韩国走上民主化道路。

steps.text: 1988: Seoul hosts the Summer Olympics, showing the world a country transformed within one generation.
steps.text_zh: 1988年，汉城举办夏季奥运会，向世界展示了一代人之间脱胎换骨的韩国。

steps.text: 2024: President Yoon Suk Yeol declares martial law; the National Assembly votes it down within hours. He is impeached, and removed from office in 2025.
steps.text_zh: 2024年，尹锡悦总统宣布紧急戒严，国会在数小时内表决解除。尹锡悦随后遭弹劾，并于2025年被罢免。

title: North Korea and the divided peninsula
summary: From the 1953 armistice, North Korea builds a closed state around Juche and the Kim family, while the two Koreas swing between hostility and talks.
summary_zh: 1953年停战后，朝鲜围绕主体思想和金氏家族建立起封闭的国家，南北关系则在对立与对话之间反复摇摆。

steps.text: 1953: The armistice signed at Panmunjom stops the Korean War and creates the Demilitarized Zone. No peace treaty has ever followed.
steps.text_zh: 1953年，交战双方在板门店签订停战协定，朝鲜战争停火并划定非军事区，此后始终没有签订和平条约。

steps.text: 1955: In Pyongyang, Kim Il-sung first speaks of Juche, self-reliance, which grows into the official ideology of North Korea.
steps.text_zh: 1955年，金日成在平壤首次提出“主体”思想，强调自主自立，后来成为朝鲜的官方指导思想。

steps.text: 1972: Seoul and Pyongyang issue the July 4 Joint Statement, agreeing that unification should be independent and peaceful. The thaw soon fades.
steps.text_zh: 1972年，汉城与平壤发表《七四南北共同声明》，同意以自主、和平的方式实现统一，但缓和很快消退。

steps.text: 1994: Kim Il-sung dies and his son Kim Jong-il takes over. Floods and the loss of Soviet aid bring a famine that kills hundreds of thousands.
steps.text_zh: 1994年，金日成逝世，其子金正日接掌权力。洪灾和苏联援助的断绝引发大饥荒，数十万人死亡。

steps.text: 2000: South Korean President Kim Dae-jung flies to Pyongyang for the first inter-Korean summit, the high point of his Sunshine Policy.
steps.text_zh: 2000年，韩国总统金大中飞赴平壤，与金正日举行首次南北首脑会谈，这是其阳光政策的高峰。

steps.text: 2004: The Kaesong Industrial Complex opens just north of the border, where southern firms employ northern workers. It runs until 2016.
steps.text_zh: 2004年，开城工业园区在军事分界线北侧投产，韩国企业雇用朝鲜工人生产，园区一直运营到2016年。

steps.text: 2006: North Korea sets off its first underground nuclear test at Punggye-ri, and the UN Security Council imposes sanctions.
steps.text_zh: 2006年，朝鲜在丰溪里进行首次地下核试验，联合国安理会随即对其实施制裁。

steps.text: 2011: Kim Jong-il dies and his young son Kim Jong-un becomes leader, the third generation of the family to rule.
steps.text_zh: 2011年，金正日去世，其子金正恩接任最高领导人，成为金氏家族的第三代统治者。

steps.text: 2018: Moon Jae-in and Kim Jong-un meet at Panmunjom and pledge peace and denuclearisation, but talks with the United States stall the next year.
steps.text_zh: 2018年，文在寅与金正恩在板门店会晤，发表宣言承诺推进半岛和平与无核化，但次年朝美谈判陷入僵局。

title: Postwar Japan: occupation to boom
title_zh: 战后日本：从占领到腾飞
summary: Defeated in 1945, Japan is remade under American occupation, adopts a pacifist constitution and grows into the world's second largest economy.
summary_zh: 1945年战败后，日本在美军占领下进行改造，制定和平宪法，并发展为世界第二大经济体。

steps.text: 1945: Allied forces under General MacArthur occupy Japan. They disband the army, break up the zaibatsu and give land to tenant farmers.
steps.text_zh: 1945年，麦克阿瑟率领的盟军占领日本，解散军队，解散财阀，并把土地分给佃农。

steps.text: 1947: The new constitution takes effect. The emperor becomes a symbol of the nation, and Article 9 renounces war.
steps.text_zh: 1947年，日本国宪法施行，天皇成为国家的象征，第九条宣布放弃战争。

steps.text: 1951: In San Francisco, Japan signs a peace treaty with 48 nations and a security treaty with the United States; it regains sovereignty in 1952.
steps.text_zh: 1951年，日本在旧金山与48个国家签订和约，同时与美国签订安保条约，次年恢复主权。

steps.text: 1955: Rapid growth begins, near 10 percent a year. By 1968 Japan is the second largest economy in the capitalist world.
steps.text_zh: 1955年，日本进入高速增长期，经济年均增长约10%，到1968年成为资本主义世界第二大经济体。

steps.text: 1956: Minamata disease is identified, caused by mercury from a chemical plant, the grimmest cost of the boom.
steps.text_zh: 1956年，熊本县确认水俣病，病因是化工厂排放的汞污染，这是经济高速增长最惨痛的代价。

steps.text: 1964: Tokyo hosts Asia's first Olympics, and days earlier the Tokaido Shinkansen, the world's first high speed railway, opens to Osaka.
steps.text_zh: 1964年，东京举办亚洲首次奥运会，开幕前几天，世界第一条高速铁路东海道新干线通车至大阪。

steps.text: 1968: Kawabata Yasunari, author of Snow Country, becomes the first Japanese writer to win the Nobel Prize in Literature.
steps.text_zh: 1968年，《雪国》作者川端康成获得诺贝尔文学奖，是第一位获此奖的日本作家。

steps.text: 1972: The United States returns Okinawa to Japan, though large American bases stay on the island.
steps.text_zh: 1972年，美国将冲绳的施政权交还日本，但大量美军基地仍保留在岛上。

steps.text: 1985: At the Plaza Hotel in New York, five finance ministers agree to weaken the dollar. The yen soars, and cheap money at home feeds a bubble in shares and land.
steps.text_zh: 1985年，五国财长在纽约广场饭店达成协议，促使美元贬值。日元大幅升值，国内的宽松政策催生了股市和地产泡沫。

steps.text: 1989: Emperor Hirohito dies after 62 years on the throne, and the Showa era closes as the bubble nears its peak.
steps.text_zh: 1989年，在位62年的裕仁天皇去世，昭和时代在泡沫经济接近顶峰时落幕。

title: Heisei and Reiwa: Japan after the bubble
title_zh: 平成与令和：泡沫之后的日本
summary: The bubble bursts, disasters strike and governments try reform after reform, as Japan moves from the Heisei era into Reiwa.
summary_zh: 泡沫破裂，灾害接踵而至，历届政府不断尝试改革，日本从平成时代走入令和时代。

steps.text: 1991: After peaking at the end of 1989, share and land prices collapse. Banks are left with bad loans, and the Lost Decade begins.
steps.text_zh: 1991年，股价和地价在1989年底见顶后暴跌，银行背负大量坏账，日本进入“失去的十年”。

steps.text: 1995: The Great Hanshin earthquake devastates Kobe and kills more than 6,400 people, exposing a slow government response.
steps.text_zh: 1995年，阪神大地震重创神户，6400多人死亡，暴露出政府救灾反应迟缓。

steps.text: 1995: Members of the Aum Shinrikyo cult release sarin gas on Tokyo subway trains, killing 14 and injuring thousands.
steps.text_zh: 1995年，奥姆真理教成员在东京地铁列车上释放沙林毒气，造成14人死亡、数千人受伤。

steps.text: 2001: Koizumi Junichiro becomes prime minister and pushes reforms such as postal privatisation; his visits to the Yasukuni Shrine strain ties with China and South Korea.
steps.text_zh: 2001年，小泉纯一郎出任首相，推行邮政民营化等结构改革，但他参拜靖国神社，使日本与中韩两国关系紧张。

steps.text: 2011: On 11 March a magnitude 9.0 earthquake strikes off Tohoku, and its tsunami leaves about 18,000 dead or missing.
steps.text_zh: 2011年3月11日，东北近海发生9.0级地震，引发的海啸造成约1.8万人死亡或失踪。

steps.text: 2011: The tsunami knocks out cooling at the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear plant; three reactors melt down and more than 100,000 people are evacuated.
steps.text_zh: 2011年，海啸导致福岛第一核电站冷却系统失灵，三座反应堆堆芯熔毁，十多万居民被迫撤离。

steps.text: 2012: Abe Shinzo returns as prime minister with Abenomics, three arrows of monetary easing, spending and reform aimed at ending deflation.
steps.text_zh: 2012年，安倍晋三再度出任首相，推出货币宽松、财政刺激和结构改革“三支箭”，力图摆脱通货紧缩。

steps.text: 2019: Emperor Akihito abdicates, the first living abdication in two centuries. Naruhito takes the throne and the Reiwa era begins.
steps.text_zh: 2019年，明仁天皇退位，这是两百年来首次天皇生前退位。德仁天皇即位，年号改为令和。

steps.text: 2022: Former prime minister Abe Shinzo is shot dead while giving a campaign speech in Nara.
steps.text_zh: 2022年，前首相安倍晋三在奈良街头发表竞选演讲时遭枪击身亡。

steps.text: 2025: Takaichi Sanae becomes Japan's first woman prime minister after winning the leadership of the Liberal Democratic Party.
steps.text_zh: 2025年，高市早苗当选自民党总裁后就任首相，成为日本历史上第一位女性首相。

title: Southeast Asia in the ASEAN era
summary: From the founding of ASEAN through war in Indochina, market reform, people power and financial crisis, Southeast Asia becomes one of the world's fastest growing regions.
summary_zh: 从东盟成立，到印度支那战火、市场改革、人民力量和金融危机，东南亚成长为世界上增长最快的地区之一。

steps.text: 1967: Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand sign the Bangkok Declaration and found ASEAN.
steps.text_zh: 1967年，印度尼西亚、马来西亚、菲律宾、新加坡和泰国签署《曼谷宣言》，成立东南亚国家联盟。

steps.text: 1976: North and South are formally reunited as the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, and Saigon is renamed Ho Chi Minh City.
steps.text_zh: 1976年，越南南北正式统一为越南社会主义共和国，西贡改名胡志明市。

steps.text: 1979: Vietnamese troops take Phnom Penh and drive out the Khmer Rouge, then occupy Cambodia for ten years.
steps.text_zh: 1979年，越南军队攻占金边，推翻红色高棉，此后占领柬埔寨长达十年。

steps.text: 1986: Millions gather peacefully on EDSA in Manila; Ferdinand Marcos flees and Corazon Aquino becomes president.
steps.text_zh: 1986年，数百万民众在马尼拉乙沙大道和平示威，马科斯出逃，科拉松·阿基诺就任总统。

steps.text: 1986: Vietnam's Communist Party adopts Doi Moi, opening the economy to markets and foreign investment.
steps.text_zh: 1986年，越南共产党六大决定实行革新开放，引入市场经济和外国投资。

steps.text: 1997: The Thai baht collapses and a financial crisis sweeps through Indonesia, Malaysia and South Korea.
steps.text_zh: 1997年，泰铢崩溃，金融危机迅速蔓延到印度尼西亚、马来西亚和韩国。

steps.text: 1998: Riots and student protests force Suharto to resign after 32 years, and Indonesia turns to democratic reform.
steps.text_zh: 1998年，骚乱和学生运动迫使执政32年的苏哈托辞职，印度尼西亚进入民主改革时期。

steps.text: 2002: After a UN-run referendum and transition, Timor-Leste becomes the first new country of the 21st century.
steps.text_zh: 2002年，经联合国主持的公投和过渡管理，东帝汶正式独立，成为21世纪第一个新国家。

steps.text: 2020: The ten ASEAN states sign RCEP with China, Japan, South Korea, Australia and New Zealand, the largest free trade area in the world.
steps.text_zh: 2020年，东盟十国与中国、日本、韩国、澳大利亚和新西兰签署《区域全面经济伙伴关系协定》，形成世界最大的自由贸易区。

steps.text: 2021: Myanmar's army detains Aung San Suu Kyi and seizes power, setting off mass protests and civil war.
steps.text_zh: 2021年，缅甸军方扣押昂山素季等领导人夺取政权，引发大规模抗议和内战。

title: Partition to Bangladesh
title_zh: 从印巴分治到孟加拉国独立
summary: Independence splits British India into India and Pakistan; the new states fight over Kashmir, build their republics, and in 1971 Bangladesh is born.
summary_zh: 独立使英属印度分为印度和巴基斯坦，两国为克什米尔而战，各自建设国家，1971年孟加拉国诞生。

steps.text: 1947: British India becomes independent as two states, India and Pakistan. About 15 million people flee across the new borders amid mass killing.
steps.text_zh: 1947年，英属印度分为印度和巴基斯坦两个国家独立，约一千五百万人越过新边界逃难，伴随大规模屠杀。

steps.text: 1947: Tribal fighters from Pakistan invade Kashmir, its maharaja accedes to India, and the first India Pakistan war leaves the valley divided by a ceasefire line.
steps.text_zh: 1947年，来自巴基斯坦的部落武装进入克什米尔，土邦王公宣布加入印度，第一次印巴战争后克什米尔沿停火线分治。

steps.text: 1948: Mahatma Gandhi is shot dead in New Delhi by the Hindu nationalist Nathuram Godse.
steps.text_zh: 1948年，圣雄甘地在新德里被印度教民族主义者戈德塞枪杀身亡。

steps.text: 1948: Ceylon gains independence peacefully as a dominion; it will take the name Sri Lanka in 1972.
steps.text_zh: 1948年，锡兰和平独立，成为自治领，1972年改国名为斯里兰卡。

steps.text: 1950: India's constitution, drafted under B. R. Ambedkar, takes effect. India becomes a republic and abolishes untouchability.
steps.text_zh: 1950年，以安贝德卡尔为首起草的印度宪法生效，印度成为共和国，并宣布废除“不可接触”制度。

steps.text: 1952: In Dhaka, police fire on students demanding Bengali as a state language of Pakistan, the seed of Bengali nationalism.
steps.text_zh: 1952年，达卡学生要求将孟加拉语定为巴基斯坦国语，遭警察开枪镇压，这成为孟加拉民族主义的起点。

steps.text: 1962: A border dispute with China flares into a short war in the Himalayas; Chinese forces advance, then declare a ceasefire and pull back.
steps.text_zh: 1962年，中印边界争端演变为喜马拉雅山区的短暂战争，中国军队推进后宣布停火并主动后撤。

steps.text: 1965: Fighting over Kashmir spreads to Punjab near Lahore. Talks at Tashkent in 1966 restore the old lines.
steps.text_zh: 1965年，克什米尔冲突扩大到拉合尔附近的旁遮普前线，次年两国在塔什干谈判，恢复战前界线。

steps.text: 1966: The Green Revolution begins in Punjab with high-yield wheat, irrigation and fertiliser, and India soon feeds itself.
steps.text_zh: 1966年，绿色革命在旁遮普起步，推广高产小麦、灌溉和化肥，印度很快实现粮食自给。

steps.text: 1971: East Pakistan rises against rule from the west. India intervenes, Pakistan's army surrenders in Dhaka, and Bangladesh is born.
steps.text_zh: 1971年，东巴基斯坦反抗西巴统治，印度出兵干预，巴军在达卡投降，孟加拉国诞生。

title: South Asia since the 1970s
summary: Nuclear tests, emergency rule, civil war in Sri Lanka, economic opening and a moon landing: the subcontinent's last half century.
summary_zh: 核试验、紧急状态、斯里兰卡内战、经济开放与登月，这是南亚次大陆最近半个世纪的历程。

steps.text: 1974: India tests its first nuclear device at Pokhran in the Rajasthan desert, code named Smiling Buddha.
steps.text_zh: 1974年，印度在拉贾斯坦沙漠的博格伦进行首次核试验，代号“微笑的佛陀”。

steps.text: 1975: Prime Minister Indira Gandhi declares a state of Emergency, jailing opponents and censoring the press until she loses the 1977 election.
steps.text_zh: 1975年，总理英迪拉·甘地宣布紧急状态，逮捕反对派并审查新闻，直到1977年大选失利。

steps.text: 1983: After the Black July riots, the Tamil Tigers go to war with Sri Lanka's government for a Tamil state in the north and east.
steps.text_zh: 1983年，“黑色七月”骚乱之后，泰米尔猛虎组织与斯里兰卡政府军开战，谋求在北部和东部建立泰米尔国家。

steps.text: 1984: The army storms the Golden Temple at Amritsar to remove Sikh militants; months later Indira Gandhi is killed by her Sikh bodyguards.
steps.text_zh: 1984年，印军攻入阿姆利则金庙清剿锡克武装，数月后英迪拉·甘地被其锡克族卫兵刺杀。

steps.text: 1991: Facing a currency crisis, Narasimha Rao and his finance minister Manmohan Singh scrap the licence raj and open India to trade and investment.
steps.text_zh: 1991年，面对外汇危机，拉奥政府和财长曼莫汉·辛格取消许可证制度，降低关税，向外资开放。

steps.text: 1998: India carries out five nuclear tests at Pokhran and Pakistan answers at Chagai; both become declared nuclear powers.
steps.text_zh: 1998年，印度在博格伦进行五次核试验，巴基斯坦随即在查盖进行核试验，两国都成为公开拥核国家。

steps.text: 2008: After a ten-year Maoist insurgency and mass protests, Nepal's assembly abolishes the Shah monarchy and declares a republic.
steps.text_zh: 2008年，经过十年毛派武装斗争和大规模抗议，尼泊尔制宪会议废除沙阿王朝，宣布成立共和国。

steps.text: 2009: Sri Lanka's army defeats the Tamil Tigers in the northeast, ending a 26-year civil war at a heavy cost in civilian lives.
steps.text_zh: 2009年，斯里兰卡政府军在东北部击败泰米尔猛虎组织，持续26年的内战结束，平民伤亡惨重。

steps.text: 2023: Chandrayaan-3, launched from Sriharikota, lands near the Moon's south pole; India is the fourth country to land on the Moon.
steps.text_zh: 2023年，从斯里赫里戈达发射的月船三号在月球南极附近着陆，印度成为第四个实现登月的国家。

steps.text: 2024: Student protests against job quotas grow into a mass uprising in Bangladesh, and Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina resigns and flees to India.
steps.text_zh: 2024年，孟加拉国学生反对公职配额的抗议演变为大规模起义，总理谢赫·哈西娜辞职并出逃印度。
